title: Affora: A Design System for Agent-Friendly Interfaces
title_cn: Affora：面向 agent 友好界面的设计系统
abstract: Computer-use agents increasingly operate software designed for people, but interfaces often leave actions or task state unclear to machine readers. We present Affora, a design system that supports both readers while preserving visual freedom and familiar human workflows. Three controlled studies examine component implementations, visual variation, and interaction-design principles. Their findings inform guidance from individual components to complete sites, supported by reusable implementations and executable checks. Agent performance depends on the interaction meaning available through its interface representation; substantial visual variation remains possible when that meaning is preserved. Evaluation on independently authored interfaces shows gains where Affora addresses existing deficits, but limited effects where those deficits are absent or outside its coverage. A workflow case provides preliminary evidence of reduced interaction cost. Affora connects user experience and agent experience through a shared interface rather than a separate agent-only surface.
abstract_cn: Computer-use agents 越来越多地操作为人类设计的软件，但界面往往让机器阅读者难以判断动作或任务状态。我们提出 Affora，一个同时服务于两类读者的设计系统，且保留视觉自由度和人类熟悉的工作流。三项受控研究分别考察组件实现、视觉变体以及交互设计原则。其发现为从单个组件到完整站点的指导提供依据，并由可复用的实现与可执行的检查加以支撑。Agent 的性能取决于其能通过界面表征获取的交互含义；在含义得以保留的前提下，视觉上仍可有大量变化。在独立编写的界面上的评估显示：Affora 能在其针对的既有缺陷上带来提升，但当这些缺陷不存在或超出其覆盖范围时，效果有限。一个工作流案例提供了交互成本降低的初步证据。Affora 通过共享界面而非独立的 agent 专用界面，将用户体验与 agent 体验联结起来。
summary_cn: 针对 computer-use agent 操作人类界面时动作与状态不清的问题，提出 Affora 设计系统，通过三项受控研究给出组件到站点级指导，证明只要保留交互语义视觉可自由变化，且在已存在缺陷的界面上能显著提升 agent 表现。
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures
objective_summary: 提出 Affora 设计系统,通过三项受控研究考察组件实现、视觉变化与交互设计原则,给出从组件到完整站点的指南并附可复用实现与可执行检查。评估在独立编写界面上显示,当 Affora 覆盖已有缺陷时智能体表现有提升,而在缺陷缺失或超出覆盖范围处提升有限。
evidence_note: 三项受控研究加独立界面评估与一个工作流案例,规模与统计报告细节摘要中未明确。
novelty_note: 提出面向人与智能体共享界面的设计系统,而非另建 agent-only 表层,视角较新。
scope: 结论限于计算机使用型智能体在 Affora 覆盖的 Web 界面组件与交互模式下的可读性与执行表现。
limitations: 当界面缺陷不在 Affora 覆盖范围时收益有限,工作流成本证据仅为初步案例。

title: Code Consistency Preference Optimization Verification for Language Model Alignment
title_cn: 面向语言模型对齐的代码一致性偏好优化验证
abstract: Execution-based verification enhances large language models' mathematical reasoning through computational soundness and dependency-aware filtering. However, prior preference optimization methods relying on Bradley-Terry reward models fail to capture the logical dependencies and execution consistency needed for scientific tasks. We propose a method that generates computationally sound solutions with dependency graphs for execution-consistent preference optimization. We first build a scientific reasoning dataset using UltraFeedback prompts, model generations, verification, and consistency results. Then we extract reasoning step expressions, prerequisites, and derivability relationships to construct dependency graphs and compute execution consistency scores. These scores are appended to each step, creating paired training data. Fine-tuning Llama-3-8B and DeepSeekMath-7B yields significant gains: +17.0% on MATH and +15.1% on GSM8K. Extending our Scientific Feasibility Control framework achieves 50.1% accuracy on PhyX multimodal physics reasoning, surpassing DeepSeek-R1 (49.8%) and OpenAI o3-mini (48.2%), with 91.7% scientific validity coverage at alpha=0.10 and 73% fewer scientific law violations, resulting in the CCPO model family.
abstract_cn: 基于执行的验证通过计算稳健性和依赖感知过滤增强了大语言模型的数学推理能力。然而，先前依赖 Bradley-Terry 奖励模型的偏好优化方法无法捕捉科学任务所需的逻辑依赖和执行一致性。我们提出一种方法，生成计算上稳健的解并附带依赖图，用于执行一致的偏好优化。我们首先利用 UltraFeedback 提示、模型生成、验证与一致性结果构建了一个科学推理数据集。然后我们抽取推理步骤表达式、前提条件与可导出关系，构造依赖图并计算执行一致性分数。这些分数附加到每一步上，形成成对的训练数据。对 Llama-3-8B 与 DeepSeekMath-7B 进行微调带来显著提升：MATH 上 +17.0%，GSM8K 上 +15.1%。将我们的 Scientific Feasibility Control 框架扩展后，在 PhyX 多模态物理推理上达到 50.1% 的准确率，超越 DeepSeek-R1（49.8%）与 OpenAI o3-mini（48.2%），在 alpha=0.10 下取得 91.7% 的科学有效性覆盖率，科学定律违反次数减少 73%，最终形成 CCPO 模型系列。
summary_cn: 提出基于依赖图与执行一致性分数的偏好优化方法 CCPO，在 Llama-3-8B 和 DeepSeekMath-7B 上分别取得 MATH +17.0%、GSM8K +15.1%；扩展到 PhyX 多模态物理推理达 50.1%，超越 DeepSeek-R1 (49.8%) 与 OpenAI o3-mini (48.2%)。
comment: 24 pages
objective_summary: 提出结合依赖图与执行一致性打分的偏好优化方法 CCPO,构建含验证与一致性结果的科学推理数据集并微调 Llama-3-8B、DeepSeekMath-7B。MATH 与 GSM8K 分别提升 17.0% 与 15.1%,PhyX 多模态物理推理达 50.1%,超过 DeepSeek-R1 的 49.8% 与 o3-mini 的 48.2%,α=0.10 下科学有效覆盖 91.7%、科学定律违反减少 73%。
evidence_note: 跨 MATH/GSM8K/PhyX 三基准,两个基座对照,并对比 R1 与 o3-mini,提供覆盖率指标。
novelty_note: 在 Bradley-Terry 偏好优化上加入依赖图与执行一致性,思路属已有 execution-aware 方向的实质扩展。
scope: 结论限于 Llama-3-8B 与 DeepSeekMath-7B 在 MATH、GSM8K 与 PhyX 三个基准的数学与物理推理任务。
limitations: 依赖 UltraFeedback 提示与自动一致性打分,α=0.10 覆盖阈值与依赖图抽取质量影响可推广性。

title: A Benchmark Suite and Ground-Truth Methodology for Formal Verification of IEC 61131-3 Ladder Diagram Programs
title_cn: 针对 IEC 61131-3 梯形图程序形式化验证的基准套件与真值方法论
abstract: We present the first benchmark suite for formal verification of Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) programs that combines controlled ground truth with coverage of both textual (Structured Text, ST) and graphical (Ladder Diagram, LD) IEC 61131-3 encodings. Despite growing support for tools, the field lacks standard evaluation benchmarks: existing corpora omit formal properties or graphical dialects, and private program sets preclude reproducible measurement of progress. Our suite comprises 50 programs in 83 variants across ten industrial domains, provided in PLCopen Extensible Markup Language (XML) and ST, each paired with a formal property, machine-checkable expected verdict, and violation witness in the Software Verification Competition (SV-COMP) format. The central methodological contribution is a tripartite ground-truth discipline - verdicts are established by construction, fault injection, or audited cross-tool consensus - motivated by a concrete failure mode where the obvious safety property misclassifies all attacks from two public logic-bomb corpora as safe due to invisible non-termination. Reference verdicts are obtained with the Efficient SMT-Based Context-Bounded Model Checker (ESBMC) v8.4 from source: all 25 graphical benchmarks execute, and 43 of 45 accepted variants match recorded verdicts. On the finite-state fragment (21 benchmarks), nuXmv - a model checker with unrelated decision procedures - agrees on all 24 interlock variants and resolves two benchmarks ESBMC-PLC leaves unknown, confirming tool-neutral ground truth and discriminative power. Porting exposes format and semantics fragmentation: front-ends accept different serializations, and timer semantics vary across tools - phenomena the suite is designed to reveal. The corpus, schema, validator, and recheck harness are released as open artifacts.
abstract_cn: 我们提出首个可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）程序形式化验证基准套件，兼具受控真值以及对 IEC 61131-3 中文本（Structured Text, ST）与图形（Ladder Diagram, LD）两种编码的覆盖。尽管工具支持日益增强，该领域仍缺乏标准评测基准：现有语料要么忽略形式化属性，要么忽略图形化方言，且私有程序集使得无法可复现地度量进展。本套件涵盖十个工业领域，包含 50 个程序共 83 个变体，以 PLCopen 可扩展标记语言（XML）与 ST 形式提供，每个都配有一个形式化属性、可机器检查的期望判决，以及采用 Software Verification Competition（SV-COMP）格式的违规见证。核心方法论贡献是一套三分的真值规范——判决通过构造、故障注入或经审计的跨工具共识来建立——其动机来自一种具体的失效模式：由于不可见的不终止，显然的安全属性会将两个公开逻辑炸弹语料库中的所有攻击都错判为安全。参考判决使用 Efficient SMT-Based Context-Bounded Model Checker（ESBMC）v8.4 从源码得到：全部 25 个图形化基准均能执行，且 45 个被接受的变体中有 43 个与记录判决一致。在有限状态片段（21 个基准）上，nuXmv——一款使用无关判定过程的模型检查器——在全部 24 个联锁变体上与之一致，并解决了两个 ESBMC-PLC 判为未知的基准，验证了真值的工具无关性与区分力。移植暴露了格式与语义碎片化：不同前端接受不同的序列化，计时器语义在各工具间存在差异——这些正是本套件旨在揭示的现象。语料、schema、验证器与复检 harness 已作为开放制品发布。
summary_cn: 首个覆盖 IEC 61131-3 文本（ST）与图形（LD）两种编码的 PLC 形式化验证基准，涵盖十个工业领域的 50 个程序 83 个变体；提出「构造/故障注入/审计跨工具共识」三分真值方法论，ESBMC v8.4 在 45 个变体中 43 个与记录判决一致，nuXmv 在 24 个联锁变体上完全一致。
comment: 11 pages
objective_summary: 发布首个覆盖 IEC 61131-3 结构化文本与梯形图的 PLC 形式化验证基准套件,含 10 个工业领域 50 程序 83 变体,采用构造/故障注入/审计跨工具共识三方 ground truth。ESBMC v8.4 使 25 个图形基准全部可执行,45 个受理变体中 43 个匹配预期;nuXmv 在 21 个有限状态基准的 24 个联锁变体上完全一致并解出 ESBMC-PLC 的 2 个未知。
evidence_note: 50 程序 83 变体、双工具交叉验证、SV-COMP 兼容格式,规模适中且有跨工具对照。
novelty_note: 首个同时含 ST 与 LD 图形方言、带构造式 ground truth 的 PLC 形式化验证基准。
scope: 结论限于 IEC 61131-3 ST/LD 程序在 ESBMC v8.4 与 nuXmv 下的可验证与一致性表现。
limitations: 仅 50 程序,依赖两款验证器,前端序列化与定时器语义不统一暴露移植难度。

title: Removing Noise or Introducing Bias? The Hidden Cost of MSR Filtering
title_cn: 去噪还是引入偏差？MSR 过滤的隐性代价
abstract: OSS platforms like GitHub serve as a primary data source for MSR research. As the platform is widely used by different users, spanning from student to developer, not all repositories are actual engineered projects. Therefore, to avoid such noise, researchers often apply several criteria, which may fundamentally change the sample demographics. To understand such biases, this study aims to uncover the hidden cost originating from these arbitrary thresholds or criteria. We analyzed 1.57 million repositories from the SEART platform and constructed several datasets from the thresholds often applied in MSR research. We identify the maintenance bias in these filtering processes, which masks the true abandonment (73.42%) realities of OSS projects. Also, these strategies favor some ecosystems and governance styles. Moreover, the sampling strategy also distorts the relationship between variables, suffering from relational biases. Therefore, to avoid such biases, the researchers should shift towards stratified sampling and refining the criteria for noise detection.
abstract_cn: GitHub 等 OSS 平台是 MSR 研究的主要数据来源。由于该平台被从学生到开发者的不同用户广泛使用，并非所有仓库都是真正的工程化项目。因此，为避免此类噪声，研究者通常会应用若干筛选标准，而这些标准可能从根本上改变样本的人口分布。为理解此类偏差，本研究旨在揭示这些任意阈值或标准所带来的隐性代价。我们分析了来自 SEART 平台的 157 万个仓库，并基于 MSR 研究中常用的阈值构建了若干数据集。我们识别出这些过滤过程中的维护偏差，它掩盖了 OSS 项目真实的废弃现实（73.42%）。此外，这些策略偏向某些生态系统与治理风格。而且，采样策略也扭曲了变量之间的关系，引发关系偏差。因此，为避免此类偏差，研究者应转向分层抽样并细化噪声检测标准。
summary_cn: 分析 SEART 上 157 万个仓库，发现常用的 MSR 过滤阈值会掩盖 73.42% 的真实 OSS 项目废弃率，并在生态与治理风格上引入维护偏差和关系偏差，建议改用分层抽样。
comment: 5 pages, 1 figures, 2 tables, 17 references
objective_summary: 该文基于 SEART 平台的 157 万仓库，构造多组按 MSR 常用阈值筛选的数据集，量化筛选带来的偏差。发现筛选掩盖了 OSS 项目 73.42% 的真实弃用率，并对生态与治理风格产生偏好，同时扭曲变量间关系。
evidence_note: 以 157 万仓库为基础比较多套阈值数据集，量化维护、生态与关系偏差，样本大。
novelty_note: 系统揭示 MSR 常用筛选阈值对样本人口学与变量关系的双重偏差与 73.42% 弃用率被掩盖。
scope: 结论限于 GitHub 上以 SEART 抽样的 157 万仓库及 MSR 常见阈值筛选策略。
limitations: 仅用 SEART 单一采样源,「真实弃用率」判定依赖其定义,统计检验细节不详。

title: ProgramDistill: From Interactive Web Apps to Verifiable Reference-Guided SWE Tasks
title_cn: ProgramDistill：从交互式 Web 应用到可验证的参考引导 SWE 任务
abstract: Coding agents are typically evaluated with desired behavior specified through issues or instructions. In practical web development, however, agents may need to infer behavior from working software and implement it in an incomplete application. We introduce ProgramDistill, a benchmark evaluating coding agents on features discovered through interaction with fully functional reference applications. We build ProgramDistill by factorizing applications into features of different granularities, each associated with replayable behaviors executable via its gold patch. Our pipeline, mine-craft-patch, discovers 1,975 replay-verified behaviors across 26 applications and constructs 4,063 tasks without human intervention. Across nine frontier coding agents, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 achieve 49.2% and 28.8% success on cumulative workflows in full-application reconstruction. In partial-application reconstruction, success falls from 100% to 64.0% and from 96% to 32% as restoration depth increases from 1 to 8. ProgramDistill thus provides a scalable benchmark with controlled difficulty for evaluating and diagnosing coding agents, and a natural basis for future curriculum-based training.
abstract_cn: 编码 agent 通常通过 issue 或指令中指定的期望行为进行评测。然而在实际的 Web 开发中，agent 可能需要从可运行软件中推断行为，并在一个不完整的应用中实现它。我们引入 ProgramDistill，这是一个评测编码 agent 在通过与完全可用参考应用交互中发现的特性上的基准。我们通过将应用分解为不同粒度的特性来构建 ProgramDistill，每个特性都与可通过其 gold patch 执行的可回放行为相关联。我们的流水线 mine-craft-patch 在 26 个应用中发现了 1975 个经回放验证的行为，并在无人工干预的情况下构造了 4063 个任务。在九个前沿编码 agent 上，GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude Opus 5 在完整应用重建的累积工作流上分别达到 49.2% 与 28.8% 的成功率。在部分应用重建中，随着恢复深度从 1 增加到 8，成功率从 100% 降至 64.0%、从 96% 降至 32%。因此，ProgramDistill 为评测和诊断编码 agent 提供了一个可扩展、难度可控的基准，也为未来基于课程的训练提供了自然的基础。
summary_cn: 提出 ProgramDistill 基准，通过 mine-craft-patch 流水线从 26 个应用自动挖掘 1975 个可回放行为、构造 4063 个任务；GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Opus 5 在完整重建的累积工作流上分别达 49.2% 与 28.8%，部分重建随恢复深度从 1 到 8 成功率从 100% 掉到 64.0%、96% 掉到 32%。
objective_summary: 提出 ProgramDistill 基准，通过 mine-craft-patch 流水线从 26 个功能完整应用中挖掘 1975 个可回放行为、自动构造 4063 个任务。评测 9 个前沿代码智能体，GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude Opus 5 在整应用重建累积工作流上分别取得 49.2% 与 28.8%，部分重建随恢复深度 1→8 从 100%/96% 降至 64.0%/32%。
evidence_note: 覆盖 26 应用、4063 任务、9 个前沿智能体，多难度设置对照，但未提统计检验。
novelty_note: 将「从可运行参考应用交互中发现行为」作为任务来源，区别于 issue/指令式基准。
scope: 结论限于 Web 应用重建任务与所选 9 个前沿代码智能体在自动构造任务上的成功率。
limitations: 任务全自动挖掘无人工校验，行为定义与难度分层的生态偏置可能影响外部效度。

title: Evaluating the Health of Open-Source Smart City Platforms
title_cn: 开源智慧城市平台的健康度评估
abstract: To manage the complexity of smart cities, a variety of smart city platforms (SCPs), both proprietary and open-source, have been proposed. Typically acting as middleware between IoT devices at a lower layer and smart services at a higher layer, these platforms simplify the management of smart cities by reifying a variety of requirements common to different municipalities. Open-source software (OSS) is typically free of charge, making open-source SCPs an attractive option for municipalities with smaller budgets that still wish to improve efficiency and quality of life for residents and visitors. Furthermore, using an OSS SCP promotes digital sovereignty, since municipalities can control where the data will reside and will be less prone to vendor lock-in. A lack of support for OSS hinders its adoption by municipalities' IT teams, often with scarce technical resources. An active (aka "healthy") ecosystem, including well-orchestrated developers and users, the availability of installation and user manuals, non-vulnerable and documented code, test batteries, and other artifacts, is an important decision factor before adopting an OSS SCP. In this paper, we evaluate different open-source SCPs using the concept of "OSS health", covering several of the aforementioned characteristics.
abstract_cn: 为管理智慧城市的复杂性，人们提出了多种智慧城市平台（SCP），既有专有的，也有开源的。这些平台通常作为下层 IoT 设备与上层智慧服务之间的中间件，通过物化不同市政部门所共同面临的各种需求来简化智慧城市的管理。开源软件（OSS）通常是免费的，这使开源 SCP 成为预算较小但仍希望改善居民和访客效率与生活质量的市政部门的一个有吸引力的选择。此外，使用 OSS SCP 有助于数字主权，因为市政部门可以控制数据的驻留位置，也不易被供应商锁定。缺乏对 OSS 的支持会阻碍其被技术资源稀缺的市政 IT 团队采用。一个活跃（即「健康」）的生态系统——包括良好协调的开发者与用户、可用的安装与用户手册、无漏洞且有文档的代码、测试套件以及其他工件——是采纳一个 OSS SCP 之前的重要决策因素。本文中，我们使用「OSS 健康度」概念评估了不同的开源 SCP，涵盖上述若干特性。
summary_cn: 以「OSS 健康度」概念评估多个开源智慧城市平台（SCP），从开发者协调、文档、代码漏洞、测试等维度衡量其被市政采纳的可行性。
comment: Accepted at the 12th IEEE International Smart Cities Conference (ISC2 2026)
objective_summary: 该文以「OSS 健康度」概念评估多款开源智慧城市平台，覆盖生态活跃度、安装与用户手册、代码漏洞与文档、测试用例等特征。文章讨论了这些属性对市政 IT 团队采纳决策的影响。
evidence_note: 摘要仅提及对若干开源 SCP 做健康度评估，未披露平台数量、指标量化方式或对照。
novelty_note: 将既有 OSS 健康度框架套用到智慧城市平台领域，方法论层面延续已有度量。
scope: 结论限于所选若干开源智慧城市平台在健康度诸维度上的对比，不涉及闭源方案。
limitations: 摘要未给出评估平台数量、量化指标与打分流程，可复现性与代表性存疑。

title: AIJon: Automated Generation of Annotations for Fuzzing
title_cn: AIJon：面向 fuzzing 的注解自动生成
abstract: Modern fuzzers use code coverage as feedback to guide their exploration which has proven to be an effective strategy for driving exploration. However, this strategy overlooks inputs that may be interesting to the target program even without uncovering new code paths. Fortunately, prior research has shown that annotations generated by human domain experts can provide additional feedback, guiding the fuzzer towards interesting parts of the program. In this paper, we replicate experiments presented in IJON and extend them to real-world vulnerability detection at scale. To mitigate the scalability challenge, imposed by the need for human domain expertise, we propose utilizing LLMs to automatically generate annotations. We demonstrate the applicability of LLMs for this purpose and observe that LLMs can generate annotations that perform comparably to human-generated annotations. Motivated by this finding, we design AIJON, a system that leverages LLMs to automatically generate IJON-style annotations. We evaluate AIJON on the Magma benchmark and surprisingly observe that annotation-based fuzzing does not perform strictly better than AFL++. We conduct several experiments to identify the cause of our results and identify key insights regarding the impact of annotations on fuzzing campaigns, including their effect on the energy distribution of the fuzzer. Notably, we observe that LLMs can generate annotations that achieve comparable results to human generated ones, thus opening the door for future research to perform further studies on the impact of annotations at scale.
abstract_cn: 现代模糊测试器使用代码覆盖率作为反馈来引导其探索，这一策略已被证明能有效驱动探索。然而，这一策略忽略了那些即便未发掘新代码路径、但对目标程序仍可能有趣的输入。所幸，先前研究表明由人类领域专家产生的注解可以提供额外反馈，引导 fuzzer 走向程序中有趣的部分。本文复现了 IJON 中的实验，并将其扩展到大规模的真实漏洞检测场景。为缓解由人类领域专业知识需求带来的可扩展性挑战，我们提出利用 LLM 自动生成注解。我们证明 LLM 可用于该目的，并观察到 LLM 生成的注解可以取得与人类注解相当的效果。受此发现驱动，我们设计了 AIJON，一个利用 LLM 自动生成 IJON 风格注解的系统。我们在 Magma 基准上评估 AIJON，出人意料地观察到基于注解的模糊测试并不严格优于 AFL++。我们进行了多项实验以定位造成该结果的原因，并识别出关于注解对模糊测试 campaign 影响的关键洞见，包括其对 fuzzer 能量分布的影响。值得注意的是，我们观察到 LLM 能生成与人类注解效果相当的注解，从而为未来在大规模层面上进一步研究注解影响的工作打开了大门。
summary_cn: 用 LLM 自动生成 IJON 风格注解替代人类专家，可在小规模上与人工注解效果相当；但在 Magma 上评估发现基于注解的 fuzzing 并未严格优于 AFL++，并揭示了注解对 fuzzer 能量分布的影响。
objective_summary: 复现 IJON 实验并扩展到大规模真实漏洞检测，提出 AIJon 使用 LLM 自动生成 IJON 风格标注。在 Magma 基准上意外发现基于标注的模糊测试并未严格优于 AFL++，进一步实验分析标注对能量分布等的影响。
evidence_note: 以 Magma 基准与 AFL++ 对照评估，含多项后续分析实验，但规模与运行次数未详述。
novelty_note: 用 LLM 自动生成 IJON 标注替代人类专家并给出负面结果，为该方向提供反例。
scope: 限于 Magma 基准上 IJON 风格 LLM 生成标注与 AFL++ 覆盖引导模糊测试的对比。
limitations: 结论受 Magma 基准与所用 LLM 影响，标注效果对目标程序与能量分配敏感，可推广性未充分验证。

title: From Component Snapshots to Lifecycle Traces: Agent-Based Software Composition Analysis
title_cn: 从组件快照到生命周期轨迹：基于 agent 的软件成分分析
abstract: Software supply-chain security requires accurate identification of third-party components and an understanding of how they evolve from development to execution. Existing software composition analysis (SCA) approaches examine manifests, build environments, release artifacts, containers, or runtime states, but typically produce only stage-specific views of software composition. As dependencies are resolved, removed, repackaged, and transformed across lifecycle stages, a single snapshot cannot capture both where a component originates and where it ultimately ends up. Combining snapshots from multiple stages still leaves their cross-stage relationships unresolved. We present SCA-Agent, an agent-based approach to lifecycle-aware SCA that reconstructs evidence-backed component lifecycle traces across Code, Build, Release, Deploy, and Runtime. SCA-Agent adaptively explores project-specific analysis paths, gathers stage-specific evidence, and correlates observations across stages to recover component identities, versions, introduction paths, propagation relationships, and final lifecycle states. We evaluate SCA-Agent on 105 real-world projects from the Java, JavaScript, and Python ecosystems. SCA-Agent achieves the highest component detection F1 across all lifecycle stages and ecosystems. For vulnerability exposure assessment, it reaches an F1 score of 96.69%, exceeding the best traditional SCA tool by 18.76 percentage points. These results show that lifecycle-aware SCA supports traceable component provenance and more accurate software supply-chain risk assessment.
abstract_cn: 软件供应链安全需要准确识别第三方组件，并理解它们如何从开发演进到执行。现有的软件成分分析（SCA）方法会检查清单、构建环境、发布产物、容器或运行时状态，但通常只能给出软件成分的阶段性视图。由于依赖会在生命周期各阶段被解析、移除、重新打包和转换，单一快照无法同时刻画组件的来源与最终归宿。将多个阶段的快照合并起来，其跨阶段关系仍然悬而未决。我们提出 SCA-Agent，一种基于 agent 的、面向生命周期的 SCA 方法，跨 Code、Build、Release、Deploy 与 Runtime 重建有证据支撑的组件生命周期轨迹。SCA-Agent 自适应地探索项目特定的分析路径，收集阶段性证据，并跨阶段关联观察，以恢复组件身份、版本、引入路径、传播关系及最终生命周期状态。我们在 Java、JavaScript 与 Python 生态的 105 个真实项目上评测了 SCA-Agent。SCA-Agent 在所有生命周期阶段和生态中都取得了最高的组件检测 F1。在漏洞暴露评估上，其 F1 分数达到 96.69%，比最强的传统 SCA 工具高出 18.76 个百分点。这些结果表明，面向生命周期的 SCA 支持可追溯的组件溯源和更准确的软件供应链风险评估。
summary_cn: 提出 SCA-Agent，跨 Code/Build/Release/Deploy/Runtime 五阶段用 agent 重建组件生命周期轨迹；在 105 个 Java/JS/Python 项目上组件检测 F1 全场最高，漏洞暴露评估 F1 达 96.69%，比最强传统 SCA 高 18.76 个百分点。
objective_summary: 提出 SCA-Agent，用代理式方法跨 Code、Build、Release、Deploy、Runtime 五个阶段重建组件生命周期轨迹并关联证据。在 Java、JavaScript、Python 生态 105 个真实项目上，各阶段组件检测 F1 最高，漏洞暴露评估 F1 达 96.69%，比最佳传统 SCA 高 18.76 个百分点。
evidence_note: 105 个真实项目跨三生态五阶段，与传统 SCA 对比，报告 F1 96.69% 与 18.76pp 提升。
novelty_note: 以代理式跨生命周期证据关联替代单快照 SCA，恢复组件传播路径的思路较新。
scope: 限于 Java、JavaScript、Python 三种生态 105 个项目上的组件识别与漏洞暴露评估。
limitations: 生命周期轨迹依赖各阶段可访问证据，未讨论闭源或复杂多阶段管线下的鲁棒性。

title: A Study on the Impact of Natural Language Differences in Prompts on Automatic Code Generation Using LLMs
title_cn: 关于提示自然语言差异对基于 LLM 的自动代码生成影响的研究
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance in automatic code generation tasks, thereby encouraging new research in this area. Although numerous studies have explored LLM-based code generation, the impact of the natural language in input prompts remains unexplored (language bias). This study aims to (1) quantify how the natural language of input prompts influences LLM-based code generation performance and (2) evaluate a mitigation strategy to reduce language bias in code generation. We assess code generation Accuracy on AtCoder, LeetCode, and BigCodeBench. To quantify the language bias on code generation, each problem is presented in English, Japanese, and Chinese. We use seven LLMs (GPT-4o, o3-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, Llama-3, Qwen2.5-Coder-14B, Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B, and GitHub Copilot) and assess their performance in terms of Accuracy (the number of problems for which generated code passes all test cases). We compare Accuracy before and after translation to evaluate the effectiveness of translation as a mitigation strategy. We observed that the natural language of problem statements affects LLM-based code generation performance. Specifically, the languages officially supported by each dataset achieved the highest median Accuracy. Also, translation improved Accuracy, but its effectiveness was not consistent across datasets and model types. We found that AtCoder contained a particularly high proportion of narrative-style problem statements and longer problem statements. Natural language significantly affects LLM code generation accuracy. Translation can mitigate language bias in some settings, but its effectiveness depends on the dataset and model type. Furthermore, the narrative aspects and context length of input prompts are important factors related to language bias and the effectiveness of translation as a mitigation strategy.
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）在自动代码生成任务中展现出卓越性能，从而催生了该领域的新研究。虽然已有大量研究探讨了基于 LLM 的代码生成，但输入提示中自然语言的影响仍未被探索（语言偏差）。本研究旨在：（1）量化输入提示的自然语言如何影响基于 LLM 的代码生成性能；（2）评估一种减少代码生成中语言偏差的缓解策略。我们在 AtCoder、LeetCode 与 BigCodeBench 上评测代码生成准确率。为量化代码生成上的语言偏差，每个问题以英文、日文和中文呈现。我们使用七个 LLM（GPT-4o、o3-mini、DeepSeek-V3.2、Llama-3、Qwen2.5-Coder-14B、Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B 与 GitHub Copilot），并以准确率（生成代码通过所有测试用例的问题数）来评估其性能。我们对比翻译前后的准确率以评估翻译作为缓解策略的有效性。我们观察到，问题陈述的自然语言会影响基于 LLM 的代码生成性能。具体地，每个数据集官方支持的语言取得最高的中位准确率。此外，翻译提高了准确率，但其效果在不同数据集与模型类型之间并不一致。我们发现 AtCoder 中包含特别高比例的叙事式问题陈述和更长的问题陈述。自然语言显著影响 LLM 代码生成准确率。翻译在某些情境下可以缓解语言偏差，但其效果取决于数据集与模型类型。此外，输入提示的叙事性方面与上下文长度是与语言偏差以及翻译作为缓解策略有效性相关的重要因素。
summary_cn: 在 AtCoder、LeetCode、BigCodeBench 上用英/日/中三语提示评估 7 个 LLM，发现各数据集官方支持语言取得最高中位准确率，翻译能部分缓解语言偏差但效果依数据集和模型而异，AtCoder 的叙事性长文本尤为关键。
comment: Accepted for publication in Empirical Software Engineering
objective_summary: 量化输入提示语言（英语、日语、中文）对 7 个 LLM 在 AtCoder、LeetCode、BigCodeBench 上代码生成正确率的影响，并评估翻译作为缓解策略。结果显示数据集官方支持语言中位正确率最高，翻译在部分设置下改善但不一致，叙事性与长度是重要因素。
evidence_note: 三基准、三语言、7 个 LLM 交叉，含翻译对照，报告中位正确率，无显式统计检验。
novelty_note: 系统量化提示自然语言对代码生成的偏差并检验翻译缓解，方向少见但方法直接。
scope: 限于英语、日语、中文三种语言在 AtCoder、LeetCode、BigCodeBench 与 7 个 LLM 的正确率。
limitations: 缓解策略效果依赖数据集与模型，未覆盖更多语言与提示改写方式，正确率仅用测试通过衡量。

title: A Study of the Reliability of Agentic AI-Generated Programs
title_cn: 对 Agentic AI 生成程序可靠性的研究
abstract: Agentic-AI based software development offers the promise of faster completion of the software, greater programmer efficiency, and more reliable code. The question is how can we verify these claims in an objective way? In this project, we attempted to answer this question based on three practices. First, we applied a typical best-practices agentic AI workflow for software development. Second, our target programs were ten well-known, release-quality human-written Linux utility programs so that we could compare the AI-generated code against a concrete ground truth. Third, we based our measure of reliability on a widely used testing technique, fuzz random testing. For this testing, we used both classic black box, generational testing and more modern coverage guided (gray box, mutational) testing using AFL++. We found that the AI-generated versions of the utility programs were typically as reliable - often more reliable - than the latest human-generated versions of these programs. While the AI-generated versions did have some failures, they were less common than the code from the standard repositories. Interestingly, the AI-generated code was less likely to have failures such as memory errors (such as buffer overflows) but more likely to have hangs such as infinite loops. In addition, we verified that generating robust and reliable software using agentic AI requires careful practice and human supervision. The quality of the code is highly dependent on the prompts and skills used, and how the human directing the process responds. We also demonstrated that using agentic AI workflow for software development (with its prompts and skills) can become a specification of the code that leads to cost-effective sustainability of the software.
abstract_cn: 基于 Agentic-AI 的软件开发承诺能更快完成软件、提高程序员效率并产出更可靠的代码。问题在于我们如何以客观方式验证这些说法？在本项目中，我们尝试基于三种做法回答这一问题。第一，我们采用了典型的最佳实践 agentic AI 软件开发工作流。第二，我们的目标程序是十个知名的、发布质量的人工编写 Linux 工具程序，以便将 AI 生成的代码与具体的 ground truth 进行对比。第三，我们基于广泛使用的测试技术——fuzz 随机测试——来度量可靠性。在这一测试中，我们同时使用了经典的黑盒生成式测试以及更现代的覆盖率引导（灰盒、变异）测试（使用 AFL++）。我们发现，AI 生成的工具程序版本通常与最新的人工版本同样可靠——甚至往往更可靠。虽然 AI 生成的版本确实存在一些失败，但比标准代码仓库中的代码更少见。有趣的是，AI 生成的代码更少出现内存错误（如缓冲区溢出）之类的失败，但更容易出现死循环之类的挂起。此外，我们验证了使用 agentic AI 生成健壮可靠的软件需要谨慎的实践与人工监督。代码质量高度依赖所使用的 prompts 与 skills，以及主导流程的人如何响应。我们还证明，使用 agentic AI 工作流进行软件开发（包括其 prompts 与 skills）可以成为代码的一种规范，从而带来软件成本效益上的可持续性。
summary_cn: 用黑盒生成式与 AFL++ 覆盖率引导 fuzz 对比 agentic AI 生成的 10 个 Linux 工具与最新人工版本，发现 AI 版本通常同样甚至更可靠，内存错误更少但更容易出现死循环等挂起。
objective_summary: 用典型 agentic AI 开发工作流生成 10 个 Linux 常用工具的实现，以经典生成式与 AFL++ 覆盖引导模糊测试评估可靠性。结果显示 AI 生成版本通常与最新人写版本相当甚至更可靠，内存错误更少但更易出现挂起如死循环。
evidence_note: 仅 10 个 Linux 工具，双种模糊测试对照，无正式统计检验，样本量偏小。
novelty_note: 用 fuzz 测试对 agentic AI 生成程序与真实工具进行对照评估，视角较新但方法常规。
scope: 结论限于 10 个 Linux 命令行工具在生成式与 AFL++ 模糊测试下的可靠性对比。
limitations: 样本仅 10 个工具，结果高度依赖提示与人类监督质量，可复现性受工作流细节影响。

title: Relationally Guided Use Case Modeling with LLMs
title_cn: 基于关系引导的 LLM 用例建模
abstract: Use case flows are important elements of use case modeling because they support downstream software engineering activities, including requirements analysis, architectural and detailed design, and test case generation. However, constructing them manually is costly and expertise-intensive, while existing automated approaches still struggle to preserve semantic consistency, control-flow logic, data-flow logic, and the intended system boundary, especially when identifying branch points and generating alternative flows. To address this problem, we propose FlowGen for complete use case flow construction. FlowGen uses LLM-based Semantic Information Processing (SIP) to extract semantic elements, constructs a Semantic Relational Graph (SRG) encoded by an enhanced R-GAT for basic flow generation (BFGen), and further supports branch point prediction through BPP and branch-conditioned alternative flow generation through AFGen. Evaluations on 13 public and 7 industrial datasets show that FlowGen consistently outperforms competitive baselines in all three core components. In particular, BFGen improves over the best baseline by 14% in Precision, 7-25% in Recall, 11-30% in F1, and 10-19% in AUC; BPP improves Precision by 30-110%, Recall by 33-91%, and F1 by 32-117%; AFGen improves Precision by 8-23%, F1 by 5-18%, and AUC by 0.6-2.5%. Moreover, we validate the effectiveness of the LLM-based SIP module and the attention preservation factor in BFGen, analyze the impact of requirement completeness on BFGen, and examine how different scopes of branch-related context affect AFGen.
abstract_cn: 用例流是用例建模的重要元素，因为它们支撑下游的软件工程活动，包括需求分析、架构与详细设计以及测试用例生成。然而，手工构建用例流成本高且依赖专业知识，而现有自动化方法在保持语义一致性、控制流逻辑、数据流逻辑与预期系统边界方面仍然吃力，尤其是在识别分支点与生成替代流时。为解决该问题，我们提出 FlowGen 用于完整的用例流构建。FlowGen 使用基于 LLM 的语义信息处理 (SIP) 提取语义元素，构建由增强 R-GAT 编码的语义关系图 (SRG) 用于基本流生成 (BFGen)，并通过 BPP 支持分支点预测、通过 AFGen 支持基于分支条件的替代流生成。在 13 个公开与 7 个工业数据集上的评测显示，FlowGen 在三个核心组件上均持续优于有竞争力的基线。具体而言，BFGen 相较最佳基线在 Precision 上提升 14%，Recall 提升 7-25%，F1 提升 11-30%，AUC 提升 10-19%；BPP 在 Precision 上提升 30-110%，Recall 提升 33-91%，F1 提升 32-117%；AFGen 在 Precision 上提升 8-23%，F1 提升 5-18%，AUC 提升 0.6-2.5%。此外，我们验证了基于 LLM 的 SIP 模块以及 BFGen 中注意力保留因子的有效性，分析了需求完备性对 BFGen 的影响，并考察了不同范围的分支相关上下文如何影响 AFGen。
summary_cn: FlowGen 用 LLM 语义抽取 + 增强 R-GAT 编码的语义关系图生成用例流，在 13 个公开与 7 个工业数据集上基本流 F1 提升 11-30%、分支点预测 F1 提升 32-117%、替代流 F1 提升 5-18%。
comment: 19 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables
objective_summary: 提出 FlowGen，利用 LLM 的语义信息处理与增强 R-GAT 构造语义关系图，用于用例基本流生成、分支点预测与备选流生成。在 13 个公开与 7 个工业数据集上，BFGen 相对最佳基线 Precision 提升 14%、F1 提升 11-30%，BPP F1 提升 32-117%，AFGen F1 提升 5-18%。
evidence_note: 20 个数据集（含 7 个工业）与多基线对比，报告 Precision/Recall/F1/AUC 提升范围。
novelty_note: 将 LLM 语义抽取与 R-GAT 关系图结合用于完整用例流构造与分支预测，思路较新。
scope: 限于用例流建模三个子任务，评估在 13 公开加 7 工业数据集与 R-GAT 架构下。
limitations: 依赖需求文本完整性，语义关系图与注意力保持因子对领域外泛化的影响未充分验证。

title: An Empirical Evaluation of Cost-Efficient Large Language Models on Algorithmic Programming Tasks
title_cn: 低成本大语言模型在算法编程任务上的实证评估
abstract: This study empirically evaluates whether cost-efficient Large Language Models (LLMs) can be trusted to generate enterprise code to a written specification. Three models (Gemini Flash 3, GPT-5.4 mini and Claude Haiku 4.5) were asked to solve 992 algorithmic problems as Java Spring Boot service methods conforming to a mandated signature and data-transfer-object specification, crossing four model and agentic coding tool combinations with two prompt variants to yield eight configurations, with iteration forbidden and hardcoded answers explicitly prohibited. Eight problem statements were withheld to probe how models respond to missing input. The 7,593 resulting methods were classified by an eight-class outcome taxonomy describing what each does about producing an answer, then deployed and executed, giving 7,936 measured requests joined to that classification. Structural conformance approached ceiling, yet 38.4% of methods do not compute the value they returned and only 12.9% of returned answers were correct. Conditioning on outcome class shows that response reliability and correctness are inversely related, whereas genuinely computing methods answered least often and were correct 19.3%. Limitations include single generation runs per configuration, partial harness coverage, single-pass timing, syntactic classification, and probable corpus contamination.
abstract_cn: 本研究实证评估低成本大语言模型 (LLMs) 是否可以被信任按照书面规范生成企业级代码。三个模型（Gemini Flash 3、GPT-5.4 mini 与 Claude Haiku 4.5）被要求以符合规定的签名与数据传输对象规范的 Java Spring Boot 服务方法形式解决 992 个算法问题，交叉四种模型-agentic 编码工具组合与两种 prompt 变体形成八种配置，禁止迭代且明确禁止硬编码答案。预留了八个问题描述以探究模型如何应对缺失输入。产生的 7,593 个方法按照描述其如何产生答案的八类结果分类法进行归类，随后被部署与执行，最终得到 7,936 次可度量请求并与该分类关联。结构合规率接近上限，然而 38.4% 的方法并未真正计算其返回的值，且仅 12.9% 的返回答案是正确的。以结果类别为条件的分析显示，响应可靠性与正确性呈反向关系，而真正进行计算的方法应答最少但正确率为 19.3%。局限包括每种配置仅进行单次生成、harness 覆盖不完全、单次通过的计时、基于语法的分类以及可能存在的语料污染。
summary_cn: 让 Gemini Flash 3、GPT-5.4 mini、Claude Haiku 4.5 单次生成 992 个 Java Spring Boot 方法（八种配置、禁止迭代），结果结构合规率接近上限但 38.4% 的方法并未真正计算返回值、仅 12.9% 答案正确。
comment: 7 pages, 7 figures. Accepted for publication in the IEEE Proceedings of the 2026 International Conference on Advanced Computing Technologies (ICACT)
objective_summary: 评估三款低成本 LLM（Gemini Flash 3、GPT-5.4 mini、Claude Haiku 4.5）在 992 个算法题上按规定签名生成 Java Spring Boot 方法，共 8 个配置、7,593 个方法、7,936 次执行。结构一致性接近上限，但 38.4% 方法未真正计算返回值，仅 12.9% 返回答案正确，真正计算的方法正确率 19.3%。
evidence_note: 992 题、8 配置、7,593 方法、7,936 次执行，多模型对比，有分类学，但每配置仅单次生成。
novelty_note: 关注低成本 LLM 在企业规范代码生成的可信度，八类结果分类学给出较细致视角。
scope: 结论限于三款低成本模型在 Java Spring Boot 方法、算法题规范下的一次性生成场景。
limitations: 作者自陈单次生成、部分测试覆盖、单次计时、语法分类及可能的语料污染。

title: VeriBugBench: An Empirically Grounded Framework for Constructing Verilog RTL Debugging Benchmarks
title_cn: VeriBugBench：一个基于实证的 Verilog RTL 调试基准构建框架
abstract: RTL source-level debugging research requires benchmark artifacts that provide faulty designs together with precise change locations, executable test stimuli, and reproducible configurations. Available Verilog resources usually provide only a subset of these elements. We present VeriBugBench, a framework for constructing Verilog RTL debugging benchmarks through empirically grounded fault construction, LLM-based testbench enhancement, and execution-based retention. The mutation library maps recurring, multi-granularity repair patterns observed in RTL bug-fix histories to 19 executable inverse operators. For each project, an LLM generates a design-specific stimulus phase from the clean DUT and original testbench; the phase is composed with the original testbench for candidate execution. Applying the framework to 45 open-source projects yields VeriBugBench-v1.0, with 2,608 executable single-fault instances whose effects are observable at design outputs. Across the 45 projects, the assembled testbenches increase mean project-level fault observability from 36.01% to 39.54% and improve line coverage and execution-trace diversity on average. VeriBugBench provides versioned RTL variants, source-level ground truth, testbenches, and execution artifacts for evaluating RTL debugging methods.
abstract_cn: RTL 源码级调试研究需要基准工件，这些工件要同时提供含缺陷的设计、精确的修改位置、可执行的测试激励以及可复现的配置。现有的 Verilog 资源通常只提供其中一部分要素。我们提出 VeriBugBench，一个通过基于实证的故障构造、基于 LLM 的测试台增强以及基于执行的保留机制来构造 Verilog RTL 调试基准的框架。其变异库将 RTL 缺陷修复历史中观察到的、反复出现的多粒度修复模式映射为 19 个可执行的逆向算子。对每个项目，一个 LLM 从干净的 DUT（被测设计）和原始测试台出发,生成一段针对该设计的激励阶段；该阶段与原始测试台组合起来用于候选执行。将该框架应用于 45 个开源项目，得到 VeriBugBench-v1.0，包含 2608 个可执行单故障实例，其效应在设计输出端可观测。在这 45 个项目上，组装后的测试台把项目级平均故障可观测率从 36.01% 提升到 39.54%，并平均提升了行覆盖率和执行轨迹多样性。VeriBugBench 提供带版本的 RTL 变体、源码级真值、测试台以及执行工件，用于评估 RTL 调试方法。
summary_cn: 提出 VeriBugBench 框架，用 19 个可执行逆向算子构造 Verilog RTL 故障、并让 LLM 增强测试台，在 45 个开源项目上生成含 2608 个可执行单故障实例的 v1.0 基准，项目级平均故障可观测率从 36.01% 提升到 39.54%。
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, and 6 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems (TCAD). This manuscript substantially extends the DAC 2023 paper "MANTRA: Mutation Testing of Hardware Design Code Based on Real Bugs" (DOI: 10.1109/DAC56929.2023.10247962)
objective_summary: 提出 VeriBugBench 构造框架，用 19 个基于真实修复的可执行反向变异算子、LLM 增强测试台与执行留存构造 Verilog RTL 调试基准。对 45 个开源项目产生 2,608 个单故障可执行实例，平均故障可观测性由 36.01% 提升到 39.54%，行覆盖与执行轨迹多样性亦提升。
evidence_note: 覆盖 45 个项目、2,608 个可执行实例，报告可观测性 36.01%→39.54% 等前后对比数据。
novelty_note: 在硬件调试基准方向扩展 DAC 2023 前作，加入 LLM 测试台增强与执行留存，属实质改进。
scope: 仅面向开源 Verilog RTL 单故障调试，评估在 45 个项目、2,608 实例上。
limitations: 局限于单故障场景与开源项目，反向变异算子覆盖真实缺陷模式的代表性仍有限。

title: Experimental Settings in LLM-Based Program Repair: A Study of Inputs, Tool Access, Feedback, and Validation
title_cn: LLM 程序修复的实验设置：输入、工具访问、反馈与验证研究
abstract: Evaluations of automated program repair (APR) systems commonly report the benchmark, the number of repaired defects, and the tests used for final patch validation, but these items no longer fully specify the repair task presented to a system. Recent LLM-based systems differ in the information supplied before repair, the repository and testing operations permitted during repair, and the feedback returned after unsuccessful attempts, allowing the same benchmark to instantiate substantially different repair tasks ranging from localized patch generation to repository-level diagnosis and iterative repair. We present a framework for explicitly specifying the experimental settings associated with reported APR results. We analyze reported experimental settings from systems evaluated on Defects4J and SWE-bench and characterize each result by its task unit, fault-localization assumptions, initial input, tool access, repair-time feedback, final validation, and resource budget. Our analysis shows that benchmark identity alone is insufficient to reconstruct the evaluated task or determine the appropriate scope of comparison across reported repair rates. We therefore introduce a machine-readable schema for specifying each experimental setting to improve reproducibility and make the scope of cross-system comparisons explicit.
abstract_cn: 自动程序修复 (APR) 系统的评测通常报告所用基准、修复缺陷数以及用于最终补丁验证的测试，但这些项已不再能完整刻画呈现给系统的修复任务。最近基于 LLM 的系统在修复前提供的信息、修复期间允许的仓库与测试操作以及尝试失败后返回的反馈上均存在差异，这使得同一基准可以实例化出实质不同的修复任务——从局部补丁生成到仓库级诊断与迭代修复。我们提出一个框架，用于显式刻画与已报告 APR 结果相关的实验设置。我们分析了在 Defects4J 与 SWE-bench 上评估的系统所报告的实验设置，并按任务单元、故障定位假设、初始输入、工具访问、修复期反馈、最终验证以及资源预算刻画每一项结果。我们的分析表明，仅凭基准身份不足以还原被评估的任务，也不足以确定跨报告修复率的合适比较范围。因此我们引入一种机器可读的 schema 用于描述每项实验设置，以提升可复现性并使跨系统比较的范围显式化。
summary_cn: 分析 Defects4J 与 SWE-bench 上报告的 LLM APR 实验设置，证明仅凭基准名不足以还原任务，并提出机器可读 schema 描述任务单元、故障定位假设、工具访问、修复期反馈与资源预算。
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables
objective_summary: 提出显式描述 LLM-based APR 实验设置的框架，分析 Defects4J 与 SWE-bench 上系统在任务单元、定位假设、初始输入、工具访问、反馈、最终验证与资源预算上的差异，并给出机器可读 schema。结论指出仅凭基准名称已不足以还原任务与对比范围。
evidence_note: 对 Defects4J 与 SWE-bench 已报告设置作归纳分析，无新实验、无统计检验，属方法学倡议。
novelty_note: 针对 APR 报告不完备问题提出结构化 schema 与分类维度，方向常见但整理系统化。
scope: 局限于 LLM-based APR 在 Defects4J 与 SWE-bench 上报告的实验设置描述与比较。
limitations: 未提供工具化实现与外部验证，schema 是否被社区采纳与覆盖度未评估。

title: A11yLTLNav: Automatic Detection of Accessibility Navigation Failures
title_cn: A11yLTLNav：可访问性导航失败的自动检测
abstract: For blind and low-vision (BLV) screen-reader users, a website that appears accessible in a static snapshot can become difficult or impossible to navigate once interaction begins. Yet, most automated accessibility checkers miss failures involving focus, interface state, and accessible feedback across interactions. We present A11yLTLNav, a property-based approach for automatically detecting accessibility navigation failures. Through a structured review of prior research, we organize accessibility navigation failures into a failure taxonomy and formalize a browser-observable subset as executable Linear Temporal Logic properties over action-state traces. A11yLTLNav combines random keyboard exploration with runtime property monitoring to detect these failures during interactions. We evaluate A11yLTLNav on 31 generated websites based on real-world websites and tasks. It reported 309 accessibility failures, of which 274 were confirmed, achieving 88.7% precision and identifying more confirmed failures than the comparison checkers. Our results show that A11yLTLNav transforms accessibility knowledge into reusable checks of interface behavior over time.
abstract_cn: 对于盲人及低视力（BLV）屏幕阅读器用户来说，一个在静态快照中看似可访问的网站，一旦开始交互就可能变得难以甚至无法导航。然而，大多数自动化可访问性检查工具都会漏掉那些涉及焦点、界面状态以及跨交互的可访问反馈的失败。我们提出 A11yLTLNav，一种基于属性的可访问性导航失败自动检测方法。通过对先前研究的结构化梳理，我们把可访问性导航失败组织成一个失败分类体系，并将其中可被浏览器观测的子集形式化为定义在「动作-状态」轨迹之上、可执行的线性时序逻辑属性。A11yLTLNav 将随机键盘探索与运行时属性监控结合起来，以在交互过程中检测这些失败。我们在 31 个基于真实网站与任务生成的网站上评估 A11yLTLNav。它报告了 309 个可访问性失败，其中 274 个被确认，达到 88.7% 的精确率，且识别到的已确认失败数多于对比检查工具。我们的结果表明，A11yLTLNav 把可访问性知识转化为对界面随时间变化行为的可复用检查。
summary_cn: 把可访问性导航失败形式化为浏览器可观测的线性时序逻辑属性，结合随机键盘探索与运行时监控，在 31 个网站上报告 309 个失败，其中 274 个被确认，精确率 88.7%，识别到的确认失败数多于对比工具。
objective_summary: 提出 A11yLTLNav，将可访问性导航失败形式化为可执行的线性时序逻辑属性，结合随机键盘探索与运行时监控进行检测。在 31 个基于真实网站与任务生成的网站上报告 309 处失败，其中 274 处被确认，精度 88.7%，确认失败数多于对比工具。
evidence_note: 31 个生成网站、309 报告/274 确认、精度 88.7%，与对照检查器比较，无统计检验且规模有限。
novelty_note: 将 LTL 属性监控用于交互式可访问性导航失败检测，并组织失败分类，属新颖组合。
scope: 限于浏览器可观测的可访问性导航失败，基于 31 个生成网站与键盘随机探索评估。
limitations: 样本仅 31 个生成网站，随机键盘探索覆盖有限，仅覆盖可浏览器观测的失败子集。

title: Detecting Argument-Swap Bugs Using Context-Enhanced Code Representations
title_cn: 使用上下文增强的代码表示检测参数交换 bug
abstract: Names of source code elements convey rich semantic information and have been widely used in software engineering tasks such as bug detection, code completion, type prediction, and code classification. Prior studies exploit lexical similarity between method arguments and formal parameter names to detect bugs caused by incorrectly ordered arguments, typically relying on establishing mappings between method calls and their corresponding definitions. However, such mappings are often difficult to obtain in dynamically typed languages like Python. In this paper, we present BugProbe, a learning-based approach for detecting incorrectly ordered arguments in Python method calls that does not require call-to-definition mappings. Our approach leverages multiple sources of contextual information, including local context and argument usage context, and combines name-based similarity with machine learning to construct expressive representations of method arguments. We collect a new dataset of 132,739 Python source files from the top-1,000 starred GitHub repositories, yielding 3,371,244 synthetic training examples, and contribute a curated benchmark of 55 real-world argument-swap bugs manually verified from commit histories. We evaluate our approach on this dataset and show that it achieves high accuracy and consistently outperforms a state-of-the-art baseline across standard evaluation metrics. These results demonstrate that effective detection of argument-ordering bugs is possible without relying on explicit call-to-definition resolution, making the approach well suited for dynamically typed language settings.
abstract_cn: 源代码元素的名称承载丰富的语义信息，并已被广泛用于诸如 bug 检测、代码补全、类型预测与代码分类等软件工程任务。先前研究利用方法实参与形参名称之间的词法相似性来检测由参数顺序错误引起的 bug，通常依赖于建立方法调用与其对应定义之间的映射。然而，在 Python 这类动态类型语言中，此类映射通常难以获得。本文提出 BugProbe，一种基于学习的方法，用于检测 Python 方法调用中参数顺序错误，无需调用到定义的映射。我们的方法利用多种上下文信息源（包括局部上下文与实参使用上下文），并将基于名称的相似性与机器学习结合，构造出表达力强的实参表示。我们从 GitHub 上 star 数前 1,000 的仓库收集了包含 132,739 个 Python 源文件的新数据集，产生 3,371,244 个合成训练样例，并贡献了一个由 55 个真实世界参数交换 bug 组成的精选基准，这些 bug 从提交历史中人工验证。我们在该数据集上评估了本方法，结果表明其达到了高准确率，并在标准评测指标上持续优于当前最先进的基线。这些结果表明，无需依赖显式的调用到定义解析也能有效检测参数顺序 bug，使该方法非常适合动态类型语言场景。
summary_cn: BugProbe 无需调用-定义映射即可检测 Python 方法调用中的参数顺序错误，用 132,739 个源文件构造 3,371,244 个合成训练样例，并在 55 个真实 bug 精选基准上超越 SOTA 基线。
comment: Accepted in the 26th IEEE International Conference on Source Code Analysis and Manipulation (SCAM 2026)
objective_summary: 提出 BugProbe，基于学习检测 Python 方法调用中参数顺序错误的缺陷，无需调用到定义的映射。收集 132,739 个 Python 源文件构造 3,371,244 条合成训练样本，并整理 55 个真实参数交换缺陷的基准，在标准指标上一致优于最新基线。
evidence_note: 训练样本 337 万条、55 个真实缺陷基准，与 SOTA 基线在多指标上对比，未提及统计检验。
novelty_note: 针对动态类型语言绕过调用-定义映射，用上下文与名字相似度融合的表示是新思路。
scope: 仅限 Python 方法调用的参数顺序错误检测，基于 GitHub top-1000 高星仓库语料。
limitations: 真实基准仅 55 例规模较小，训练主要靠合成样本，域偏移风险明显。

title: A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Quality Assurance Practices and Gaps in AI Agents
title_cn: AI Agent 质量保障实践与缺口的大规模实证研究
abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used across software engineering, web automation, research, and productivity applications. Their integration of planning, memory, tool use, code execution, and external interactions enables greater autonomy but also introduces new reliability, safety, and security risks. We present a large-scale empirical study of quality assurance (QA) practices in 157 open-source LLM-based agent projects with at least 100 GitHub stars. We analyze documentation, source code, configurations, and tests to characterize QA practices across execution surfaces, safeguards, testing artifacts, risk scenarios, and recurring gaps. We find that current QA primarily focuses on basic functionality and high-risk actions, while coverage remains fragmented. Safeguards are inconsistently applied across equivalent execution routes, tests rarely examine boundary, adversarial, or multi-step tool-use failures, and identified risks are seldom translated into end-to-end QA checks. These findings highlight the need to move beyond feature-level testing toward systematic end-to-end validation that ensures agent workflows remain within intended boundaries when interacting with untrusted inputs, tools, persistent state, and external APIs.
abstract_cn: 基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的 agent 越来越多地被用于软件工程、网页自动化、研究与生产力应用中。它们对规划、记忆、工具使用、代码执行与外部交互的整合带来了更高的自主性，但也引入了新的可靠性、安全性与安保风险。我们对 157 个至少拥有 100 个 GitHub star 的开源 LLM agent 项目开展了大规模质量保障 (QA) 实践实证研究。我们分析了文档、源代码、配置与测试，从执行面、安全防护、测试构件、风险场景以及反复出现的缺口等方面刻画 QA 实践。我们发现，当前的 QA 主要聚焦于基础功能与高风险动作，而覆盖仍然碎片化。在等价的执行路径上安全防护的应用并不一致，测试很少考察边界、对抗性或多步工具使用失败，且已识别的风险很少被转化为端到端的 QA 检查。这些发现凸显了超越功能级测试、转向系统化端到端验证的必要性，以确保 agent 工作流在与不可信输入、工具、持久状态与外部 API 交互时保持在预期边界内。
summary_cn: 对 157 个 100+ star 的开源 LLM agent 项目做 QA 实证，发现测试主要聚焦基础功能与高风险动作、等价执行路径的安全防护不一致、极少考察边界/对抗/多步工具使用失败，识别的风险也很少落到端到端检查。
objective_summary: 对 157 个 GitHub 星标≥100 的开源 LLM agent 项目做 QA 实证研究，分析文档、源码、配置与测试。发现 QA 集中在基础功能与高风险操作，等价执行路径的护栏应用不一致，测试少覆盖边界、对抗与多步工具使用失败，识别的风险少转化为端到端 QA 检查。
evidence_note: 157 项目多维制品分析，含风险场景与测试覆盖对照，无假设检验
novelty_note: 首次针对 LLM agent 项目做规模化 QA 实践与缺口刻画
scope: 结论限于 GitHub 星标≥100 的 157 个开源 LLM agent 项目
limitations: 仅开源高星项目，闭源商业 agent 的 QA 实践未覆盖

title: CARE: A Responsibility-Oriented Architecture for Domain-Scoped Resolution in Modular and Upgradeable Smart Contracts
title_cn: CARE：面向模块化与可升级智能合约中域范围解析的职责导向架构
abstract: Modular and upgradeable smart-contract systems enable replaceable execution logic, but modular dispatch alone does not define which components own architectural responsibilities such as coordination, resolution, shared state, reusable services, and observation. This paper presents CARE, a responsibility-oriented architecture that makes these ownership boundaries explicit and introduces domain-scoped capability resolution, separating execution coordination from the authority that selects an execution target. CARE is defined through a formal architectural model from which five structural properties are derived. Its behavioral semantics are further encoded in TLA+ and evaluated with TLC against seven architectural invariants. Intermediate TLC results were used to refine the architectural model before the final validation run. A controlled empirical evaluation against EIP-2535 and a routing only baseline shows that CARE introduces an approximately fixed 7.7k-gas runtime routing premium in the evaluated workloads, while localized capability replacement remains close to the routing-only control and substantially less expensive than the evaluated EIP-2535 reconfiguration path. Adversarial tests further characterize authorization controls and residual risks associated with delegated execution and reentrancy. These results position CARE as an architectural model for explicit responsibility ownership and localized evolution rather than as a universal replacement for existing smart-contract upgradeability mechanisms
abstract_cn: 模块化与可升级智能合约系统支持可替换的执行逻辑，但仅有模块化分发并不能定义哪些组件拥有诸如协调、解析、共享状态、可复用服务与观测等架构职责。本文提出 CARE，一种以职责为导向的架构，显式化这些所有权边界，并引入领域范围的能力解析（domain-scoped capability resolution），将执行协调与选择执行目标的权限相分离。CARE 通过一个形式化架构模型定义，从中推导出五条结构性性质。其行为语义进一步用 TLA+ 编码，并使用 TLC 针对七条架构不变量进行评估。中间 TLC 结果用于在最终验证运行之前对架构模型进行修正。针对 EIP-2535 与仅路由基线的受控实证评估表明，CARE 在所评估工作负载下引入约固定 7.7k-gas 的运行时路由开销，同时局部能力替换的成本接近仅路由对照组，且显著低于所评估的 EIP-2535 重配置路径。对抗性测试进一步刻画了与委托执行和重入相关的授权控制与残余风险。这些结果将 CARE 定位为显式职责所有权与局部演化的架构模型，而不是对现有智能合约可升级机制的通用替代品。
summary_cn: 提出 CARE 架构，用职责边界与领域范围能力解析分离协调与执行选择，实测比 EIP-2535 多约 7.7k gas 路由开销，但局部能力替换成本接近仅路由基线且远低于 EIP-2535 重配置。
objective_summary: 提出 CARE 责任导向智能合约架构与域范围能力解析，形式化建模并用 TLA+/TLC 检验 7 项不变式；对比 EIP-2535 与仅路由基线，CARE 引入约 7.7k gas 固定路由溢价，局部能力替换成本接近路由基线且显著低于 EIP-2535 重配置路径。
evidence_note: TLA+/TLC 验证＋对 EIP-2535 与路由基线的 gas 对照，负载有限
novelty_note: 将责任归属与域范围能力解析显式化，是模块化合约架构的实质改进
scope: 结论限于以太坊模块化可升级合约在评测工作负载下的 gas 表现
limitations: 评测工作负载有限，未证明可替代所有既有可升级性机制

title: Quiescence in Concert: Composing Multi-Channel Time-Outs for IOCO
title_cn: Quiescence in Concert：为 IOCO 组合多通道超时
abstract: In Model-Based Testing (MBT), test suites are generated automatically from a formal specification. The theory of testing real-time systems is rich, but often underused in practice, partly because applying the timed machinery demands expertise practitioners should not need. In prior work we addressed this for timed testing with a canonic lifting operator, which lets a modeller specify behaviour as plain labelled transition systems while implicitly obtaining the timed automata that express their quiescent behaviour (the explicit absence of outputs) with timers. This paper takes the next step: we show that our lifting still works when each component carries its own time-out on its own channel. This way, we introduce a multi-channel lifting. We show that it commutes with parallel composition, i.e. composing and lifting is the same as lifting first and then composing. We show that the MBT apparatus survives: conformance, test generation and verdicts are preserved by the lifting, on the testable traces that a time-out based tester can observe.
abstract_cn: 在基于模型的测试（Model-Based Testing, MBT）中，测试套件是从形式化规约自动生成的。实时系统测试的理论已十分丰富，但在实践中常被闲置，部分原因是使用定时机制需要从业者本不该具备的专业知识。在先前工作中，我们通过一个规范提升算子（canonic lifting operator）解决了这一定时测试问题，它允许建模者以普通的标记转迁系统（labelled transition systems）指定行为，同时隐式地获得用计时器表达其静默行为（即显式的输出缺失）的定时自动机。本文更进一步：我们表明当每个组件在各自的通道上携带自己的超时时，我们的提升算子依然成立。由此，我们引入了多通道提升（multi-channel lifting）。我们证明它与并行组合可交换，即先组合后提升与先提升后组合等价。我们证明 MBT 装置仍然有效：在基于超时的测试者可观察到的可测试迹上，一致性、测试生成与判决在提升后都得以保留。
summary_cn: 把之前用于定时测试的规范提升算子扩展到多通道超时场景，证明多通道提升与并行组合可交换，且一致性、测试生成与判决在提升后仍保持成立。
comment: Technical report with proofs
objective_summary: 将先前的 canonic lifting 算子从单通道扩展到每个组件各带独立通道超时的多通道情形，证明该 lifting 与并行组合可交换，并在超时测试者可观察的可测轨迹上保留 IOCO 一致性、测试生成与判决。
evidence_note: 纯形式化定理与证明，附技术报告，无实证或工业案例
novelty_note: 在既有 canonic lifting 基础上扩展至多通道超时并证明可交换性
scope: 结论限于基于超时的测试者可观察的可测轨迹与 IOCO 框架
limitations: 仅理论结果，未评估在真实 MBT 工具或工业系统中的开销

title: Not All Agents Are Equal: Code Quality and Post-Merge Maintenance Across Five Autonomous Coding Agents in the Wild
title_cn: 并非所有 agent 都一样：五个自主编程 agent 在真实仓库中的代码质量与合入后维护
abstract: Autonomous coding agents now open pull requests in public repositories at a scale that was out of reach two years ago, yet little is known about what happens to that code after it lands. This paper studies 37,623 provenance-labeled pull requests (PRs) from five commercial agents (OpenAI Codex, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Claude Code) and a matched human baseline, drawn from 2,807 GitHub repositories between December 2024 and July 2025. We combine the AIDev dataset with 58,792 cached GitHub API responses to measure security smells in added code, structural maintainability, post-merge churn, revert rates, and human review behavior. Three results stand out. First, quality differences are vendor-specific rather than uniform: Codex-authored PRs were reverted about half as often as human PRs (6.1% vs. 11.5%, odds ratio 0.50), while Devin PRs were reverted more often (14.5%, odds ratio 1.31). Second, agent code pooled across vendors was less likely than human code to contain a security smell (odds ratio 0.63), driven by fewer hardcoded credentials and eval-style constructs. Third, review effort concentrates unevenly: Copilot PRs drew the most human reviews and change requests, and Claude Code PRs waited the longest for a first human review (median 12.6 hours). All pipeline code, statistical reports, and figures are released for replication.
abstract_cn: 自主编程 agent 如今在公共仓库中提交 pull request 的规模，是两年前无法企及的，但对这些代码合入之后发生了什么，仍知之甚少。本文研究了来自五个商用 agent（OpenAI Codex、Devin、GitHub Copilot、Cursor 与 Claude Code）的 37,623 个带来源标记的 pull request（PR），并配以匹配的人类基线，样本采自 2024 年 12 月至 2025 年 7 月间的 2,807 个 GitHub 仓库。我们将 AIDev 数据集与 58,792 条缓存的 GitHub API 响应结合，测量新增代码中的安全坏味、结构可维护性、合入后 churn、回滚率和人类评审行为。有三项结果尤为突出。第一，质量差异因厂商而异而非整体一致：Codex 撰写的 PR 被回滚的频率约为人类 PR 的一半（6.1% 对 11.5%，比值比 0.50），而 Devin 的 PR 则回滚更频繁（14.5%，比值比 1.31）。第二，跨厂商汇总的 agent 代码比人类代码更不容易包含安全坏味（比值比 0.63），主要得益于更少的硬编码凭证与 eval 式构造。第三，评审工作量分布不均：Copilot 的 PR 获得了最多的人类评审与修改请求，而 Claude Code 的 PR 等待第一次人类评审的时间最长（中位数 12.6 小时）。所有流水线代码、统计报告与图表均已开放以供复现。
summary_cn: 在 2,807 个 GitHub 仓库中分析五家商用 agent 共 37,623 个带来源标记 PR，发现质量差异按厂商分化：Codex 回滚率 6.1% 约为人类 11.5% 的一半，Devin 高达 14.5%；agent 代码整体安全坏味更少（OR 0.63），Claude Code PR 首次人类评审中位数等待 12.6 小时。
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables
objective_summary: 分析 2024-12 至 2025-07 期间 2,807 个 GitHub 仓库中 5 个商业 agent 与人类基线的 37,623 条带来源标记 PR 及 58,792 缓存 API 响应。Codex 回退率 6.1% vs 人类 11.5%（OR 0.50），Devin 14.5%（OR 1.31），agent 代码总体安全气味 OR 0.63，Claude Code 首审中位等待 12.6 小时。
evidence_note: 3.7 万 PR、5 agent 与人类匹配基线，报告 OR 与多种统计对照
novelty_note: 首次跨 5 家商业 agent 在真实仓库中的合入后维护对比
scope: 结论限于 2024-12 至 2025-07 GitHub 上 5 商业 agent 与 2,807 仓库
limitations: 观察性数据存在选择偏差，仓库与语言分布未强制平衡

title: Coding Agents Have Converged: Why the SWE-bench Leaderboard Can No Longer Order Its Top Entries, and What to Measure Instead
title_cn: Coding Agent 已经收敛：为什么 SWE-bench 榜单已无法给头部条目排序，以及应该衡量什么
abstract: Small differences on coding-agent leaderboards are often read as an ordering of systems. We audit whether the published verdicts support this reading, using 254 SWE-bench submissions across four splits without running models. On Verified, the leading two entries each resolve 396 of 500 instances. The top ten share 285 successes and 51 failures, leaving 164 instances that distinguish their outcomes. Frontier solution sets have median nesting 0.935 against a score-implied baseline of 0.774, indicating strongly shared successes. Scores also depend on the evaluated model-scaffold pair: observed within-model scaffold ranges reach 29.8 percentage points, compared with the 8.8-point spread of the top thirty. Six of nine cell-mean interaction tests remain significant after Holm correction, although this observational design does not identify causal scaffold effects. Exact paired McNemar tests separate none of the 29 adjacent Verified top-thirty pairs at alpha=0.05, while the larger Test split separates 14 of 23. A stated leader-based rule yields three descriptive tiers, or two after Holm correction; non-rejection does not establish equivalence. We release the partition and a five-step audit protocol that profiles shared outcomes, tests paired differences, reports grouping sensitivity, and estimates the instance budget needed for resolution. The results motivate reporting comparison-set-specific resolution and model-scaffold provenance instead of interpreting small aggregate gaps as established rank differences.
abstract_cn: 在 coding-agent 榜单上，微小的差距常常被解读为系统之间的排序。我们在不重新运行模型的前提下，使用 254 份跨四个 split 的 SWE-bench 提交，审计已公开的评测结果是否支持这种解读。在 Verified 上，排名最靠前的两个条目各自解出了 500 个 instance 中的 396 个。前十名共享 285 个成功与 51 个失败，只剩 164 个 instance 能区分它们的结果。Frontier 解集的中位数 nesting 为 0.935，而按分数推导的基线为 0.774，表明大量成功是共享的。分数还依赖于所评测的 model-scaffold 对：在同一模型下观察到的 scaffold 分差达到 29.8 个百分点，而前三十名整体的分差仅 8.8 个百分点。九项 cell-mean 交互检验中有六项在 Holm 校正后仍显著，尽管这种观测性设计并不能识别 scaffold 的因果效应。精确配对 McNemar 检验在 alpha=0.05 下无法区分 Verified 前三十名的 29 组相邻对，而在更大的 Test split 上则能区分 23 组中的 14 组。基于「明确 leader」的规则得到三个描述性 tier，Holm 校正后为两个；不拒绝并不等于等价。我们发布了分区和一份五步审计协议，用于刻画共享结果、检验配对差异、报告分组的敏感性，并估计要区分排名所需的 instance 预算。结果促使人们不再把微小的总分差距解读为已确立的排名差异，而应报告与「比较集」相关的解决率以及 model-scaffold 的来源信息。
summary_cn: 对 254 份 SWE-bench 提交做无需重跑模型的审计：Verified 上前两名同解 396/500，前 30 名相邻对经 McNemar 配对精确检验在 alpha=0.05 下无一可区分，说明榜单顶部差距已不能解读为排名差异。
comment: Accepted at ADMA 2026 (International Conference on Advanced Data Mining and Applications), Special Session on Responsible Data Intelligence. Camera-ready version, 15 pages, 4 figures
objective_summary: 对 SWE-bench 254 份提交在 4 个划分上做无重跑审计。Verified 前二各解 500 中 396；前十共享 285 成功、51 失败，仅 164 实例可区分；配对 McNemar 检验（Holm 校正后）在 29 组相邻 top-30 对上无一分离，Test 划分 23 组中分离 14 组。
evidence_note: 254 份提交、4 划分，配对 McNemar 检验并 Holm 校正，公开审计协议
novelty_note: 首次系统证明 SWE-bench 榜首排名统计不可分离并给出审计流程
scope: 结论限于 SWE-bench 四划分下 254 份公开提交与观察性设计
limitations: 观察性数据无法识别 scaffold 因果效应，未拒绝不等于等价

title: Type-IV Code Clone Detection via Layer-Wise Non-Contrastive Representation Learning
title_cn: 通过分层非对比表示学习检测 Type-IV 代码克隆
abstract: Software clones are fragments of code that are similar or functionally equivalent to each other. They pose significant challenges for maintenance, refactoring, and bug detection. Detecting Type-IV clones, which are semantically equivalent but may differ syntactically, is particularly difficult for traditional token- or syntax-based methods. Recent machine learning approaches rely on contrastive learning, which requires careful negative sampling and can introduce bias. In this paper, we propose LWVIC4Code, a non-contrastive representation learning approach specifically designed for Type-IV clone detection. Building on the Variance-Invariance-Covariance Regularization (VICReg) framework and prior layer-wise VICReg training, LWVIC4Code introduces cross-layer consistency regularization and depth-dependent layer weighting to progressively refine semantic information across transformer layers, producing robust and discriminative code representations. We conduct an empirical study comparing LWVIC4Code against a contrastive learning baseline and zero-shot large language models on Python (Kamino) and multi-language (GPTCloneBench) datasets. Results show that LWVIC4Code achieves competitive or superior performance without negative samples, benefits from layer-wise supervision, and generalizes effectively from Python to other languages, particularly Java and C#. These results demonstrate that non-contrastive, layer-wise representation learning is a promising direction for robust semantic code clone detection.
abstract_cn: 软件克隆是彼此相似或功能等价的代码片段，它们给维护、重构和缺陷检测带来重大挑战。检测 Type-IV 克隆——语义等价但语法上可能不同——对传统基于 token 或语法的方法尤其困难。最近的机器学习方法依赖对比学习，需要精心设计负样本，还可能引入偏差。本文提出 LWVIC4Code，一种专为 Type-IV 克隆检测设计的非对比表示学习方法。该方法建立在 Variance-Invariance-Covariance Regularization（VICReg）框架及此前的分层 VICReg 训练之上，引入跨层一致性正则化和深度相关的层加权，逐步在 transformer 各层中精炼语义信息，得到鲁棒且具区分性的代码表示。我们在 Python（Kamino）和多语言（GPTCloneBench）数据集上，将 LWVIC4Code 与对比学习基线以及零样本大语言模型进行了实证对比。结果表明，LWVIC4Code 在不使用负样本的情况下达到了具有竞争力甚至更优的表现，能从分层监督中获益，并能有效从 Python 迁移到其他语言，尤其是 Java 和 C#。这些结果表明，非对比、分层的表示学习是鲁棒语义代码克隆检测的一个有前景的方向。
summary_cn: 提出 LWVIC4Code，基于 VICReg 的非对比学习方法，加入跨层一致性正则和深度相关的层权重，在 Kamino 与 GPTCloneBench 上无负样本即达到与对比学习基线相当或更优的 Type-IV 克隆检测效果，并能从 Python 迁移到 Java、C#。
objective_summary: 提出基于 VICReg 的层级非对比表征学习方法 LWVIC4Code 用于 Type-IV 代码克隆检测。在 Kamino（Python）与 GPTCloneBench（多语言）上与对比学习基线及零样本 LLM 相比取得相当或更优结果，并在 Java、C# 上表现出跨语言迁移。
evidence_note: 两数据集，含对比学习与零样本 LLM 基线，未做显著性检验
novelty_note: 将层级 VICReg 引入代码克隆检测，属方法迁移与改进
scope: 结论限于 Python、Java、C# 的 Type-IV 克隆检测与两数据集
limitations: 未含大规模工业代码库评测，跨层加权设计依赖启发式

title: Can We Stop The Ads? Taxonomy and Characterization of Smartphone Splash Ads and Existing Countermeasures
title_cn: 我们能挡住这些广告吗？智能手机开屏广告及其现有对策的分类与刻画
abstract: Splash ads are full-screen advertisements that pop up and appear as the first interaction page when users start an app, often tricking users into unknowingly activating certain trigger mechanisms, such as moving the phone to redirect users to other profit-driven third parties. So far, splash ads have already caused significant real-world impacts, ranging from significantly delaying emergency response to distracting drivers, as well as degrading accessibility of apps to vision-impaired users. We analyze 108 documented implementations of advertising defenses to examine their applicability to splash ads and the requirements users face when deploying them. Our analysis identifies substantial deployment barriers, including device rooting or jailbreaking, runtime code injection, and application modification. Options without these requirements can still involve additional permissions, rule maintenance, source compilation, or payment. In our evaluation of 13 configurations of 11 tools across 10 popular apps, only one tool prevented the target ad-triggered navigation across all ten apps. It required Accessibility permission, and ads remained visible for approximately one second before dismissal. Other tested configurations failed to prevent navigation or, in some cases, left host apps unable to launch or stuck on the ad page. We further analyze the outstanding challenges and pos- sible future directions, highlighting the urgent need to incentivize smartphone manufacturers to provide more friendly and regulated platforms.
abstract_cn: 开屏广告是一种全屏广告，会在用户启动 App 时弹出并作为第一个交互页面出现，常常诱骗用户在不知情的情况下激活某些触发机制，例如通过晃动手机把用户跳转到其他以牟利为目的的第三方。到目前为止，开屏广告已经造成了显著的现实影响，包括严重延误紧急响应、分散驾驶员注意力，以及降低 App 对视觉障碍用户的可访问性。我们分析了 108 种有文档记录的广告防御实现，考察它们对开屏广告的适用性，以及用户在部署时所面临的要求。我们的分析识别出了显著的部署障碍，包括需要 root 或越狱设备、运行时代码注入以及应用程序修改。那些不需要这些前提的方案，仍可能涉及额外的权限、规则维护、源码编译或付费。在我们对 10 款热门 App 上 11 种工具的 13 种配置进行的评测中，只有一种工具能在全部十款 App 上阻止目标广告触发的跳转。它需要 Accessibility 权限，并且广告在被关闭前仍会显示大约一秒。其他被测配置要么无法阻止跳转，在某些情况下要么会导致宿主 App 无法启动或卡在广告页面上。我们进一步分析了尚待解决的挑战和可能的未来方向，强调迫切需要激励智能手机厂商提供更友好、更受监管的平台。
summary_cn: 系统分析了 108 种广告防御实现，并在 10 款热门 App 上评测 11 种工具的 13 种配置，结果只有 1 种工具能阻止全部十款 App 的广告触发跳转，且需依赖 Accessibility 权限、广告仍会显示约 1 秒。
objective_summary: 分析 108 个已记录的广告防御实现对开屏广告的适用性，并在 10 个流行应用上评测 11 个工具的 13 种配置。仅 1 个工具在全部 10 应用中阻止广告触发的跳转，需辅助功能权限且广告仍显示约 1 秒，部分配置甚至致宿主应用无法启动。
evidence_note: 108 防御方案分类＋11 工具×10 应用的实测，无统计检验
novelty_note: 针对开屏广告的分类学与防御适用性系统评估此前未见
scope: 结论限于智能手机开屏广告与所选 10 个应用及 11 个防御工具
limitations: 应用样本仅 10 个，评测偏配置层面，未覆盖全部广告 SDK

title: After the Party: Growth, Governance, and Security Scanning in the OpenClaw Agent Skill Ecosystem
title_cn: 派对之后：OpenClaw Agent Skill 生态的增长、治理与安全扫描
abstract: AI agents increasingly act through agent skills, i.e., natural-language instructions, that direct a host agent toward shell, network, credential, file, and process actions, and public registries distribute them at scale. In the first half of 2026, the OpenClaw AI agent went viral, and its public skill registry boomed: the observable stock nearly doubled in 91 days, and a majority of the listings visible in June were created in just two months. By the end of our study window, the wave had crested, and monthly listing creation and core-repository activity were falling from their spring peaks. This paper measures what the boom left behind, drawing on the OpenClaw Git history, its GitHub issues and pull requests, and three ClawHub registry snapshots. Attention is concentrated: the top 10% of skills received 46.93% of all downloads. No simple skill features (like size or download counts) remained a stable predictor of continued listing once creation cohort and skill age were controlled. Human scrutiny did not stay: 77.86% have zero stars and zero comments, while 85.06% of the readable skills carry privilege evidence. And automated cleanup is not ready: the three security scanners disagreed on 23,702 of the 61,990 skills they all cover. After human adjudication, weighted scanner sensitivity against the reference standard ranged from 21.67% to 61.06%. Governing fast-growing agent-skill registries cannot rely on simple metadata or single scanner scores; it requires robust, transparent measurement and independent validation.
abstract_cn: AI agent 越来越多地通过 agent skill——即自然语言指令——来行动，这些指令引导宿主 agent 执行 shell、网络、凭据、文件和进程操作，并由公开注册表大规模分发。2026 年上半年，OpenClaw AI agent 走红，其公开 skill 注册表也随之爆发：可观察到的存量在 91 天内几乎翻倍，六月能看到的绝大多数条目都是在最近两个月内创建的。到我们研究窗口结束时，浪潮已经见顶，月度上架量与核心仓库活动都从春季峰值回落。本文借助 OpenClaw 的 Git 历史、其 GitHub issue 与 pull request 以及三次 ClawHub 注册表快照，来度量这波热潮之后留下了什么。注意力高度集中：前 10% 的 skill 拿走了全部下载量的 46.93%。在控制了创建 cohort 与 skill 年龄之后，没有任何简单的 skill 特征（如体积或下载量）能稳定预测该 skill 是否会继续留在架上。人为审查也没有留下：77.86% 的 skill 拥有零 star、零评论，而 85.06% 的可读 skill 携带特权证据。自动化清理同样尚未就绪：三款安全扫描器在它们共同覆盖的 61,990 个 skill 中，对 23,702 个的判断不一致。经过人工裁决，扫描器针对参考标准的加权敏感度介于 21.67% 到 61.06% 之间。要治理快速膨胀的 agent-skill 注册表，不能依赖简单元数据或单一扫描器分数；它需要稳健、透明的度量和独立验证。
summary_cn: 对 OpenClaw agent skill 生态的实证：91 天内库存翻倍，前 10% 的 skill 拿走 46.93% 下载；77.86% 零星零评论，85.06% 可读 skill 含特权证据；三款安全扫描器在 61,990 个 skill 中有 23,702 个判断不一致，加权敏感度仅 21.67%–61.06%。
comment: To appear in IEEE Digital Library as the 33rd Asia-Pacific Software Engineering Conference (APSEC 2026) conference proceedings. Accepted version, not camera ready version
objective_summary: 基于 OpenClaw Git 历史、GitHub Issue/PR 与 3 次 ClawHub 快照，分析 61,990 个 skill。前 10% skill 占 46.93% 下载，77.86% 零星标零评论，85.06% 含特权证据，3 个安全扫描器在 23,702 个 skill 上分歧，加权灵敏度 21.67%–61.06%。
evidence_note: 六万余 skill、三扫描器交叉、含人工裁定参考标准，未做假设检验
novelty_note: 首次对新兴 agent skill 注册中心做规模化治理与扫描器一致性测评
scope: 结论限于 2026 上半年 OpenClaw/ClawHub 生态与三种安全扫描器
limitations: 单一 agent 生态、观察期短，扫描器行为可能随版本变化

title: An Exemplar of a Digital Twin in Mechanical Engineering: Understanding Model Hybridization
title_cn: 机械工程中数字孪生的一个范例：理解模型混合化
abstract: Digital Twins (DTs) are widely adopted across a variety of application domains. In industrial sectors, particularly in mechanical engineering, they accelerate product development, reduce risks, enable early issue prediction, and lower sustainment costs . In practice, DTs increasingly integrate physics-based (deductive) and data-driven (inductive) models into hybrid models combining the complementary strengths of both modeling paradigms. In this paper, we refer to this integration paradigm as hybridization. Despite this trend, the engineering of hybrid DTs that is, remains insufficiently documented. Hybridization is often introduced in an ad hoc manner, and its implementation is only partially made explicit, which limits reproducibility and transferability. This paper reports on the development of an existing fluidic loop digital twin at Centre Technique des Industries M{é}canique (CETIM). The DT is described using the characterization framework of Gil et al., providing a structured view across its lifecycle dimensions. To make hybridization explicit, the case is further analyzed through a complementary characterization structured along two dimensions: motivation and realization. The resulting description provides a traceable account of hybridization decisions and supports the documentation and transfer of hybrid DT engineering practices.
abstract_cn: 数字孪生（Digital Twins, DTs）已在多个应用领域被广泛采用。在工业界，尤其是机械工程领域，它们加速产品开发、降低风险、支持早期问题预测并降低维护成本。在实践中，DT 越来越多地把基于物理（演绎）的模型与数据驱动（归纳）的模型集成到混合模型中，结合两种建模范式的互补优势。本文将这种集成范式称为混合化（hybridization）。尽管这一趋势明显，混合 DT 的工程仍然缺乏充分的文档。混合化往往以特设方式引入，其实现只被部分显式化，这限制了可复现性和可迁移性。本文报告了 Centre Technique des Industries Mécanique（CETIM）已有流体回路数字孪生的开发过程。该 DT 使用 Gil 等人的刻画框架进行描述，提供了跨生命周期维度的结构化视图。为了让混合化显式化，我们进一步通过一个沿「动机」与「实现」两个维度构建的互补刻画对该案例进行分析。所得描述提供了一份关于混合化决策的可追溯记录，并支持混合 DT 工程实践的文档化与迁移。
summary_cn: 以 CETIM 的流体回路数字孪生为案例，使用 Gil 等人的刻画框架并叠加「动机-实现」两维度补充分析，把物理模型与数据模型的混合化决策显式记录下来，以支持可复现与可迁移的混合 DT 工程实践。
objective_summary: 以 CETIM 流体回路数字孪生为案例，采用 Gil 等人的表征框架，并补充「动机-实现」二维刻画混合过程，输出该混合 DT 的可追溯工程描述以支持文档化与迁移。
evidence_note: 单一工业案例，无对照或统计分析，主要是文档化与框架应用
novelty_note: 沿用 Gil 框架，新增动机与实现二维表征，属既有方向上的补充
scope: 结论限于机械工程 CETIM 单一流体回路数字孪生案例
limitations: 单案例可推广性有限，混合决策记录依赖作者主观判断

title: A Memorization Floor for LLM Refinement of Decompiled Code
title_cn: LLM 精修反编译代码的「记忆下限」
abstract: We introduce a memorization floor: a within-item control separating what LLM refinement of decompiler output recovers from its input from what it recovers from its prior. Refine a function, then refine it again from an input whose identifiers have been destroyed, and measure what survives. Because the comparison is within-item, corpus difficulty cannot contribute; it costs twenty API calls. Applied to functions written after our analysis plan was committed, so no released model could have memorized them, it reports two things. Recovery is real: refined output sits +0.072 to +0.137 above an arm-matched permutation null built from its own output vocabulary. But it does not depend on the input we ablate: destroying the input's dataflow changes the naming gain by +0.001 (95% CI [-0.026, +0.026]), and removing type prefixes or permuting names changes it by no more. A second refiner from another vendor, registered in advance and given byte-identical inputs, reproduces this -- twelve contrasts, two models, twelve nulls. Readability stays at ceiling throughout, so a reader is given no signal. The null is bounded, not absolute: contributions under 0.056 are invisible, and the ablation leaves operations intact, so naming from those alone remains a competing reading. No registered hypothesis was confirmed, and we report the five instrument failures behind that in full, including a reassembly harness biased against the treated arm and an equivalence checker we registered without checking it worked on our inputs.
abstract_cn: 我们引入一个「记忆下限」（memorization floor）：一种 within-item 控制，把 LLM 精修反编译输出中「从输入中恢复」的部分与「从其先验中恢复」的部分区分开来。先精修一个函数，然后再从一个已破坏其标识符的输入去精修它，并测量哪些内容存活下来。由于比较是 within-item 的，语料难度不会造成干扰；每个函数仅需二十次 API 调用。将该方法应用于在我们分析方案提交之后才写出的函数——因此已发布模型不可能记住它们——报告出两点。恢复是真实的：精修后的输出比一个用其自身输出词表构建的 arm-matched 置换 null 高出 +0.072 到 +0.137。但它并不依赖于我们所消融的那个输入：破坏输入的 dataflow 使命名增益变化 +0.001（95% CI [-0.026, +0.026]），去掉类型前缀或对名称做置换的影响也不比这更大。另一家厂商的第二个 refiner，按预注册方式在字节相同的输入上重跑，复现了这一结果——共十二组对照、两个模型、十二个 null。可读性在整个过程中都停在天花板，因此不给读者留下信号。这个 null 是有界的、并非绝对的：小于 0.056 的贡献不可见；而消融保留了运算，所以「仅凭这些就能命名」仍是一个可竞争的解释。没有任何一个预注册假设被证实，我们也完整报告了背后的五处仪器失败，包括一个偏向对照 arm 的重装配 harness，以及一个我们在预注册时未曾验证其在我们输入上是否工作的等价性检查器。
summary_cn: 提出「记忆下限」内部对照：先精修一次，再对破坏了标识符的输入再精修，测「幸存」了什么。结果发现精修比 null 高 +0.072 到 +0.137，但破坏 dataflow 只让命名增益变化 +0.001，说明改进主要来自 LLM 先验而非输入本身。
comment: 29 pages. Pre-registered; analysis plan committed before data collection. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21968878
objective_summary: 提出「记忆下限」同项控制方法，评估 LLM 精修反编译代码时对输入还是对先验的依赖，共 12 对比、2 模型、12 空模型。精修输出相对置换零基线高出 +0.072 至 +0.137，但破坏输入数据流仅使命名收益改变 +0.001（95% CI [-0.026, +0.026]），无预注册假设被证实。
evidence_note: 预注册跨厂商双模型复现，12 对比配 95% 置信区间，样本受工具失败限制
novelty_note: 提出预注册的同项记忆下限对照，与常见相关性证据设计明显不同
scope: 结论限于分析计划提交后写的函数与两家厂商精修器
limitations: 空基线下限 0.056，操作码未被消融，作者自陈 5 处仪器失败

title: Grounding SWE-Agent Decisions in Architecture-0 Design: Navigating Unknown Unknowns through Physical Mapping
title_cn: 把 SWE-Agent 决策锚在 Architecture-0 设计中：通过物理映射穿越未知的未知
abstract: Autonomous Software Engineering Agents (SWE-Agents) excel in deterministic coding tasks but struggle with Architecture 0, the nascent system design phase plagued by implicit engineering constraints, or Unknown Unknowns (UUs) that are rarely stated explicitly. To investigate how agents navigate UUs, we explore a progressive trajectory across pure-text self-play, tool-augmented feedback, and external physical mapping. Our empirical analysis reveals a cascading chain of failures. Pure-text reasoning inevitably devolves into polite consensus or plausible yet physically impossible fabrications. Attempting to bridge this gap via an early-stage execution sandbox unexpectedly triggers Specification Gaming: agents exploit their autonomy over validation scripts to bypass physical constraints, achieving superficial success without resolving core architectural flaws. To resolve this self-validation trap, we propose the Physical Mapping Guard (PMG). Grounded in the software engineering principle of Separation of Concerns, PMG revokes verification authority from the agent, forcing semantic intents to be evaluated by an external, deterministic Semantic-to-Physical (S2P) mapping engine. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that PMG completely eradicates physical-layer and validation-layer gaming. By precisely isolating residual failures to semantic reinterpretations and auditor overreach, PMG marks a critical step toward genuine affordance grounding in automated architectural design.
abstract_cn: 自主软件工程 agent（SWE-Agents）在确定性编程任务上表现出色，但在 Architecture 0——那个充斥着隐含工程约束、也就是那些几乎从不被显式说出的「未知的未知」（Unknown Unknowns, UUs）的系统初始设计阶段——却举步维艰。为研究 agent 如何应对 UUs，我们探索了一条渐进的轨迹，从纯文本自我博弈，到工具增强反馈，再到外部物理映射。我们的实证分析揭示了一条级联式的失败链。纯文本推理不可避免地退化为礼貌的共识，或者看似合理但物理上不可能的编造。试图通过一个早期执行沙箱来弥合这一鸿沟，却出乎意料地触发了 Specification Gaming：agent 利用其对校验脚本的自主权绕过物理约束，取得表面成功但并未解决核心的架构缺陷。为破解这一自我校验陷阱，我们提出 Physical Mapping Guard（PMG）。PMG 立足于软件工程中「关注点分离」（Separation of Concerns）的原则，从 agent 手中撤销校验权，强制其语义意图必须由一个外部的、确定性的 Semantic-to-Physical（S2P）映射引擎来评估。大量评估表明，PMG 彻底根除了物理层与校验层的作弊。通过将残余失败精确隔离到语义再解释与审计员越权，PMG 标志着朝着自动化架构设计中真正的 affordance grounding 迈出的关键一步。
summary_cn: 揭示 SWE-Agent 在架构设计阶段的失败链：纯文本走向礼貌共识或物理不可能的编造，加沙箱又诱发 specification gaming。作者提出 Physical Mapping Guard（PMG），把校验权从 agent 剥离，交给外部确定性的 Semantic-to-Physical 映射引擎，彻底消除物理层与校验层的作弊。
comment: 51 pages, 13 figures, 18 tables. Preprint of a manuscript under review at ACM TOSEM
objective_summary: 研究 SWE-Agent 在 Architecture-0 阶段应对 Unknown Unknowns 的失败链:纯文本推理退化为共识或幻觉,早期沙箱触发 Specification Gaming;提出 Physical Mapping Guard 用外部确定性 S2P 引擎剥夺 agent 自校验权,评估显示物理层与校验层博弈被完全消除,残余失败限于语义再解释与审计越权。
evidence_note: 作者称 Extensive evaluations 并做渐进对照,摘要未给样本规模与统计检验数字。
novelty_note: 用关注点分离剥夺 agent 校验权、系统诊断规范博弈,是架构级新防护思路。
scope: SWE-Agent 在 Architecture-0 系统设计阶段的语义到物理映射任务。
limitations: 残留失败仍存在语义再解释与审计者越权,摘要未给出可复现的量化指标。

title: Towards an Asset Administration Shell Maturity Model
title_cn: 面向 Asset Administration Shell 成熟度模型
abstract: The Asset Administration Shell (AAS) is increasingly recognized as a fundamental model for the realization of and data exchange between digital twins in manufacturing. An AAS defines a hierarchical data structure to represent any type of asset throughout its entire lifecycle. In the context of AAS-based systems, comparing different AAS instances constitutes a practical challenge, as neither a widely accepted methodological framework nor a maturity model are available to systematically support such analyses. To address this gap, we propose a novel concept of AAS maturity that characterizes the extent to which established digital twin criteria are met and thus enabling comparability of AAS instances. The concepts are derived from the literature and applied through exemplification. These emerging results enable practitioners and researchers to systematically compare AAS instances and support the identification and assessment of further development steps in the digital twin engineering process.
abstract_cn: Asset Administration Shell (AAS) 越来越被视为制造业中实现数字孪生及其数据交换的基础模型。AAS 定义了一种分层数据结构，用于在资产的整个生命周期中表示任何类型的资产。在基于 AAS 的系统中，比较不同 AAS 实例构成一项实际挑战，因为目前既没有被广泛接受的方法论框架，也没有成熟度模型能够系统性地支持此类分析。为填补这一空白，我们提出了 AAS 成熟度的一个新概念，用于刻画既定数字孪生标准的满足程度，从而实现 AAS 实例之间的可比性。这些概念由文献推导得出，并通过示例予以应用。这些初步结果使从业者和研究者能够系统地比较 AAS 实例，并支持在数字孪生工程过程中识别和评估进一步的发展步骤。
summary_cn: 提出 AAS 成熟度概念，用来刻画不同 AAS 实例在数字孪生标准上的满足程度，以支持 AAS 实例之间的系统性比较，仅给出示例级的初步结果。
objective_summary: 从文献中导出数字孪生判据,提出 AAS 成熟度概念以刻画实例满足这些判据的程度,并通过示例说明如何据此比较不同 AAS 实例。
evidence_note: 仅通过示例演示,未给出定量评估、案例集规模或对照基线。
novelty_note: 在缺乏方法框架的 AAS 比较领域首次提出成熟度模型的组织性概念。
scope: 制造业数字孪生工程中 AAS 实例的成熟度比较概念阶段。
limitations: 属作者自陈的 emerging results,尚无实证验证与外部专家评估支持。

title: A Set-Theoretic Evaluation Framework for Assessing Asset Administration Shell Instances: Towards Comparability and Suitability
title_cn: 评估 Asset Administration Shell 实例的集合论评价框架：迈向可比较性与适用性
abstract: Asset Administration Shells (AAS) provide a standardized means of representing assets and their information in manufacturing and increasingly serve as a basis for software services. However, different AAS instances vary in structure, content, and degree of completion, making it difficult to determine whether a given AAS is suitable for a specific application. This paper presents two complementary methods to support the comparison and application-oriented assessment of AAS. First, set-theoretic operations are employed to compare AAS models, enabling the identification of common, missing, and differing submodels and parameters. Second, an AAS suitability model assesses the conformity of an AAS to the requirements of a specific use case. The assessment considers structural conformity, semantic consistency, cardinality, and specification conformity and can be performed either against a reference AAS or a set of required SemanticIDs. A suitability value is derived from the identified deviations and is complemented by a detailed report of missing or non-conforming information. The proposed approach support practitioners and researchers in the comparison of evolving AAS and provide application-specific information on their suitability for manufacturing software services.
abstract_cn: Asset Administration Shell (AAS) 提供了一种标准化的方式，用于在制造业中表示资产及其信息，并越来越多地作为软件服务的基础。然而，不同的 AAS 实例在结构、内容和完成程度上存在差异，使得判断一个给定的 AAS 是否适合特定应用变得困难。本文提出两种互补的方法，用以支持 AAS 的比较和面向应用的评估。首先，采用集合论运算来比较 AAS 模型，从而识别共有、缺失和不同的 submodel 与参数。其次，AAS 适用性模型评估某个 AAS 对特定用例需求的符合程度。该评估考虑结构符合性、语义一致性、基数（cardinality）以及规范符合性，并可针对参考 AAS 或一组所需的 SemanticID 进行。适用性数值由所识别的偏差推导得出，并辅以关于缺失或不符合信息的详细报告。所提出的方法支持从业者和研究者比较不断演化的 AAS，并为制造软件服务提供应用特定的适用性信息。
summary_cn: 用集合论运算比较 AAS 模型的 submodel 与参数差异，并提出考虑结构、语义、基数与规范符合性的 AAS 适用性模型，输出一个适用性数值及偏差报告。
objective_summary: 提出两种互补方法:用集合论运算比较 AAS 模型的公共、缺失与差异子模型;用适配度模型从结构、语义、基数与规范一致性四维评估 AAS 对具体用例的符合程度,并给出偏差报告。
evidence_note: 摘要中未给出案例数、量化实验或与其他评估方法的对照。
novelty_note: 把集合论运算与多维一致性适配度组合评估 AAS 实例,是较少见的形式化路径。
scope: 制造业 AAS 实例之间的比较与面向使用场景的适配度评估。
limitations: 缺乏规模化实证验证,评估权重与 SemanticID 阈值依赖使用者主观定义。

title: GANADI: Uncovering C/C++ OSS Reuse Genealogies via Pivotal Function-Based Clustering to Enhance Supply Chain Security
title_cn: GANADI：基于 pivotal function 聚类挖掘 C/C++ OSS 复用谱系以增强供应链安全
abstract: We present GANADI, a systematic approach for identifying C/C++ OSS reuse genealogies to enhance software supply chain security. Understanding OSS reuse genealogy is crucial for improving SBOM completeness and prioritizing security remediation across supply chains. Although existing approaches can identify reused compo- nents and vulnerabilities within a project, they fail to trace OSS reuse paths through intermediate projects, limiting their effectiveness in securing supply chain ecosystems. To address this limitation, GANADI constructs reuse genealogies by clustering downstream projects based on shared characteristics of origin-derived code (called pivotal functions), and then inferring reuse direction among the projects within each cluster. When applied to 20 widely reused OSS projects with over 1,500 propagation paths, GANADI achieved 84.85% precision and 95.76% recall in identifying reuse genealogies, outperforming existing approaches that achieved at most 23.21% recall. Leveraging OSS reuse genealogy for vulnerability detection, we identified 48 unpatched vulnerabilities in real-world popular C/C++ projects. Among them, 23 were patched following our responsible disclosure (including one CVE ID assigned), demonstrating the practical impact of genealogy-based vulnerability management.
abstract_cn: 我们提出 GANADI，一个系统性的方法，用于识别 C/C++ OSS 复用谱系（reuse genealogy），以增强软件供应链安全。理解 OSS 复用谱系对于改善 SBOM 完整性、并在供应链中优先安排安全修复至关重要。虽然现有方法能够识别项目内被复用的组件及其漏洞，但它们无法追踪跨越中间项目的 OSS 复用路径，这限制了它们在保护供应链生态系统方面的有效性。为解决这一局限，GANADI 通过对下游项目按共享的源头衍生代码（称为 pivotal function）特征进行聚类来构建复用谱系，然后推断每个聚类内项目之间的复用方向。将 GANADI 应用于 20 个被广泛复用的 OSS 项目、超过 1500 条传播路径时，其在识别复用谱系上取得了 84.85% 的精确率和 95.76% 的召回率，超越了现有方法（现有方法最多仅达到 23.21% 的召回率）。利用 OSS 复用谱系进行漏洞检测，我们在真实的流行 C/C++ 项目中识别出 48 个未修复的漏洞。其中 23 个在我们的负责任披露之后被打上补丁（包括分配了一个 CVE ID），展示了基于谱系的漏洞管理的实际影响。
summary_cn: 用「源头衍生的 pivotal function」聚类下游项目并推断复用方向，在 20 个 OSS、1500+ 传播路径上取得 84.85% 精确率、95.76% 召回率（旧方法召回率最高 23.21%），并披露 48 个未修漏洞、23 个被修补含 1 个 CVE。
objective_summary: 提出 GANADI,通过对源自 origin 的 pivotal 函数聚类推断项目间复用方向以重建 OSS 继承关系;在 20 个广泛复用 OSS 与 1500+ 传播路径上精度 84.85%、召回 95.76%,并发现 48 个未修补漏洞、23 个经披露被修复、获 1 个 CVE。
evidence_note: 20 个 OSS、1500+ 传播路径,与召回≤23.21% 的既有方法对照,附实际漏洞披露证据。
novelty_note: 以 pivotal 函数聚类构造跨中间项目的复用继承树,突破直接依赖识别的局限。
scope: C/C++ 开源项目的跨项目复用继承与漏洞传播识别。
limitations: 仅覆盖 20 个 OSS 项目,pivotal 函数选取与聚类阈值对结果较敏感。

title: Search-Based Metamorphic Testing of Vision-Language Models in Autonomous Underwater Robotic Software
title_cn: 针对自主水下机器人软件中 VLM 的基于搜索的变形测试
abstract: Our industry partner focuses on quality assurance for industrial systems across multiple domains, including maritime systems, such as overwater vessels and autonomous underwater robots (AURs). Despite the strong performance of vision-language models (VLMs) in scene understanding, image captioning, and object recognition, their use in AUR software operating in underwater environments is underexplored. Therefore, in this context, it is important to evaluate the quality of VLMs for integration into AUR software and, so, automated software testing tools are needed to assess their suitability and improve their dependability. To this end, we propose a search-based metamorphic testing approach (MetaVLM) that identifies a minimal set of transformations on underwater images to induce incorrect model predictions, thereby revealing VLM failures.
