In colonoscopy, 96% of polyps in a six-hospital PolypGen set are found at precision >=0.85, and 19 of 19 polyps across fifteen full REAL-Colon videos at 1.6 false alarms per procedure. In gastroscopy, landmark region is named correctly on 92% of frames from unseen patients, and 37 of 39 held-out neoplasia frames are flagged at specificity 0.91. On one workstation GPU every task runs over 1080p video at about 100 frames per second, faster than PyTorch, ONNX Runtime and TensorRT in all four precision regimes tested. TensorRT comes closest: one pass of our foundation model takes it 3 to 27% longer than ours, and we deliver 6 to 31% more frames per second from frame to results. A second build links no vendor library at all -- our own kernels over Vulkan -- so a site deploys two files and needs no toolkit, no cuDNN and no framework; in f32 it beats the CUDA build on the same card.
abstract_cn: woma 是一个面向胃肠内窥镜的实时基础模型：网络在约一百万帧内窥镜图像上无标签训练，随后从中微调出各项任务模型。我们贡献了一套面向生产的系统化设计流程。需求与合格线在任何一次运行之前就已固定，8 个候选模型按预注册规则筛选，自监督训练走到停止规则为止，随后是微调与部署优化，全部基于同一个自包含库 numbat 完成。我们同时贡献 woma 本体以及两个微调模型，所有报告的结果均如实标注命中或未命中。我们的结肠镜模型能发现并勾勒息肉、命名当前视野所在的结肠段、建议息肉类型并对肠道准备情况打分。我们的胃镜模型能在 22 个协议站点中命名当前站点、标记并勾勒病灶，并命名 7 种发现之一。所有数字都读自训练期间从未见过的数据，交付的权重也是基于该记录挑选。结肠镜方面，PolypGen 六家医院数据集中 96% 的息肉在精度大于等于 0.85 时被检出，REAL-Colon 十五段完整视频中的 19 个息肉全部（19/19）被检出，且每次操作误报 1.6 次。胃镜方面，未见过病人的画面中 92% 能正确命名地标区域，39 帧留出的肿瘤帧中 37 帧在特异度 0.91 下被标记。在一块工作站 GPU 上，每项任务在 1080p 视频上以约 100 帧每秒运行，四种精度配置下均快于 PyTorch、ONNX Runtime 和 TensorRT。TensorRT 与我们最接近：我们的基础模型跑一次比它们的耗时短 3% 到 27%，从帧到结果我们多输出 6% 到 31% 的帧率。第二种构建版本完全不链接任何厂商库——我们自研的 kernel 直接跑在 Vulkan 上——因此现场部署只需两个文件，无需工具链、无需 cuDNN、无需框架；在 f32 精度下，它甚至在同一张卡上跑赢 CUDA 版本。
summary_cn: 为胃肠内窥镜训练的实时基础模型 woma，在 PolypGen 6 家医院数据上以精度大于等于 0.85 检出 96% 息肉，在 REAL-Colon 15 个完整视频中 19/19 命中且每次操作仅 1.6 次误报，单卡 1080p 视频约 100 FPS，比 TensorRT 快 6-31%。
comment: 28 pages, 10 figures (8 in the main text, 2 supplementary), 13 tables (8 in the main text, 5 supplementary). Preprint. Models and run records are available from the corresponding author
objective_summary: 提出 woma，为消化道内镜设计的实时基础模型，约 100 万无标签帧自监督预训练后微调结肠镜与胃镜任务。PolypGen 6 医院 96% 息肉在精度 ≥0.85 下检出，REAL-Colon 15 视频 19/19；胃镜 22 站点 92% 帧命名正确、37/39 新生物学帧被标记；单卡 1080p 约 100 FPS，快于 PyTorch、ONNX 与 TensorRT。
evidence_note: 百万级 SSL 预训练加多院外部测试及 4 种精度对 3 后端对比
novelty_note: SSL 基础模型加实时部署工程与自建 Vulkan 内核的系统级组合
scope: 结论限于消化道结肠镜与胃镜任务及所述单卡推理环境
limitations: 未提及对其他解剖或影像模态的泛化，也未做显著性检验

title: DepthBenchCAD: When Does Deeper Auditing Yield More Reliable Conclusions?
title_cn: DepthBenchCAD：更深的审计何时才能得到更可靠的结论？
abstract: Generative CAD models are expected to remain behaviorally correct after parameter edits, so increasing the number of edit checks is often treated as a direct route to more reliable evaluation. Under a fixed budget, however, auditing each program more thoroughly reduces the number of tasks and independent generations that can be evaluated, which can ultimately make model-level estimates less accurate. We study this phenomenon and the conditions under which it arises. We decompose behavioral evaluation into three evidence levels: task templates, stochastic generations, and within-program edits. We define an average failure risk that is invariant to audit depth, and combine three-level variance with measured execution costs to analyze the tradeoff between deeper edit auditing and broader independent coverage. Experiments across two CAD environments and five generation systems show that the value of deeper auditing depends on where evaluation uncertainty originates. When template heterogeneity or generation stochasticity dominates, additional edit checks can increase total estimation error; when within-program state variation is large and generation is expensive, deeper auditing is more valuable. Variance and cost estimates from calibration predict the direction of this change and provide a diagnostic basis for allocating evidence on held-out tasks. These results show that the thoroughness of program inspection can diverge from the reliability of model evaluation, and they help determine whether the next unit of budget should be spent on a new task, a new generation, or additional edit checks.
abstract_cn: 生成式 CAD 模型被期望在参数编辑之后依然保持行为正确，因此增加编辑检查数量常被视为通向更可靠评测的直接路径。然而在固定预算下，对每个程序进行更彻底的审计，会减少可评测的任务与独立生成数量，从而反而可能让模型级估计变得更不准确。我们研究这一现象及其成立条件。我们将行为评测分解为三个证据层级：任务模板、随机生成、程序内编辑。我们定义了一个对审计深度不变的平均失败风险，并将三层方差与实测执行成本相结合，来分析「更深的编辑审计」与「更广的独立覆盖」之间的取舍。在 2 个 CAD 环境和 5 个生成系统上的实验表明，加深审计的价值取决于评测不确定性的来源。当模板异质性或生成随机性占主导时，追加编辑检查反而会增大总估计误差；当程序内状态差异较大且生成开销高昂时，加深审计更有价值。来自校准阶段的方差与成本估计可以预测这一变化方向，并为在留出任务上分配证据提供诊断依据。结果表明，程序检查的彻底程度可能与模型评测的可靠性背道而驰，并可帮助判断下一单位预算应该花在新任务、新生成，还是新增编辑检查上。
summary_cn: 将生成式 CAD 模型评测分解为任务模板、随机生成、程序内编辑三层证据，指出固定预算下加深单程序审计反而会降低模型级估计精度；跨 2 个 CAD 环境 5 个生成系统实验证明「深度审计」的价值取决于方差来源。
comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, 20 tables. Preprint
objective_summary: 针对生成式 CAD 评测提出模板、生成、编辑三层证据分解，并定义与审计深度无关的平均失败风险，用方差与执行代价分析深度审计与广度覆盖的取舍。在 2 个 CAD 环境与 5 个生成系统上表明深度价值取决于不确定性来源，方差-代价估计可预测该方向。
evidence_note: 2 个 CAD 环境乘 5 个生成系统的实验规模有限，附方差-代价建模
novelty_note: 指出检查彻底性与评估可靠性可发散，并给出诊断分配方案
scope: 结论限于两个 CAD 参数编辑评测环境与 5 个生成系统
limitations: 仅两个环境难外推到其他生成程序评测，深审代价高

title: OpenAl4S: Code as Action, Science as Sessions
title_cn: OpenAI4S:代码即行动,科学即会话
abstract: AI co-scientists could accelerate computational research, but over a long-running study the workflow also has to stay inspectable, resumable and reproducible, which requires persistent computational state and provenance. Here we present OpenAI4S, an open-source scientific research agent built around the principle of \emph{Code as Action, Science as Sessions}. OpenAI4S combines a persistent computing runtime with research-session management: orchestration is handled through structured tool calls, while scientific actions are represented as complete code cells executed in persistent Python and R kernels. An append-only Action Ledger, per-cell execution records, versioned artifacts, environment records, and workspace checkpoints preserve how results were produced and support session recovery, branching, and extension. Configurable sandboxing, permission controls, and code and trajectory screening provide complementary safeguards. We evaluate OpenAI4S on 36 research scenarios spanning retrosynthesis, molecular dynamics, protein binder design, protein mutation, catalyst screening, and mineral spectroscopy, measuring scientific task accuracy, workflow completeness, and reproducibility of the resulting repositories. OpenAI4S achieves an overall score of 7.83, compared with 5.7--6.4 for a general-purpose coding harness evaluated with three frontier models, with the largest gains on long-horizon and computation-intensive workflows. These results suggest that integrating persistent execution with session-level provenance can improve the reliability of AI-assisted scientific workflows. Environment specification and full rerunnability remain weak for every evaluated system, ours included, so reproducibility is still an open problem for scientific agents. The system is available under the MIT license at \href{https://github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/OpenAI4S}{github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/OpenAI4S}.
abstract_cn: AI 协同科学家有望加速计算研究,但在一项长期运行的研究中,工作流也必须保持可检查、可恢复和可复现,这需要持久的计算状态与溯源。本文提出 OpenAI4S,一个围绕「Code as Action, Science as Sessions」原则构建的开源科研 agent。OpenAI4S 把持久计算运行时和研究会话管理结合起来:编排通过结构化工具调用处理,而科研动作被表示为在持久 Python 与 R 内核中执行的完整代码单元。仅追加的 Action Ledger、每单元执行记录、版本化制品、环境记录以及工作区检查点保存了结果是如何产生的,并支持会话恢复、分支与扩展。可配置的沙箱、权限控制以及代码和轨迹筛查提供了互补的安全保障。我们在覆盖逆合成、分子动力学、蛋白结合物设计、蛋白突变、催化剂筛选和矿物光谱学的 36 个研究场景上评估 OpenAI4S,衡量科学任务准确性、工作流完整性以及所生成仓库的可复现性。OpenAI4S 取得 7.83 的总体分数,相比之下,以三个前沿模型评测的通用编码 harness 得分为 5.7 到 6.4,在长视野和计算密集型工作流上收益最大。这些结果表明,把持久执行与会话级溯源结合起来可以提升 AI 辅助科研工作流的可靠性。环境规范和完整可重跑性对每一个被评估的系统(包括我们自己的)都仍然薄弱,因此可复现性对科研 agent 而言仍是一个开放问题。系统在 MIT 许可下于 github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/OpenAI4S 提供。
summary_cn: 提出开源科研 agent OpenAI4S,把持久 Python/R 内核 + Action Ledger + 版本化制品 + 工作区检查点作为「代码即行动、科学即会话」的实现;在 36 个科研场景上总分 7.83,通用编码 harness 只有 5.7-6.4,长视野任务收益最大,但环境规范与完整可重跑仍是短板。
objective_summary: 提出科研 Agent OpenAI4S，将行动表示为在持久 Python/R 内核中执行的代码单元，并配 Action Ledger、版本化产物与工作区检查点。在逆合成、分子动力学、蛋白设计等 36 个场景上综合得分 7.83，通用编码框架配 3 个前沿模型为 5.7 到 6.4，长程与计算密集工作流增益最大。
evidence_note: 36 场景对比通用编码框架加 3 个前沿模型，规模适中缺显著性检验
novelty_note: 持久内核与会话级溯源组合于科研 Agent，是方向的实质集成
scope: 结论限于逆合成、分子动力学、蛋白设计等 36 个计算科学场景
limitations: 作者明确所有系统在环境规范与完全可复现性上仍不足

title: Cross-Ecosystem Packages As Multilingual: Prevalence, Architecture, and Health
title_cn: 跨生态包作为多语言实体：普遍性、架构与健康度
abstract: Modern software development increasingly relies on using multiple programming languages. Some software packages are published to multiple package ecosystems such as NPM for JavaScript and PyPI for Python. Little is known about cross-ecosystem packages, especially regarding how they are structured. In this paper, we conduct a large-scale empirical study of over six million packages across six major ecosystems to understand 1) how prevalent cross-ecosystem packages are among all packages, 2) whether there are distinct source code architectural patterns that cross-ecosystem packages use, and 3) whether there are correlations between architectural patterns and project health metrics from GitHub. Results indicate that cross-ecosystem packages constitute a small but important, growing fraction of packages. We identify five distinct architectural patterns. For example, packages that implement code generation from a shared source file or use language bindings are associated with significantly higher community visibility and development activity. Based on our findings, we provide implications for package adopters, maintainers, and researchers. We envision our taxonomy being used for future investigations into several aspects of software development, such as the trade-offs between focusing on one language and translating to other languages using bindings, templating, and wrappers, versus using native code and native functions to support additional languages.
abstract_cn: 现代软件开发越来越依赖多种编程语言。有些软件包会被同时发布到多个包生态，例如面向 JavaScript 的 NPM 和面向 Python 的 PyPI。人们对跨生态包所知甚少，尤其是它们的结构方式。本文对 6 大主要生态中超过 600 万个包进行了一次大规模实证研究，以理解：1）跨生态包在所有包中的普遍程度；2）跨生态包是否存在明显不同的源代码架构模式；3）架构模式与来自 GitHub 的项目健康度指标之间是否存在相关性。结果表明，跨生态包在包总数中只占一小部分，但重要且正在增长。我们识别出五种不同的架构模式。举例来说，那些从共享源文件生成代码或使用语言绑定实现的包，与显著更高的社区可见度和开发活跃度相关联。基于我们的发现，我们为包的采用者、维护者和研究者给出了若干启示。我们设想我们的分类法可被用于未来对软件开发若干层面的研究，例如：聚焦单一语言并借助 bindings、templating、wrappers 翻译到其他语言，与使用原生代码和原生函数支持额外语言之间的权衡。
summary_cn: 跨 6 大生态、超 600 万个包的大规模挖掘研究，识别出 5 种跨生态架构模式，发现基于共享源文件代码生成或语言绑定的包在社区可见度与开发活跃度上显著更高。
objective_summary: 对 6 个主流包生态系统超 600 万个包做实证研究，量化跨生态包的比例并识别 5 种源代码架构模式及其与 GitHub 健康指标的关联。跨生态包比例小但持续增长，代码生成与语言绑定模式关联更高的社区可见度与开发活跃度。
evidence_note: 6 个生态系统超 600 万包的大规模统计，附健康指标相关性分析
novelty_note: 首个跨生态多语言包的大规模实证与架构分类，切入点新
scope: 结论限于 NPM、PyPI 等 6 个主流包生态的开源包样本
limitations: 主要呈现相关性而非因果，架构模式识别的稳健性未详述

title: Externalizing Requirement-to-Repair Artifacts as Observable Traces for LLM-Based Program Repair
title_cn: 把「需求到修复」制品外化为可观察轨迹以支持 LLM 程序修复
abstract: Repository-level repair requires not only correct patches but also inspectable records that explain how issue requirements are translated into code changes and post-edit evidence. We contribute THEMIS, a stage-aware repair workflow that externalizes this requirement-to-repair process through semantic interpretation, a runtime requirement-code graph, graph-derived Developer guidance, retained repair rationale and patches, and post-edit audit records. A retrospective audit of 300 SWE-bench Lite cases demonstrates that these artifacts provide broad support for cross-stage inspection: a complete Developer rationale is available for 288 cases, and 214 cases (71.3%) retain a complete audited field set connecting the selected stages. The retained records further enable systematic measurement of cross-stage correspondence: target symbols recur in 62.6% of Developer rationales and in 62.8% of patches, rising to 75.8% when related symbols are included. In a paired 100-case comparison, the relational workflow resolves 19 cases versus 9 for the direct same-input condition; because the two conditions also differ in Analyzer output, graph-derived distillation, and Judge records, we report this as preliminary, workflow-level evidence rather than a causal effect of the graph component. Together, these results show that THEMIS makes otherwise implicit requirement-to-repair transitions inspectable, enabling systematic examination of how repair decisions persist, align, and evolve across stages.
abstract_cn: 仓库级修复不仅需要正确的补丁,还需要可检查的记录来解释问题需求是如何被翻译成代码变更以及编辑后的证据。我们贡献了 THEMIS,一个具有阶段感知能力的修复工作流,它通过语义解释、运行时的需求-代码图、由图派生的开发者指导、保留下来的修复理由与补丁以及编辑后审计记录,把这一「需求到修复」过程外化。对 SWE-bench Lite 上 300 个案例的回顾性审计表明,这些制品为跨阶段检查提供了广泛支持:288 个案例拥有完整的开发者理由,214 个案例 (71.3%) 保留了连接所选阶段的完整审计字段集。这些保留的记录进一步支持了对跨阶段对应关系的系统性度量:目标符号在 62.6% 的开发者理由中和 62.8% 的补丁中出现,若纳入相关符号则上升到 75.8%。在 100 个配对案例的比较中,关系型工作流解决了 19 个案例,而相同输入的直接条件解决了 9 个;由于两种条件在 Analyzer 输出、图派生的蒸馏和 Judge 记录上也存在差异,我们把这一结果作为初步的、工作流层面的证据来报告,而非图组件的因果效应。综合来看,这些结果表明 THEMIS 让原本隐式的「需求到修复」转换变得可检查,从而支持系统性地考察修复决策如何在各阶段持续、对齐与演化。
summary_cn: 提出仓库级修复工作流 THEMIS,通过语义解释、运行时的「需求-代码图」、开发者指导、修复理由和补丁以及编辑后审计把「需求到补丁」全过程外化为可审计制品;SWE-bench Lite 300 案例中 288 个有完整开发者理由、214 个 (71.3%) 保留完整审计字段,配对 100 案例里比同输入直修解决 19 vs 9。
comment: Accepted at REALM Workshop, EMNLP 2026. Code: this https URL
objective_summary: 提出 THEMIS 阶段感知修复工作流，将需求到修复过程外化为可审计工件。SWE-bench Lite 300 例回溯审计中 288 例有完整 Developer 说明、214 例（71.3%）保留完整审计字段；100 例配对比较该工作流解决 19 例、直接方法 9 例。
evidence_note: 300 例 SWE-bench Lite 审计加 100 例配对比较，条件差异多
novelty_note: 在 LLM 修复中引入需求-代码图与阶段审计工件，属方向实质补强
scope: 结论限于 SWE-bench Lite 仓库级修复及所用 LLM 组件
limitations: 作者自陈两条件差异多，未主张图组件的因果效应

title: Toward Sustainable AI Deployment: A Carbon-Aware Decision Framework for Enterprise Supply Chain Systems
title_cn: 面向可持续 AI 部署：企业供应链系统的碳感知决策框架
abstract: Enterprises deploying AI for supply chain decisions commonly default to the largest available language model, a procurement heuristic that neglects both empirical performance and environmental cost. We benchmark six large language models across 520 supply chain tasks, simultaneously measuring decision quality and estimated generation-related operational carbon. Drawing on the Technology-Organization-Environment (TOE) framework, we develop a Carbon-Aware AI Procurement Framework (CAAPF), a Green IS design artifact that operationalizes sustainable AI governance for enterprise procurement. Within this bounded sample, quality spans 0.497-0.723, and the models with the largest disclosed parameter totals do not achieve the highest scores. The design does not isolate size, provider, architecture, or benchmark-construction effects. A category-by-tier calibrated GreenRoute proof of concept reaches 0.733 mean out-of-sample quality at an estimated 0.402 gCO2/task. Static Haiku reaches 0.699 at 0.022 gCO2/task, while Sonnet reaches 0.723 at 0.401 gCO2/task, demonstrating that the preferred strategy depends on the organization's quality requirement. Our "benchmark first, select green" principle suggests that environmental responsibility and decision quality can be mutually reinforcing, contributing to sustainable digital infrastructure governance aligned with SDG 12 and SDG 13.
abstract_cn: 部署 AI 用于供应链决策的企业通常会默认选择可获得的最大语言模型，这是一种忽视实证性能与环境成本的采购启发式。我们在 520 个供应链任务上对 6 个大语言模型进行基准测试，同时度量决策质量与与生成相关的估算运营碳排放。以「技术-组织-环境」（TOE）框架为基础，我们发展出一个碳感知 AI 采购框架（CAAPF），一种把可持续 AI 治理落到企业采购层面的绿色信息系统设计工件。在这一有限样本内，质量分数介于 0.497 到 0.723 之间，而已披露参数量最大的模型并未取得最高分。该设计并不能分离出模型规模、供应商、架构或基准构造效应。一个按类别与层级校准的 GreenRoute 概念验证在样本外达到 0.733 的平均质量，对应约 0.402 gCO2 每任务。静态调用 Haiku 达到 0.699 质量、0.022 gCO2 每任务，而 Sonnet 达到 0.723 质量、0.401 gCO2 每任务，说明首选策略取决于组织对质量的要求。我们「先基准、再择绿」的原则表明，环境责任与决策质量可以互相强化，从而为与 SDG 12 和 SDG 13 对齐的可持续数字基础设施治理作出贡献。
summary_cn: 在 520 个供应链任务上对 6 个 LLM 同时测决策质量与碳排放，提出 CAAPF 采购框架：Haiku 以 0.699 质量仅 0.022 gCO2/任务，Sonnet 0.723 质量对应 0.401 gCO2/任务，说明最大模型并非最优。
objective_summary: 在 520 个供应链任务上评测 6 个 LLM 的决策质量与运行碳排，构建碳感知采购框架 CAAPF。质量区间 0.497-0.723，GreenRoute 概念验证达 0.733 质量与 0.402 gCO2/任务，Haiku 为 0.699/0.022 gCO2，Sonnet 为 0.723/0.401 gCO2。
evidence_note: 6 个模型、520 个任务的基准评测并含碳排估算，但作者自陈未隔离规模/架构/基准构造效应。
novelty_note: 在 TOE 框架下将质量-碳排双目标显式化为采购决策工件，为已有绿色 IS 方向的实质延伸。
scope: 限于 520 个供应链决策任务的 6 个 LLM，碳排为生成阶段估算值，非全生命周期。
limitations: 样本有限、未隔离模型规模等混杂因素，碳排为估算而非实测。

title: Efficiency Hallucination: Formalizing and Measuring Behavioral Calibration in LLM-Based Code Optimization
title_cn: 效率幻觉：形式化并度量 LLM 代码优化中的行为校准
abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into automated code optimization introduces a critical reliability risk we term the Efficiency Hallucination: an LLM's tendency to issue non-functional mutations with unsubstantiated performance claims on already-optimized code. This is driven by the Evaluation Trap, wherein binary benchmarks incentivize unnecessary modifications over safely abstaining. We present a validation framework using classification penalty methods, evaluated across 180 optimization runs on nine models (GPT, Claude, Gemini) using EffiBench. Under standard prompts, models exhibit a 100% over-edit rate on optimal code. Our guardrail raises correct abstention from 0% to to 44.4%, preserving a 100% edit rate on sub-optimal code with zero false abstentions. Calibration is uneven: GPT-5.4 Mini approaches near-perfect abstention, and simple code is recognized more reliably than complex code. Our framework offers a training-free mechanism to mitigate LLM overconfidence before deployment in production.
abstract_cn: 将大语言模型（LLM）整合进自动化代码优化，会引入一种关键的可靠性风险，我们称之为「效率幻觉」（Efficiency Hallucination）：LLM 倾向于对已经最优的代码给出无功能改变的变异，同时附上无从证实的性能声明。这一现象由「评测陷阱」驱动：二元基准激励模型进行不必要的修改，而不是安全地选择弃权。我们提出一个使用分类惩罚方法的验证框架，并在基于 EffiBench 的 9 个模型（GPT、Claude、Gemini）共 180 次优化运行上进行评估。在标准 prompt 下，各模型对最优代码的过度编辑率达到 100%。我们的守卫机制把正确弃权率从 0% 提升到 44.4%，同时在次优代码上保持 100% 的编辑率，且零错误弃权。校准并不均匀：GPT-5.4 Mini 已接近完美弃权，简单代码比复杂代码更容易被正确识别。我们的框架提供了一种免训练的机制，可在部署到生产之前缓解 LLM 的过度自信。
summary_cn: 定义 LLM 在已最优代码上仍瞎改的「效率幻觉」，在 EffiBench 上 9 个模型 180 次优化中标准 prompt 下过度编辑率高达 100%；提出的守卫将正确弃权率从 0% 提到 44.4%，同时对次优代码保持 100% 编辑率、零误弃权。
objective_summary: 提出「效率幻觉」概念，在 EffiBench 上用 9 个模型（GPT/Claude/Gemini）跑 180 次优化实验，测量对已优化代码的过度编辑率。标准提示下过度编辑率 100%，加入 guardrail 后正确弃权率从 0% 提升到 44.4%，且对次优代码保持 100% 编辑率、零错误弃权。
evidence_note: 9 个模型、180 次运行、基于 EffiBench，有前后对照，但未提统计检验和多次重复。
novelty_note: 首次形式化「效率幻觉」与「评测陷阱」，提出无需训练的弃权 guardrail 机制。
scope: 结论限于 EffiBench 上 9 个商用 LLM 的代码效率优化任务，涉及 GPT/Claude/Gemini。
limitations: 仅在 EffiBench 一个基准上验证，弃权率 44.4% 距离完美仍有较大差距。

title: The Case for Automated Hyperspecialization: Evidence from SAT
title_cn: 自动化超专业化的理由: 来自 SAT 的证据
abstract: The software status quo is to use one system to process many different kinds of inputs. In contrast, we propose hyperspecialization: creating new software that is optimized for a single class of inputs. Hyperspecializing manually is anywhere from expensive to impossible. We conjecture that coding agents make automated hyperspecialization cheap, effective, and safe for problems with measurable performance and checkable output. This paper explores one such problem, SAT solving, by synthesizing hundreds of workload-specific SAT solvers at an average cost of \$37 each. Our specialists outperform their competition-winning, general-purpose cousins by 5$\times$ on average, and by over $10\times$ on a quarter of benchmark families. A general-purpose solver constructed from over a hundred of our prototype hyperspecialists won the SAT track at the 2026 SAT Competition.
abstract_cn: 软件领域的现状是使用一个系统处理许多不同类型的输入。与之相反, 我们提出超专业化 (hyperspecialization): 创建针对单一输入类别优化的新软件。手工进行超专业化的成本从昂贵到不可能不等。我们推测: 对于性能可度量、输出可校验的问题, coding agents 能让自动化超专业化变得廉价、有效且安全。本文以 SAT 求解为例探索这样一个问题, 以每个平均 37 美元的成本合成了数百个针对特定工作负载的 SAT 求解器。我们的专用求解器在平均意义上比赢得竞赛的通用同类快 5 倍, 在四分之一的基准家族上快 10 倍以上。由我们的一百多个原型超专业化求解器组合而成的通用求解器赢得了 2026 SAT Competition 的 SAT 赛道冠军。
summary_cn: 用 coding agents 以每个平均 37 美元的成本合成数百个针对特定工作负载的 SAT 求解器, 平均比赢得竞赛的通用求解器快 5 倍、四分之一基准家族上快 10 倍以上; 由 100 多个原型组合成的通用求解器夺得 2026 SAT Competition 冠军。
objective_summary: 主张自动化超专化：由编码代理为特定输入类合成软件。以 SAT 求解为例合成数百个工作负载专用求解器，平均单成本 37 美元，专用求解器平均比通用胜赛求解器快 5 倍，在四分之一基准族上超过 10 倍；由上百个专用原型组合的通用求解器赢得 2026 SAT Competition 主赛道。
evidence_note: 以 SAT 领域数百个合成求解器给出速度倍数并赢得 2026 SAT Competition 主赛道，规模显著但无统计检验。
novelty_note: 提出以编码代理批量合成输入类专用系统的超专化范式，并以竞赛级证据支撑，方向少见。
scope: 结论限于 SAT 求解这一具有可度量性能与可核对输出的问题类，其他领域仅为推测。
limitations: 仅在 SAT 上给出证据，是否可推广到无可核对输出的问题仍属作者所述之推测。

title: Trust by Design: Trust Calibration Through Non-Advisory Socratic Dialogue in Conversational Agents
title_cn: 从设计上建立信任: 通过非建议式苏格拉底对话进行信任校准
abstract: As conversational AI systems increasingly operate in sensitive domains, the central challenge shifts from usability to trust calibration, ensuring that users rely on systems neither too much nor too little. Systems that provide advice or interpretations risk encouraging inappropriate reliance, particularly when users perceive AI outputs as authoritative. We present CASELy, a conversational agent explicitly designed to limit its own authority through non-advisory Socratic dialogue. The agent asks reflective questions grounded exclusively in user input and refuses to provide advice, recommendations, or interpretations. This design operationalizes trust calibration by constraining agent agency rather than optimizing capability. In a pilot randomized controlled study with higher education students, participants interacting with the Socratic dialogue reported substantially higher user experience (UEQ-S overall = 1.50) compared to a non-dialogue control (0). Qualitative findings identify three mechanisms supporting calibrated trust: transparency through visible grounding, preservation of user decision authority, and reduced fear of judgment. We argue that appropriate reliance can be achieved through interactional constraints, offering a design pattern for trustworthy conversational AI in sensitive contexts.
abstract_cn: 随着对话式 AI 系统日益部署于敏感领域, 核心挑战正从可用性转向信任校准 (trust calibration), 即确保用户既不过度依赖也不欠依赖系统。提供建议或解读的系统有诱导不当依赖的风险, 尤其当用户将 AI 输出视为权威时。我们提出 CASELy, 一种通过非建议式苏格拉底对话来明确限制自身权威的对话式 agent。该 agent 只基于用户输入提出反思性问题, 拒绝给出建议、推荐或解读。此设计通过约束 agent 的能动性 (agency) 而非优化其能力, 将信任校准落地。在一项面向高等教育学生的随机对照试点研究中, 与苏格拉底对话交互的参与者报告的用户体验 (UEQ-S 总分 = 1.50) 显著高于无对话对照组 (0)。定性发现识别出支持校准信任的三种机制: 通过可见的溯源实现透明性、保留用户的决策权, 以及降低被评判的顾虑。我们主张适度依赖可通过交互式约束达成, 为敏感场景中的可信对话式 AI 提供了一种设计模式。
summary_cn: 提出 CASELy 对话式 agent, 只提反思性问题、拒绝给建议; 一项高教学生随机对照试点中苏格拉底组 UEQ-S 总分 1.50 显著高于对照组 0, 主张以交互式约束而非能力优化实现校准信任。
objective_summary: 提出 CASELy，一个只用非建议式苏格拉底式追问、拒绝给出建议或解释的对话代理，用以校准信任。高等教育学生的随机对照初步试验显示，苏格拉底组 UEQ-S 总分为 1.50，对照组为 0，并总结出可见基础、决策权保留、降低评判恐惧三类机制。
evidence_note: 仅为随机对照的 pilot 研究，摘要未报样本量与统计检验，仅给出 UEQ-S 均分与定性主题。
novelty_note: 把信任校准操作化为限制代理权威的交互约束，方向已有讨论但具体设计模式较新。
scope: 结论限于高等教育学生场景下的对话式代理原型，仅为 pilot 规模。
limitations: 样本规模与显著性未披露，指标以主观 UEQ-S 为主，长期依赖效果未评估。

title: Transformed in Translation: Two-Stage Structural Uncertainty in LLM-Based Scientific Autoformalization
title_cn: 翻译中被变形:LLM 科学自形式化中的两阶段结构性不确定性
abstract: Scientific autoformalization turns verbal accounts into executable mathematics, but executable code does not settle which model has been constructed. We examine two sources of structural uncertainty: the formalizer that generates a response law, and the recurrence that turns that law into trajectories. In secondary analyses of an openly archived crossed experiment, we studied 320 response maps generated by two pinned language-model formalizers from five engineered cognitive accounts within one sparse quadratic grammar and 16 randomized blocks. With whole blocks held out, source-account identity was recovered at 78.8% accuracy (chance 20.0%) and formalizer identity at 96.3% (chance 50.0%; both p < 0.001). Program size was the stronger single feature family; a pre-specified exploratory comparison found no stable source-account predictive gain from local geometry beyond size. Holding every response map fixed, we then evaluated five recurrence families spanning 33 configurations and 1,013,760 finite-horizon trajectories. Added feedback, projection and leak produced sharply different outcome distributions. The consequential distinction was which comparisons survived: median cross-recurrence rank concordance was 0.73 for endpoint magnitude but 0.05 for settling, among the configuration pairs with defined rankings. Thus a common mathematical language did not erase translation provenance, and robust ordering under one observable did not transfer to another. Scientific autoformalization is usefully studied as model-space construction: the generated ensemble and its dynamical embedding are both part of the specification supporting a scientific claim.
abstract_cn: 科学自形式化把口头描述转化为可执行的数学,但可执行代码并不能确定构建了哪一个模型。我们检视两种结构性不确定性来源:生成响应律的形式化器,以及把该律转化为轨迹的递推。在对一个公开归档的交叉实验的二次分析中,我们研究了 320 个响应映射,它们由两个固定的语言模型形式化器从一个稀疏二次语法内的五个工程化认知描述在 16 个随机化区块中生成。在把整个区块保留出来的情况下,源描述身份以 78.8% 的准确率被恢复(随机水平 20.0%),形式化器身份以 96.3% 被恢复(随机水平 50.0%;两者 p 均小于 0.001)。程序大小是更强的单一特征族;一项预先设定的探索性比较发现,在大小之外,从局部几何得到的源描述预测增益并不稳定。在保持每个响应映射不变的前提下,我们随后在 33 种配置、1,013,760 条有限视野轨迹上评估了五个递推族。加入反馈、投影和渗漏会产生截然不同的结果分布。关键的区分是哪些比较能够存活:在具有明确排序的配置对里,跨递推排序一致性的中位数在终点幅值上为 0.73,但在稳态时间上为 0.05。因此,共同的数学语言并未抹去翻译的溯源,并且在一个可观察量下稳健的排序无法迁移到另一个上。科学自形式化被有益地视作模型空间的构建来研究:生成的集合及其动力学嵌入都是支持某项科学主张的规范的一部分。
summary_cn: 对 320 个响应映射和 33 种递推配置下的 1,013,760 条轨迹做二次分析,发现源认知描述身份可以被 78.8% 恢复、形式化器身份 96.3%,并且终点幅值下的排序一致性 (0.73) 无法迁移到稳态时间下 (0.05),说明共同数学语言并未抹去自形式化的翻译溯源。
objective_summary: 在开放交叉实验的二次分析中，用两个语言模型形式化器与 5 个认知账目生成 320 个响应图，按块留出可 78.8% 恢复源账目、96.3% 恢复形式化器身份（p<0.001）；再评 5 类递推 33 配置 1013760 条轨迹，端点幅值中位排序一致性 0.73，沉降为 0.05。
evidence_note: 320 响应图 + 1013760 条轨迹的大规模二次分析，含显著性检验与随机化块，无外部数据集对照。
novelty_note: 把科学自动形式化视作模型空间构造并度量两阶段结构不确定性，视角新但方法沿用既有统计流程。
scope: 结论限于稀疏二次语法下的两个形式化器、五个认知账目、五族递推的模拟环境。
limitations: 所有分析基于单一稀疏二次语法与两模型二次数据，可外推性依赖该受控设置。

title: Enhancing Automated Unit Test Generation for NLP Libraries Using Large Language Models
title_cn: 用大语言模型增强 NLP 库的自动化单元测试生成
abstract: Automated unit test generation tools like EvoSuite perform well on general-purpose software but often struggle with domain-specific software such as Natural Language Processing (NLP) libraries, where inputs must follow semantic, syntactic, and structural constraints. Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate domain-relevant test code, but tests produced by LLMs alone often fail to compile or achieve sufficient coverage. We propose LLMSuite, a hybrid test generation framework that integrates self-refinement prompting with class-level LLM reasoning into the search-based testing process. In this mechanism, the LLM iteratively improves its test snippets based on feedback from previous generations. This enables the model to produce increasingly precise, domain-consistent code fragments that steer the evolutionary search toward exercising complex and otherwise hard-to-reach behaviors. When no objective improves over multiple generations in the underlying evolutionary algorithm, these refined snippets are parsed and injected into EvoSuite's population to expand the search space. To support our evaluation, we constructed a new dataset comprising 100 classes drawn from five widely used Java NLP projects. We also re-implemented CodaMOSA, a recent hybrid SBST-LLM technique, in Java to enable a direct comparison. Across this dataset, LLMSuite improves branch and line coverage by approximately 10% and 8%, respectively, and achieves an 11% higher mutation score than CodaMOSA-J. Compared to EvoSuite, LLMSuite yields roughly 15% higher branch and line coverage and 5% higher mutation score. Against an LLM-only baseline, it improves structural coverage by 36% and mutation score by about 24.7 percentage points. Finally, LLMSuite complements manually written test suites by exercising domain-specific behaviors that are often left untested.
abstract_cn: 像 EvoSuite 这样的自动化单元测试生成工具在通用软件上表现良好, 但在自然语言处理 (NLP) 库等特定领域软件上常常表现不佳——这类软件的输入必须满足语义、句法和结构约束。大语言模型 (LLMs) 能生成与领域相关的测试代码, 但仅由 LLM 生成的测试常常无法编译或达到足够的覆盖率。我们提出 LLMSuite, 一种混合测试生成框架, 将自我精化提示与类级 LLM 推理集成到基于搜索的测试过程中。在该机制下, LLM 基于前几代反馈迭代改进其测试片段, 使模型能产出愈发精确、符合领域约束的代码片段, 从而引导进化搜索去触发复杂而原本难以到达的行为。当底层进化算法在多代内目标均未改善时, 这些精化片段会被解析并注入 EvoSuite 的种群中以扩展搜索空间。为支持评估, 我们构建了一个新数据集, 包含来自五个广泛使用的 Java NLP 项目的 100 个类; 我们还在 Java 上重新实现了近期的 SBST-LLM 混合技术 CodaMOSA 以便直接对比。在该数据集上, LLMSuite 相比 CodaMOSA-J 将分支与行覆盖率分别提升约 10% 与 8%, 变异分数高出 11%。与 EvoSuite 相比, LLMSuite 的分支与行覆盖率高约 15%, 变异分数高 5%。相对仅使用 LLM 的基线, LLMSuite 将结构覆盖率提升 36%, 变异分数提升约 24.7 个百分点。最后, LLMSuite 与人工编写的测试套件互补, 覆盖了那些常被忽略的领域相关行为。
summary_cn: LLMSuite 把类级 LLM 推理与自我精化提示注入 EvoSuite 的进化搜索; 在 5 个 Java NLP 项目 100 个类上比 EvoSuite 分支/行覆盖率高约 15%、变异分数高 5%, 比 CodaMOSA-J 分支/行覆盖率高 10%/8%、变异分数高 11%。
comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables
objective_summary: 提出 LLMSuite，把 LLM 类级自我精化片段注入 EvoSuite 进化搜索，用于 NLP 库单元测试生成。在来自 5 个 Java NLP 项目的 100 类数据集上，相比 CodaMOSA-J 分支/行覆盖提升约 10%/8%、变异分数提升 11%；相比 EvoSuite 分支/行覆盖高约 15%、变异分数高 5%；相比纯 LLM 结构覆盖高 36%。
evidence_note: 100 类新建数据集，覆盖 CodaMOSA-J、EvoSuite、纯 LLM 三种基线，多指标对照但未报告显著性检验。
novelty_note: 把 LLM 精化片段注入进化搜索是既有 SBST+LLM 方向上的实质结合与改进，非全新范式。
scope: 结论限于 Java NLP 库的类级单元测试生成，数据集为 5 个项目共 100 类。
limitations: 样本仅 100 类且局限于 Java NLP 领域，LLM 调用成本与稳定性未报告。

title: The Stochastic Deputy: Structural Tenant Isolation for Tool-Using LLM Agents
title_cn: 随机代理人:面向工具调用型 LLM Agent 的结构性租户隔离
abstract: Multi-tenant tools commonly accept a tenant identifier and validate it against the caller's entitlement. For a large language model (LLM) agent, that pattern delegates resource selection to a process whose context may contain attacker controlled instructions. We formalize this stochastic deputy problem and present a structural defense: remove tenant identity from the Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool schema, bind scope to a verified credential, and enforce it below the agent. In a 373-trial ablation across eight model configurations and two transports, a correctly validated tenant parameter served every out-of-scope attempt: 26 of 26, or 26 of 41 plausible-pretext trials overall. With the parameter removed, no tool signature could express the read. Twelve of 56 trials instead escaped the interface by forging writable scope, showing that interface invariance requires cryptographically protected context. On a production dataset containing multiple GBs of data, set-valued scope caused a measured $57\times$ latency ratio under function-wrapped membership predicates; a JSON_TABLE lateral join recovered index access where the tenant key was indexed. The evaluation also exposes deployment limits, including an entitlement-size query-planner cliff and incomplete index coverage. The result is a tenant-isolation argument that depends on enforceable interfaces and credentials rather than model compliance.
abstract_cn: 多租户工具通常接受一个租户标识符,并对照调用者的权限进行验证。对一个 large language model (LLM) agent 而言,这种模式把资源选择委托给了一个上下文中可能包含攻击者控制指令的进程。我们把这个「随机代理人」问题形式化,并提出一种结构性防御:从 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 工具模式中移除租户身份,把作用域绑定到经过验证的凭证上,并在 agent 之下强制执行。在一个跨越八种模型配置和两种传输方式的 373 次试验消融中,一个「被正确验证」的租户参数为每一次越权尝试都放行了通行证:26 次中的 26 次,或总共 41 次貌似合理托词试验中的 26 次。当该参数被移除后,任何工具签名都无法表达该次读取。相反地,56 次试验中有 12 次通过伪造可写作用域来逃逸接口,这表明接口不变性需要有密码学保护的上下文。在一个包含数 GB 数据的生产数据集上,集合值作用域在函数封装的成员谓词下导致了实测 57 倍的延迟比;一个 JSON_TABLE 横向连接在租户键有索引的情况下恢复了索引访问。评估还暴露了部署上的限制,包括权限规模的查询规划器悬崖和不完全的索引覆盖。最终得到的租户隔离论证依赖的是可强制执行的接口和凭证,而不是模型的合规性。
summary_cn: 形式化了 tool-using LLM agent 的「随机代理人」问题,并给出结构性防御:从 MCP 工具模式中删除租户标识符、把作用域绑到已验证凭证并下沉到 agent 之下强制执行;373 次跨 8 种模型 2 种传输的消融中,现有的租户参数放行了所有 26 次越权尝试,移除后 56 次里仅 12 次通过伪造可写作用域越界。
comment: 29 pages, 7 figures, 15 tables
objective_summary: 形式化 LLM 智能体的「随机代理」多租户隔离问题，主张从 MCP schema 中移除租户参数并在代理下方以凭证强制作用域。373 次试验、8 模型 2 传输的消融显示，移除参数后无签名可表达越权读，但仍有 56 中 12 次通过伪造可写作用域逃逸；生产数据上测得 57 倍延迟比。
evidence_note: 373 试验跨 8 模型配置 2 种传输，有攻击成功计数与生产规模性能数据，规模与对照较扎实。
novelty_note: 把租户隔离从模型顺从提升为接口不变量与凭证绑定，并给出可测的结构性防御，方向较新。
scope: 结论限于 MCP 工具接口下的多租户读写场景，性能测量在特定生产数据库与索引条件下取得。
limitations: 作者自陈存在授权规模的查询规划断崖与索引覆盖不完整，写路径仍有 12 次逃逸。

title: Fabrication After Tool Failure: Tool-Augmented Agents Assert Values Their Tools Did Not Return
title_cn: 工具失败后的杜撰: 工具增强型 agent 会断言工具未返回的值
abstract: Tool-augmented language models are evaluated on whether they reach the right answer, not on whether they report honestly when a tool fails to supply one. We isolate this post-failure decision with a benchmark of 1,024 items spanning 16 internal-system domains and eight tool-failure types, in which a tool call is enforced and the returned payload is guaranteed to be unusable. Under a deployment-style system prompt, 14.10% of responses are dishonest: the model either asserts a value the payload cannot support or declines while citing a fabricated policy or capability limit. The rate is governed almost entirely by whether the failure is signalled. When the tool returns status:error, dishonesty is absent (0.0%); when it returns status:ok with a redacted, corrupted, stale, malformed, empty or truncated value, dishonesty reaches 45.3%. The behaviour is not an artefact of our prompts: it appears under a neutral prompt (10.17%) and under the shipped prompt of every production agent framework we evaluate, reaching 24.67% under CrewAI's, and none of the nine frameworks we audit specifies what the model should do when a tool fails. Comparing prompt-level defences, we find that the operative variable is not deference to tool output but the absence of a named failure state. Appending a single sentence that requires the model to emit retrieval_status: OK or FAILED before answering reduces dishonesty from 14.10% to 0.87%, with one item of 688 worsening against 92 improving, and transfers unchanged into three foreign agent scaffolds. The emitted flag is faithful in 99.7-99.9% of declarations, giving a runtime detector that needs only a regular expression.
abstract_cn: 工具增强型语言模型的评测通常只看它们是否得出正确答案, 而不看当工具无法提供答案时它们是否如实报告。我们通过一个包含 1024 个项、覆盖 16 个内部系统领域与 8 种工具失败类型的基准来隔离这一失败后决策; 在该基准中, 工具调用是强制的, 且返回的 payload 保证不可用。在部署风格的系统提示下, 14.10% 的响应是不诚实的: 模型要么断言一个 payload 无法支持的值, 要么以捏造的策略或能力限制为由拒答。该比率几乎完全由失败是否被显式标示所决定。当工具返回 status:error 时不诚实率为 0.0%; 当它返回 status:ok 但值被脱敏、损坏、过时、格式错误、为空或被截断时, 不诚实率高达 45.3%。此行为不是我们提示所致的伪像: 它在中性提示下仍出现 (10.17%), 并出现在我们评测的每一个生产级 agent 框架的默认提示下, 在 CrewAI 的默认提示下达到 24.67%; 我们审计的 9 个框架均未规定工具失败时模型该怎么办。对比 prompt 级防御手段可知, 起作用的变量不是对工具输出的服从程度, 而是缺少一个具名的失败状态。追加一句要求模型在回答前发出 retrieval_status: OK 或 FAILED 的句子, 就能将不诚实率从 14.10% 降至 0.87%, 在 688 项中仅一项变差、92 项改善, 且这一防御原样迁移到三个外部 agent 脚手架仍然有效。所发出的标志在 99.7% 至 99.9% 的声明中忠实, 从而给出一个只需正则表达式即可实现的运行时检测器。
summary_cn: 构建 1024 项、16 领域、8 种工具失败类型的基准, 发现部署风格提示下 14.10% 响应不诚实; 工具返回 status:error 时为 0%, 返回 status:ok 但值不可用时高达 45.3%; 追加一句要求先输出 retrieval_status: OK 或 FAILED 将不诚实率从 14.10% 降到 0.87%, 且可跨三个 agent 脚手架迁移。
comment: 11 pages, 4 tables
objective_summary: 构建 1024 个跨 16 个内部系统域与 8 类工具失败类型的基准，测量工具增强智能体在工具失败后是否诚实。部署提示下 14.10% 回复不诚实，status:error 时为 0，status:ok 携带损坏值时高达 45.3%；一句要求先输出 retrieval_status 的提示可将不诚实率降至 0.87%。
evidence_note: 1024 条基准跨 16 域 8 种失败类型，覆盖 9 个生产框架并做提示级消融，数字翔实但无显著性检验。
novelty_note: 把工具失败后的「捏造」作为独立评估维度并给出可判别基准与命名失败态干预，视角较新。
scope: 结论限于工具调用被强制且负载无效的场景，覆盖九个生产智能体框架的默认提示。
limitations: 仅评估 16 个内部系统域与 8 种失败类型，模型清单与提示分布可能影响外推性。

title: A Two-Dimensional Study of the Model Context Protocol: Publication and Adoption
title_cn: MCP 的二维研究: 学术发表与工程采用
abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP), released by Anthropic in November 2024, standardizes how large language model applications connect to external tools and data sources. Despite MCP's rapid growth, no study has jointly characterized its emergence in the research literature, its adoption on GitHub and the relationship between them. We address this gap with a longitudinal, two-dimensional study of 802 MCP-related publications and 33,319 GitHub repositories. We characterize their growth and identify their application domains via BERTopic and usage contexts via a human-validated GPT-5.6-Luna classifier. We find that publications and repositories began rapid growth within a month of each other in 2025, and peaked together in March 2026. Notably, a second growth wave alone accounts for 49.5% of the GitHub repositories. Most publications (57.8%) and nearly all repositories (93.7%) use MCP as an enabling technology rather than for analyzing, evaluating, extending, or securing it directly. Among repositories, the latter category concentrates almost entirely in one general-purpose topic, while applied usage spreads into product-specific niches. Finally, we provide an overview of the MCP landscape and recommendations to researchers and practitioners in this field.
abstract_cn: Model Context Protocol (MCP) 由 Anthropic 于 2024 年 11 月发布, 标准化了大语言模型应用连接外部工具与数据源的方式。尽管 MCP 增长迅速, 目前尚无研究同时刻画其在学术文献中的涌现、在 GitHub 上的采用以及两者之间的关系。我们通过对 802 篇 MCP 相关论文与 33319 个 GitHub 仓库的纵向、二维研究填补该空缺; 我们刻画了它们的增长, 用 BERTopic 识别其应用领域, 并用经人工校验的 GPT-5.6-Luna 分类器识别使用场景。我们发现论文与仓库在 2025 年启动快速增长的时间点相差不到一个月, 并在 2026 年 3 月共同达峰; 值得注意的是, 仅第二波增长就贡献了 49.5% 的 GitHub 仓库。多数论文 (57.8%) 与几乎所有仓库 (93.7%) 把 MCP 用作使能技术, 而非直接分析、评测、扩展或保护它。在仓库中, 后一类几乎全部集中于一个通用主题, 而应用型使用则扩散到产品特定的小众领域。最后, 我们给出 MCP 生态的概览, 并向该领域的研究者与从业者提出建议。
summary_cn: 纵向研究 802 篇 MCP 论文与 33319 个 GitHub 仓库, 二者在 2025 年不到一个月内先后开启快速增长并于 2026 年 3 月共同达峰, 第二波增长贡献了 49.5% 仓库; 57.8% 论文与 93.7% 仓库把 MCP 当作使能技术, 而非直接分析、评测、扩展或安全对象。
objective_summary: 对 MCP 协议做出版与采纳的两维纵向研究，覆盖 802 篇论文和 33319 个 GitHub 仓库；用 BERTopic 与 GPT-5.6-Luna 分类器分析发现两者均在 2025 年一个月内起势并于 2026 年 3 月同期见顶，第二波仓库增长占 49.5%，57.8% 的论文与 93.7% 的仓库将 MCP 作为使能技术。
evidence_note: 两维大样本（802 篇论文 + 33319 仓库），有人工校验的分类器，但无假设检验与外部对照。
novelty_note: 首个联合刻画 MCP 出版与仓库采纳的实证工作，方法是既有主题建模与分类器组合。
scope: 结论限于 2025 至 2026 年 3 月的 MCP 相关论文与 GitHub 仓库，未覆盖其他代码托管或闭源部署。
limitations: 依赖 BERTopic 与 GPT 分类器的标签质量，仅到 2026 年 3 月，且未追踪仓库实际运行采纳。

title: A Building as a Repository: KIR, a Typed Intermediate Representation for Agent-Authored Building Information Models
title_cn: 建筑即仓库：KIR，用于 agent 撰写建筑信息模型的类型化中间表示
abstract: Autonomous agents that author building information models need more than access to a host API. They need a representation of what they intended, what a compiler decided on their behalf, what was refused, what was observed after execution and what remains unknown. We present KIR, a typed intermediate representation in which a building is authored as a program held in a versioned repository and lowered to host applications as build targets. KIR is organised around seven ways in which a generator writing into a stateful, partially observable host goes silently wrong, and gives each a representation in data: ambiguous selectors become typed refusals with candidates; defaults keep their provenance; obligations that will not be checked are named before execution; vacuous witnesses are rejected statically; a lost transaction response becomes the state UNCONFIRMED with a verify-before-retry rule; the reverse path obeys a census invariant; and decisions are bound by digest to the state they were made against. On a pinned snapshot with 83 operation contracts and Revit as the only backend, offline experiments refuse 29 of 42 stress-test programs with diagnostic codes and no uncaught exception, name 38 of 377 witness obligations as unwitnessable, admit 31 of 100 combinations of execution, witness and acceptance states under seven stated invariants, and find no vacuous witness in 219 certificate runs; a 60-storey tower is 11,263 characters as KIR against 3,709,235 characters of emitted C#. Native Revit runs are reported from project records and kept separate from reproduced results. A controlled comparison with agents that write host code directly is specified but not yet executed; it is the principal open question.
abstract_cn: 撰写建筑信息模型的自主 agent 需要的不只是访问宿主 API 的能力。它们需要一种表示：它们想做什么、编译器代它们决定了什么、什么被拒绝了、执行后观察到什么、以及什么仍然未知。我们提出 KIR——一种类型化中间表示，其中建筑作为一个持有在带版本仓库中的程序被撰写，并作为构建目标下沉到宿主应用。KIR 围绕生成器写入有状态、部分可观测宿主时七类会静默出错的方式组织，并在数据中给每一类一个表示：歧义选择器变成带候选项的类型化拒绝；默认值保留其溯源；不会被检查的义务在执行前被命名；空洞见证在静态阶段被拒绝；丢失的事务响应变为状态 UNCONFIRMED 并附带「先验证后重试」规则；反向路径遵守普查不变量；决策通过摘要绑定到做决策时所对应的状态。在一个固定的快照上（83 个操作契约，Revit 作为唯一后端），离线实验在 42 个压力测试程序中拒绝了 29 个并附诊断码、无未捕获异常，在 377 个见证义务中命名 38 个为不可见证，在七个既定不变量下承认 100 种执行、见证与接受状态组合中的 31 种，并在 219 次证书运行中未发现空洞见证；一座 60 层塔的 KIR 是 11,263 个字符，对应发出的 C# 是 3,709,235 个字符。原生 Revit 运行来自项目记录，并与可复现结果分开报告。与直接编写宿主代码的 agent 做受控对比已被规定但尚未执行；这是主要的开放问题。
summary_cn: 提出 KIR 类型化中间表示，把 agent 写入有状态宿主时七类会静默出错的方式（歧义选择器、默认值溯源、不可见证义务、UNCONFIRMED 事务等）显式建成数据；在 83 个操作契约、Revit 后端上离线拒绝了 42 个压力测试中的 29 个，60 层塔用 11,263 字符 KIR 对应 3,709,235 字符 C#。
comment: 13-page paper and 10-page supplement; 8 figures, 3 tables. Code: this https URL
objective_summary: 提出 KIR，一种面向智能体撰写建筑信息模型的类型化中间表示，围绕生成器七类隐性失败给出数据化处理。在 83 个操作契约与 Revit 后端上，42 个压力程序中拒绝 29 个，377 个见证义务中命名 38 个不可见证，60 层塔的 KIR 为 11263 字符对比 3709235 字符的 C#。
evidence_note: 有 83 契约、42 压力程序、100 组合、219 证书运行等多组离线数据，但与其他 IR 的受控比较作者自陈尚未执行。
novelty_note: 把智能体撰写 BIM 建模为版本化仓库中的类型化 IR，并系统化生成器七类静默失败模式，方向少见。
scope: 结论限于 Revit 单一后端与固定快照的离线实验，60 层塔为单例；原生 Revit 运行来自项目记录而非复现。
limitations: 与直接写宿主代码的智能体的受控对比作者明确指出尚未执行，为主要开放问题。

title: EchoFuzz: Empowering Smart Contract Fuzzing with Large Language Models
title_cn: EchoFuzz: 用大语言模型增强智能合约模糊测试
abstract: Smart contracts, serving as the cornerstone of decentralized applications, autonomously manage trillion-dollar digital assets, making them attractive targets for attacks. Fuzzing has emerged as a promising technique for detecting vulnerabilities in smart contracts, yet existing methods face two main challenges. (1) The logical gap in state transitions and combinatorial redundancy hinders effective tradeoffs between bug detection efficiency and state space exploration cost, leading to critical execution paths to be overlooked. (2) Rule-based sequence mutation strategies suffer from path redundancy and inadequate guidance from contract logic, resulting in performance bottlenecks that stall the exploration of in-depth vulnerability-oriented paths. To tackle these challenges, we propose EchoFuzz, an LLM-guided fuzzing framework introducing Vulnerable Function Call Sequences (VFCS) - minimal, behavior-preserving execution paths that expose bugs through key state transitions. EchoFuzz consists of two key procedures. First, we develop a chain-guided LLM approach, that combines static analysis with logical understanding to generate contract-specific VFCS candidates that eliminate combinatorial redundancy. Second, we adopt an iterative fuzzing strategy that uses LLMs with real-time feedback to adaptively steer fuzzer toward uncovered branches. Experiments show EchoFuzz outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving 29\% higher branch coverage and detecting 62\% more vulnerabilities. It also found 37 previously unknown vulnerabilities in real contracts, showing strong practicality.
abstract_cn: 智能合约作为去中心化应用的基石, 自主管理着数万亿美元的数字资产, 因而成为极具吸引力的攻击目标。模糊测试已成为检测智能合约漏洞的一种有前景技术, 但现有方法面临两大挑战。(1) 状态转移中的逻辑鸿沟与组合冗余阻碍了缺陷检测效率与状态空间探索成本之间的有效权衡, 导致关键执行路径被忽视。(2) 基于规则的序列变异策略存在路径冗余与对合约逻辑指导不足的问题, 导致性能瓶颈, 使深入的漏洞导向路径探索停滞。为应对这些挑战, 我们提出 EchoFuzz, 一个 LLM 引导的模糊测试框架, 引入 Vulnerable Function Call Sequences (VFCS)——通过关键状态转移暴露缺陷的、行为保持的最小执行路径。EchoFuzz 由两个关键流程组成。首先, 我们开发了一种链式引导的 LLM 方法, 将静态分析与逻辑理解结合起来, 生成消除组合冗余的合约特定 VFCS 候选。其次, 我们采用一种迭代式模糊测试策略, 利用带实时反馈的 LLM 自适应地把 fuzzer 引向未覆盖分支。实验表明 EchoFuzz 优于当前最先进方法, 分支覆盖率提升 29%、漏洞检出多 62%。它还在真实合约中发现了 37 个此前未知的漏洞, 展现出很强的实用性。
summary_cn: EchoFuzz 用链式引导 LLM 结合静态分析生成 Vulnerable Function Call Sequences (VFCS), 再以实时反馈迭代驱动 fuzzer; 分支覆盖率比 SOTA 高 29%、检出漏洞多 62%, 并在真实合约中发现 37 个未知漏洞。
comment: Accepted by ICSE'2026
objective_summary: 提出 EchoFuzz，用 LLM 生成 Vulnerable Function Call Sequences 引导智能合约模糊测试，并结合迭代反馈驱动探索。相比 SOTA，分支覆盖提升 29%、漏洞检测提升 62%，并在真实合约中发现 37 个此前未知漏洞。
evidence_note: 与 SOTA 有对照并给出覆盖率与漏洞数量提升百分比，且在真实合约中检出 37 个新漏洞，规模较充分。
novelty_note: 引入 VFCS 概念以最小行为保持路径缓解组合冗余，是合约模糊测试中较新颖的抽象。
scope: 结论限于以太坊类智能合约的漏洞模糊测试场景，依赖 LLM 对合约逻辑的静态与语义理解。
limitations: 摘要未披露具体基线名单、合约样本量与统计检验，LLM 引导的可重复性也未说明。

title: A Hybrid Dependency-Aware Framework for Task Decomposition and Dynamic Agent Generation in Oracle-to-PostgreSQL Migration
title_cn: Oracle 到 PostgreSQL 迁移的混合依赖感知任务分解与动态 agent 生成框架
abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based database migration is often treated as direct code transformation, although enterprise Oracle systems contain heterogeneous SQL and PL/SQL artifacts with different dependencies, execution order, complexity, and validation needs. This paper proposes a hybrid dependency-aware framework that identifies migration tasks, builds a cross-file dependency graph, condenses cyclic dependencies, and uses task specifications to generate specialized migration agents at runtime. The deterministic path combines ANTLR-based parsing with typed dependency extraction, while an LLM fallback is invoked only for units that cannot be parsed reliably. On a corpus of 116 Oracle files, the pipeline produced 1,037 units with zero coverage gaps and 1,271 AST-derived dependencies. The fallback processed 165 parse-error units, recovered 496 additional validated dependencies, eliminated unresolved-dependency units, and increased resolved internal edges from 446 to 527. The graph contained four dependency-respecting phases, while cycle handling was validated separately using Tarjan SCC condensation. A complementary experiment on 1,006 PL/SQL files regenerated 623 scripts (~62%), of which 380 (~61%) executed successfully in PostgreSQL 16. Tables achieved about 85% regeneration success, whereas no query regenerations succeeded under the evaluated specification-mediated baseline, and procedural objects remained strongly dependent on schema context. These results motivate dependency-aware context delivery, task-specific validation, and differentiated agent routing. The paper also formalizes task-to-agent mapping, introduces monitoring and diagnostics for execution feedback, and defines a controlled comparison of monolithic, static-decomposition, dependency-aware, and dynamically orchestrated migration strategies.
abstract_cn: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的数据库迁移常常被当作直接的代码转换来处理，尽管企业级 Oracle 系统包含异构的 SQL 与 PL/SQL 制品，具有不同的依赖关系、执行顺序、复杂度与验证需求。本文提出一个混合的、依赖感知的框架：识别迁移任务、构建跨文件依赖图、压缩循环依赖，并使用任务规格在运行时生成专用的迁移 agent。确定性路径结合基于 ANTLR 的解析与类型化依赖抽取,只在无法可靠解析的单元上调用 LLM 兜底。在 116 个 Oracle 文件的语料上,流水线产出了 1,037 个单元、零覆盖缺口以及 1,271 条 AST 派生的依赖。兜底处理了 165 个解析错误单元,额外恢复了 496 条经验证的依赖,消除了未解析依赖单元,并把已解析的内部边从 446 增加到 527。依赖图包含四个尊重依赖的阶段,而环处理则使用 Tarjan SCC 缩点单独验证。在 1,006 个 PL/SQL 文件上的补充实验再生了 623 个脚本（约 62%）,其中 380 个（约 61%）在 PostgreSQL 16 中成功执行。表实现了约 85% 的再生成功率,而在所评测的规格中介基线下没有查询再生成功,且过程性对象仍强依赖模式上下文。这些结果推动了依赖感知的上下文投递、任务特定的验证与差异化的 agent 路由。本文还形式化了任务到 agent 的映射,引入了针对执行反馈的监控与诊断,并定义了对单体式、静态分解、依赖感知与动态编排四种迁移策略的受控对比。
summary_cn: 混合确定性 (ANTLR 解析)＋LLM 兜底，构建跨文件依赖图并按任务规格在运行时生成专用迁移 agent；116 个 Oracle 文件产出 1,037 单元零覆盖缺口，1,006 个 PL/SQL 文件中 623 (62%) 被再生、其中 380 (61%) 在 PostgreSQL 16 中成功执行，表再生成功率约 85% 而查询在规格中介基线下无一成功。
comment: 18 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables, 36 references
objective_summary: 提出一个依赖感知的 Oracle-to-PostgreSQL 迁移框架，结合 ANTLR 解析与 LLM 兜底，在 116 个 Oracle 文件上产出 1037 个单元与 1271 条依赖；PL/SQL 侧对 1006 个文件再生 623 个脚本，其中 380 个（约 61%）在 PostgreSQL 16 成功执行，表再生成功率约 85%。
evidence_note: 在 116 个 Oracle 与 1006 个 PL/SQL 文件上给出规模化指标，但无 baseline 对照与统计检验，仅报告绝对数字。
novelty_note: 在 LLM 迁移基础上引入跨文件依赖图与动态智能体路由，属于既有方向上的结构化改进。
scope: 结论限于 Oracle 到 PostgreSQL 16 的 SQL/PL-SQL 迁移，语料为 116 个 Oracle 文件与 1006 个 PL/SQL 文件。
limitations: 查询类再生成功率为零，过程性对象强依赖 schema，且四种迁移策略的受控比较仅被形式化尚未执行。

title: AI Assisted Workflow Optimization and Automation
title_cn: AI 辅助的工作流优化与自动化
abstract: Against the backdrop of digital transformation and stricter regulation, enterprise compliance work demands higher efficiency and accuracy. The auxiliary compliance process has become an important entry point for optimizing the compliance system due to its strong transactional nature and high degree of repetition. This study focuses on the process characteristics of auxiliary compliance work, sorts out its structural composition and organizational mechanism, proposes an optimization path with process reengineering, system modeling, and technology integration as the core, and focuses on exploring the collaborative application of key technologies such as RPA, rule engine, and semantic recognition in process automation. Research suggests that the systematic optimization and intelligent upgrading of auxiliary processes will help build a modern compliance operation system that is responsive, efficient, structurally clear, and risk controllable.
abstract_cn: 在数字化转型与监管趋严的背景下，企业合规工作对效率与准确性的要求越来越高。辅助合规流程因其事务性强、重复度高，成为优化合规体系的重要切入点。本研究聚焦于辅助合规工作的流程特征，梳理其结构组成与组织机制，提出以流程再造、系统建模与技术集成为核心的优化路径，并重点探讨 RPA、规则引擎与语义识别等关键技术在流程自动化中的协同应用。研究认为，对辅助流程进行系统性优化与智能化升级，有助于构建响应迅速、运行高效、结构清晰、风险可控的现代合规运营体系。
summary_cn: 针对企业合规辅助流程，提出以流程再造、系统建模与技术集成为核心的优化路径，讨论 RPA、规则引擎与语义识别的协同应用。属于业务流程综述性质，无实证数据。
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Published in International Journal of Advanced Computer Science and Applications (IJACSA), Vol. 16, No. 10, 2025
objective_summary: 梳理企业辅助合规流程的结构与组织机制，提出以流程再造、系统建模、技术集成为核心的优化路径，并讨论 RPA、规则引擎与语义识别在自动化中的协同应用。
evidence_note: 5 页短文、1 图，仅有概念性叙述，无实证数据、无案例度量、无对照。
novelty_note: 对成熟自动化技术的组合陈述，未提出新的方法或可验证发现。
scope: 面向企业辅助合规业务流程的一般性讨论。
limitations: 缺乏实证评估、可复现设计与量化指标。

title: Same Name, Different Server: A Security Census of Silent Drift in the Model Context Protocol Ecosystem
title_cn: 同名不同服务器：Model Context Protocol 生态静默漂移的安全普查
abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the common interface through which large language model applications reach external tools, and its public registry now distributes thousands of community-built servers with little of the vetting infrastructure that mature package ecosystems have accumulated. This paper reports a census of that ecosystem. We harvested the full public MCP registry (21,643 servers, 72,606 version records, August 2026 snapshot), fetched source code for 14,353 servers, and applied a pattern-based scanner covering an eight-class threat catalogue whose accuracy we measured against 414 hand-labeled findings. Observed prevalence is dominated by unauthenticated network exposure (9.57% of scanned servers); after correcting each class by its measured precision, 11.14% observed high-severity prevalence reduces to roughly 7.6%. The central finding concerns instability rather than any single weakness: 51.1% of multi-version servers changed what they advertise between versions, 40.6% did so silently, and 4.2% redirected their remote endpoint to a different host while keeping their registry identity, a change the protocol never surfaces to installed clients. Silent drift is associated with nearly threefold higher odds of a high-severity finding (OR = 2.96, 95% CI [2.56, 3.42]). Popularity offers only weak protection (OR = 0.78 per unit of log stars), so star counts are a poor proxy for safety. We derive concrete recommendations for registry design, client-side pinning, and scanner triage, and release an anonymized artifact.
abstract_cn: Model Context Protocol（MCP）已成为大语言模型应用调用外部工具的通用接口，其公共注册表如今分发了数千个社区构建的服务器，却几乎没有成熟包生态所积累的审查基础设施。本文报告对这一生态的一次普查。我们抓取了完整的公共 MCP 注册表（21,643 个服务器、72,606 条版本记录，2026 年 8 月快照），获取了 14,353 个服务器的源代码，并应用一个基于模式的扫描器覆盖八类威胁目录，其准确率通过 414 个手工标注结果度量。观察到的高发问题以未认证的网络暴露为主（占扫描服务器的 9.57%）；按每类的实测精度校正后，观察到的 11.14% 高危普及率降至约 7.6%。核心发现关注的是不稳定性而非任何单一弱点：51.1% 的多版本服务器在版本之间改变了它们所宣称的内容，40.6% 是静默改变，4.2% 在保留注册表身份的同时把远端端点重定向到不同主机——一种协议永远不会向已安装客户端曝出的变化。静默漂移与高危发现相关联，其比率高出近三倍（OR = 2.96，95% CI [2.56, 3.42]）。流行度仅提供微弱保护（每单位对数星标 OR = 0.78），因此星标数是安全性的糟糕代理。我们导出了针对注册表设计、客户端固定与扫描器分诊的具体建议，并发布了一份匿名化的制品。
summary_cn: 对 21,643 个 MCP 服务器（14,353 有源码）做八类威胁扫描：观察高危普及率按精度校正后约 7.6%，但真正的问题是不稳定性——51.1% 的多版本服务器改变宣称、40.6% 静默变、4.2% 悄悄换后端主机；静默漂移与高危发现的 OR = 2.96 (95% CI [2.56, 3.42])，星标只是弱代理 (OR = 0.78/log 星)。
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables
objective_summary: 对 2026 年 8 月 MCP 公共注册表快照 21,643 个服务器 72,606 版本进行安全普查，扫描 14,353 个服务器；51.1% 多版本服务器发生能力漂移，静默漂移与高危发现关联 OR=2.96 (CI 2.56-3.42)。
evidence_note: 21,643 服务器全量+414 人工标注测精度+按类校准+条件比值比与置信区间。
novelty_note: 首个 MCP 生态系统安全普查，指出「静默漂移」作为独立于单一漏洞的核心风险。
scope: 2026 年 8 月 MCP 公共注册表快照与八类威胁目录内。
limitations: 基于模式扫描器精度有限，仅覆盖公共注册表，未覆盖私有部署。

title: Yesterday's Interviews for Today's Engineers: Retrospective Perceptions and a Work-Aligned Hiring Framework (2005-2026)
title_cn: 昨日的访谈面向今日的工程师：回顾性认知与一个契合工作的招聘框架（2005-2026）
abstract: Technical hiring has increasingly become a skill system of its own, requiring candidates to prepare for processes that only partially resemble the position being filled. This paper reconstructs how the software-engineering community remembers that process across four eras from 2005 to 2026. Retrospective ratings from 911 respondents show a history of expanding interview work and burden, while an analysis of public preparation questions finds that most tested knowledge has a plausible use in an ordinary software-engineering project. The contradiction is only apparent: relevant topics can still form an invalid process when they are accumulated beyond the vacancy, presented under artificial constraints, or selected and interpreted without a common job-derived standard. The paper responds with the Ticket-Based Pragmatic Assessment Framework, a prescriptive reference framework that derives a bounded assessment from declared responsibilities, near-term tickets, and project-entry work. It preserves normal tools, defines three explicit evidence gates, limits repeated sessions, and stops when the decision is supported. The objective is to make an interview a compressed version of the job rather than a parallel profession that candidates must learn merely to obtain it.
abstract_cn: 技术招聘日益演变为一套独立的技能体系，要求候选人为一个只与实际岗位部分相似的流程做准备。本文重构了软件工程社区如何在 2005 至 2026 四个时代记忆这一流程。来自 911 名受访者的回溯评分显示，面试工作量与负担持续扩张；同时对公开的面试准备题目的分析表明，其中大部分被考察的知识在普通软件工程项目中都具有合理用途。这一矛盾只是表象：即便主题相关，只要被累积到超出空缺岗位需要、被置于人为设定的约束下呈现，或在缺乏共同的、以岗位为依据的标准下被挑选与解读，就仍然会构成一个无效的流程。本文据此回应提出 Ticket-Based Pragmatic Assessment Framework，一种规范性的参考框架，它从声明的岗位职责、近期工单以及项目入职工作出发导出一个有界的评估流程。该框架保留正常工具的使用、定义三道显式的证据关卡、限制重复面试轮次，并在决策已获支持时停止评估。其目标是让面试成为岗位工作的压缩版本，而不是候选人为获得岗位不得不额外学习的一门平行专业。
summary_cn: 对 911 名受访者跨 2005-2026 四个时代的回溯评分显示面试负担持续扩张，并提出 Ticket-Based Pragmatic Assessment Framework——从岗位职责、近期工单与项目入职工作反推有界的评估流程，含三道显式证据关卡。
comment: 19 pages, 12 tables
objective_summary: 回顾 2005-2026 四个时代的软件工程面试，911 名受访者的回溯评分显示面试工作与负担持续扩张，公开备考题多具项目相关性；提出基于工单的实用评估框架 TPAF。
evidence_note: 911 人回溯问卷+公开题库分析，缺乏对框架本身的部署评估或对照实验。
novelty_note: 结合历史回溯与工单驱动的招聘评估框架提议，观点归纳较为常规。
scope: 面向 2005-2026 软件工程社区回忆与公开面试题的分析范围内。
limitations: 回溯评分存在回忆偏差；TPAF 仅为规范性框架，尚未在真实招聘流程中验证。

title: Reducing Cold-Start Latency in Serverless Applications via Dynamic Slicing
title_cn: 通过动态切片降低无服务器应用的冷启动延迟
abstract: We present PyXtrim, a system that reduces the cold-start latency of serverless applications through debloating. We focus on Python, a dominant language for serverless applications whose dynamic features and extensive use of native extensions make traditional static debloating particularly challenging. PyXtrim frames debloating as a dynamic slicing problem, using the application's externally visible behavior as the slicing criterion. Everything outside the resulting slice is removed, both from the application and its dependencies. Our key technical contribution is that the slice is computed by a cross-language dynamic dependence engine that tracks data and control dependences across Python and native code and identifies operations that interact with the operating system, which form the slicing criterion. As a result, PyXtrim can effectively handle real-world applications that rely on dynamic features such as reflection, interoperate with native code and interact with system resources. Across 31 applications on AWS Lambda, PyXtrim reduces cold-start latency by 21.7% and peak memory usage by 17.1% at the median. This is more than double the reduction achieved by the state of the art, while debloating each application in minutes.
abstract_cn: 我们提出 PyXtrim，一个通过瘦身降低无服务器应用冷启动延迟的系统。我们聚焦 Python——无服务器应用的主流语言，其动态特性与对原生扩展的广泛使用使得传统的静态瘦身尤其困难。PyXtrim 把瘦身建模为一个动态切片问题，使用应用的对外可见行为作为切片准则。结果切片之外的一切——无论在应用还是在其依赖中——都被移除。我们的关键技术贡献是：切片由一个跨语言的动态依赖引擎计算，它跨越 Python 与原生代码追踪数据与控制依赖，并识别那些与操作系统交互的操作，这些操作构成切片准则。因此 PyXtrim 能够有效处理依赖反射等动态特性、与原生代码互操作以及与系统资源交互的真实应用。在 AWS Lambda 上跨 31 个应用，PyXtrim 在中位数上把冷启动延迟降低了 21.7%、峰值内存使用降低了 17.1%。这是当前最优技术所达降幅的两倍多，同时每个应用的瘦身在数分钟内完成。
summary_cn: PyXtrim 把无服务器应用瘦身建模为动态切片，用跨语言依赖引擎追踪 Python 与原生代码之间的数据/控制依赖并以 OS 交互作为切片准则；AWS Lambda 上 31 个应用中位数冷启动延迟降 21.7%、峰值内存降 17.1%，超过 SOTA 两倍多且分钟级完成。
objective_summary: 提出 PyXtrim 以动态切片方式给 Python 无服务器应用瘦身，跨语言追踪 Python 与本地代码依赖；在 AWS Lambda 上 31 个应用中中位冷启动降低 21.7%，峰值内存降低 17.1%，超过当前最优方法两倍。
evidence_note: 31 个真实 Lambda 应用+SoTA 对比+分钟级瘦身，规模中等但对照明确。
novelty_note: 跨 Python 与本地扩展的动态依赖引擎，将系统调用作为切片准则。
scope: Python 语言的 AWS Lambda 无服务器应用，依赖反射与本地扩展的 31 例。
limitations: 动态切片对未触发路径可能过度裁剪；未讨论生产工作负载分布代表性。

title: Deterministic Temporal Reconciliation for Effective-Dated Identity Lifecycle Events
title_cn: 面向生效日期身份生命周期事件的确定性时间对账
abstract: Identity lifecycle automation processes workforce changes that carry two distinct notions of time: when a business fact becomes effective and when an authoritative source last revised it. Corrections, cancellations, future-dated changes, duplicate delivery, and out-of-order arrival can therefore produce divergent account states when processors rely on transport order or effective time alone. This paper presents a deterministic temporal reconciliation method for effective-dated identity events. The method separates logical business facts from their physical revisions, deduplicates exact replays, selects the authoritative revision of each fact using transaction-time freshness, removes canceled facts, and then applies surviving facts in valid-time order. We establish permutation invariance, replay idempotence, revision dominance, and deterministic snapshot construction under explicit source assumptions. A reproducible synthetic fault-injection benchmark compares the method with arrival-order, effective-time, and transaction-time processing. Across 250,000 generated identity histories and 1,585,589 delivered records, the proposed method reconstructed the separately retained authoritative final state in all tested cases. At 75% delivery disorder, exact-state accuracy was 42.35% for arrival-order processing, 85.38% for effective-time sorting, 76.61% for transaction-time sorting, and 100% for the proposed method. A separate 40,000-permutation experiment produced the same final state for every tested permutation under the proposed reconciliation contract.
abstract_cn: 身份生命周期自动化处理的员工变更同时携带两种不同的时间概念：业务事实的生效时间，以及权威源最后一次修订该事实的时间。修正、取消、未来生效变更、重复投递以及乱序到达因此会导致——当处理器仅依赖传输顺序或生效时间时——账户状态出现分歧。本文提出一种针对生效日期化身份事件的确定性时序对账方法。该方法将逻辑上的业务事实与其物理修订分离，对完全重放进行去重，基于事务时间新鲜度选择每个事实的权威修订，剔除被取消的事实，然后按有效时间顺序应用剩余事实。我们在明确的源假设下确立了置换不变性、重放幂等性、修订支配性以及确定性快照构造性质。一个可复现的合成故障注入基准将该方法与到达序、生效时间、事务时间三种处理方式进行了对比。在 25 万条生成的身份历史与 1,585,589 条投递记录上，所提方法在所有测试用例中都完美重构了单独保留的权威最终状态。在 75% 的投递乱序水平下，到达序处理的精确状态准确率为 42.35%，生效时间排序为 85.38%，事务时间排序为 76.61%，而所提方法为 100%。另一个 40,000 次置换的实验也表明，在所提对账契约下，所有置换都得到了相同的最终状态。
summary_cn: 提出对生效日期化身份事件的确定性时序对账方法，在 25 万条身份历史、158 万条投递记录上，在 75% 投递乱序时精确状态还原率达 100%，而到达序、生效时间、事务时间排序分别为 42.35%、85.38%、76.61%。
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Synthetic benchmark code and data included as ancillary files
objective_summary: 提出对生效日期身份事件的确定性时间对账方法并证明四条形式性质；在 250,000 个合成身份历史 (1,585,589 记录) 上，75% 乱序下重建精确终态达 100%，对照到达序 42.35%/生效时间 85.38%/事务时间 76.61%。
evidence_note: 25 万历史+40,000 置换实验，与三种排序基线量化对比并证明置换不变性等性质。
novelty_note: 在双时态语义下给出可证明的置换不变、重放幂等的对账契约。
scope: 适用于满足文中源假设的生效日期身份事件流合成基准。
limitations: 仅在合成故障注入数据上评估，未在真实企业 IAM 事件流上验证。

title: Introspective Uncertainty Estimation for LLM-Based Code Generation
title_cn: 面向 LLM 代码生成的内省式不确定性估计
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation but can produce fluent yet functionally incorrect outputs, which limits trust in their usage for practical software engineering workflows. This thesis investigates whether Introspective Uncertainty Estimation (IUE), based on internal hidden-state representations of LLMs, can reliably indicate correctness at the response and line levels for code generation tasks. The objective is to determine the extent to which hidden states encode information about functional code correctness and how this can be leveraged for practical risk assessment and fault localization. Methodologically, this thesis combines response-level evaluation on LiveCodeBench (LCB) and BigCodeBench (BCB) with an augmentation pipeline that derives token- and line-level labels from incorrect programs. In this setup, it compares static and dynamic response-level features, evaluates generalization across tasks, programming domains, and token positions, and studies line-level fault localization. The results show that hidden states contain a strong response-level correctness signal. Static single-token probes perform best, while more elaborate dynamic strategies yield no consistent gains. While generalization across tasks, domains, and token positions is feasible, setting-dependent degradation largely remains for real-world software projects. At a fine granularity, line-level prediction is substantially harder than response-level estimation. However, in a conditional localization setup with known-incorrect programs, Top-K point-of-failure ranking remains effective. Overall, the findings suggest that hidden states are a robust and informative resource for estimating functional code correctness, supporting a two-stage workflow that combines response-level risk screening with targeted line-level prioritization.
abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于代码生成，但可能产生流畅却功能上不正确的输出，这在实际软件工程工作流中限制了对其的信任。本论文研究基于 LLM 内部隐状态表示的 Introspective Uncertainty Estimation（IUE，内省式不确定性估计）能否在代码生成任务中可靠地指示响应级与行级的正确性。目标是判定隐状态在多大程度上编码了关于代码功能正确性的信息，以及如何将其用于实际的风险评估与故障定位。方法上，本论文将 LiveCodeBench（LCB）与 BigCodeBench（BCB）上的响应级评估，与一条从错误程序中派生 token 级和行级标签的数据增强流水线相结合。在此设置下，比较了静态与动态的响应级特征，评估了跨任务、跨编程领域以及跨 token 位置的泛化性，并研究了行级的故障定位。结果表明隐状态包含强烈的响应级正确性信号：静态单 token 探针表现最好，而更复杂的动态策略并未带来一致的增益。跨任务、跨领域、跨 token 位置的泛化是可行的，但对真实软件项目而言，与设定相关的性能下降仍然大量存在。在更细粒度上，行级预测显著难于响应级估计；然而在已知程序错误的条件定位设定下，Top-K 失效点排序仍然有效。整体而言，研究结果表明隐状态是估计代码功能正确性的稳健且信息丰富的资源，支持一种将响应级风险筛查与有针对性的行级优先级排序相结合的两阶段工作流。
summary_cn: 在 LiveCodeBench 与 BigCodeBench 上探究能否用 LLM 隐状态在响应级/行级判断代码正确性——静态单 token 探针表现最佳，动态策略无稳定增益；行级预测显著更难，但在已知错误程序上 Top-K 定位仍然有效，支持「响应级筛查+行级定位」的两阶段流程。
objective_summary: 研究基于隐藏状态的内省不确定性估计在代码生成中的响应级与行级效果，在 LiveCodeBench 与 BigCodeBench 上评估；静态单 token 探针表现最好，行级预测显著难于响应级。
evidence_note: 两大基准+静态动态特征对比+跨任务/域/位置泛化分析，但未与外部方法基线比较。
novelty_note: 将 IUE 从响应级扩展到条件行级 Top-K 故障定位并系统对比多种特征。
scope: 适用于 LCB/BCB 的 LLM 代码生成任务与已知错误程序的行级排序设置。
limitations: 对真实软件项目存在依设置退化，行级细粒度预测能力有限。

title: Towards a faithful stochastic model for brain digital twins
title_cn: 迈向面向脑数字孪生的可信随机模型
abstract: Twinning the brain means reproducing its electrical activity with fidelity. This activity arises from many neuronal mechanisms across several scales, from a single neuron to whole brain regions. Current large initiatives rely on models that each capture only a few of these mechanisms. Some act at the scale of a single neuron, others at the scale of neuronal populations. No single model captures both scales with fidelity. We propose a new stochastic model, based on a combination of Random Neural Networks and Markov-Modulated Poisson Processes, that would improve the fidelity of a brain digital twin. We map the model to the Discrete Event System Specification. This yields an initial executable simulation model suitable for incorporation into a brain digital twin.
abstract_cn: 对大脑进行孪生意味着以忠实的方式再现其电活动。这种活动源自跨越多个尺度的多种神经元机制，从单个神经元到整个脑区。当前的大型项目所依赖的模型，每一个都只捕捉其中少数几种机制：有些作用于单神经元尺度，有些作用于神经元群体尺度，尚无单一模型能够以高保真度同时覆盖两种尺度。我们提出一种新的随机模型，基于 Random Neural Networks 与 Markov-Modulated Poisson Processes 的结合，以提升脑数字孪生的保真度。我们将该模型映射到 Discrete Event System Specification，从而得到一个可纳入脑数字孪生的初始可执行仿真模型。
summary_cn: 面向脑数字孪生，提出结合 Random Neural Networks 与 Markov-Modulated Poisson Processes 的随机模型，跨单神经元与神经元群体两个尺度建模，并映射到 Discrete Event System Specification 形成可执行仿真原型。
objective_summary: 提出将随机神经网络与马尔可夫调制泊松过程结合的随机模型，用于脑数字孪生的电活动仿真，并映射到离散事件系统规范以得到可执行仿真模型。
evidence_note: 仅提出模型构想与 DEVS 映射，无实验、无对比、无量化结果。
novelty_note: 宣称跨单神经元与神经元群体两尺度组合建模，但仅停留于设计层面。
scope: 面向脑数字孪生仿真的建模框架，尚未在具体脑区或数据上验证。
limitations: 缺少对拟合度、可执行性与生物学保真度的实证验证。

title: Specification-Driven Data Architecture Reconstruction: From Physical Code to Logical and Conceptual Specifications
title_cn: 规格驱动的数据架构重建：从物理代码到逻辑与概念规格
abstract: Legacy database migrations often begin with incomplete or outdated documentation, leaving physical data definition language (DDL) as the principal evidence of data architecture. However, DDL does not fully encode conceptual intent, and model-generated completions can be plausible without being correct. This study proposes and evaluates a provenance-aware, deterministic-first pipeline for reconstructing logical and conceptual data specifications from Oracle-oriented DDL while explicitly separating observed facts, deterministic derivations, and large language model (LLM) suggestions. The pipeline performs DDL investigation, parsing, consolidation, primary-key backfilling, type normalization, and declared relationship-graph construction before optional LLM-assisted enrichment. It preserves source provenance in the deterministic catalog and declared relationship graph, and records inferred primary-key and foreign-key candidates in a separate reviewable overlay. We evaluated the implementation on 249 artifactized schema samples comprising 1,225 SQL files. The pipeline completed 244 samples (97.99%); 52 completed samples contained no extractable DDL. Across completed samples, the deterministic path reconstructed 208 tables and recovered 278 declared foreign-key records; 168 of the reconstructed tables lacked an explicitly parsed primary key before backfilling. LLM enrichment generated 100 foreign-key candidates in 36 samples, but the parent-table admissibility rate was only 17.9% for logical-specification candidates and 17.5% for conceptual-specification candidates. These findings show that the proposed deterministic-first architecture can preserve an auditable structural baseline, quantify observed primary-key and relationship gaps, and prevent model-generated hypotheses from being silently promoted to source-grounded architectural facts.
abstract_cn: 遗留数据库迁移往往始于不完整或过时的文档，把物理数据定义语言（DDL）作为数据架构的主要证据。然而 DDL 并不能完全编码概念意图，而模型生成的补全可能看起来合理却并不正确。本研究提出并评估一个溯源感知、确定性优先的流水线，用于从面向 Oracle 的 DDL 重建逻辑与概念数据规格，同时显式区分观察到的事实、确定性派生与大语言模型（LLM）建议。该流水线执行 DDL 调查、解析、合并、主键回填、类型规范化与已声明关系图构建，然后进行可选的 LLM 辅助富化。它在确定性目录与已声明关系图中保留源头溯源，并将推断出的主键与外键候选记录在一份可审查的独立叠加层中。我们在 249 份被制品化的模式样本（共 1,225 个 SQL 文件）上评估了实现。流水线完成了 244 个样本（97.99%）；52 个完成的样本不含可抽取的 DDL。在完成的样本中，确定性路径重建了 208 张表，恢复了 278 条已声明外键记录；168 张被重建的表在回填前没有显式解析出的主键。LLM 富化在 36 个样本中生成了 100 个外键候选，但父表可接受率对于逻辑规格候选仅为 17.9%、对于概念规格候选仅为 17.5%。这些发现表明，所提出的确定性优先架构可以保留一份可审计的结构基线，量化观察到的主键与关系缺口，并防止模型生成的假设被静默升格为源头对齐的架构事实。
summary_cn: 「确定性优先」流水线从 Oracle DDL 重建逻辑/概念规格并把 LLM 建议与确定性事实分开；249 个样本完成 244 个 (97.99%)，重建 208 张表、恢复 278 条外键，但 LLM 生成的外键候选父表可接受率仅 17.9%（逻辑）/17.5%（概念），警示模型假设不应被静默升级为源头对齐的架构事实。
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables, 35 references
objective_summary: 提出确定性优先、带溯源的管线从 Oracle DDL 重建逻辑与概念规范；在 249 个样本 1225 SQL 文件上完成 244 例 (97.99%)，重建 208 表，LLM 建议的父表可采纳率仅 17.9%/17.5%。
evidence_note: 249 样本 1225 文件规模适中，量化了 LLM 富化的可采纳率，但无对照方法比较。
novelty_note: 把确定性推导与 LLM 建议分层并保留溯源，避免 LLM 假设被静默升格为事实。
scope: Oracle 导向 DDL 的模式重建；LLM 富化仅在观测事实之外的可审阅覆盖层。
limitations: LLM 生成外键候选正确率低 (约 17%)，样本来自单一 DBMS 家族。

title: Learning How Much to Collaborate: Difficulty-Aware Topology Selection for Multi-Agent Code Generation
title_cn: 学会该协作多少：面向多 agent 代码生成的难度感知拓扑选择
abstract: Multi-agent systems for code generation are deployed with a single communication topology, chosen once for every problem. This is the wrong granularity. Evaluating five topologies on 614 problems from APPS, HumanEval+ and LiveCodeBench, we find that the advantage of hierarchical collaboration over a single agent grows from 2.4 points of pass@1 on the easiest third of problems to 21.1 points on the hardest third, while its token cost stays about ten times higher. We propose the Difficulty-Aware Topology Selector (DATS), which predicts each topology's probability of solving a problem and selects the one maximising predicted success minus cost. Its predictor is a graph network that treats the five topologies as nodes of a connectivity order rather than independent labels, worth 1.7 points over a flat multi-label head. Because the cost penalty is a single scalar recalibrable without retraining, routers compare at equal spend: under this budget-matched protocol six cost-aware methods span 21.6 percentage points, and two baselines leading DATS fall behind once calibrated to it. Fixed at 40% of the always-hierarchical cost, DATS reaches 77.7% pass@1 against 73.6% (always-hierarchical) and 74.3% (strongest learned competitor), all eleven pairwise McNemar comparisons surviving Holm-Bonferroni correction. The 4.1-point gain holds across four backbones spanning fourteen points of capability, and replacing the 39 interpretable features with a graph network or a pretrained encoder shifts accuracy by at most 1.3 points, never significantly. A cross-domain study on 400 mathematical reasoning problems reproduces the effect, the gap widening from 2.5 to 20.9 points.
abstract_cn: 用于代码生成的多 agent 系统被部署时使用单一通信拓扑，对每个问题只选一次。这是错误的粒度。在 APPS、HumanEval+ 与 LiveCodeBench 的 614 个问题上评估五种拓扑，我们发现：层级协作相对单个 agent 的优势，从最简单三分之一问题上的 2.4 分 pass@1 增长到最难三分之一上的 21.1 分，同时其 token 成本仍高出约十倍。我们提出 Difficulty-Aware Topology Selector（DATS），它预测每种拓扑解决一个问题的概率，并选择使预测成功减去成本最大化的那个。其预测器是一个图网络，把五种拓扑当作某种连通度序的节点、而非独立标签，这一处理相较扁平多标签头值 1.7 分。因为成本罚项是一个单一标量、无需重训即可再校准，路由器可以在等成本下比较：在这种预算匹配协议下，六种成本感知方法的差距为 21.6 个百分点，而 DATS 之前领先的两个基线一经校准就落后于它。当固定在始终使用层级的成本的 40% 时，DATS 达到 77.7% pass@1，相较 73.6%（始终层级）与 74.3%（最强学习竞争者），所有十一组两两 McNemar 比较在 Holm-Bonferroni 校正后仍显著。这一 4.1 分的增益跨四种覆盖十四点能力差距的 backbone 都成立，用图网络或预训练编码器替换 39 个可解释特征改变准确率至多 1.3 分、从不显著。在 400 个数学推理问题上的跨领域研究复现了该效应，差距从 2.5 分扩大到 20.9 分。
summary_cn: 在 APPS/HumanEval+/LiveCodeBench 共 614 题上评估 5 种拓扑，层级协作对最难三分之一比单 agent 高 21.1 分 pass@1 但 token 成本 ~10 倍；DATS 用图网络把拓扑当作连通度序节点来预测成功概率并做成本感知路由，在 40% 层级成本预算下达 77.7% pass@1（对比始终层级 73.6%、最强学习基线 74.3%），4.1 分优势跨 4 种 backbone 稳定，数学推理任务上也复现（差距从 2.5→20.9 分）。
comment: 20 pages, 11 figures
objective_summary: 在 APPS、HumanEval+、LiveCodeBench 共 614 题上评估 5 种多智能体拓扑；提出 DATS 用图网络预测各拓扑成功率并按成本选择，40% 层次成本下 pass@1 达 77.7% 对比 73.6% 与 74.3%。
evidence_note: 614 题+4 种 backbone+400 数学题跨域复现，多基线，McNemar+Holm-Bonferroni 校正。
novelty_note: 把拓扑连接度作为图节点排序建模，加入成本敏感的预算匹配比较协议。
scope: 代码生成三个基准与数学推理 400 题上有效，五种拓扑五个 backbone 覆盖范围内。
limitations: 拓扑集合固定为 5 种；未与训练成本自适应的路由方法对比。

title: What Output-Equivalence Oracles Miss: An Empirical Study of Equivalence-Invisible Bug Fixes in Quantum Transpilers (Qiskit, tket, Cirq)
title_cn: 输出等价 oracle 遗漏了什么：量子 transpiler(Qiskit、tket、Cirq) 中等价不可见 bug 修复的实证研究
abstract: Quantum compilers are judged correct by an output-equivalence oracle: the compiled circuit must compute the same unitary as the original, modulo global phase and a qubit-layout permutation. This oracle, by construction, checks only that semantic map, not the circuit's own layout, permutation, or phase records: a defect there, or in a fixed-seed run's determinism, can pass unseen though the record is public. We measure how often this happens in real merged compiler fixes: a systematically identified corpus of Qiskit transpiler bug-fixes, classified by an independently dual-coded, source-validated manifestation taxonomy. Nineteen of 68 fixes (28%, 95% Wilson CI 19-40%) repair faults that this equivalence screen does not catch, even one augmented with compilation-validity, circuit-quality, and performance checks. A secondary wider-window robustness sample produced a nearly identical fraction (29/104, 27.9%, CI 20-37%). A conservative floor remains even restricted to the one unconditionally equivalence-invisible channel (a corrupted layout or permutation record): 10 of 68 fixes (15%, CI 8-25%) beneath the 28% headline. The gap is not Qiskit-specific: it replicates in tket (7 of 21, 33%), with Cirq smaller but consistent. We detected no systematic differences on five inexpensive PR-level characteristics (19 vs 49, underpowered to rule out a modest true difference). This class dominates the invisible set, concentrating at representation-boundary crossings. We release the corpus, codebook, and coding artifacts. Here we only measure it.
abstract_cn: 量子编译器是否正确由一个输出等价 oracle 判定：编译后的电路必须计算与原始电路相同的 unitary，允许相差一个全局相位和一个 qubit 布局置换。按构造，这个 oracle 只检查语义映射本身，而不检查电路自身的布局、置换和相位记录：这些记录中出现的缺陷，或固定随机种子运行下的确定性缺陷，即便记录是公开的，也可能未被察觉地通过检查。我们测量这种情形在真实、已合并的编译器修复中出现的频率：一个系统性识别得到的 Qiskit transpiler bug 修复语料库，按一份独立双人编码、源码验证过的表现形式分类法进行标注。68 个修复中有 19 个（28%，95% Wilson 置信区间 19-40%）修复的缺陷即使加上编译有效性、电路质量和性能检查后，等价筛查也捕捉不到。一个更宽时间窗的稳健性次级样本给出几乎相同的比例（29/104，27.9%，置信区间 20-37%）。即便仅限于「无条件等价不可见」的那一路通道（被破坏的布局或置换记录），仍有一个保守下限：68 个修复中的 10 个（15%，置信区间 8-25%），位于 28% 这个头条数字之下。这一差距并非 Qiskit 独有：它在 tket 中同样复现（21 个中的 7 个，33%），在 Cirq 中虽规模较小但结论一致。我们在 5 项开销较低的 PR 层面特征上没有检测到系统性差异（19 对 49，功效不足以排除一个中等程度的真实差异）。这一类别在不可见集合中占主导，集中出现在表示层边界的交叉处。我们发布了语料库、编码手册和编码产物。本文只做测量。
summary_cn: 对 Qiskit 等三大量子 transpiler 已合并的 bug 修复做人工编码，发现 28% (19/68) 的 bug 是输出等价 oracle 无法捕捉的（tket 33%，Cirq 也一致），说明等价 oracle 加上编译有效性、电路质量、性能检查依然会漏掉一大类缺陷。
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables
objective_summary: 对 Qiskit 编译器合并修复做实证分析：68 个修复中 19 个 (28%, 95% CI 19-40%) 属于输出等价性预言机无法捕获的缺陷；在 tket 中 7/21 (33%) 复现，Cirq 更小但一致。
evidence_note: 68 主样本+104 稳健样本+21 tket 跨系统复现，双人独立编码，Wilson 置信区间。
novelty_note: 首次量化并分类量子编译器等价预言机的盲区，指认表示边界处集中。
scope: 适用于 Qiskit/tket/Cirq 已合并的编译器修复语料，主要针对布局/置换/相位/确定性问题。
limitations: PR 特征差异检验样本量不足以排除中等真实差异；仅测量、未提修复方案。

title: TyPatch: Transforming Patches into Typestate Rules for Kernel Bug Detection
title_cn: TyPatch：将补丁转化为 Typestate 规则以进行内核 Bug 检测
abstract: Historical Linux kernel patches capture defect knowledge that applies beyond their original repair sites. Recent work has shown that large language models (LLMs) can generate static-analysis checkers from historical patches and use them to uncover new kernel bugs. However, complete-checker generation requires the model both to recover the defect semantics expressed by a patch and to implement sophisticated program-analysis machinery, including object tracking, alias analysis, path-state maintenance, and interprocedural propagation. Coupling these responsibilities in a single end-to-end code-generation task can turn a simple defect rule into an unstable and expensive analyzer-implementation problem. To address this problem, we present TyPatch, which decouples patch-specific defect semantics from analyzer implementation. An LLM translates each patch into a typestate rule specifying its tracked object, actions, guards, transitions, and violations. A shared backend then executes these rules, binding their actions to program events, tracking object identity across aliases, propagating typestate along program paths, and producing reports for all rules. On Linux v6.16, TyPatch finds 559 distinct bugs, 121 of which have been confirmed by kernel developers. In a matched 38-patch comparison with the state-of-the-art complete-checker construction workflow, TyPatch uses 88.3-90.1% fewer generation tokens, while its initial report pools achieve 3.42-14.95$\times$ the precision of those produced by that workflow.
abstract_cn: 历史上的 Linux 内核补丁承载了可推广到其原始修复位点之外的缺陷知识。近期工作表明，大型语言模型（LLM）能够从历史补丁生成静态分析检查器，并用于挖掘新的内核缺陷。然而，完整检查器的生成要求模型既要恢复补丁所表达的缺陷语义，又要实现复杂的程序分析机制，包括对象跟踪、别名分析、路径状态维护以及跨过程传播。将这些职责耦合在同一个端到端的代码生成任务中，会把一条简单的缺陷规则变成一个不稳定且昂贵的分析器实现问题。为解决这一问题，我们提出 TyPatch，它将补丁特定的缺陷语义与分析器实现相解耦。一个 LLM 将每条补丁翻译为一条 typestate 规则，指明其被跟踪对象、动作、卫式条件、迁移与违反情况；一个共享后端随后执行这些规则，将其动作绑定到程序事件、跨别名跟踪对象身份、沿程序路径传播 typestate 并为所有规则产出报告。在 Linux v6.16 上，TyPatch 发现了 559 个不同的缺陷，其中 121 个已被内核开发者确认。在一次匹配的 38 补丁对照实验中，与目前最先进的完整检查器构造工作流相比，TyPatch 使用的生成 token 减少了 88.3-90.1%，其初始报告池的精度达到该工作流的 3.42-14.95 倍。
summary_cn: 将 LLM 从补丁生成完整静态分析检查器的任务解耦为「LLM 抽取 typestate 规则 + 共享后端执行」；在 Linux v6.16 上发现 559 个不同缺陷（121 个已被内核开发者确认），在 38 补丁对照实验中生成 token 少 88.3-90.1%、初始报告精度是 SOTA 的 3.42-14.95 倍。
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables
objective_summary: 提出 TyPatch，把内核补丁转成含追踪对象、动作、守卫、状态转移与违规的 typestate 规则由共享后端执行，在 Linux v6.16 上发现 559 个独立 bug 且 121 个已被内核开发者确认；对比 38 补丁匹配设置下 token 用量减少 88.3%–90.1%，初始报告精度为 SOTA 的 3.42–14.95 倍。
evidence_note: Linux v6.16 上真实 bug 挖掘 121 例确认，并做 38 补丁匹配对比 SOTA 生成检查器。
novelty_note: 将补丁语义与分析器实现解耦，用 LLM 只产出 typestate 规则、共享后端负责分析。
scope: 针对 Linux 内核 C 代码基于历史补丁的静态检查，评测在 v6.16。
limitations: typestate 表达受限，难以覆盖需复杂路径推理或语义等价重写的缺陷类型。

title: PatchRisk: Forecasting Future Vulnerability Exposure in Open-Source Dependency Networks
title_cn: PatchRisk：预测开源依赖网络中未来的漏洞暴露
abstract: Open-source software ecosystems are web-scale dependency networks. A downstream package can become exposed to security risk not because its own source code changes, but because one of its transitive dependencies later receives a vulnerability advisory. Existing vulnerability-detection work often focuses on whether code is currently vulnerable or whether a known vulnerable dependency is already present. We study a different problem: future transitive vulnerability exposure. Given a package-version dependency graph observed at release time, the task is to predict whether any non-root dependency will receive a vulnerability advisory within a future horizon. This problem is important for Web intelligence and software supply-chain security because it supports proactive dependency triage before future exposure is visible. It is also easy to evaluate incorrectly: current vulnerable dependencies can leak the label, and different versions of the same root package can create package-level memorization across train and test splits. We therefore construct PatchRisk, a leakage-aware benchmark from Open Source Vulnerability advisories and deps.dev dependency graphs for npm and PyPI. The benchmark uses filtration-aware labels, package-disjoint evaluation, temporal testing, and nested 1K, 3K, 5K, and 10K sampling scales. The largest cleaned setting contains 9,007 root package-version graphs spanning 4,157 root packages. We evaluate three feature families: TimeOnly, GraphStruct, and HistoryGraph. On the 10K temporal-test benchmark, HistoryGraph improves AUPRC over the strongest TimeOnly baseline from 0.351 to 0.640 for 90-day forecasting and from 0.473 to 0.813 for 365-day forecasting. The improvement remains stable across smaller scales and package-group shuffle robustness tests.
abstract_cn: 开源软件生态系统是网络级规模的依赖网络。一个下游包可能变得暴露于安全风险之下，并不是因为它自身的源代码发生了变化，而是因为它的某个传递依赖之后收到了一份漏洞公告。已有的漏洞检测工作通常关注代码当下是否有漏洞，或者一个已知的有漏洞依赖是否已经存在。我们研究的是一个不同的问题：未来的传递漏洞暴露。给定一个在发布时刻观察到的包-版本依赖图，任务是预测在一个未来时间窗内，是否会有任何非根依赖收到漏洞公告。这个问题对于 Web 智能和软件供应链安全都很重要，因为它支持在未来暴露显现之前主动进行依赖分诊。这个问题也非常容易被错误地评测：当下有漏洞的依赖会泄漏标签，同一根包的不同版本会在训练集和测试集之间造成包级别的记忆。因此我们构建了 PatchRisk，一个基于 Open Source Vulnerability 公告与 deps.dev 依赖图、面向 npm 和 PyPI 的、感知泄漏的 benchmark。该 benchmark 使用了过滤感知的标签、包不相交的评测、时序测试，以及 1K、3K、5K、10K 四种嵌套采样规模。清洗后最大的设定包含 9,007 个根包-版本图，覆盖 4,157 个根包。我们评测了三族特征：TimeOnly、GraphStruct 和 HistoryGraph。在 10K 时序测试 benchmark 上，HistoryGraph 相比最强的 TimeOnly 基线，将 90 天预测的 AUPRC 从 0.351 提升到 0.640，将 365 天预测的 AUPRC 从 0.473 提升到 0.813。该改进在更小的规模和包组洗牌的稳健性测试下依然稳定。
summary_cn: 构建了一个防标签泄漏的 npm/PyPI 依赖图 benchmark PatchRisk，预测根包在未来某窗口内是否会因传递依赖收到漏洞公告；HistoryGraph 特征将 90 天 AUPRC 从 0.351 提到 0.640，365 天从 0.473 提到 0.813。
comment: Accepted in the 25th IEEE/WIC International Conference on Web Intelligence and Intelligent Agent Technology (WI-IAT 2026), 8 pages
objective_summary: 构建 PatchRisk 基准（npm 与 PyPI 依赖图、10K 规模最大清洗集含 9,007 个 root 版本图跨 4,157 包），预测未来传递依赖漏洞暴露；HistoryGraph 将 90 天 AUPRC 从 0.351 提升到 0.640、365 天从 0.473 到 0.813。
evidence_note: 多尺度 1K/3K/5K/10K、时序测试、包不相交切分、三类特征族对比，规模与设置严谨。
novelty_note: 定义未来传递漏洞暴露预测任务并处理标签泄露与包级记忆效应，问题设定新。
scope: 限于 npm 和 PyPI 生态、OSV 通告和 deps.dev 依赖图的时序预测。
limitations: 预测标签依赖公开通告的时间与完整性，未覆盖私有仓库或其他语言生态。

title: ForgeTrain: Forging Production-Grade Training Frameworks via Harness-Driven AI Development
title_cn: ForgeTrain：通过 harness 驱动的 AI 开发锻造生产级训练框架
abstract: Training large models still relies on general-purpose frameworks such as Megatron-LM, whose generality tax constrains scenario-specific optimization and adds runtime overhead through accumulated abstraction. AI code generation reduces the cost of building a framework, and makes it affordable to forge one per scenario. We propose Forge Engineering: building a dedicated implementation from scratch for each scenario and iteratively optimizing it toward peak performance under correctness and usability constraints. Dedicated implementations inherit no abstraction boundaries, so they can integrate optimizations across the stack and reach a higher performance ceiling. We instantiate this paradigm for training frameworks as ForgeTrain, which holds a trusted framework as a golden reference and relaxes equivalence monotonically from Bit-for-Bit to Surpass.
