Experiments across multiple model--hardware configurations show that ForgeTrain consistently produces correct training engines and improves MFU over established training frameworks by 4.7--33.2%. To our knowledge this is the first production-grade training framework forged end-to-end by AI to match or surpass its human reference.
abstract_cn: 训练大模型仍然依赖 Megatron-LM 等通用框架，其通用性代价约束了场景化优化，并通过累积的抽象引入了运行时开销。AI 代码生成降低了构建框架的成本，使得「每个场景锻造一个框架」变得可负担。我们提出 Forge Engineering：为每个场景从零构建专用实现，并在正确性与可用性约束下迭代优化至性能极限。专用实现不继承任何抽象边界，因此可以跨栈整合优化并达到更高的性能上限。我们将这一范式实例化为训练框架 ForgeTrain，它以受信任框架作为黄金参考，并将等价性从 Bit-for-Bit 到 Surpass 单调放宽。跨多种模型-硬件配置的实验表明，ForgeTrain 持续产出正确的训练引擎，并相较既有训练框架将 MFU 提升 4.7-33.2%。据我们所知，这是首个由 AI 端到端锻造并达到或超越其人类参考的生产级训练框架。
summary_cn: 提出 Forge Engineering 范式：以受信任框架为黄金参考、把等价性从 Bit-for-Bit 单调放宽到 Surpass，由 AI 端到端锻造训练框架 ForgeTrain，相较 Megatron-LM 等既有框架把 MFU 提升 4.7-33.2%，据称是首个由 AI 端到端产出并达到/超越人类参考的生产级训练框架。
comment: 21 pages, 9 figures
objective_summary: 提出 Forge Engineering 理念并实例化为 ForgeTrain，让 AI 端到端为每个场景生成训练框架，以可信框架为金标，从 Bit-for-Bit 到 Surpass 单向放松等价性；多种模型—硬件配置上 MFU 相比现有框架提升 4.7%–33.2%。
evidence_note: 跨多种模型硬件配置对比 Megatron 等基线，但样本设置数量与统计检验细节未在摘要给出。
novelty_note: 主张放弃通用抽象、由 AI 逐场景铸造训练框架，并给出等价性放松路径。
scope: 适用于给定模型—硬件组合下的训练框架生成，结论限于所测配置。
limitations: 依赖可信参考框架做金标，跨新硬件或异构场景的可扩展性未验证。

title: Same Patient, Different Order: Action-Level Reliability of Clinical LLM Agents Under Repeated Runs
title_cn: 同一位患者，不同的顺序：临床 LLM Agent 在重复运行下的动作级可靠性
abstract: A clinical agent benchmark can report the same verdict on identical inputs while the agent files a materially different order on each run. Such agents order tests, request medications and place referrals, yet benchmarks typically score one run per task and rarely ask whether identical inputs produce identical actions; MedAgentBench, the benchmark we use, scores a single attempt and says so. To measure this gap we introduce "same-input rerun", which replays a task with every input held fixed and compares the orders rather than the score, with six reliability metrics, and apply it to 1000 MedAgentBench runs across 50 tasks from its five write-capable families, two open-weight models below ten billion parameters quantised to four bits, and two temperatures. The study establishes that action-level divergence exists and can pass unrecorded by the score, not that any rate generalises. Under the 8B model at temperature 0.7, all 43 ordering groups emit a different set of orders across five identical runs, 26 emit the order on some runs and not others, and 28 record a different coded value, dose or analyte. In 22 of those 43 the benchmark reports the same failing verdict for materially different behaviour, as it does for all 10 divergent groups of the 4B model at 0.7. Orders also reach different endpoints across runs, one of which the record server rejects while the agent is told it succeeded. These findings motivate repeated-run evaluation, action-level stability reporting and execution-faithful environment feedback in clinical-agent benchmarks.
abstract_cn: 一个临床 agent benchmark 可能对同样的输入报出同样的判定，而 agent 每次运行却提交出实质上不同的医嘱。这类 agent 会开检查、请求药物、下转诊，然而 benchmark 通常每个任务只打一次分，也很少去问相同的输入是否产生相同的动作；我们使用的 benchmark MedAgentBench 就明说自己只算一次尝试。为了测量这个差距，我们提出「same-input rerun」，即在每一个输入都保持固定的条件下重放一个任务，用六个可靠性指标比较下单本身而不是分数，并将其应用于 MedAgentBench 中来自五个具备写入能力的任务族的 50 个任务，跑 1000 次运行，采用两个参数低于百亿、被量化到 4 比特的开权重模型，以及两个温度。这项研究确立的是「动作级差异存在且可以不被分数记录」这一事实，而不是「任何比率具有普遍性」。在 8B 模型、温度 0.7 下，全部 43 个下单组在 5 次相同的运行中都发出了不同的下单集合，26 组在某些运行中发出该下单而在另一些运行中未发，28 组记录了不同的编码值、剂量或分析物。在这 43 组中的 22 组里，尽管行为存在实质差异，benchmark 却报出了相同的失败判定；对 4B 模型温度 0.7 下 10 个存在差异的组也是如此。下单还会在不同运行间到达不同的端点，其中某些端点被记录服务器拒绝而 agent 却被告知已经成功。这些发现推动了在临床 agent benchmark 中采用重复运行评测、动作级稳定性报告和执行忠实的环境反馈。
summary_cn: 对 MedAgentBench 做 same-input rerun 实验（1000 次运行/50 任务/2 个 8B 及以下模型/2 个温度），发现 8B/温度 0.7 下全部 43 个下单组在 5 次相同输入运行间给出不同的下单集合，其中 22 个尽管行为差异巨大却被 benchmark 报告为相同的失败判定，说明单次评分严重掩盖了 agent 的动作级不稳定。
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Code, run records and the rerun harness: this https URL ; github: this https URL
objective_summary: 在 MedAgentBench 上引入「同输入重跑」协议与 6 项可靠性指标，用 2 个 4bit 量化开源模型、2 个温度对 50 个任务跑 1000 次；温度 0.7 下 8B 模型 43 个下单组全部出现跨 5 次运行的动作差异，22 组行为不同但基准仍报同一失败。
evidence_note: 1000 次运行、50 任务，覆盖 2 模型 2 温度，指标齐全，但模型规模与基准均较受限。
novelty_note: 指出临床 Agent 基准动作级不可靠被单次评分掩盖，并给出可重跑度量。
scope: 结论限于 MedAgentBench 五类可写任务、两个 10B 以下量化开源模型和两个温度。
limitations: 作者自述不主张比率可外推，且未覆盖更大或闭源模型。

title: Comparative Framework Analysis for Enterprise Generative AI Applications: Chatbot, Automation, and Oracle-to-PostgreSQL Migration
title_cn: 面向企业生成式 AI 应用的框架对比分析：Chatbot、自动化与 Oracle 到 PostgreSQL 迁移
abstract: This study compares framework suitability across three classes of enterprise generative AI applications: a documentation-based development assistant, an email and inquiry automation system, and an Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration tool. The analysis evaluates component boundaries, orchestration, policy retrieval or reasoning, model integration, deterministic validation, persistence, observability, and operational efficiency. Across the three applications, the evidence supports layered architectures in which probabilistic components generate proposals, while deterministic components retain authority over routing, authorization, validation, persistence, idempotency, and final outcomes. The results indicate that framework suitability depends on the application, deployment conditions, and component responsibility: search quality, workflow control, safety behavior, and migration validation cannot be reduced to a single cross-application assessment. Therefore, the study substantiates the need for framework selection at the component level, supported by explicit contracts, application-specific evidence, and independent validation boundaries.
abstract_cn: 本研究比较了框架在三类企业生成式 AI 应用中的适用性：基于文档的开发助手、邮件与咨询自动化系统，以及 Oracle 到 PostgreSQL 的迁移工具。分析评估了组件边界、编排、策略检索或推理、模型集成、确定性验证、持久化、可观测性与运行效率。在这三个应用中，证据支持分层架构：由概率性组件生成建议，而确定性组件对路由、授权、验证、持久化、幂等性与最终结果保留权威。结果表明，框架适用性取决于应用、部署条件与组件职责：搜索质量、工作流控制、安全行为与迁移验证无法归结为一次跨应用的统一评估。因此，本研究论证了在组件级别进行框架选型的必要性，并需辅以显式契约、面向特定应用的证据以及独立的验证边界。
summary_cn: 在文档助手、邮件与咨询自动化、Oracle→PostgreSQL 迁移三类企业应用上比较框架适用性，结论是应采用「概率组件出建议、确定性组件把关路由/授权/验证/持久化」的分层架构，并主张框架选型必须下沉到组件级、辅以显式契约与独立验证边界。
comment: 33 pages, 2 figures, 34 tables, 58 references
objective_summary: 针对文档助手、邮件自动化和 Oracle 到 PostgreSQL 迁移三类企业 GenAI 应用，从组件边界、编排、检索、模型集成、验证、观测等维度比较框架适配度，主张分层架构由确定性组件掌控最终决策。
evidence_note: 以三个案例做定性比较框架，缺量化基准、无对照实验，也无外部验证结果。
novelty_note: 对已知分层／概率＋确定性思路做企业场景归纳，未提出新方法。
scope: 覆盖三类特定企业 GenAI 应用，结论强调框架选择需按组件而非跨应用统一评估。
limitations: 结论主要基于作者定性判断，缺少可复现的评测数据与量化指标。

title: AutoTailor: Automatic, User-Aligned Capability Selection and Adaptation for Web Agents
title_cn: AutoTailor：面向 Web Agent 的自动、用户对齐的能力选择与适配
abstract: Web agents can utilize reusable tools to reduce the cost and latency of low-level browser interaction, but automatically discovered tool collections can be large, redundant, and poorly aligned with user demand. We present AutoTailor, a meta-agentic framework for constructing and maintaining a compact set of trajectory-derived Model Context Protocol (MCP) APIs. Offline, AutoTailor converts web trajectories into parameterized browser-automation programs, applies a Quality Filter to remove APIs with unsuitable granularity and redundant functionality, and applies a Usage Likelihood Filter to prioritize broadly useful capabilities while preserving semantic coverage. Online, Dynamic Reselection monitors task outcomes and API usage, identifies recurring coverage gaps, adds relevant candidates, and prunes persistently unused capabilities. We evaluate AutoTailor on 106 WebArena Postmill tasks. Offline filtering reduces the initial 1,283 unrefined APIs to 87, and Dynamic Reselection produces a 33-API set. With reasoning and acting (ReAct) fallback, this set achieves 90.6% correctness, compared with 87.5% for ReAct alone, while reducing average total request-token cost by 57.8% and latency by 29.4%. Without ReAct, it achieves 60.1% correctness, marginally matching the performance of unrefined set, while reducing request-token usage by 94.9%. Together, these results show that static filtering produces a compact inventory of APIs expected to support core, high-likelihood tasks, while dynamic reselection further tailors that inventory to observed user needs. This combination improves accuracy and latency while sharply reducing token usage and end-to-end cost, demonstrating the value of user-aligned capability management for efficient web agents.
abstract_cn: Web agent 可以利用可复用工具来降低底层浏览器交互的成本和延迟，然而自动发现得到的工具集合可能规模庞大、冗余且与用户需求对不齐。我们提出 AutoTailor，一个用于构建并维护紧凑的、由轨迹派生出来的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）API 集合的元 agent 框架。离线阶段，AutoTailor 将 Web 轨迹转换为参数化的浏览器自动化程序，用 Quality Filter 剔除粒度不合适、功能冗余的 API，并用 Usage Likelihood Filter 优先保留那些广泛有用的能力，同时保留语义覆盖度。在线阶段，Dynamic Reselection 监控任务结果和 API 使用，识别反复出现的覆盖缺口，加入相关候选，并剪掉长期未使用的能力。我们在 106 个 WebArena Postmill 任务上评测 AutoTailor。离线过滤将起初 1,283 个未精炼的 API 减少到 87 个，Dynamic Reselection 又产出一个 33 个 API 的集合。在配合推理与行动（ReAct）回退的情况下，该集合达到 90.6% 的正确率，相比单独 ReAct 的 87.5%，同时将平均总请求 token 成本降低 57.8%，延迟降低 29.4%。在不使用 ReAct 的情况下，它达到 60.1% 的正确率，与未精炼集合的性能几乎持平，同时将请求 token 使用量降低了 94.9%。综合起来，这些结果显示静态过滤产出了一个紧凑的 API 库存，可望支持核心的、高使用可能性的任务，而动态重选进一步把这个库存针对观察到的用户需求做定制。这种组合在提升准确率与延迟的同时大幅降低 token 使用量与端到端成本，展示了面向高效 Web agent 的、用户对齐的能力管理的价值。
summary_cn: AutoTailor 用离线质量/使用可能性过滤加在线 Dynamic Reselection 把 1283 个自动生成的 MCP API 精简到 33 个，在 106 个 WebArena Postmill 任务上配合 ReAct fallback 达 90.6% 正确率（对比 ReAct 独立 87.5%），token 成本降 57.8%、延迟降 29.4%。
objective_summary: 提出 AutoTailor 元 Agent 框架，将 1,283 个原始 MCP API 经离线过滤压到 87 个、经动态重选到 33 个，在 106 个 WebArena Postmill 任务上加 ReAct 回退时正确率 90.6% vs ReAct 87.5%，token 成本降低 57.8%，延迟降低 29.4%。
evidence_note: 106 个任务的单一基准，含 ReAct baseline 和消融，但未跨模型、缺少统计检验。
novelty_note: 在轨迹合成 API 之上加质量与用户使用似然过滤并做动态维护，属方向内改进。
scope: 结论限于 WebArena Postmill 的 106 个网页任务和 MCP API 场景。
limitations: 只在单一基准与固定模型上验证，未评估长期用户偏好漂移与稳健性。

title: PEAT: Pseudo-Error Assessment for GPU Kernel Validation in DNN Training
title_cn: PEAT：DNN 训练中 GPU kernel 验证的伪错误评估
abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) are widely adopted in various fields, driving an emerging trend in developing software stacks associated with DNN training systems. For example, many codes have been ported across different frameworks or developed to leverage the computing power of GPUs or domain-specific accelerators. However, validating a kernel implementation in DNN training is time-consuming and generally requires massive storage. Specifically, this poses a fundamental question: how to characterize the behavior of a new implementation when it is integrated into a DNN training flow. Unfortunately, this problem is not well investigated in the literature, to the best of our knowledge. To address this shortcoming, we present PEAT - a lightweight inspection framework for \underline{P}seudo-\underline{E}rror \underline{A}ssessment associated with GPU kernel validation in DNN \underline{T}raining. Firstly, inspired by conventional fault injection (FI), PEAT's Profiler invokes an operation-wise kernel in a training flow to collect a DNN model's states (e.g., checkpoints and activations). More importantly, the Profiler introduces two simple yet effective techniques, playback FI and frequency-based runtime FI, leveraging persistent kernel calling during the training process. Secondly, PEAT's Analyzer characterizes profiled errors, revealing some signatures from the error distribution of a kernel compared to the golden one. Lastly, PEAT's Detector provides some guidelines as a sufficient condition, which enables associating several well-known error models with signature patterns. We demonstrate the applicability of our approach by presenting the results and analysis using GPUs from the two most popular vendors, NVIDIA V100 and AMD MI250, on various AI models, from vision tasks to language models, for both pretraining and finetuning scenarios.
abstract_cn: 深度神经网络（DNN）在众多领域被广泛采用，推动了围绕 DNN 训练系统的软件栈开发的新兴趋势。例如，许多代码在不同框架之间移植，或被开发用来利用 GPU 或领域专用加速器的算力。然而，验证 DNN 训练中的一个 kernel 实现耗时且通常需要海量存储。具体来说，这提出了一个根本问题：当一个新实现被集成进 DNN 训练流程时，如何刻画它的行为。遗憾的是，据我们所知，这个问题在文献中还未被充分研究。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出 PEAT——一个轻量的检查框架，用于对 DNN 训练中 GPU kernel 验证的伪错误评估（Pseudo-Error Assessment）。首先，受传统故障注入（FI）启发，PEAT 的 Profiler 在训练流程中调用某个算子级 kernel，收集 DNN 模型的状态（例如 checkpoint 和 activation）。更重要的是，Profiler 引入了两项简单却有效的技术——回放 FI 和基于频率的运行时 FI，利用训练过程中持续的 kernel 调用。其次，PEAT 的 Analyzer 刻画所记录的错误，从错误分布中揭示一个 kernel 相比黄金参照的一些特征。最后，PEAT 的 Detector 提供一些作为充分条件的指南，能够将若干已知的错误模型与特征模式关联起来。我们通过展示在两大主流厂商 GPU——NVIDIA V100 和 AMD MI250——上跨多种 AI 模型（从视觉任务到语言模型、涵盖预训练和微调两种场景）的结果与分析，展示了本方法的适用性。
summary_cn: 提出 PEAT 框架用故障注入思路在 DNN 训练流程中做算子级 kernel 状态采样，通过回放 FI 和基于频率的运行时 FI 分析错误分布，在 NVIDIA V100 和 AMD MI250 上跨视觉与语言模型的预训练与微调场景验证了适用性。
comment: 15 pages, 19 figures, and three tables
objective_summary: 提出 PEAT 轻量级检查框架，通过 Profiler／Analyzer／Detector 三阶段结合 playback 和频率 FI 表征 GPU kernel 的伪错误，在 NVIDIA V100 与 AMD MI250 上覆盖视觉与语言模型的预训练和微调。
evidence_note: 两个厂商 GPU、多种 AI 模型、预训练与微调两场景演示，但缺少与其他 FI／验证方法的定量对比。
novelty_note: 将故障注入思想改造为 DNN 训练场景下的 kernel 验证工具，属实质性工程改进。
scope: 面向 DNN 训练中 GPU kernel 实现验证，验证平台为 V100 和 MI250。
limitations: 缺乏与已有 kernel 验证／数值调试方法的 baseline 比较，效果指标未量化归纳。

title: Is Self-Admitted Technical Debt Tested? An Empirical Study of Coverage, Co-change, and Impact
title_cn: 自认技术债有被测试吗？覆盖率、共变更与影响的实证研究
abstract: When developers write a TODO or FIXME comment, they are explicitly admitting that the code is suboptimal: a built-in warning that this logic deserves extra scrutiny. Yet it is an open question whether Self-Admitted Technical Debt (SATD) actually receives that scrutiny in the form of software testing. We aim to characterize the relationship between SATD and testing across three dimensions: the extent to which SATD-affected code is covered by existing tests, whether developers synchronize test additions with debt resolution, and whether such testing affects the long-term observability of resulting defects. For that, we conducted an empirical study on eight open-source Java projects, analyzing test coverage of 784 SATD instances identified in the latest releases and performing a longitudinal examination of 5,175 SATD removal events. Our results show that while 60.7% of SATD-affected code is covered by existing test suites, developers rarely synchronize test modifications with debt resolution; manual inspection confirms that only 3.4% of SATD removal commits include new tests specifically targeting the resolved debt (vs. 12.5% that co-add tests in the same commit). Longitudinal analysis further suggests that SATD resolutions exhibit nearly identical localized bug induction rates within short-to-medium-term windows regardless of test modifications. However, over a longer, unrestricted observation window, a slight divergence emerges where the test-added group reaches a higher cumulative defect alignment probability (6.32% vs. 4.37%), a counterintuitive trend potentially driven by the selective testing of inherently complex components. Developers treat SATD repayment as an ordinary code change rather than as a high-risk maintenance activity: most debt removals proceed without targeted verification, despite the developer's own prior flag that the code is suboptimal.
abstract_cn: 当开发者写下 TODO 或 FIXME 注释时，他们是在明确承认这段代码存在不足：这是一条内建的警告，表明该逻辑值得额外审视。然而 Self-Admitted Technical Debt (SATD) 是否真的通过软件测试获得了这种审视，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们旨在从三个维度刻画 SATD 与测试的关系：受 SATD 影响的代码被现有测试覆盖的程度、开发者是否将测试新增与债务修复同步进行、以及此类测试是否影响所生成缺陷的长期可观测性。为此，我们在 8 个开源 Java 项目上开展了实证研究，分析了最新版本中 784 个 SATD 实例的测试覆盖情况，并对 5,175 个 SATD 移除事件进行了纵向考察。结果表明，虽然 60.7% 受 SATD 影响的代码被既有测试套件覆盖，但开发者很少将测试修改与债务修复同步；人工审查确认，仅有 3.4% 的 SATD 移除提交包含专门针对所修复债务的新测试（相比之下，12.5% 的提交在同次提交中协同新增了测试）。纵向分析进一步表明，无论是否伴随测试修改，SATD 修复在短期到中期窗口内表现出几乎相同的局部 bug 引入率。然而在更长的、不受限制的观察窗口下，出现了轻微的分化：新增测试组达到更高的累积缺陷对齐概率（6.32% vs 4.37%），这一反直觉趋势可能源于对本身较为复杂组件的选择性测试。开发者将 SATD 偿还视为普通代码变更，而非高风险的维护活动：尽管他们此前已亲手标注该代码不足，大多数债务移除仍在没有针对性验证的情况下推进。
summary_cn: 在 8 个开源 Java 项目、784 个 SATD 实例与 5,175 次 SATD 移除事件上发现：60.7% 的 SATD 代码被既有测试覆盖，但仅 3.4% 的移除提交新增了针对该债务的测试（同次共同新增测试的也只有 12.5%）；长期看新增测试组的累积缺陷对齐概率反而更高（6.32% vs 4.37%），提示开发者把 SATD 偿还当普通改动而非高风险维护。
objective_summary: 对 8 个开源 Java 项目做实证研究，分析 784 个 SATD 实例和 5,175 次移除事件；60.7% 的 SATD 代码有测试覆盖，但只有 3.4% 的移除提交新增针对性测试，长期缺陷对齐率 6.32% vs 4.37%。
evidence_note: 8 个 Java 项目、784 实例加 5,175 移除事件的纵向分析，含人工核查，但未做显著性检验。
novelty_note: 首次系统联结 SATD 与测试覆盖／共同修改／长期缺陷可观测性三个维度。
scope: 结论局限于 8 个开源 Java 项目、基于注释的 SATD 识别方式。
limitations: SATD 依赖关键词识别，样本仅 Java 且属开源，未控制项目差异等混杂因素。

title: Root-Cause Attribution Is a Search Problem: Continual Search for Long-Horizon Agent Failures
title_cn: 根因归因是一个搜索问题：面向长时程 agent 失败的 Continual Search
abstract: The increasing deployment of AI agents in long-horizon tasks yields massive execution logs. Diagnosing failures within these records is crucial for reliability, as it transforms outcome-level signals into actionable interventions. The sheer scale of the data renders human review impractical, driving the need for automated root-cause attribution (RCA). However, automated RCA methods using LLMs suffer from low diagnostic accuracy, especially as execution traces grow larger. They struggle because relevant information is often sparse, distributed across distant actions, and disconnected from the visible failure, reducing root-cause attribution to a massive search problem. Existing RCA methods typically rely on one-shot LLM judgments to diagnose failures from execution traces. While effective for shorter trajectories, these judges tend to settle on a plausible diagnosis early, leaving critical evidence in longer traces unexamined. We introduce Continual Search, an iterative framework that nudges the judge, over successive turns, to keep searching for unresolved diagnostic evidence. We evaluate Continual Search across four existing RCA benchmarks. Recognizing the lack of massive execution traces in current benchmarks, we introduce MegaRCA-Mix to evaluate RCA at scale. MegaRCA-Mix provides a challenging testbed of 50 human-annotated failure trials spanning long-horizon, execution-heavy tasks. Across multiple benchmark suites and model families, Continual Search consistently improves attribution performance. On MegaRCA-Mix, for example, it improves GPT-5.5's F1 score by more than 40\%, from $0.349$ to $0.498$. More interestingly, within the same model family, lower-tier models can even surpass their higher-tier counterparts, demonstrating that effective search supersedes raw model scale.
abstract_cn: AI agent 在长时程任务中的日益部署产生了海量执行日志。诊断这些记录中的失败对可靠性至关重要，因为它将结果层面的信号转化为可执行的干预。数据的规模让人工审阅不可行，从而推动了对自动根因归因（RCA）的需求。然而，使用 LLM 的自动 RCA 方法诊断准确率较低，尤其在执行轨迹变大时。它们之所以吃力，是因为相关信息往往稀疏、散布在相距很远的动作之中，且与可见的失败断开联系，将根因归因削减为一个大规模搜索问题。已有的 RCA 方法通常依赖一次性的 LLM 判断来从执行轨迹中诊断失败。虽然对较短的轨迹有效，这些判断器往往过早锁定一个看起来合理的诊断，从而让较长轨迹中的关键证据未被查看。我们提出 Continual Search，一个迭代式框架，让判断器在连续多轮中被推动去继续搜索尚未解决的诊断证据。我们在四个已有的 RCA benchmark 上评测 Continual Search。鉴于当前 benchmark 缺少海量执行轨迹，我们提出 MegaRCA-Mix 用于在大规模上评测 RCA。MegaRCA-Mix 提供了一个由 50 个人工标注失败试验组成的具挑战性测试床，涵盖长时程、执行密集的任务。跨多个 benchmark 套件和多个模型族，Continual Search 一致地提升了归因性能。例如在 MegaRCA-Mix 上，它将 GPT-5.5 的 F1 分数提升了超过 40%，从 0.349 提高到 0.498。更有趣的是，在同一模型族内，低阶模型甚至可以反超其高阶对应者，表明有效搜索胜过原始的模型规模。
summary_cn: 把 agent 根因归因看成搜索问题，提出 Continual Search 让判断器多轮迭代地追查未解证据，并发布含 50 个人工标注长时程 trace 的 MegaRCA-Mix；在其上把 GPT-5.5 的 F1 从 0.349 提升到 0.498（涨幅超 40%），且同族低阶模型在有效搜索下能反超高阶模型。
objective_summary: 提出 Continual Search 迭代式根因归因框架，并构建 50 例人工标注的 MegaRCA-Mix 基准，在 4 个已有 RCA 基准与多个模型上验证，GPT-5.5 F1 从 0.349 提升到 0.498（+40% 以上）。
evidence_note: 覆盖 4 个已有基准加自建 50 例基准，多模型家族对比，含 baseline，但无显著性检验。
novelty_note: 把长轨迹 RCA 显式建模为搜索问题并用多轮追问替代一次判断，视角较新。
scope: 面向长执行轨迹的 AI agent 失败诊断，评测限于 4 个 RCA 基准与 MegaRCA-Mix。
limitations: MegaRCA-Mix 仅 50 例样本规模有限，且依赖 LLM 判官自身能力上限。

title: Rethinking Software Development as a Self-Adaptive Socio-Technical System
title_cn: 把软件开发重新审视为一个自适应的社会-技术系统
abstract: Agentic AI is expanding across various software engineering activities, yet human-agent organization is typically treated as fixed, which is problematic because development configurations may become suboptimal as development context evolves. We propose viewing software development as a self-adaptive socio-technical system in which both the software project and the development configuration (participants, responsibilities, authority, information, and verification) adapt as goals, evidence, uncertainty, and risk evolve. This yields two coupled forms of adaptation: evolving the software and reconfiguring how subsequent engineering is performed. We illustrate the idea with a proof of concept, outlining challenges and future plans.
abstract_cn: Agentic AI 正扩展到各种软件工程活动，然而人-agent 的组织通常被当作固定的，这是有问题的，因为随着开发上下文演化，开发配置可能变得次优。我们提出把软件开发视为一个自适应的社会-技术系统，其中软件项目与开发配置（参与者、职责、权限、信息、验证）都随着目标、证据、不确定性与风险的演化而进行适应。这产生了两种相互耦合的适应形式：演进软件本身，以及重构后续工程的执行方式。我们以一个概念验证阐述这一想法，并勾勒出挑战与未来计划。
summary_cn: 针对 agentic AI 时代人-agent 组织被当作固定不变的问题，提出把软件开发视为自适应社会-技术系统：软件与开发配置（参与者、职责、权限、信息、验证）随目标/证据/不确定性/风险的演化而共同适应，并给出概念验证。
objective_summary: 提出将软件开发视为自适应社会技术系统的框架，让软件与开发配置（参与者、职责、权限、信息、验证）随目标、证据、不确定性和风险共同演化，并给出一个概念验证。
evidence_note: 仅一个 proof of concept 示意，未做定量评估、无 baseline、无对比实验。
novelty_note: 将自适应系统理念套用到人—Agent 协作配置上，视角有新意但缺乏具体机制。
scope: 面向 agentic AI 参与的软件开发组织形态，结论停留在概念与示例层面。
limitations: 只是概念性提议加简单示例，未验证适应机制在真实项目中的可行性与代价。

title: Usage Control in Public Data Exchange Infrastructures for Future Digital Governance
title_cn: 面向未来数字治理的公共数据交换基础设施中的使用控制
abstract: Public data exchange infrastructures, such as X-Road, are essential to data-intensive digital public services and the EU digital economy. Their next generation requires advanced data usage control (DUC) mechanisms that address emerging requirements, including privacy by design, to mitigate privacy threats inherent in large-scale automated data exchange. Although research within the individual disciplines already addresses many of the emerging requirements, significant practical challenges arise at the intersection of the disciplines. This paper analytically examines the practical challenges and requirements of data usage control in public data exchange infrastructures. We examine the Estonian X-Road system and emerging use cases through an interdisciplinary lens that integrates formal verification and monitoring of usage control, requirements engineering, and digital governance research. We formulate key requirements and propose a conceptual vision for developing usage control in public data-exchange infrastructures to enable future digital-governance systems to comply with privacy requirements by design.
abstract_cn: 公共数据交换基础设施，例如 X-Road，是数据密集型数字公共服务与欧盟数字经济的关键。其下一代要求先进的数据使用控制（DUC）机制，以应对新兴需求，包括隐私 by design，从而缓解大规模自动化数据交换所固有的隐私威胁。虽然各学科内部的研究已涉及许多新兴需求，但在学科交叉处出现了显著的实践挑战。本文分析性地考察了公共数据交换基础设施中数据使用控制的实践挑战与需求。我们通过一个整合形式化验证与使用控制监控、需求工程与数字治理研究的跨学科视角，考察了爱沙尼亚 X-Road 系统与新兴用例。我们提炼了关键需求，并提出一个概念性愿景，用于在公共数据交换基础设施中发展使用控制，使未来数字治理系统能够 by design 地满足隐私要求。
summary_cn: 以爱沙尼亚 X-Road 为对象，通过整合形式化验证与使用控制监控、需求工程和数字治理的跨学科视角，分析公共数据交换基础设施中数据使用控制（DUC）的实践挑战，提炼关键需求并给出让未来数字治理系统 by design 满足隐私要求的概念性愿景。
objective_summary: 以爱沙尼亚 X-Road 系统与新兴用例为对象，从形式验证与监控、需求工程、数字治理跨学科视角分析公共数据交换基础设施中数据使用控制的挑战，提炼关键需求并给出概念愿景。
evidence_note: 以 X-Road 与新兴用例为分析对象的愿景性论文，无系统实验或量化评估。
novelty_note: 整合形式验证、需求工程与数字治理三学科分析公共数据交换的使用控制需求。
scope: 结论以爱沙尼亚 X-Road 与欧盟数字经济情境下的公共数据交换基础设施为限。
limitations: 分析性愿景，未给出实现或经验评估，所提需求与愿景仍需实证验证。

title: The Agentic Company OS: Substrate Inversion for Sustained Enterprise Agent Deployment
title_cn: Agentic Company OS：面向企业 agent 持续部署的「基底反转」
abstract: Enterprise AI agents often succeed in a demonstration and then stall once they must operate day after day. An industry report estimates that most pilots never reach production and that deployed systems rarely retain feedback or improve over time, while agent benchmarks show single-run successes masking unreliable repetition. We argue that these failure modes share a common architectural root: agents reason over data structured for human operators and traditional applications, not for the language models that power them. This position paper proposes that companies deploying agents in sustained operation should rebuild their cognitive substrate, the shared environment agents read as working context, around representations matched to that reasoning surface, isolating schema translation to the action boundary. Markdown is the instantiation available today, not a proven agent-native primitive. Two mechanisms ground the argument: context-bandwidth asymmetry, the gap between one-pass reading of connected prose and field-by-field typed access that strips relations; and cross-loop coupling, the claim that action, skill, and policy loops compound only if they share one substrate. A four-layer framework (Data, Knowledge, Intelligence, Governance) operationalizes the position, with a Sync Agent enforcing the action boundary and a per-skill trust gradient, making governance and auditability structural properties of the substrate. The position revives the shared-substrate tradition of classical multi-agent systems under LLM-era economics. We analyze the main objections and risks, including indirect prompt injection on the compile path, and outline a research agenda for evaluating substrates directly.
abstract_cn: 企业 AI agent 常常在演示中成功，但一旦必须日复一日地运行便陷入停滞。一份行业报告估计大多数试点从未进入生产，已部署系统也很少保留反馈或随时间改进，与此同时 agent 基准显示：单次运行的成功掩盖了不可靠的重复执行。我们认为这些失败模式共享一个共同的架构根源：agent 是在为人类操作员和传统应用而组织的数据之上进行推理，而不是为驱动它们的语言模型所准备的数据。这篇立场论文提出，部署 agent 进行持续运营的公司应当重建其认知基底——agent 作为工作上下文所读取的共享环境——围绕与其推理表面匹配的表示进行组织，并把模式转换隔离到动作边界。Markdown 是目前可用的实例，而非已被证明的 agent 原生原语。有两个机制支撑该论点：上下文-带宽不对称，即一次性读取连贯散文与逐字段类型化访问（会剥离关系）之间的差距；以及跨循环耦合，即动作、技能与策略循环只有共享同一基底时才能相互复合的论断。一个四层框架（数据、知识、智能、治理）将立场操作化，由 Sync Agent 强制执行动作边界并提供每项技能的信任梯度，使治理与可审计性成为基底的结构性属性。这一立场在 LLM 时代的经济学之下复兴了经典多 agent 系统的共享基底传统。我们分析了主要反对意见与风险，包括编译路径上的间接 prompt 注入，并勾勒了直接评估基底的研究议程。
summary_cn: 立场论文认为企业 agent 从演示走不到生产的根源是「在为人类和传统应用组织的数据上推理」，主张围绕匹配 LLM 推理面的表示重建认知基底、把 schema 转换隔离到动作边界；提出「数据/知识/智能/治理」四层框架与 Sync Agent，讨论上下文-带宽不对称、跨循环耦合以及编译路径上的间接 prompt 注入等风险。
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted as a peer-reviewed short paper (position-paper track) at the 2nd International Conference on Agentic and Generative Techniques in Intelligent Computational Systems (AGENTICS 2026), Angers, France, 28-30 October 2026, part of IJCCI 2026, and for publication in the Springer CCIS proceedings. This is the author's accepted manuscript
objective_summary: 立场论文主张长期部署的企业代理应围绕匹配 LLM 推理面的共享认知基底重建（当前以 Markdown 为实例），并将模式翻译隔离到动作边界；提出数据、知识、智能、治理四层框架与 Sync Agent 概念。
evidence_note: 19 页立场短文，仅有机制论证与主要反驳分析，无量化实验或对照评估。
novelty_note: 以「基底反转」重述共享基底传统，将治理与可审计性作为基底结构性质。
scope: 结论为立场性主张，面向长期运行的企业级代理部署，未限定行业或规模。
limitations: 作者自陈 Markdown 并非已验证的代理原生原语，评估基底的研究议程尚待推进。

title: SkillSeam: Six Principles for Auditing Agent Skill Collections
title_cn: SkillSeam：审计 agent 技能集合的六项原则
abstract: A folder of competent skills is not yet a reliable system. Skills rarely fail alone; they fail at the seams of a collection. As an agent's skill library grows, procedures compete for attention, aliases double-load, boundaries blur, and poorly sized skills turn routing errors into task failures. We introduce SkillSeam, a method that audits the relationships through which individual skill files become a system. It maps each collection-level principle to a failure mechanism, its strongest observable, and a controlled perturbation test. From one sealed skill system, SkillSeam perturbs six design principles: persistence gradient, system coherence, regime gating, orthogonal coverage, flow, and granularity discipline. Crucially, each principle is evaluated through the channel its failure mechanism predicts rather than through accuracy alone. Flattening the persistence hierarchy increases loaded-skill tokens by 60%; a dangling anchor raises total tokens by 64% and shifts accuracy by -3.1pp; with skill count and context size held fixed, replacing an unrelated control with a synonymous alias raises noncanonical routes from 0/32 to 15/32 and flips half of matched paraphrase pairs; in a candidate-ownership audit, overlapping lanes raise reported ownership conflicts from 0/16 to 14/16; bland triggers drive routing conflicts from 3/32 to 30/32 and inflate loaded-skill tokens 3.7x; and one granularity mis-mix produces the largest accuracy drop, -12.5pp. These outcomes turn six pieces of authoring advice into testable system properties without treating every probe as confirmation. We release the byte-differenced variants, task slices, rollups, and a one-screen design checklist so that other skill systems can measure the same failure channels.
abstract_cn: 一个装满合格技能的文件夹还不等于一个可靠的系统。技能很少单独失败；它们在集合的接缝处失败。随着 agent 的技能库增长，各种流程会争抢注意力，别名会重复加载，边界变得模糊，尺寸不当的技能会把路由错误变成任务失败。我们提出 SkillSeam，一种审计单个技能文件如何组成系统的方法。它将每一条集合层面的原则映射到一种失败机制、其最强可观测量以及一次受控扰动测试。从一个封装好的技能系统出发，SkillSeam 扰动六项设计原则：persistence gradient（持久性梯度）、system coherence（系统一致性）、regime gating（体制门控）、orthogonal coverage（正交覆盖）、flow（流）和 granularity discipline（粒度纪律）。关键在于每一条原则都通过其失败机制所预测的通道来评估，而不是仅仅通过准确率。压平持久性层级会让已加载技能的 token 增加 60%；一个悬空锚点会让总 token 提升 64% 并让准确率下降 3.1pp；在技能数量与上下文大小固定的情况下，用同义别名替换一个无关的对照，会把非规范路由从 0/32 提高到 15/32，并翻转半数匹配的释义对；在候选归属审计中，重叠的车道会把所报告的归属冲突从 0/16 提高到 14/16；平淡的触发词会把路由冲突从 3/32 拉到 30/32，并把已加载技能的 token 膨胀 3.7 倍；一次粒度错配则带来最大的准确率下降，-12.5pp。这些结果把六条创作建议转化为可测试的系统属性，而不是把每一个探针都当作证实。我们发布了 byte-differenced 变体、任务切片、汇总以及一份一屏可读的设计清单，让其他技能系统可以测量相同的失败通道。
summary_cn: SkillSeam 对 agent 技能集合的六条设计原则做受控扰动，把创作建议转成可测的失败通道：例如一次粒度错配让准确率下降 12.5pp，同义别名替换让非规范路由从 0/32 飙到 15/32，平淡触发词把已加载技能 token 膨胀 3.7 倍。
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables
objective_summary: 提出六条技能集合审计原则，对单一封装技能系统做受控扰动：扁平化持久性令加载技能 token +60%，悬挂锚点致总 token +64% 与 -3.1pp 准确率，同义别名将非规范路由由 0/32 升至 15/32，粒度错配 -12.5pp。
evidence_note: 单一封装技能系统上做六项受控扰动，报告 token、路由、准确率多通道量化。
novelty_note: 首次将六项技能集合作者建议转化为按预测失效通道可测的系统属性。
scope: 结论来自单个封装技能系统的受控扰动，六原则通道以此系统为验证基。
limitations: 仅在一个封装技能系统扰动，未评估其他代理、不同规模或真实部署下的推广性。

title: From Experiments to Decisions: Reusing Evidence in Autonomous Coding Research
title_cn: 从实验到决策：在自主编码研究中复用证据
abstract: Autonomous coding agents can remember an experiment yet carry forward a conclusion it does not justify. We reconstruct how evidence is reused in a 400-task NeuroGolf campaign, with selected wellbore-prediction records from the same operator as cross-domain comparisons. A numerical counterexample exposes an overbroad exclusion; other episodes distinguish what failed, incomplete and revised programs justify doing next. The wellbore records reveal an additional weakness: a coordinator correctly acknowledges a novelty-only rejection, then summarizes it as measured closure. Separately, a prefix-based acceptance gate at three thresholds yields worse target scores than ungated adaptation in the retained experiment. These cases motivate an inspectable handoff linking the tested proposition, its scope, candidate and evaluator identity, check statuses, and reopening condition. A dispatch tree separates investigation, repair, reopening and stopping; a promotion predicate requires that each check both passes and has evidence supporting its use for the requested decision. The practical lesson is to preserve not just experimental results, but their limits on subsequent action.
abstract_cn: 自主编码 agent 能记住一次实验，却携带一个该实验并不支持的结论。我们重构了在一次 400 任务 NeuroGolf 活动中证据是如何被复用的，并选取了同一操作者的 wellbore-prediction 记录作为跨领域对照。一个数值反例暴露了一次过宽的排除；其他事件区分了什么失败，以及不完整和修订后的程序凭什么去做下一步。wellbore 记录还揭示了一个额外的弱点：一个协调器正确地承认了一次只针对新颖性的拒绝，却把它总结为已测度的收敛。此外，在保留的实验中，基于前缀的接受门控在三个阈值下都得到比未经门控的适配更差的目标分数。这些案例促成一种可检查的交接方式，把被测命题、其适用范围、候选者与评估者身份、检查状态以及重开条件连接起来。一棵 dispatch tree 将调查、修复、重开与停止分离；一个提升谓词要求每一项检查既通过、又有证据支持其被用于所请求的决策。实践教训是：不仅要保留实验结果，还要保留它们对后续行动的约束。
summary_cn: 在一次 400 任务 NeuroGolf 活动中重构自主编码 agent 复用证据的方式，发现 agent 会「记住实验却携带该实验并不支持的结论」，并提出把命题、范围、候选/评估者身份、检查状态与重开条件绑定的可检查交接机制。
comment: 31 pages, including technical appendices. Submitted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding (VeriCodeGen)
objective_summary: 以 400 任务 NeuroGolf 及若干井筒预测记录为对象，展示自动编码代理如何错误复用证据；提出可检验的交接结构、分派树与推广谓词，并指出前缀阈值门控劣于未门控自适应。
evidence_note: 400 任务加井筒预测记录，属案例分析，无系统基线对照或统计显著性检验。
novelty_note: 提出保存实验限度的可视交接、分派树与要求证据支持的推广谓词。
scope: 结论以 NeuroGolf 与井筒预测两类任务上的自动编码代理行为为限。
limitations: 以案例驱动的定性论证为主，缺乏对照实验与跨领域推广的量化验证。

title: Abstention Errors and Segment Support in CUAD: An Auditable Contract-Extraction Case Study
title_cn: CUAD 上的弃答错误与分段支持：一次可审计的合同抽取案例研究
abstract: Contract-clause extraction benchmarks measure reference recovery, but interpreting a system for review assistance also requires measuring unnecessary output and the evidence available within categories. This paper presents a retrospective, reproducible evaluation of a fixed public RoBERTa checkpoint on CUAD's published 102-contract test split. Candidate generation is preserved from an earlier frozen run; matching errors are corrected and category thresholds are reselected on 62 training-split contracts using the original 90% recall target. The corrected operating point recovers 82.2% of reference spans at 8.2% CUAD precision. Of 30,464 returned candidate strings, 19,562 occur on questions with no annotated answer. The system answers 1,335 of 2,938 such questions, a 45.4% false-positive rate (95% contract-bootstrap interval: 43.3-47.9%). Matching candidates constitute 20.3% of returned strings, illustrating why reference-based precision and candidate-level review burden require different denominators. Only nine of 41 categories have at least 30 positive and 30 negative contracts; this count changes to 18 and two under support minima of 20 and 40. Two categories have no negative contracts, making their no-answer false-positive rates undefined. These findings describe one checkpoint, decoder, and threshold policy. Earlier test access and uncertain checkpoint training overlap limit confirmatory interpretation. The paper supplies the original and corrected analyses, predictions, and software checks as ancillary artifacts; it establishes neither a new release criterion nor production readiness.
abstract_cn: 合同条款抽取基准衡量参考文本的召回情况，但为审查辅助解读一个系统还需要度量不必要的输出以及各类别内可用的证据。本文对一个固定的公开 RoBERTa 检查点在 CUAD 已公布的 102 合同测试集上进行了一次回顾性、可复现的评估。候选生成沿用一次此前冻结的运行；纠正了匹配错误，并在 62 份训练集合同上以最初 90% 的召回目标重新选择类别阈值。修正后的操作点以 8.2% 的 CUAD precision 恢复了 82.2% 的参考跨度。在返回的 30,464 条候选字符串中，有 19,562 条出现在没有标注答案的问题上。系统回答了此类 2,938 个问题中的 1,335 个，false-positive rate 为 45.4%（95% 合同 bootstrap 区间：43.3-47.9%）。匹配到的候选占返回字符串的 20.3%，说明了为什么基于参考的 precision 与候选级的审查负担需要不同的分母。41 个类别中只有 9 个同时具有至少 30 个正例与 30 个负例合同；在支持下限为 20 和 40 时，这一数目分别变为 18 和 2。两个类别没有负例合同，使得其无答案 false-positive rate 未定义。这些发现描述的是一个 checkpoint、解码器和阈值策略。较早的测试访问以及 checkpoint 训练重叠的不确定性限制了对确证性解读。本文提供了原始与修正的分析、预测以及软件检查作为附属工件；它既未确立新的发布标准，也未确立生产可用性。
summary_cn: 用固定公开 RoBERTa 检查点在 CUAD 已公布的 102 合同测试集上做回顾性评估，指出在 82.2% 参考召回时对无答案问题仍有 45.4% 假阳性率，41 个类别里只有 9 个同时具备至少 30 正 30 负样本。
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. Includes appendices and ancillary data and code for reproducibility
objective_summary: 在 CUAD 102 合同测试集上重评固定公开 RoBERTa 检查点：修正匹配错误并按 90% 召回目标在 62 训练合同上重选阈值后，回收 82.2% 参考跨度、CUAD 精度 8.2%，无答案题的假阳率 45.4%（自助 95% 区间 43.3-47.9%）。
evidence_note: 在 CUAD 102 合同测试集重评单一检查点，报告类别支持与自助置信区间，但未做多基线比较。
novelty_note: 引入弃权错误与类别证据支持维度，区分参考精度与候选级审查负担。
scope: 结论仅针对一个固定 RoBERTa 检查点、单一解码器与阈值策略在 CUAD 上的表现。
limitations: 作者自陈：早期测试集访问与检查点训练重叠不确定，限制确证性解读。

title: Adaptive Human-AI Collaboration: A Review of Multimodal Context Modeling, Uncertainty-Aware Intervention, and Longitudinal Co-Adaptation
title_cn: 自适应人机协作：多模态上下文建模、不确定性感知干预与纵向共适应综述
abstract: Artificial intelligence is shifting from a static decision-support tool to an adaptive collaborator that must sense context, decide when and how to intervene, and improve through repeated interaction with humans individually and in groups. Yet meta-analytic evidence shows that human-AI combinations often fail to outperform the best of either partner alone, and the enabling literature remains fragmented across multimodal sensing, uncertainty quantification, reliance and delegation, facilitation, and teaming. This paper reports a review of adaptive human-AI collaboration literature through a closed-loop lens. Following iterative identification, staged selection against explicit criteria, structured extraction, taxonomy-driven synthesis, and snowballing, we analyze 50 reviewed works. We contribute i) a taxonomy of multimodal context modeling, from individual states to collective states such as group engagement and participation equality; ii) a taxonomy of uncertainty-aware intervention, covering uncertainty sources, estimation and calibration mechanisms, an intervention repertoire that ranges from explanation modulation and deferral to group facilitation, and intervention policies; and iii) a taxonomy of longitudinal co-adaptation and synergy-oriented evaluation. We integrate the three taxonomies into MCAL, a dual-timescale Multimodal Co-Adaptation Loop reference model, and instantiate it on a mixed human-robot workspace, walking every stage of the loop through one concrete setting to show what each taxonomy cell holds in practice.
abstract_cn: 人工智能正从静态决策支持工具转向自适应协作者，它必须感知上下文、决定何时以及如何介入，并通过与个体和群体人类的反复交互而不断改进。然而元分析证据表明，人机组合往往无法超越任一方单独工作的最佳表现，且相关文献散落在多模态感知、不确定性量化、依赖与委派、引导与团队协作等多个方向，呈现碎片化状态。本文以闭环视角对自适应人机协作文献进行综述。我们经过迭代识别、按明确标准进行分阶段筛选、结构化抽取、以分类法为驱动的综合以及滚雪球检索，共分析了 50 篇被纳入综述的工作。我们的贡献包括：i) 一套多模态上下文建模的分类法，覆盖从个体状态到集体状态（如群体投入度和参与均衡性）；ii) 一套不确定性感知干预的分类法，涵盖不确定性来源、估计与校准机制、从解释调制与延后决策到群体引导的干预策略库，以及干预策略本身；iii) 一套纵向共适应与面向协同增效的评估的分类法。我们将三套分类法整合为 MCAL——一个双时间尺度的多模态共适应循环参考模型（Multimodal Co-Adaptation Loop），并在一个人机器人混合工作空间中对其进行实例化，通过一个具体场景走完循环的每一个阶段，展示每个分类单元在实践中的具体内容。
summary_cn: 以闭环视角综述 50 篇自适应人机协作文献，提出多模态上下文建模、不确定性感知干预、纵向共适应三套分类法，并整合为双时间尺度的 MCAL 参考模型，在人机器人共享工作空间上做实例化演示。
comment: Accepted to be published at the Companion of the INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON MULTIMODAL INTERACTION (ICMI Companion '26), October 05--09, 2026, Napoli, Italy
objective_summary: 以闭环视角综述 50 篇自适应人机协作文献，构建多模态情境建模、不确定性驱动干预、纵向共适应三套分类，并整合为双时间尺度的 MCAL 参考模型，在混合人机工作台场景实例化。
evidence_note: 综述 50 篇文献，采用迭代识别、分阶段筛选与结构化提取，样本规模中等。
novelty_note: 将多模态情境、不确定性干预与纵向共适应整合为闭环参考模型 MCAL。
scope: 结论限于 50 篇纳入文献覆盖的自适应人机协作与人机团队场景。
limitations: 仅在一个混合人机工作台场景做走查式实例化，未做量化验证或外部评估。

title: Beyond Establishing the Four-Day Workweek: Understanding Adaptation and Long-Term Survival in an Agile Software Organization
title_cn: 超越确立四天工作制：理解敏捷软件组织中的适应与长期存续
abstract: Context: Existing research on the four-day workweek (4DWW) has primarily examined its introduction and short-term effects, with limited understanding of its long-term survival or its interaction with agile software development. Objective: We study how a reduced-hour 4DWW is introduced, adapted, institutionalized, and sustained under changing organizational and external conditions in an agile software organization. Method: We conducted a longitudinal single-case study of a software organization operating a 32-hour, four-day week. The study draws on 15 semi-structured interviews in 2022 and 2026, analyzed using qualitative content analysis. Results: The 4DWW is better understood as an evolving arrangement than a one-off intervention. After the introduction, teams redesigned coordination, communication, meetings, agile practices, and iterations to adapt to reduced working time. Once institutionalized, the 4DWW faced ownership change, economic downturn, and market and AI pressures. Rather than reverting to five-day workweek, employees absorbed these pressures through voluntary protective adaptations, while anticipating that a rollback would harm job satisfaction, organizational commitment, and employer image. Contribution: We contribute longitudinal evidence on sustaining 4DWW in agile software development and propose two conceptual artifacts: a lifecycle model of the 4DWW and a 4DWW survival matrix, explaining how external pressures and management rationale rollback risk.
abstract_cn: Context：已有关于四天工作制（4DWW）的研究主要考察其引入与短期效应，对其长期存续或其与敏捷软件开发的交互理解有限。Objective：我们研究一种减少工时的 4DWW 如何在敏捷软件组织中被引入、适应、制度化，并在变化的组织与外部条件下被持续。Method：我们对一家采用 32 小时四天工作制的软件组织进行了纵向单案例研究。研究依托 2022 年与 2026 年的 15 次半结构化访谈，采用质性内容分析。Results：4DWW 更适合被理解为一种演化中的安排，而非一次性干预。引入之后，团队重新设计了协调、沟通、会议、敏捷实践与迭代以适应减少的工作时间。一旦制度化，4DWW 面临所有权变更、经济下行以及市场与 AI 压力。员工没有回退到五天工作制，而是通过自愿的保护性适应吸收这些压力，同时预期回退会损害工作满意度、组织承诺与雇主形象。Contribution：我们为在敏捷软件开发中维持 4DWW 提供了纵向证据，并提出两个概念性产物：4DWW 的生命周期模型以及 4DWW 存续矩阵，用于解释外部压力与管理层理据如何影响回退风险。
summary_cn: 对一家 32 小时四天工作制的敏捷软件公司做 2022 与 2026 两轮共 15 次访谈的纵向单案例研究，提出 4DWW 生命周期模型与存续矩阵；关键结论：面对所有权变更、经济下行与 AI 压力，员工通过自愿的保护性适应吸收压力而未回退到五天工作制。
objective_summary: 对一家实行 32 小时四天工作制的敏捷软件公司做 2022 与 2026 两轮共 15 次半结构化访谈的纵向案例研究，提出四天工作制生命周期模型与生存矩阵。
evidence_note: 单一软件组织纵向案例，两轮共 15 次访谈的质性内容分析，无跨案例对照。
novelty_note: 补齐 4DWW 在敏捷软工背景下长期存续与适应的纵向证据，并给出两个概念产物。
scope: 结论限于单一敏捷软件公司在 32 小时四天工作制下的适应与制度化过程。
limitations: 单案例样本，仅 15 次访谈，向其他行业、组织规模或工作制形态外推受限。

title: Involving before Evolving: A Vision for Trustworthy Enterprise Digital Twin Engineering
title_cn: 先介入再演化：可信企业数字孪生工程的愿景
abstract: Enterprise Digital Twins (EDTs) promise data-driven decision support at organizational scale, but realizing them requires navigating siloed departments, tacit knowledge, and high-stakes decisions with long-horizon consequences. Existing approaches involve domain experts during model development but focus less on early organizational buy-in in EDTs. We present a vision for trustworthy EDT engineering grounded in an `involving before evolving' paradigm: rapidly involving stakeholders through a working prototype before evolving toward federation and full interoperability. Our three-stage approach combines foundation models for rapid prototyping, an ontological backbone for federated interoperability, and observability tooling for stakeholder trust. We ground our vision in an ongoing collaboration with Michelin, a multinational manufacturer, where an initial prototype has helped support stakeholder buy-in.
abstract_cn: 企业数字孪生（EDTs）承诺在组织规模上提供数据驱动的决策支持，但要实现它们需要跨越部门孤岛、隐性知识以及具有长时程后果的高风险决策。已有方法在模型开发过程中引入领域专家，但较少关注 EDT 早期的组织认同建立。我们提出了一种可信 EDT 工程的愿景，立足于「先介入，再演化」（involving before evolving）范式：先通过一个可工作的原型迅速让利益相关者参与进来，再朝联邦化与完全互操作演化。我们的三阶段方法结合了用于快速原型的基础模型、用于联邦互操作的本体骨架，以及用于建立利益相关者信任的可观测性工具。我们的愿景植根于与跨国制造商 Michelin 的持续合作，其中一个初始原型已经帮助获得了利益相关者的认同。
summary_cn: 提出「先介入再演化」范式的三阶段可信企业数字孪生工程愿景：用基础模型做快速原型、用本体骨架实现联邦互操作、用可观测性建立信任，并以与 Michelin 的合作原型作为落地佐证。
comment: Accepted for publication at MODELS Companion 2026 (Málaga, Spain). 5 pages (4 pages + 1 page references)
objective_summary: 提出企业数字孪生「参与先于演化」三阶段方法：基础模型快速原型、本体骨架实现联邦互操作、可观测工具支持信任，并以与米其林合作的初步原型为背景。
evidence_note: 5 页愿景短文，仅以米其林合作的初步原型作背景，无量化实验或对照。
novelty_note: 将「参与先于演化」纳入 EDT 工程流程，强调早期组织认同优先于技术演化。
scope: 结论为愿景性主张，仅以米其林一家制造企业的进行中原型为经验背景。
limitations: 无系统评估或多案例对照，方法有效性依赖单一正在进行的企业合作。

title: Intelligent Semantic Matching (ISM) for Video Tutorial Search using Transformer Models
title_cn: 面向视频教程搜索的智能语义匹配（ISM）：基于 Transformer 模型
abstract: The rise in the number and diversity of available software development video tutorials has enhanced digital learning for developers but also introduced challenges in locating relevant content efficiently. Existing video search methods, including keyword-based approaches and tools like CodeTube and TechTube, rely primarily on retrieval algorithms such as BM25, which fail to capture the semantic nuances and user intentions behind search queries. To address these limitations, we introduce ISM, an approach that uses SBERT to generate semantically rich vectors from video tutorial transcripts to improve the search for programming video tutorials. By segmenting transcripts and implementing a re-ranking process, ISM effectively preserves context and enhances the relevance of search results. Additionally, ISM generates informative video summaries using GPT-4, allowing developers to quickly assess the relevance of video content. To evaluate our approach, we first performed a quantitative study comparing ISM with the baseline TechTube. The results revealed that ISM performs better in both video retrieval and fragment identification, achieving a Hit@5 score of 0.95 and an average F1 score of 0.70 compared to the baseline's 0.58 and 0.52, respectively. We also performed a user study, which revealed that users strongly preferred the semantic matching capabilities and AI-generated summaries of our approach. This work advances the state-of-the-art in programming video tutorial search and summarization by offering more nuanced and user-aligned retrieval and summarization mechanisms.
abstract_cn: 可用的软件开发视频教程在数量与多样性上不断增加，提升了开发者的数字学习，但也带来了高效定位相关内容的挑战。已有的视频搜索方法，包括基于关键词的方法以及 CodeTube 和 TechTube 等工具，主要依赖 BM25 等检索算法，无法捕捉搜索查询背后的语义细微差别与用户意图。为解决这些局限，我们提出了 ISM 方法，它使用 SBERT 从视频教程转录中生成语义丰富的向量，以改进对编程视频教程的搜索。通过对转录进行分段并实施重排流程，ISM 有效保留了上下文并提升了搜索结果的相关性。此外，ISM 使用 GPT-4 生成信息丰富的视频摘要，允许开发者迅速评估视频内容的相关性。为评估我们的方法，我们首先进行了将 ISM 与基线 TechTube 相比较的定量研究。结果表明 ISM 在视频检索与片段识别上均表现更好，取得 Hit@5 为 0.95、平均 F1 为 0.70，而基线分别为 0.58 和 0.52。我们还进行了用户研究，结果显示用户强烈偏好我们方法的语义匹配能力与 AI 生成的摘要。这项工作通过提供更细致、更契合用户的检索与摘要机制，推进了编程视频教程搜索与摘要的最新水平。
summary_cn: 用 SBERT 对编程视频教程转录做语义向量化+重排、GPT-4 生成摘要的 ISM 方法，在检索与片段识别上把 Hit@5 从基线 TechTube 的 0.58 拉到 0.95、平均 F1 从 0.52 拉到 0.70，并通过用户研究验证偏好。
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Author accepted manuscript of the MSR 2025 paper
objective_summary: 用 SBERT 对视频教程转录做分段语义向量化并重排，配合 GPT-4 生成摘要；相比 TechTube，Hit@5 由 0.58 升至 0.95，平均 F1 由 0.52 升至 0.70，用户研究显示偏好本方法。
evidence_note: 仅与 TechTube 单一基线对比并做用户研究，数据规模与显著性检验未汇报。
novelty_note: 将 SBERT + 重排 + GPT-4 摘要应用于编程视频教程搜索，属已有方向上的实质改进。
scope: 结论限于编程视频教程语料及与单一 BM25 类基线 TechTube 的比较。
limitations: 仅单一基线，未报数据规模、显著性或抗噪；GPT-4 摘要质量未系统评测。

title: Detecting HTTP Status Code Misuses in REST APIs via Static and Dynamic Analysis
title_cn: 通过静态与动态分析检测 REST API 中的 HTTP 状态码误用
abstract: REST APIs are widely used on the web for client-server communications. As REST is based on HTTP, server responses contain status codes to indicate the outcome of requests (e.g., 200 OK for a success and 404 Not Found for an unavailable resource). While HTTP status codes are standardized, their semantics are not enforced in REST, leading to many misuses in practice (e.g., using 500 Internal Server Error to describe a client error). Such misuses may have nefarious consequences, such as reducing interoperability, misleading API clients, or causing false positives in testing tools. In this paper, we present a combined static and dynamic analysis approach for detecting HTTP status code misuses in REST APIs. We first study 2,625 real-world REST API specifications to identify relevant status codes and derive a set of 30 usage rules based on HTTP standards and REST API principles. We then implement tools to identify such rule violations in OpenAPI specifications (static analysis) and in API behavior (dynamic analysis). Our evaluation finds that status code misuses are frequent and systematic in REST APIs, with both static and dynamic approaches detecting various misuses. We highlight that both approaches may be used in a complementary manner, and also provide insight for REST API testers and users alike.
abstract_cn: REST API 在 web 上被广泛用于客户端-服务器通信。由于 REST 基于 HTTP，服务器响应包含状态码以指示请求的结果（例如成功用 200 OK，资源不可用用 404 Not Found）。虽然 HTTP 状态码是标准化的，但其语义在 REST 中并未被强制执行，导致实践中出现许多误用（例如使用 500 Internal Server Error 描述客户端错误）。这类误用可能带来有害后果，如降低互操作性、误导 API 客户端，或在测试工具中造成假阳性。本文提出了一种结合静态与动态分析的方法，用于检测 REST API 中的 HTTP 状态码误用。我们首先研究了 2,625 个真实世界的 REST API 规范，以识别相关状态码，并基于 HTTP 标准与 REST API 原则推导出 30 条使用规则。随后我们实现工具，用于在 OpenAPI 规范中（静态分析）以及在 API 行为中（动态分析）识别对这些规则的违反。我们的评估发现，状态码误用在 REST API 中普遍且系统性存在，静态与动态方法均能检测到各类误用。我们强调两者可以互补使用，并为 REST API 测试者与使用者提供了洞见。
summary_cn: 分析 2,625 份真实 REST API 规范并从 HTTP 标准/REST 原则中提炼 30 条使用规则，然后对 OpenAPI 规范做静态、对 API 行为做动态检测，发现状态码误用普遍且系统性存在，两种方法可互补。
objective_summary: 分析 2,625 个真实 REST API 规范，提炼 30 条 HTTP 状态码使用规则，实现静态（OpenAPI 规范）与动态（API 行为）分析工具，评估显示状态码误用普遍存在且两种方法互补。
evidence_note: 基于 2,625 个 API 规范；有静动双通道评估，但未提及基线对比与统计显著性检验。
novelty_note: 首次系统化提出并检测 REST API 中 HTTP 状态码误用，规则源自标准与实证。
scope: 结论限于 OpenAPI 规范与真实 REST API 运行时行为，覆盖 30 条自定规则范围。
limitations: 规则由作者依 HTTP 标准与 REST 原则推导；动态实验的具体规模与代表性未详述。

title: GraphAHA: Graph-Based Adaptive Search with Heterogeneous Actions for Test-Time Code Generation
title_cn: GraphAHA：面向测试时代码生成的异构动作图搜索
abstract: Test-time scaling improves code generation by spending additional inference budget (e.g., calls or tokens) on direct sampling, feedback-conditioned repair, and reasoning-guided implementation. Search-based methods can allocate this budget adaptively, but two challenges remain. First, tree-structured search treats each generation history as a separate state even when trajectories converge to the same program, duplicating evaluation and preventing statistics from being shared. Second, sampling, repair, and reasoning have complementary and state-dependent payoffs, making online allocation among them difficult under a finite budget. To address these challenges, we propose an adaptive graph search method with heterogeneous actions (GraphAHA). GraphAHA organizes the test-time code generation in a typed directed acyclic graph. Equivalent programs are merged into a single code node, allowing their downstream search statistics to be reused across all discovery paths. Hierarchical Thompson sampling then selects whether to generate a new state or follow an existing successor and, for generation, chooses among the type-valid sampling, reasoning, implementation, and repair operations. Evaluated on LiveCodeBench and CodeContests with Qwen2.5-Coder and DeepSeek-Coder, GraphAHA achieves the best score in 18 of 20 cases. For Pass@1 measured using visible tests, it outperforms the strongest baseline for both models on both benchmarks by 4.1 percentage points on average, demonstrating more effective use of a fixed inference budget.
abstract_cn: 测试时扩展（test-time scaling）通过在直接采样、反馈条件下的修复以及推理引导的实现上花费额外推理预算（例如调用次数或 tokens），来改进代码生成。基于搜索的方法可以自适应地分配这份预算，但仍存在两个挑战。第一，树结构的搜索把每个生成历史视为独立状态，即便不同轨迹收敛到同一程序，也会重复评估并阻止统计信息的共享。第二，采样、修复与推理具有互补且依赖状态的收益，使得在有限预算下对它们的在线分配变得困难。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种带异构动作的自适应图搜索方法（GraphAHA）。GraphAHA 将测试时代码生成组织为一个有类型的有向无环图。等价的程序被合并成同一个代码节点，使得它们下游的搜索统计能在所有发现路径间被复用。分层 Thompson 采样随后决定是生成新状态还是沿现有后继前进，并在生成时从类型合法的采样、推理、实现与修复操作中做选择。在 LiveCodeBench 与 CodeContests 上，使用 Qwen2.5-Coder 与 DeepSeek-Coder 进行评估，GraphAHA 在 20 个案例中的 18 个取得最佳分数。就以可见测试测量的 Pass@1 而言，它在两个基准与两个模型上均以平均 4.1 个百分点优于最强基线，证明了对固定推理预算更有效的利用。
summary_cn: 把测试时代码生成组织成有类型的 DAG，合并等价程序节点以共享统计，用分层 Thompson 采样在采样/推理/实现/修复四种异构动作间自适应分配预算；在 LiveCodeBench 与 CodeContests 上 20 项中 18 项拿最高分，Pass@1 平均超最强基线 4.1 个百分点。
objective_summary: 提出 GraphAHA：将测试时代码生成组织为有类型的有向无环图，等价程序合并为同一节点以共享统计，用分层 Thompson 采样在采样、修复、推理、实现之间自适应分配预算；在 LiveCodeBench 与 CodeContests、Qwen2.5-Coder 与 DeepSeek-Coder 上 20 组配置中 18 组最优，Pass@1 平均比最强基线高 4.1 个百分点。
evidence_note: 2 基准 × 2 模型 × 多操作与基线对比，20 组配置中 18 组占优，未提统计显著性检验。
novelty_note: 用类型化 DAG 合并等价程序 + 分层 Thompson 采样调度异质动作，是测试时扩放的新组合。
scope: 限于 LiveCodeBench、CodeContests 与 Qwen2.5-Coder、DeepSeek-Coder 两个骨干。
limitations: 仅在编程竞赛类基准评测，未覆盖长程仓库级任务与更多模型规模。

title: What Drives Recovery in Agentic Text-to-Cypher? LAST-CQ: An LLM Agent Self-Refinement Framework
title_cn: Agentic Text-to-Cypher 中恢复靠什么起效？LAST-CQ 自我改进框架
abstract: Agentic pipelines for structured-query generation are rapidly expanding, but it is unclear which part of the loop produces the gain. We use LAST-CQ -- a five-agent, training-free, execution-grounded Text-to-Cypher framework -- as an instrumented testbed, running three counterfactuals over 2,471 live-database queries and six backbones spanning three vendor scale tiers. Removing correction is worth between 3.1% aggregate execution-BLEU against the single-pass system and 12.3% against a no-refinement counterfactual (up to 80.7% for the weakest backbone). Replacing schema-grounded, LLM-synthesised feedback with raw database error strings costs almost nothing (20.9% vs. 19.9% naive exact match; <0.2% end-to-end; equivalent within $\pm 0.075$ set-F1 by two one-sided tests). Spending the same call budget on parallel sampling degrades quality by 10-11%. What works is detecting failure and routing it to a retry, not the feedback sophistication or number of samples. LAST-CQ itself recovers 91.7% of queries that fail under single-pass generation, while a query that succeeds first time still costs exactly one LLM call. We also show that n-gram overlap on serialised results is not a bound in either direction: it over-scores against set equivalence on 65.9% of results while under-scoring against judged semantics. Finally, we calibrate our LLM judge against blind human labels and find it optimistic by 9 points.
abstract_cn: 面向结构化查询生成的 agentic 流水线正在迅速扩张，但目前尚不清楚循环中的哪一部分带来了增益。我们使用 LAST-CQ——一个五-agent、免训练、执行接地的 Text-to-Cypher 框架——作为受控测试台，在 2,471 条真实数据库查询和涵盖三个厂商规模层级的六个后端上运行三种反事实实验。移除纠正机制导致的执行-BLEU 损失介于 3.1%（相对于单次通过系统的聚合值）与 12.3%（相对于无自我改进的反事实）之间，最弱后端的损失可达 80.7%。将基于 schema 的、由 LLM 合成的反馈替换为原始数据库报错字符串几乎不带来代价（naive exact match 为 20.9% 对 19.9%；端到端差异小于 0.2%；在两次单侧检验下 set-F1 差异在正负 0.075 范围内等价）。若把同样的调用预算用于并行采样，则质量下降 10-11%。真正起作用的是检测失败并将其路由到重试，而不是反馈的复杂程度或样本数量。LAST-CQ 本身能恢复在单次通过下失败的查询中的 91.7%，同时一次即成功的查询仍然只花费一次 LLM 调用。我们还表明，在序列化结果上的 n-gram 重叠在两个方向上都不是可靠的界：它在 65.9% 的结果上相对于集合等价性打分偏高，而相对于人工判定的语义又常常打分偏低。最后，我们将 LLM 评审员与盲测的人工标签进行校准，发现其偏乐观 9 个百分点。
summary_cn: 以 5-agent、免训练、执行接地的 LAST-CQ 为测试台，在 2,471 条真实数据库查询和 6 个后端上做反事实：去掉纠正机制损失 3.1-12.3%（最弱后端达 80.7%），把 LLM 合成反馈换成原始报错代价近乎为零；同预算的并行采样反而下降 10-11%；真正起效的是「检测失败并路由到重试」。
comment: Accepted at REALM: The 2nd Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models at Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026), 15 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables
objective_summary: 以 LAST-CQ 五智能体、无训练、执行接地的 Text-to-Cypher 框架为测试床，在 2,471 条真实库查询、6 个跨厂商规模等级骨干上做三种反事实实验；结果显示纠错模块贡献 3.1%–12.3%（最弱骨干达 80.7%）exec-BLEU，能挽回 91.7% 单遍失败查询，而反馈复杂度与并行采样几乎无收益或反降 10–11%。
evidence_note: 2,471 查询 × 6 骨干、多组反事实与人工盲标校准，含 TOST 等价检验，规模与对照充分。
novelty_note: 用反事实拆解定位「检测失败并重试」才是收益来源，反驳反馈精细度与并行采样有用的常见叙事。
scope: 限于 Text-to-Cypher 结构化查询生成场景与所测 6 个骨干模型。
limitations: 仅一种任务（Cypher）与一个五智能体架构；LLM 裁判乐观偏差 9 分未完全消除。

title: What is the Difference Between Me and You? Benchmarking the Quality Gap Between Human-Written and AI-Generated Code
title_cn: 我和你的差别是什么？对人类编写与 AI 生成代码质量差距的基准评测
abstract: AI coding assistants are becoming co-authors of production software, yet their evaluation centers on functional correctness, leaving open whether their code differs from human code in the quality dimensions dominating lifecycle cost. We compare human-written and AI-generated code at scale: 787,562 function pairs across Python, Java, and C, each human function mined from open-source repositories paired with implementations generated from its docstring by three AI assistants (OpenAI GPT models, DeepSeek-Coder, Qwen2.5-Coder). We characterize structural complexity and statistical naturalness, and map static-analysis findings onto Orthogonal Defect Classification for defects and the Common Weakness Enumeration for vulnerabilities, making authors and languages directly comparable. AI-generated code is structurally compressed and stylistically templated: roughly half the size and branching of human code, clustering apart at the style level. Defect profiles differ in kind: human code concentrates issues of mature codebases, AI code repetitive boilerplate; security is language-dependent, with LLMs producing more, and more severe, findings in Python and Java but fewer high-severity memory-safety findings than humans in C. Once size is controlled for, complexity metrics carry little signal, while naturalness separates authors. Finally, we release CQBench, a benchmark of 27,346 issue-prone tasks with baselines and an evaluation pipeline for quality assurance and security testing.
abstract_cn: AI 编码助手正成为生产软件的合著者，但对它们的评估集中在功能正确性上，是否在主导生命周期成本的质量维度上与人类代码有差异仍是开放问题。我们在规模上比较人类编写的代码与 AI 生成的代码：跨 Python、Java 与 C 的 787,562 对函数对，每一个来自开源仓库挖掘的人类函数都配以三种 AI 助手（OpenAI GPT 模型、DeepSeek-Coder、Qwen2.5-Coder）根据其 docstring 生成的实现。我们刻画结构复杂度与统计自然度，并将静态分析的发现映射到用于缺陷的 Orthogonal Defect Classification 与用于漏洞的 Common Weakness Enumeration，使作者与语言之间可直接比较。AI 生成的代码在结构上被压缩且风格上被模板化：体量与分支大约是人类代码的一半，在风格层面聚成独立的簇。缺陷剖面在种类上不同：人类代码集中于成熟代码库的问题，AI 代码集中于重复性模板问题；安全性依赖语言，LLM 在 Python 与 Java 中产生更多、更严重的发现，但在 C 中产生的高严重度内存安全问题少于人类。一旦控制体量，复杂度指标几乎不再携带信号，而自然度可以区分作者。最后，我们发布了 CQBench，一个含 27,346 个易出问题任务的基准，附带基线以及用于质量保证与安全测试的评估流程。
summary_cn: 在 Python/Java/C 上构造 787,562 对「人类函数 vs 三家 LLM（OpenAI GPT、DeepSeek-Coder、Qwen2.5-Coder）从 docstring 生成」的函数对，用 ODC/CWE 映射静态分析结果；发现 AI 代码结构压缩且模板化（体量与分支约为人类一半），控制体量后复杂度指标失去区分力而自然度仍可区分作者，安全性依赖语言（Python/Java 中 LLM 缺陷更多更严重，C 中人类的高危内存问题反而更多），并发布含 27,346 个易出问题任务的 CQBench。
comment: Preprint. This manuscript is currently under peer review
objective_summary: 在 Python/Java/C 上对 787,562 个函数对（人写 vs GPT、DeepSeek-Coder、Qwen2.5-Coder 生成）做结构复杂度、自然度、ODC 缺陷与 CWE 漏洞对比，发现 AI 代码体量与分支约为人类一半、缺陷偏模板样板，安全性随语言而异；并发布含 27,346 任务的 CQBench。
evidence_note: 78 万余函数对、3 语言、3 模型、多维度静态分析与 ODC/CWE 映射，规模与对照均充分。
novelty_note: 将 ODC 与 CWE 映射到人机代码的大规模并行对比，是超越功能正确性的实证新角度。
scope: 限于 Python/Java/C 上开源函数与三家 LLM 由 docstring 生成的实现。
limitations: 仅函数级 docstring-to-code、依赖静态分析工具，未做运行时或人工审读验证。

title: Separating Engineering Reasoning from DEXPI Serialization in LLM-Based Greenfield Surface-Process Design: A Three-Case Study for Underground Gas Storage
title_cn: 在基于 LLM 的地下储气全新地面过程设计中分离工程推理与 DEXPI 序列化：三案例研究
abstract: Large language models can produce engineering descriptions and structured process representations, but standards-level serialization can substantially increase the generation burden. This diagnostic study examines whether separating engineering reasoning from Data Exchange in the Process Industry (DEXPI) serialization changes where representation and engineering failures occur in constrained greenfield surface-process design for underground gas storage. We compare Direct DEXPI generation with generation of a lightweight Engineering Intermediate Representation (IR) on three cases: single-pressure injection, withdrawal and export, and dual-pressure injection. All six conditions use one fixed model snapshot, qwen3.8-max-0902, with one completed hosted generation per condition. Direct outputs are XSD-valid in 2 of 3 cases, while all 3 Engineering IR outputs are structurally valid under a minimal validator. Direct prompt inputs contain approximately 121.8k-121.9k tokens, compared with 617-699 tokens for the Engineering IR prompts. Engineering feasibility does not uniformly favor the IR: one IR output is rejected for an explicit cooling-state contradiction. The cases also reveal two distinct Direct DEXPI failure modes: engineering inconsistency and standards-level serialization failure. The observed comparison shows that, in these evaluated method bundles, deferring DEXPI serialization substantially reduces representation burden and helps isolate serialization failure, but reducing representation burden alone does not eliminate engineering inconsistencies.
abstract_cn: 大语言模型能够生成工程描述和结构化过程表示，但标准级序列化会显著增加生成负担。本诊断性研究考察在受约束的地下储气全新地面过程设计中，将工程推理与 Data Exchange in the Process Industry (DEXPI) 序列化分离是否会改变表示失败和工程失败发生的位置。我们在三个案例——单压注入、抽取与外输、以及双压注入——上比较了直接 DEXPI 生成与轻量级 Engineering Intermediate Representation (IR) 生成。所有六种条件都使用同一固定模型快照 qwen3.8-max-0902，每种条件各完成一次托管生成。直接生成的输出在 3 个案例中有 2 个通过 XSD 校验，而 3 个 Engineering IR 输出在最简校验器下全部结构合法。直接提示输入约含 121.8k-121.9k 个 token，而 Engineering IR 提示只有 617-699 个 token。工程可行性并不一致地偏向 IR：其中一个 IR 输出因显式的冷却状态矛盾而被否决。案例还揭示了直接 DEXPI 生成的两种不同失败模式：工程不一致和标准级序列化失败。对比结果表明，在所评估的方法组合中，推迟 DEXPI 序列化能显著降低表示负担并有助于隔离序列化失败，但仅降低表示负担并不能消除工程不一致问题。
summary_cn: 在 3 个地下储气案例上对比直接生成 DEXPI 与先生成轻量 Engineering IR：用 qwen3.8-max-0902 时 Direct 提示约 121.8k-121.9k tokens、IR 仅 617-699 tokens；Direct 3 例中 2 例 XSD 合法，IR 3 例全部结构合法但有 1 例存在冷却状态工程矛盾。
objective_summary: 以地下储气三个案例（单压注入、采出与外输、双压注入）对比直接生成 DEXPI 与生成轻量工程中间表示两种方式；固定 qwen3.8-max-0902 模型下，直接生成 3 例中 2 例 XSD 合规，中间表示 3 例结构合规，输入 token 从约 12 万降到约 617–699。
evidence_note: 仅 3 案例 × 1 模型 × 每条件 1 次生成，无重复运行与统计检验，属诊断性小样本。
novelty_note: 提出把工程推理与 DEXPI 序列化解耦并观测两类失败模式，是新的诊断视角。
scope: 限于地下储气地面工艺绿地设计三个案例、单一固定模型快照。
limitations: 样本极小、单模型单次生成，中间表示自身仍出现工程可行性问题。

title: A Retrieval-Augmented Automated Stakeholder for Requirements Elicitation Education: A Comparative Study
title_cn: 面向需求获取教育的检索增强自动化利益相关者：一项对照研究
abstract: Developing the skills required for requirements engineering students to conduct effective requirements elicitation interviews is critical yet challenging, as it requires the development of soft skills in addition to technical knowledge. Role-playing is widely adopted in requirements engineering education to support the development of these skills but is often constrained by time and resource limitations. Although recent advances in large language models (LLMs) enable automated and interactive stakeholder simulations for role-playing, their application in requirements engineering education remains limited by hallucinations and inconsistent responses. To address these limitations, this study investigates the use of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), implemented using the LangChain framework, to support requirements elicitation activities in a requirements engineering course. We conducted controlled experiments with 69 students, comparing cohorts who interacted with non-technical faculty role-players and those who engaged with RAG-based simulated stakeholders. The results indicate that while students perceived invited stakeholders as more realistic and engaging, the RAG-based automated stakeholder produced higher-quality elicitation questions and more complete feature identification.
abstract_cn: 培养需求工程学生进行有效需求获取访谈所需的技能既关键又具挑战性，因为它除了技术知识外还需要培养软技能。角色扮演在需求工程教育中被广泛用于支持这些技能的培养，但常受时间和资源限制的制约。尽管大语言模型 (LLMs) 的最新进展使角色扮演中的自动化交互式利益相关者模拟成为可能，但其在需求工程教育中的应用仍受幻觉和回答不一致的限制。为解决这些限制，本研究考察了基于 LangChain 框架实现的检索增强生成 (RAG) 在需求工程课程中支持需求获取活动中的使用。我们对 69 名学生进行了对照实验，比较了与非技术教师角色扮演者互动的组和与基于 RAG 的模拟利益相关者互动的组。结果表明，虽然学生认为受邀真人利益相关者更真实、更具吸引力，但基于 RAG 的自动化利益相关者却产生了更高质量的获取问题和更完整的特性识别。
summary_cn: 在需求工程课上用 LangChain RAG 模拟利益相关者做需求获取访谈，对 69 名学生做对照实验：学生认为真人扮演更真实、更有吸引力，但 RAG 版反而能引出更高质量的获取问题和更完整的特性识别。
comment: 28 pages, 9 figures
objective_summary: 用 LangChain 实现 RAG 驱动的模拟利益相关方，用于需求获取访谈教学；对 69 名学生做对照实验，与非技术教师角色扮演相比，RAG 版本产出更高质量提问与更完整特征识别，但真实感与参与度较低。
evidence_note: 69 名学生的对照实验，有真人对照组与多维度评价，但样本规模有限、检验方法未在摘要说明。
novelty_note: 将 RAG 应用于需求工程教学的角色扮演场景，是既有 LLM 教学方向上的实质拓展。
scope: 限于单门需求工程课程、69 名学生与该特定角色扮演任务。
limitations: 样本量小、单课程、结果依赖学生主观感知与教师作为对照的可比性。

title: Confidence-Gated Transductive Test Generation for Code Reranking
title_cn: CoTT：面向代码重排的置信度门控 transductive 测试生成
abstract: Test case synthesis is crucial for evaluating and ranking programs generated by large language models (LLMs). However, constructing high-quality test cases remains challenging because reliable expected outputs are often difficult to obtain. We propose Confidence-Gated Transductive Test Generation (CoTT), which first uses an efficient inductive procedure and invokes transductive generation only when inductive confidence is low. This adaptive design improves output reliability while allocating extra computation only when needed. On code reranking benchmarks, CoTT outperforms prior baselines across the reported metrics while reducing cost relative to applying transductive generation to every input. These results show that confidence-based allocation of test-time computation provides a favorable efficiency-effectiveness trade-off with a single efficient LLM.
abstract_cn: 测试用例合成对于评估和重排大语言模型（LLM）生成的程序至关重要。然而，构造高质量的测试用例仍具有挑战性，因为可靠的期望输出往往难以获得。我们提出 Confidence-Gated Transductive Test Generation（CoTT），它先使用一种高效的归纳式（inductive）流程，仅在归纳置信度较低时才调用 transductive 生成。这种自适应设计在提升输出可靠性的同时，只在必要时才额外投入计算。在代码重排基准上，CoTT 在所报告的各项指标上都优于此前的基线，同时相较于对每个输入都应用 transductive 生成，成本显著降低。这些结果表明，基于置信度来分配测试时计算，能够在单个高效 LLM 上取得良好的效率-效果权衡。
summary_cn: 提出 CoTT：先用高效的归纳式流程生成测试，只在归纳置信度低时才触发 transductive 生成，实现按需分配测试时算力；在代码重排基准上优于既有基线，同时相比对所有输入都做 transductive 生成显著降本。
objective_summary: 提出 CoTT：先用高效归纳过程生成测试，仅在归纳置信度低时才触发直推式生成；在代码重排基准上多项指标优于基线，同时降低直推调用成本。
evidence_note: 摘要仅笼统称在代码重排基准上超基线，未给具体数据集、规模、baseline 名称或数字。
novelty_note: 用置信度门控在归纳/直推之间做测试时算力分配，是测试生成的实质性调度改进。
scope: 限于用 LLM 做程序候选重排时的测试用例合成场景。
limitations: 具体基准、样本量、置信度阈值敏感性与统计检验均未在摘要交代。

title: Hieronym: Leveraging Hierarchical Multi-Source Information for Function Renaming in Stripped Binary
title_cn: Hieronym：利用分层多源信息进行剥离二进制中的函数重命名
abstract: Function renaming in stripped binaries can substantially assist reverse engineers by improving code readability, yet it is a challenging task. The difficulty stems from the need to accurately capture function semantics from low-level binary code across diverse instruction sets, architectures, and compiler optimizations, and to express these semantics in concise, human-readable names. Existing approaches either inadequately capture comprehensive function semantics or exhibit limited generalization to previously unseen binaries. In this paper, we present Hieronym, a generative large language model (LLM)-based framework for stripped binary function renaming. Hieronym adopts a hierarchical summarization-driven domain adaptation strategy and integrates multi-source information, including global binary context, local calling context, and intrinsic function semantics, to enhance the LLM's understanding of binary code. To enable systematic evaluation, we further propose a dual-layer evaluation framework that incorporates both token-level and whole-name-level metrics. We evaluate Hieronym on binary functions compiled with four compiler optimization levels (O0-O3) for four architectures (x64, x86, ARM, and MIPS). Experimental results demonstrate that Hieronym significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving token-level improvements of 50.12% in precision, 41.75% in recall, and 45.10% in F1-score, as well as a 79.94% improvement in name-level accuracy, while also exhibiting strong generalization capability. Moreover, experiments on real-world malware samples further validate the practical effectiveness of Hieronym in security-critical scenarios.
abstract_cn: 在剥离符号的二进制文件中进行函数重命名，可以通过提升代码可读性显著协助逆向工程师，但这是一项具有挑战性的任务。其难点在于需要跨多种指令集、架构和编译器优化，准确捕获底层二进制代码的函数语义，并将这些语义表达为简洁且可读的名称。现有方法要么无法充分捕获完整的函数语义，要么对未见过的二进制表现出有限的泛化能力。本文提出 Hieronym，一个基于生成式大语言模型 (LLM) 的剥离二进制函数重命名框架。Hieronym 采用分层摘要驱动的领域适配策略，并整合多源信息——包括全局二进制上下文、局部调用上下文和函数内在语义——以增强 LLM 对二进制代码的理解。为实现系统性评测，我们进一步提出了一个双层评估框架，同时纳入 token 级和整名级指标。我们在四种编译器优化级别 (O0-O3) 和四种架构 (x64、x86、ARM、MIPS) 下编译的二进制函数上评测 Hieronym。实验结果表明，Hieronym 显著优于最新方法，在 token 级上精确率提升 50.12%、召回率提升 41.75%、F1 提升 45.10%，在整名级准确率上提升 79.94%，同时表现出较强的泛化能力。此外，在真实恶意软件样本上的实验进一步验证了 Hieronym 在安全关键场景中的实际有效性。
summary_cn: 提出 Hieronym，一个基于生成式 LLM 的剥离二进制函数重命名框架，采用分层摘要驱动的领域适配并融合全局/局部/内在语义三源信息；在 O0-O3 × x64/x86/ARM/MIPS 上 token 级精确率/召回率/F1 分别提升 50.12%/41.75%/45.10%，整名级准确率提升 79.94%。
comment: 20 pages, ACM CCS 2026
objective_summary: 提出基于生成式 LLM 的剥离二进制函数重命名框架 Hieronym，采用层次化摘要驱动的领域适配并融合全局、调用与函数内部语义；在 4 架构（x64/x86/ARM/MIPS）× 4 优化级（O0–O3）上，token 级 P/R/F1 分别提升 50.12%/41.75%/45.10%，名称级准确率提升 79.94%。
evidence_note: 覆盖 4 架构 × 4 优化级并与 SOTA 对比，另有真实恶意样本验证，未提统计显著性。
novelty_note: 以层次化摘要 + 多源上下文做 LLM 领域适配，并配套 token/name 双层评估框架，是该任务的新组合。
scope: 限于 x64/x86/ARM/MIPS、O0–O3 编译的剥离二进制函数重命名任务。
limitations: 依赖生成式 LLM，成本与实际长函数、混淆二进制上的表现摘要未量化。

title: ParaRecover: A Process-Level Benchmark for Error Localization and Recovery in Parallel Tool-Use Agents
title_cn: ParaRecover：面向并行工具调用 Agent 错误定位与恢复的过程级基准
abstract: Existing agent benchmarks mainly evaluate final task success or tool-call correctness, providing limited insight into whether agents can reliably diagnose and recover from intermediate execution failures. This limitation becomes particularly critical in multi-turn parallel tool-use scenarios, where errors may propagate across dependent branches and trigger cascading failures. We introduce ParaRecover, a process-level benchmark for evaluating error localization and recovery in multi-turn parallel tool-use agents. Built upon a fine-grained taxonomy of 14 error types covering planning dependencies, tool selection, and argument matching, the benchmark comprises 10,626 instances spanning two difficulty levels. To enable finegrained, process-oriented evaluation, we further propose the SDE rubric, which measures structural integrity, diagnostic reasoning, and evolutionary strategy during agent execution.Experiments across more than ten mainstream LLMs reveal that even state-of-the-art models still struggle with multi-turn error propagation,implicit tool-use failures, and precise replanning. Moreover, we demonstrate that the SDE rubric provides effective supervision signals for improving agents' reflective recovery capabilities. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/gbw206/ParaRecover.
abstract_cn: 现有的 agent 基准主要评估最终任务是否成功或工具调用是否正确，对 agent 能否可靠地诊断并从中间执行失败中恢复缺乏洞察。这一局限在多轮、并行工具调用场景中尤为关键，此时错误可能沿依赖分支传播并触发级联失败。我们提出 ParaRecover，一个用于评估多轮并行工具调用 agent 错误定位与恢复能力的过程级基准。该基准建立在一个细粒度的分类体系之上，涵盖 14 种错误类型，涉及规划依赖、工具选择与参数匹配，包含 10,626 个实例，分为两个难度层级。为实现细粒度、面向过程的评测，我们还提出了 SDE 评价准则，用于度量 agent 执行过程中的结构完整性（structural integrity）、诊断推理（diagnostic reasoning）和演进策略（evolutionary strategy）。在十余个主流 LLM 上的实验表明，即使最先进的模型也仍难以应对多轮错误传播、隐式的工具调用失败以及精确的重规划。此外，我们还证明 SDE 评价准则可以为提升 agent 的反思式恢复能力提供有效的监督信号。数据与代码可在 https://github.com/gbw206/ParaRecover 获取。
summary_cn: 构建过程级基准 ParaRecover，覆盖 14 种错误类型、10,626 个实例、两种难度，并提出 SDE 评价准则（结构完整性/诊断推理/演进策略）；在 10+ 主流 LLM 上发现即使最强模型仍在多轮错误传播、隐式工具失败和精确重规划上挣扎，SDE 还可作为提升反思恢复能力的监督信号。
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
objective_summary: 构建 ParaRecover 过程级基准，覆盖 14 类错误、10,626 个实例、两种难度，配套 SDE 评价准则；在 10 余个主流 LLM 上评测，显示对多轮错误传播、隐式工具失败与重规划仍存挑战。
evidence_note: 10,626 实例、14 错误类、10+ LLM 与 SDE 准则对比，覆盖较广，但未提统计显著性检验。
novelty_note: 从最终成败转向过程级错误定位与恢复的评测视角，配套细粒度错误分类，是新的评测切面。
scope: 限于多轮并行工具使用 Agent 场景与该 14 类错误分类下的评估。
limitations: 错误分类由作者预设，SDE 指标的外部效度未与人工判断校准。

title: PQLS: A High-Performance Python Library for Steady-State Simulation of Open Quantum Systems
title_cn: PQLS：面向开放量子系统稳态仿真的高性能 Python 库
abstract: PQLS (Parallel Quantum Liouvillian Solver) is a high-performance Python library for computing steady-state solutions of the Lindblad master equation. It provides a layered user-facing API with three levels of abstraction. The high-level API accepts physical descriptions of atomic ladder systems and automatically determines the required model parameters; the mid- level API accepts quantities such as Rabi frequencies, detunings, decay rates, and network topology; finally the low-level API allows users to directly specify the Hamiltonian and collapse operators. This layered design enables users to choose between physical convenience and direct numerical control depending on the application. PQLS is built on JAX and XLA to enable vectorized and hardware-accelerated computation of large parameter sweeps. Rather than solving the steady-state problem sequentially for each parameter configuration, PQLS represents multiple Hamiltonians as batched tensors and processes them through a JAX-compiled solver, reducing Python-level overhead and improving hardware utilization. This is particularly useful for applications requiring large or multidimensional parameter sweeps, such as computing frequency spectra, evaluating field-dependent responses, and performing Doppler averaging over atomic velocity distributions. PQLS has been benchmarked against QuTiP, QuTiP-JAX, and RydIQule on CPU and GPU platforms, demonstrating substantial computational speedups across the tested configurations.
abstract_cn: PQLS (Parallel Quantum Liouvillian Solver) 是一个用于计算 Lindblad 主方程稳态解的高性能 Python 库。它提供了具有三层抽象的分层面向用户 API。高层 API 接受原子阶梯系统的物理描述并自动确定所需的模型参数；中层 API 接受 Rabi 频率、失谐、衰减率和网络拓扑等量；底层 API 允许用户直接指定哈密顿量和坍缩算子。这种分层设计使用户能够根据应用场景在物理便利性和直接数值控制之间进行选择。PQLS 基于 JAX 和 XLA 构建，以支持大规模参数扫描的向量化和硬件加速计算。不同于对每种参数配置顺序求解稳态问题，PQLS 将多个哈密顿量表示为批处理张量，并通过 JAX 编译的求解器处理它们，从而降低 Python 层开销并提升硬件利用率。这对于需要大规模或多维参数扫描的应用尤为有用，例如计算频谱、评估场依赖响应和对原子速度分布进行 Doppler 平均。PQLS 已在 CPU 和 GPU 平台上与 QuTiP、QuTiP-JAX 和 RydIQule 进行了基准测试，在所测配置中显示出显著的计算加速。
summary_cn: PQLS 是求解 Lindblad 主方程稳态解的 Python 库，提供三层 API，基于 JAX/XLA 将多个哈密顿量作为批处理张量并行求解，在 CPU/GPU 上相较 QuTiP、QuTiP-JAX、RydIQule 有显著加速。
objective_summary: 发布基于 JAX/XLA 的 Python 库 PQLS，用批量张量并行求解 Lindblad 主方程稳态问题，提供三层 API；在 CPU 与 GPU 上与 QuTiP、QuTiP-JAX、RydIQule 基准对比，显示大幅加速。
evidence_note: 与 3 个已有库在 CPU/GPU 上做基准对比，具体规模与是否有统计检验未在摘要给出。
novelty_note: 将参数扫掠向量化为批量张量并接入 JAX 编译，是既有量子求解器的实质工程改进。
scope: 适用于原子阶梯系统的 Lindblad 稳态求解与参数扫掠、多普勒平均等场景。
limitations: 仅稳态问题，不涉及瞬态；具体加速倍数与硬件配置摘要未量化。

title: Mission Performance: Automatic and Adaptive Race Pace Progression for Autonomous Racing
title_cn: Mission Performance：自主赛车的自动自适应赛道节奏推进
abstract: In this paper, we describe the Mission Performance module implemented for a fully autonomous racing car to automatically manage the longitudinal, lateral, and combined performances, aiming to speedup the laptime progression while assuring safety. Motivated by the difficulty and risks of applying the real-time estimation of the grip to critical modules like the motion planner and controller, the Mission Performance guides these modules adapting their target performance instead of changing the vehicle model parameters. The module is formed by pre-defined progressions to warm up the tires at the beginning of a run. Then, the system continuously monitors safety and vehicle dynamics metrics on a per-sector basis to adaptively reduce, maintain, or increase the performance levels for each sector, progressively converging toward the maximum allowed value. The solution's effectiveness is demonstrated on the EAV-25, a fully autonomous Dallara Superformula, at the Yas Marina Circuit during the Abu Dhabi Autonomous Racing League (A2RL) Season 2.
abstract_cn: 本文描述了为一辆全自主赛车实现的 Mission Performance 模块，用于自动管理纵向、横向及组合性能，目标是在保证安全的前提下加快圈速进步。考虑到将实时抓地力估计应用于运动规划器与控制器等关键模块的难度与风险，Mission Performance 通过调整这些模块的目标性能来引导它们，而不是更改车辆模型参数。该模块由预定义的渐进过程组成，用于在跑圈开始时预热轮胎。随后，系统按赛道分段持续监控安全性与车辆动力学指标，自适应地降低、维持或提高每一分段的性能水平，逐步收敛到允许的最大值。该方案的有效性在 EAV-25 (一辆全自主 Dallara Superformula 赛车) 上得到了验证，验证场景是在阿布扎比自主赛车联赛 (A2RL) 第 2 赛季的 Yas Marina 赛道。
summary_cn: 为全自主赛车实现 Mission Performance 模块，按赛道分段自适应调节纵/横向性能目标而非改动车辆模型参数，在 A2RL 第 2 赛季 Yas Marina 赛道的 EAV-25 Dallara Superformula 上得到验证。
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC 2026)
objective_summary: 提出面向全自动赛车的 Mission Performance 模块，通过按赛道分段监控安全与动力学指标，自适应调整目标性能而非车辆模型参数；在 A2RL 第二季 Yas Marina 赛道上用 EAV-25 Dallara Superformula 验证。
evidence_note: 仅在一辆车、一条赛道的一次实赛演示，无与其他方法的对照或统计检验。
novelty_note: 将实时抓地估计的风险转嫁为分段目标性能自适应调整，是常规控制思路上的实质改进。
scope: 结论限于 Dallara Superformula 单车、Yas Marina 赛道、A2RL 实赛场景。
limitations: 仅单车单赛道验证，未与其他自适应策略量化比较，泛化性未证。

title: Open Source Stewardship Communities: "We need you, but not your pull request"
title_cn: 开源「管家式」社区：「我们需要你，但不需要你的 pull request」
abstract: Human-centric AI for software engineering means keeping humans responsible for work performed with AI. In Open Source Software (OSS), AI lowers the cost of implementing changes, but reviewing someone else's contribution remains comparatively expensive, so some projects now restrict who may contribute implementations while still welcoming other participation---not because the code is AI-generated, but because it no longer justifies the review cost. We call the resulting form a stewardship community: a small core retains implementation authority while a broader community continues to shape the software without writing code, and access to coding increasingly depends on approval rather than self-initiated contribution. This raises a broader question: what happens to the human community when coding agents let maintainers replace implementation work once supplied by external contributors? For human-centric software engineering, keeping humans in control of AI agents is not enough: AI can replace implementation labor while weakening how OSS communities renew themselves.
abstract_cn: 面向软件工程的以人为本 AI 意味着让人类对借助 AI 完成的工作负责。在开源软件 (OSS) 中，AI 降低了实施变更的成本，但审查他人贡献的成本仍相对高昂，因此一些项目开始限制谁可以贡献实现代码，但仍欢迎其他形式的参与——原因不是代码由 AI 生成，而是它不再值得付出审查成本。我们称由此形成的形态为「管家式社区 (stewardship community)」：一个小规模核心保留实现权威，而更广泛的社区在不写代码的情况下继续塑造软件，编码权限越来越依赖于审批而非自发贡献。这引出一个更宽泛的问题：当编码 agent 让维护者能够替代原本由外部贡献者提供的实现工作时，人类社区将何去何从？对于以人为本的软件工程而言，仅让人类掌控 AI agent 是不够的：AI 在替代实现劳动的同时，也会削弱 OSS 社区自我更新的方式。
summary_cn: 概念论文提出「stewardship community」形态：当编码 agent 让维护者能替代外部贡献者的实现劳动，一些 OSS 项目开始限制谁能提交实现代码但仍欢迎其他参与；作者警告仅让人类掌控 AI 不够，agent 会削弱 OSS 社区的自我更新机制。
objective_summary: 论证在 AI 降低实现成本而评审成本相对提高的背景下,部分开源项目正在演变为「监护社区」形态:小核心保留实现权,更广泛社区不写代码地塑造软件,并指出这可能削弱 OSS 的贡献者更新机制。
evidence_note: 以概念论证与轶事式项目观察推进,无系统数据、样本或量化分析。
novelty_note: 将 OSS 治理从「AI 生成代码是否可接受」转向「评审成本主导的贡献准入」,属视角上的实质翻转。
scope: 适用于外部贡献主要为代码实现的 OSS 项目,不覆盖企业内部或非代码社区。
limitations: 缺少经验数据支持该形态的普遍性、演化路径与对社区更新率的实际影响。

title: Learning to adapt GR(1) specifications through degradation
title_cn: 通过降级学习自适应 GR(1) 规约
abstract: Reactive synthesis is a powerful tool for generating correct-by-construction controllers from formal specifications. GR(1) is an assume-guarantee specification framework that enables efficient synthesis, allowing synthesised controllers to be used in a wide array of applications. The limitation of such controllers is that, should they encounter environment behaviour unspecified in the assumptions of the specification, the specified system guarantees are no longer ensured. Our work proposes an approach based on oracle-guided inductive synthesis to adapt the specification to be consistent with the observed assumption violation, while degrading system guarantees as little as possible to maintain realisability. Our methodology discovers multiple potential solutions, so we propose a preference criteria, based on the ability of the specification to enable robustness under adaptation. Although our approach is capable of degrading the entire specification, for our case studies we successfully discover degradations that preserve the entire set of original guarantees.
abstract_cn: 反应式合成是一种强大的工具，可以从形式化规约生成构造正确的控制器。GR(1) 是一种假设-保证式规约框架，能够实现高效合成，使得所合成的控制器可以用于广泛的应用。这类控制器的局限在于，一旦它们遇到规约假设中未描述的环境行为，规约的系统保证就不再成立。我们的工作提出一种基于 oracle 引导的归纳合成方法，使规约适配与观测到的假设违背相一致，同时尽可能少地降级系统保证以维持可实现性。我们的方法会发现多个潜在解，因此我们提出了一个偏好准则，基于规约在适配下支持鲁棒性的能力。虽然我们的方法能够降级整个规约，但在案例研究中我们成功发现了保留全部原始保证的降级方案。
summary_cn: 针对 GR(1) 规约在环境假设违背时失效的问题，提出基于 oracle 引导归纳合成的自适应方法：调整规约以匹配观测到的违背，同时最小化系统保证的降级；在案例研究中能找到保留全部原始保证的降级方案。
comment: 59 pages (39 pages main text, 20 pages appendices), 24 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology
objective_summary: 提出基于神谕引导归纳合成的方法,在观测到 GR(1) 规约假设被违反时自适应地降级规约以保持可实现性并尽量少削减系统保证,并给出偏好准则选择更鲁棒的降级;案例研究中均能保留全部原始保证。
evidence_note: 以若干案例研究支撑,无大规模基准、无对比方法数值、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 在反应式合成 GR(1) 框架中系统化地把假设违反转为规约自适应降级并加入鲁棒性偏好,较新。
scope: 结论限于 GR(1) 假设-保证规约与所选反应式合成案例研究。
limitations: 案例数量与多样性有限,方法在大型工业规约上的可扩展性与最优性未评估。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Scientific Code Understanding
title_cn: 面向科学代码理解的 Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: Large language models have become central to modern coding assistants, but state-of-the-art systems such as Claude Code or Codex rely on very large, cloud-hosted models with significant computational cost and data-privacy implications. This work investigates whether a useful, fully local coding agent can be built around small open-source models by shifting the computational burden away from inference. We develop a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for scientific code understanding that strictly separates an expensive offline ingestion stage parsing, structural graph construction, LLM-generated entity explanations, and embedding from a lightweight online answering stage. The system is evaluated on a 100-question benchmark spanning eleven categories over the IPPL scientific codebase written in C++, with answers scored by an independent frontier model as the judge. Across seven answering models, we find that model family and retrieval quality matter more than parameter count, i.e. a 9B model achieves the highest average score (0.795), outperforming both larger models within our pipeline and the same models embedded in the Claude Code retrieval architecture. The results indicate that front-loading code understanding into a reusable, codebase-specialised vector store enables small local models to deliver grounded and repository-specific answers, making the agent well suited as a privacy-preserving development tool for in-house scientific codebases.
