Our analysis shows that the modularity, flexibility, and reactivity of classical BTs are insufficient for adaptation needs involving runtime restructuring, reasoning under uncertainty, mission reinterpretation, learning, or integration with external knowledge and planning mechanisms. Enhanced BT approaches address several of these limitations, but to different extents and often with limitations of their own. Our findings relate adaptation needs to both the capabilities and limitations of classical and enhanced BTs, providing guidance on when classical BTs are sufficient, when enhanced mechanisms are needed, and which challenges remain or emerge for adaptive robotic control architectures.
abstract_cn: 机器人系统越来越多地运行在动态、不确定和开放式的环境中，设计时的假设可能不再成立，因而需要自适应来维持有效且安全的运行。行为树（Behavior Trees, BTs）因其模块化、可读性和反应性，在机器人控制架构中被广泛使用。这引出了一个核心问题：BTs 是否足以满足现代机器人系统的自适应需求？本文通过一项由文献驱动、并辅以实证验证的研究来考察这一问题。首先，我们从文献中提炼出机器人自适应需求的分类，将其组织为六个类别：知识、感知、执行、系统、任务和环境。然后，我们针对这些需求分析经典 BTs 的能力与局限。接着，我们刻画了现有文献中基于 BT 的自适应方法，并把它们归入四个主要族系，即生成、扩展、演化和精化，其中也包括组合了多个族系的方法。我们的分析表明，经典 BTs 的模块化、灵活性与反应性，不足以应对那些涉及运行时重构、不确定性下推理、任务重新解释、学习，或与外部知识和规划机制集成的自适应需求。增强型 BT 方法解决了其中的若干局限，但解决的程度各不相同，而且往往自身也带有局限。我们的发现把自适应需求与经典及增强型 BTs 的能力和局限联系起来，为「何时经典 BTs 已经足够、何时需要增强机制、以及自适应机器人控制架构中仍然存在或新出现哪些挑战」提供了指导。
summary_cn: 把机器人自适应需求归纳为知识、感知、执行、系统、任务、环境六类，并把基于行为树的自适应方法分为生成、扩展、演化、精化四族；结论是经典 BTs 无法覆盖运行时重构、不确定性推理、任务重解释与学习类需求。
objective_summary: 通过文献研究并辅以实证验证，归纳机器人系统 6 类适配需求与 4 类基于行为树的适配方法族，分析经典与增强行为树对各类需求的支持与局限。
evidence_note: 以文献驱动的分类分析为主，声称有实证验证但摘要未给规模、基线或统计检验。
novelty_note: 对行为树适配能力提出较系统的需求-方法双向对应分类，属已有方向上的整理与延伸。
scope: 适用于机器人控制架构中经典及增强型行为树的适配讨论。
limitations: 验证细节与覆盖文献范围在摘要未量化，结论偏定性。

title: Ritgard: T(r)opical Islands of Socio-Technical Artifacts on GitHub
title_cn: Ritgard：GitHub 上社会技术制品的「热带岛屿」
abstract: A software project is more than just code. Non-code artifacts often document the human processes and decisions behind source code. The rationale behind a library change, an architectural decision, a problem encountered by a user are all examples of information typically present in socio-technical artifacts (STAs), created and persisted in channels separate from the repository itself (yet sometimes very close---e.g., GitHub Issues with GitHub repositories). These STAs are a trove of information about the project's architecture and its evolution, containing details and insights that code alone cannot provide. Unfortunately, this information is not easily extracted and explored as STAs are frequently fragmented over different communication channels, and are written in natural language. We present Ritgard, a tool that mines GitHub repositories for their STAs, namely Issues, Pull Requests, and Discussions, and visualizes them as 3D islands covered with trees. Each tree represents a single artifact and each island is a topic extracted from the artifacts through a combination of text embedding and text summarization. The terrain of the islands rises out of the ocean as the topic becomes active and sinks back in when it becomes stale, thus depicting the evolution of features and concerns throughout the project's lifetime. We describe the tool's usage and implementation, showing the numerous technical challenges behind Ritgard's visualization.
abstract_cn: 一个软件项目不只是代码。非代码制品常常记录了源代码背后的人类过程与决策。一次库变更背后的理由、一个架构决策、一位用户遇到的问题，都是典型存在于社会技术制品（socio-technical artifacts, STAs）中的信息的例子，这些制品被创建并留存在与仓库本身相分离的渠道中（但有时又离得很近——例如 GitHub Issues 与 GitHub 仓库）。这些 STAs 是关于项目架构及其演化的信息宝库，包含了仅凭代码无法提供的细节与洞见。遗憾的是，这些信息并不容易被抽取和探索，因为 STAs 经常碎片化地分散在不同的沟通渠道中，并且是用自然语言写成的。我们提出 Ritgard，一个从 GitHub 仓库中挖掘其 STAs（即 Issues、Pull Requests 和 Discussions）并把它们可视化为覆盖着树木的 3D 岛屿的工具。每一棵树代表一个单独的制品，每一座岛屿是通过文本嵌入（text embedding）与文本摘要相结合的方式从这些制品中抽取出来的一个主题。当某个主题变得活跃时，岛屿的地形会从海洋中升起；当该主题变得陈旧时又会重新沉没，从而刻画出项目整个生命周期中功能与关注点的演化。我们描述了该工具的使用方式与实现，展示了 Ritgard 的可视化背后众多的技术挑战。
summary_cn: 工具 demo 论文：Ritgard 挖掘 GitHub 仓库的 Issues、Pull Requests 和 Discussions，用文本嵌入加摘要聚成主题，再把每个主题渲染成 3D 岛屿、每个制品渲染成一棵树，主题活跃时岛屿浮出海面、沉寂时沉没，从而可视化项目关注点的演化。
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, tool demo paper accepted at VISSOFT 2026
objective_summary: 介绍工具 Ritgard，从 GitHub 挖掘 Issues、PR、Discussions，通过文本嵌入与摘要聚成主题，并以 3D 岛屿-树木可视化其活跃演化，展示工具用法与实现挑战。
evidence_note: 工具演示论文，摘要仅描述实现，未提及用户研究或量化评估。
novelty_note: 作为同主题研究论文的工具实现，可视化隐喻较新，但方法与配套长文重叠。
scope: 面向 GitHub 仓库的 Issues、PR、Discussions 三类社交技术制品。
limitations: 摘要中未报告评估，主题抽取质量与规模上限未明。

title: Trace2Tower: Transition-Aware EigenTrace Induction of Multi-Level Skills for LLM Agents
title_cn: Trace2Tower：面向 LLM agent 的转移感知 EigenTrace 多层技能归纳
abstract: Large language model agents increasingly rely on execution traces to master complex interactive tasks. However, current paradigms are bottlenecked by shallow trajectory retrieval and flat skill summarization, fundamentally ignoring the temporal dependencies and outcome-conditioned topology of agent behavior. We introduce Trace2Tower, a transition-aware EigenTrace framework that distills raw trajectories into a robust skill hierarchy. Trace2Tower abstracts step-level interactions into canonical events, constructing a unified graph governed by semantic compatibility, transition dynamics, and outcome evidence. Through a novel contrastive spectral decomposition, it isolates stable, success-aligned behavioral modes while rigorously suppressing failure-prone shortcuts. These modes organically populate a dynamic skill tower of action templates, procedural routines, and overarching task strategies, continuously refined via verifier-guided feedback. On ALFWorld, Trace2Tower achieves 87.31% success requiring only 10.35 steps and 0.26 invalid actions; on WebShop, it reaches 50.67% exact success. Across both benchmarks, Trace2Tower significantly outperforms existing baselines in task mastery and context-efficient experience reuse.
abstract_cn: 大语言模型 agent 越来越依赖执行轨迹（execution trace）来掌握复杂的交互式任务。然而，当前的范式受制于浅层的轨迹检索和扁平的技能摘要，从根本上忽视了 agent 行为的时序依赖性以及以结果为条件的拓扑结构。我们提出 Trace2Tower，一个转移感知（transition-aware）的 EigenTrace 框架，它把原始轨迹蒸馏成稳健的技能层级结构。Trace2Tower 将步骤级的交互抽象为规范化事件，构建一个由语义兼容性、转移动力学和结果证据共同支配的统一图。通过一种新颖的对比式谱分解（contrastive spectral decomposition），它分离出稳定的、与成功相对齐的行为模式，同时严格抑制易于失败的捷径。这些模式有机地填充成一座动态的技能塔（skill tower），其中包含动作模板、过程性例程和总体任务策略，并通过 verifier 引导的反馈持续精化。在 ALFWorld 上，Trace2Tower 取得了 87.31% 的成功率，仅需 10.35 步和 0.26 次无效动作；在 WebShop 上，它达到 50.67% 的精确成功率。在这两个 benchmark 上，Trace2Tower 在任务掌握度和上下文高效的经验复用方面都显著优于现有基线。
summary_cn: 用对比式谱分解从 agent 执行轨迹中分离出与成功对齐的行为模式，组织成动作模板/过程例程/任务策略三层「技能塔」并由 verifier 反馈持续精化；ALFWorld 成功率 87.31%（仅 10.35 步、0.26 次无效动作），WebShop 精确成功率 50.67%。
comment: 13 pages, 9 figures
objective_summary: 提出 Trace2Tower 框架，将 LLM 智能体的执行轨迹通过对比谱分解抽取多层次技能塔，在 ALFWorld 达 87.31% 成功率、10.35 步、0.26 无效动作，在 WebShop 达 50.67% 精确成功率，优于基线。
evidence_note: 两大基准 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上有多项指标与基线对比，但未提统计显著性。
novelty_note: 以对比谱分解识别成功对齐行为模式并组织成技能塔，与浅层轨迹检索路线不同。
scope: 结论限于文本交互式基准 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上的 LLM 智能体。
limitations: 仅两个封闭领域基准，跨真实开放任务的可迁移性未验证。

title: T(r)opical Islands: Visualizing & Understanding Socio-Technical Artifacts
title_cn: T(r)opical Islands：可视化与理解社会技术制品
abstract: Projects hosted on collaborative software development platforms, such as GitHub, include many non-code artifacts documenting the project's lifecycle, with its challenges, plans, design, and even community. These socio-technical artifacts include, for example, bug reports, feature requests, and forum posts, offering a useful prospect on the project's evolution. However, these artifacts are dispersed over multiple communication channels and written in natural language, making their analysis difficult, as they are fragmented and with considerable noise. We present a 3D visualization approach mapping topics found across a project's socio-technical artifacts onto vegetation-covered islands, where the individual artifacts are depicted as trees of various types. The topic islands rise out of the ocean as they become discussed, to sink again when they are no longer so. We built a prototype implementing the entire visualization pipeline, from data mining to interactive rendering, leveraging machine learning techniques to cluster the artifacts and extract their topics. We present, through several case studies, the insights that our approach elicits about discussions of development topics throughout a project's history. The user study we conducted (N=34) further strengthens our conclusions about its suitability for understanding socio-technical artifacts and their evolution.
abstract_cn: 托管在 GitHub 等协作式软件开发平台上的项目包含许多非代码制品，它们记录了项目的生命周期，包括其挑战、计划、设计，甚至社区。这些社会技术制品例如包括缺陷报告、功能请求和论坛帖子，为项目的演化提供了有价值的视角。然而，这些制品分散在多个沟通渠道中且以自然语言写成，使得对它们的分析变得困难，因为它们是碎片化的并且带有相当多的噪声。我们提出一种 3D 可视化方法，把在一个项目的社会技术制品中发现的主题映射到覆盖植被的岛屿上，其中单个制品被描绘成各种类型的树。主题岛屿在被讨论时从海洋中升起，在不再被讨论时又重新沉没。我们构建了一个原型，实现了从数据挖掘到交互式渲染的完整可视化流水线，利用机器学习技术对制品进行聚类并抽取其主题。我们通过若干案例研究展示了我们的方法就项目历史中开发主题的讨论所引出的洞见。我们所开展的用户研究（N=34）进一步强化了我们关于该方法适用于理解社会技术制品及其演化的结论。
summary_cn: 上一篇工具 demo 的完整研究版：把项目跨渠道的社会技术制品聚类成主题，映射为随讨论热度升降的 3D 植被岛屿，配多个案例研究和 N=34 的用户研究验证其对理解制品演化的有效性。
comment: 12 pages, 11 figures, 1 table, accepted at ICSME 2026
objective_summary: 提出将 GitHub 等社交技术制品聚类为主题并以 3D 岛屿-树木可视化的方法，实现数据挖掘到交互渲染全流程原型，并通过若干案例与 N=34 用户研究验证。
evidence_note: 有原型实现、案例研究以及 N=34 的用户研究，但无量化对照方法与统计检验细节。
novelty_note: 将主题演化映射为岛屿升沉的隐喻式 3D 可视化在社交技术制品分析中较为新颖。
scope: 适用于 GitHub 类平台的 Issue、PR、论坛帖等自然语言制品可视化。
limitations: 聚类与主题抽取质量依赖 ML 组件，用户研究规模有限。

title: An Empirical Study on Learning Paths and Gender Dynamics in Scrum Master Roles
title_cn: Scrum Master 角色中的学习路径与性别动态的实证研究
abstract: Context: Agile development methodology has been widely adopted by industry and the demand for experienced professionals in Agile-related roles is persistently high. Objectives: We focus on the learning path for a Scrum Master role in multicultural software companies and investigate the role in relation to team size, together with the learning process for a career path, and how companies monitor soft skills development. Method: We conducted our study in two phases, two qualitative surveys (interview studies) and performed a qualitative and quantitative data analysis of the results. Conclusions: Our results identified that the need for a Scrum Master (SM) depends on the size of the team, with our study indicating a six-member limit. There is no overall standardized process for soft skills learning or metrics to measure progress. Some companies measure soft skills based on feedback received from the client or from the team, and other companies are taking both types of feedback into consideration. Many learning initiatives, especially on soft skills for an SM role, were based on actions of the employees. The version of Record of this contribution is published in Software Engineering and Advanced Applications. SEAA 2025. Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol 16083. Springer, Cham. and available online at: check DOI.
abstract_cn: 背景：敏捷开发方法学已被工业界广泛采用，对敏捷相关角色中有经验的专业人员的需求持续高企。目标：我们聚焦于多元文化软件公司中 Scrum Master 角色的学习路径，考察该角色与团队规模的关系，以及职业路径的学习过程，还有公司如何监测软技能的发展。方法：我们分两个阶段开展研究，进行了两次定性调查（访谈研究），并对结果进行了定性与定量的数据分析。结论：我们的结果表明，对 Scrum Master（SM）的需求取决于团队的规模，我们的研究显示存在一个六人成员的界限。对于软技能学习或衡量进展的度量指标，并不存在整体标准化的流程。一些公司基于从客户或团队收到的反馈来衡量软技能，另一些公司则同时考虑这两类反馈。许多学习举措，特别是针对 SM 角色软技能的学习举措，都是基于员工自身的行动。本文的正式版本发表于 Software Engineering and Advanced Applications. SEAA 2025. Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol 16083. Springer, Cham.，可通过 DOI 在线获取。
summary_cn: 两轮定性访谈式调查发现：团队规模超过六人才真正需要专职 Scrum Master，且业界对软技能培养既无标准流程也无度量指标，多数学习行为靠员工自发。
objective_summary: 通过两轮定性访谈研究 Scrum Master 角色的学习路径与团队规模关系，发现团队超过 6 人时才需要 SM，且软技能培养缺乏标准化流程与度量。
evidence_note: 两轮定性访谈，样本量未在摘要给出，无量化对照或统计检验，仅定性归纳。
novelty_note: 对已有敏捷角色与软技能话题的定性再确认，团队规模阈值属于经验观察。
scope: 结论限于受访的多文化软件公司中 Scrum Master 角色情境。
limitations: 样本规模与代表性摘要未披露，定性方法难以外推。

title: ARIA - An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Testing of Infotainment Systems
title_cn: ARIA——一个用于车载信息娱乐系统自主测试的 agentic 框架
abstract: Automotive infotainment validation still relies on manual testing, slow, costly, and incompatible with agile releases and OTA updates. Scripted automation only partly helps: it couples test logic to implementation, yielding brittle, high-maintenance suites. Existing LLM-driven frameworks mostly target web/mobile apps, using single- or dual-agent setups that overload one or two models with perception, planning, action selection, and validation at once, prone to hallucinations and unproductive exploration loops given infotainment complexity. We present ARIA (Autonomous Real-time Infotainment Assessment), a multi-agent LLM framework that autonomously runs end-to-end tests on Android infotainment systems via visual interaction, using a closed-loop pipeline of four specialized agents per step plus a report stage. From single-sentence scenarios (path, action, expected outcome), ARIA runs the interactions and produces reports, reproducible scripts, and visual evidence per step. Evaluated on a manufacturer's physical Android infotainment system across 30 scenarios, ARIA completed 28 (93.3%) with a verdict (2 errored), 20 of which (71.4%) matched ground truth. It caught all 5 known defects, no fault passed as working; its 8 false positives stem from navigation/image limits and unsupported gestures, showing multi-agent LLMs can run infotainment tests industrially while exposing the cost of a low false-positive tolerance. A single-agent baseline confirms the multi-agent design's value: on the first pass, before stronger-model revisitation narrows the gap, it shows a far higher false-positive rate (72.0% vs. 52.6%), conflating navigational difficulty with system failure. We report first-pass/post-revisitation results, token/call/cost per scenario, and show via repeated runs that stability tracks complexity, with fault detection perfectly consistent, pointing to CI integration of visual testing.
abstract_cn: 汽车信息娱乐系统的验证仍然依赖人工测试，这一过程缓慢、昂贵，并且与敏捷发布和 OTA 更新不兼容。脚本化自动化只能部分缓解问题：它把测试逻辑与实现耦合在一起，产生脆弱、维护成本高的测试套件。现有的 LLM 驱动框架大多面向 web/移动应用，采用单 agent 或双 agent 的设置，把感知、规划、动作选择和验证同时压在一两个模型上，在信息娱乐系统的复杂度面前容易产生幻觉和无效的探索循环。我们提出 ARIA（Autonomous Real-time Infotainment Assessment），一个多 agent LLM 框架，通过视觉交互在 Android 信息娱乐系统上自主运行端到端测试，每一步使用由四个专职 agent 构成的闭环流水线，外加一个报告阶段。从单句场景描述（路径、动作、预期结果）出发，ARIA 执行交互并产出报告、可复现的脚本以及每一步的可视化证据。在某制造商的物理 Android 信息娱乐系统上跨 30 个场景进行评估，ARIA 完成了其中 28 个（93.3%）并给出判定（2 个出错），其中 20 个（71.4%）与 ground truth 一致。它捕获了全部 5 个已知缺陷，没有任何故障被误判为正常；其 8 个误报源自导航/图像方面的限制以及不受支持的手势，这表明多 agent LLM 能够在工业场景中运行信息娱乐测试，同时也暴露出低误报容忍度所带来的代价。一个单 agent 基线证实了多 agent 设计的价值：在第一轮（在更强模型的再访问缩小差距之前），它表现出高得多的误报率（72.0% 对 52.6%），把导航难度与系统失败混为一谈。我们报告了首轮/再访问后的结果、每个场景的 token 数/调用次数/成本，并通过重复运行表明稳定性随复杂度变化，而故障检测则完全一致，这指向把视觉测试集成进 CI 的可能性。
summary_cn: 四个专职 agent 组成闭环流水线，在真实 Android 车机上跑 30 个场景：93.3% 给出判定、71.4% 与 ground truth 一致、5 个已知缺陷全部检出；单 agent 基线首轮误报率 72.0% vs 多 agent 52.6%，量化了多 agent 分工的价值与误报代价。
objective_summary: 提出 ARIA 多 agent LLM 框架，每步 4 个专门 agent 加报告阶段，通过视觉交互在 Android 车载信息娱乐系统上跑端到端测试；在制造商实机 30 场景下 93.3% 得出裁决、71.4% 与 ground truth 一致、检出全部 5 个已知缺陷；单 agent 基线首轮 FP 率 72.0% 对多 agent 52.6%。
evidence_note: 30 场景实机测试，含单 agent 基线，样本较小且限于单一系统
novelty_note: 把多 agent LLM 视觉测试首次落到 Android 车载信息娱乐场景
scope: 单一制造商 Android infotainment 系统上的 30 个测试场景
limitations: 场景仅 30、导航与图像识别受限，FP 率仍偏高，不支持部分手势

title: Better Understanding, Better Fixes? A Study of Hallucination in LLM-based Automated Program Repair
title_cn: 理解得更好，修得更好吗？LLM 驱动的自动程序修复中的幻觉研究
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly advanced automated program repair (APR), yet existing evaluations remain largely result-centric and provide limited insight into hallucination during repair. In APR, hallucination may arise not only in final patches but also in the intermediate artifacts that guide patch generation. To address this gap, we perform a multi-layered analysis of hallucination throughout the APR process. Specifically, we characterize hallucination as the production of patches or intermediate artifacts that are not faithfully grounded in the available repair evidence. We examine repair hallucination in final patches and understanding hallucination in intermediate artifacts through three tasks, namely triggering testcase identification, line coverage prediction, and additional testcase generation.We then evaluate three representative LLMs on 832 Defects4J bugs through automatic evaluation and manual analysis. Our results show that both repair and understanding hallucinations remain prevalent. Across models and settings, only 21.0%-55.9% of generated patches pass the developer-written test suite. Moreover, although more accurate intermediate artifacts are generally associated with successful repairs, this relationship does not always hold. Manual analysis of 812 sampled repairs identifies repair hallucinations in 72.7% of cases, including patches that pass all available tests; incorrect causal localization and incorrect repair strategies account for 45.9% and 18.5% of these hallucinations, respectively. Meanwhile, models frequently misidentify triggering testcases, mispredict line coverage involving branching control flow, and generate additional testcases with missing bug-triggering conditions or incorrect expected behavior.
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLMs）显著推进了自动程序修复（APR），但现有评估在很大程度上仍以结果为中心，对修复过程中的幻觉（hallucination）提供的洞见有限。在 APR 中，幻觉不仅可能出现在最终补丁里，也可能出现在指导补丁生成的中间制品中。为填补这一空白，我们对 APR 全过程中的幻觉进行了多层次分析。具体而言，我们把幻觉刻画为产出那些没有忠实地建立在可用修复证据之上的补丁或中间制品。我们通过三项任务考察最终补丁中的修复幻觉以及中间制品中的理解幻觉，这三项任务分别是触发性测试用例识别、行覆盖预测和额外测试用例生成。随后我们在 832 个 Defects4J 缺陷上，通过自动评估与人工分析对三个有代表性的 LLM 进行了评测。我们的结果显示，修复幻觉和理解幻觉都依然普遍存在。在各模型与各设置下，生成的补丁中只有 21.0%–55.9% 能通过开发者编写的测试套件。此外，尽管更准确的中间制品通常与成功的修复相关联，这种关系并不总是成立。对 812 个抽样修复的人工分析在 72.7% 的案例中识别出修复幻觉，其中包括那些通过了全部可用测试的补丁；错误的因果定位和错误的修复策略分别占这些幻觉的 45.9% 和 18.5%。与此同时，模型经常错误识别触发性测试用例，在涉及分支控制流时错误预测行覆盖，并生成缺少缺陷触发条件或预期行为不正确的额外测试用例。
summary_cn: 在 832 个 Defects4J 缺陷上评测三个 LLM：只有 21.0%-55.9% 的补丁能通过开发者测试套件，人工分析 812 个修复发现 72.7% 存在修复幻觉（包括通过了全部可用测试的补丁），其中 45.9% 是因果定位错误、18.5% 是修复策略错误。
objective_summary: 在 832 个 Defects4J bug 上用 3 个代表性 LLM 做多层次幻觉分析，涵盖最终补丁与三类中间产物（触发用例识别、行覆盖预测、附加测试生成）；补丁通过率 21.0% 到 55.9%，对 812 个采样人工分析显示 72.7% 存在修复幻觉，其中错误因果定位 45.9%、错误策略 18.5%。
evidence_note: 832 个 bug 加 3 个 LLM，812 样本人工分析，多任务多设置
novelty_note: 把 APR 幻觉细分到中间产物与最终补丁的多层刻画与定量分析
scope: Defects4J Java bug、3 个代表性 LLM、四个 APR 子任务
limitations: 单一 Java benchmark，LLM 覆盖数量有限，无干预式修复实验

title: CPL: A Compact C-like Systems Language with Explicit Low-Level Control
title_cn: CPL：一种具备显式底层控制能力的紧凑类 C 系统语言
abstract: This paper presents Cordell Programming Language (CPL), a compact C-like systems language that retains C's direct access to memory, layout, and machine interfaces while experimenting with a smaller grammar and selected conveniences from newer languages. Also this paper studies whether C-like are more convenient to use for compiler experiments than modern approaches and paradigms. While the language and compiler provide primitive values, pointers, arrays, containers with methods, unions, generic functions, overloads, entry-point and section control, system calls, and inline assembly, they do not provide high-level constructs such as classes, built-in methods, a standard library, or memory protection. The article describes the language design, compiler pipeline, target backends, static-analysis architecture, and OS-facing use cases, then evaluates the prototype backend with reproducible x86_64 and i386 microbenchmarks against C compiler baselines. The obtained results suggest that the compiler can produce code comparable to that produced by production compilers such as GCC and Clang, as well as by small compilers such as TinyC and SmallerC.
abstract_cn: 本文介绍 Cordell 编程语言（Cordell Programming Language, CPL），一种紧凑的类 C 系统级语言，它保留了 C 对内存、内存布局和机器接口的直接访问能力，同时尝试使用更小的语法，并从较新的语言中选取了一些便利特性。此外，本文还研究了在编译器实验中，类 C 语言是否比现代的方法和范式更便于使用。虽然该语言及其编译器提供了原始值、指针、数组、带方法的容器、联合体、泛型函数、重载、入口点与段（section）控制、系统调用以及内联汇编，但它们并不提供类、内建方法、标准库或内存保护等高层构造。文章描述了语言设计、编译器流水线、目标后端、静态分析架构以及面向操作系统的使用场景，随后在可复现的 x86_64 与 i386 微基准上，将该原型后端与 C 编译器基线进行对比评估。所获得的结果表明，该编译器能够生成与 GCC、Clang 这类生产级编译器，以及 TinyC、SmallerC 这类小型编译器相当的代码。
summary_cn: 提出类 C 的系统级语言 CPL 及其编译器（含静态分析架构、x86_64 与 i386 后端、内联汇编与系统调用支持），在可复现微基准上生成的代码质量与 GCC/Clang 及 TinyC/SmallerC 相当。
objective_summary: 提出 Cordell Programming Language（CPL），支持指针、数组、带方法容器、联合体、泛型、重载、入口与 section 控制、内联汇编与系统调用；实现原型编译器（x86_64 与 i386），以微基准与 GCC、Clang、TinyC、SmallerC 比较，作者报告性能相当。
evidence_note: x86_64 与 i386 微基准对四种 C 编译器，基准细节与规模有限
novelty_note: 又一款 C 类系统语言，语法糖组合为主，无提出新的语言机制
scope: x86_64 与 i386 上的微基准；无标准库、无内存保护
limitations: 仅微基准评估，缺乏真实应用与安全性、可维护性论证

title: Same Request, Different Answer: Quantization Amplifies Cache-Induced Divergence in LLM Serving
title_cn: 同样的请求，不同的答案：量化放大了 LLM 服务中由缓存引起的分歧
abstract: Prefix caching, in which a serving engine reuses the key and value tensors of a shared prompt prefix across requests, is enabled by default in the major open-source stacks and treated as a transparent optimization. We measure what it costs in reproducibility, and find that the cost rises sharply with weight quantization. Holding the model, decoding parameters, seed, and request order fixed, and issuing every request serially at batch size one, we ran an eighty-episode multi-turn agentic tool-use workload with caching enabled and disabled across two engines and four weight formats. Enabling the cache changed the agent's trajectory on 36.2 percent of episodes at 16-bit precision and on 75.0 percent at four-bit, a gradient that survives re-measurement under a controlled cache configuration. With caching disabled, repeated execution was bit-identical in every configuration, 0 of 800 episodes, which bounds other sources of nondeterminism at 0.5 percent. Repeated cache-enabled runs did diverge, and three experiments locate the cause: a single server-level prompt-cache setting moves run-to-run divergence by 37.5 percentage points, execution order acts only while that setting is active, and restoring cache state makes the cached and recompute paths each reproduce on 40 of 40 items while still differing from each other on 14. Cached serving is deterministic given cache state, and irreproducible in practice because that state is absent from the request and never reset by default. A single-turn bridge shows the divergence reaching task outcomes without shifting aggregate accuracy. We release the harness, logs, and analysis pipeline.
abstract_cn: 前缀缓存（prefix caching）——即服务引擎在多个请求之间复用共享 prompt 前缀的 key 与 value 张量——在主流开源技术栈中默认启用，并被当作一种透明的优化。我们测量了它在可复现性上的代价，并发现这一代价会随着权重量化而急剧上升。在固定模型、解码参数、随机种子和请求顺序，并以 batch size 为 1 串行发出每个请求的条件下，我们在两个引擎和四种权重格式上，分别以启用和禁用缓存的方式运行了一个包含八十个 episode 的多轮 agentic 工具使用工作负载。启用缓存后，在 16-bit 精度下有 36.2% 的 episode 改变了 agent 的轨迹，在 4-bit 下这一比例为 75.0%，这一梯度在受控缓存配置下的重新测量中依然存在。在禁用缓存的情况下，重复执行在每一种配置下都是逐位一致的，800 个 episode 中有 0 个出现差异，这把其他非确定性来源的上界限定在 0.5%。启用缓存的重复运行确实出现了分歧，三个实验定位了原因：单个服务器级的 prompt-cache 设置可以把运行间的分歧改变 37.5 个百分点；执行顺序只在该设置处于激活状态时才起作用；而恢复缓存状态会让缓存路径与重算路径各自在 40 个条目中的 40 个上复现，但两者之间仍在 14 个条目上存在差异。带缓存的服务在给定缓存状态时是确定性的，但在实践中不可复现，因为该状态并不包含在请求中，并且默认从不被重置。一个单轮的桥接实验表明，这种分歧会影响到任务结果，却不会改变总体准确率。我们公开了测试框架、日志和分析流水线。
summary_cn: 固定模型、参数、种子与请求顺序后，开启 prefix cache 会让 16-bit 下 36.2% 的 agentic 工具使用回合改变轨迹，4-bit 下高达 75.0%；关缓存时 800 个回合全部逐位一致——直接威胁所有 agent 实验的可复现性。
comment: Submitted to IEEE Access
objective_summary: 固定模型、参数、种子并以 batch=1 串行发送，跑 80 集多轮 agentic tool-use 工作负载，覆盖 2 个 engine 与 4 种权重格式；开启前缀缓存时 16 位改变 36.2% 集轨迹、4 位达 75.0%，关闭缓存下 800 集完全比特一致；单一 server 级 prompt-cache 设置移动分歧 37.5 个百分点。

title: Building a research-software catalog with a coding agent: from hackathon prototype to public deployment
title_cn: 用 coding agent 构建科研软件目录：从黑客松原型到公开部署
abstract: Generative AI and coding agents can accelerate research software development, but they also increase the need for efficient software discovery and maintenance. We developed a repository catalog during a three-day hackathon and subsequently examined the engineering required to make it suitable for public deployment, including adversarial review, data-quality checks, browser-level validation, and publication safeguards. We then explored whether the lessons learned from this prototype could be transferred to a much larger, human-curated portal, through a retrieval agent under development for MateriApps that combines curated portal metadata, external documentation, vector search, and local language-model generation. Implementation with coding agents was rapid, but achieving reliable operation required substantial additional engineering: the most consequential problems were not crashes but silent failures that produced plausible yet incomplete or incorrect outputs, arising from incomplete data acquisition, misleading assessments, and retrieval or preprocessing failures. These observations suggest that AI-assisted software portals require explicit validation, monitoring, and repeated review, and that curated metadata and maintained documentation remain essential. The MateriApps work is exploratory and remains under active development, so the observations reported for it are preliminary; a comparable combination of curated metadata, automatically collected documentation, and retrieval-based assistance may nevertheless be useful for extending other research-software portals.
abstract_cn: 生成式 AI 与 coding agents 能够加速科研软件的开发，但它们同时也加大了对高效软件发现与维护的需求。我们在一次为期三天的黑客松中开发了一个仓库目录，随后考察了要使其适合公开部署所需要的工程工作，包括对抗性评审、数据质量检查、浏览器级验证以及发布方面的保障措施。接着我们探究了从这个原型中得到的经验教训是否可以迁移到一个规模大得多、由人工策展的门户上，途径是一个正在为 MateriApps 开发的检索 agent，它结合了经过策展的门户元数据、外部文档、向量检索以及本地语言模型生成。用 coding agents 实现的过程很快，但要达到可靠运行则需要大量额外的工程投入：最要命的问题不是崩溃，而是那些产出看似合理却不完整或不正确输出的静默失败，它们源自不完整的数据采集、具有误导性的评估，以及检索或预处理环节的失败。这些观察表明，AI 辅助的软件门户需要显式的验证、监控和反复评审，并且经过策展的元数据与持续维护的文档仍然不可或缺。MateriApps 方面的工作属于探索性质且仍在积极开发中，因此针对它报告的观察是初步的；不过，这种把经过策展的元数据、自动收集的文档与基于检索的辅助相结合的做法，对于扩展其他科研软件门户也可能是有用的。
summary_cn: 三天黑客松用 coding agent 搭出仓库目录原型，但走向公开部署时的真正瓶颈不是崩溃而是「静默失败」——产出看似合理却不完整或错误的结果，需要对抗性评审、数据质量检查和浏览器级验证等大量额外工程。

title: Beyond Code Generation: Reliability, Verification, and Cost Economics in the Agentic Software Development Lifecycle
title_cn: 超越代码生成：agentic 软件开发生命周期中的可靠性、验证与成本经济学
abstract: AI coding systems are moving from autocomplete and chat toward agents that can inspect repositories, edit multiple files, run tools, write tests, open pull requests, and work for long periods with limited supervision. This capability changes the bottleneck in software delivery. Recent field studies show meaningful gains in coding activity, but newer evidence also shows that those gains attenuate sharply between writing code and shipping reliable software. Review, integration, testing, security, deployment, and production operations remain constraining stages, while the economics are shifting from predictable per-seat licensing toward variable token, tool, sandbox, CI, and rework costs. This paper synthesizes peer-reviewed software-engineering research, university studies, benchmark audits, production reports from major technology companies, developer telemetry, and cost-management evidence released primarily from 2024 through September 2026. No new model experiment is claimed; numerical findings remain attributed to their original studies. The synthesis proposes four engineering concepts: the Agentic SDLC Throughput Paradox, Production-Qualified Change (PQC), the Verification Tax, and an Agentic SDLC Control Plane that allocates autonomy subject to cost, reliability, and human-attention budgets. An evidence-based horizon then maps today's supervised agents to future policy-bounded software factories. The central research question shifts from how much code an agent can generate to how much production-qualified value an engineering system can deliver per dollar, per reviewer-hour, and per unit of operational risk.
abstract_cn: AI 编码系统正在从自动补全和聊天走向能够检视仓库、编辑多个文件、运行工具、编写测试、提交 pull request 并在有限监督下长时间工作的 agents。这种能力改变了软件交付中的瓶颈。近期的现场研究显示编码活动上有实质性的收益，但更新的证据也表明，这些收益在从写出代码到交付可靠软件之间急剧衰减。评审、集成、测试、安全、部署和生产运维仍然是受限环节，与此同时经济模式也正从可预测的按席位授权转向可变的 token、工具、沙箱、CI 和返工成本。本文综合了同行评审的软件工程研究、大学研究、基准审计、大型科技公司的生产报告、开发者遥测数据以及成本管理方面的证据，主要来自 2024 年至 2026 年 9 月发布的材料。本文不声称任何新的模型实验；数值性发现仍归属于其原始研究。该综合提出了四个工程概念：Agentic SDLC 吞吐悖论（Agentic SDLC Throughput Paradox）、生产合格变更（Production-Qualified Change, PQC）、验证税（Verification Tax），以及一个在成本、可靠性和人类注意力预算约束下分配自主性的 Agentic SDLC 控制平面。随后，一条基于证据的发展路线把今天受监督的 agents 映射到未来受策略约束的软件工厂。核心研究问题从一个 agent 能生成多少代码，转向一个工程系统每一美元、每一个评审人小时、每一单位运营风险能交付多少经生产验证的价值。

title: How Developers Discuss Generative AI: A Longitudinal Study of the Visual Studio Code Community
title_cn: 开发者如何讨论生成式 AI：对 Visual Studio Code 社区的纵向研究
abstract: Generative AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, and coding agents have rapidly become part of everyday software development, yet little is known about how mainstream open source communities discuss them in practice. This paper presents a longitudinal analysis of generative-AI-related discussions in the Visual Studio Code (VS Code) GitHub repository, using 43,806 candidate issues created between January 2021 and June 2026. To improve corpus quality, we combined keyword retrieval with semantic relevance filtering, yielding a filtered corpus of 25,227 AI-related issues. We applied BERTopic to the retrieved corpus to identify discussion topics, using the filtered corpus for theme validation and a robustness re-clustering, and analyzed their evolution over time using monthly prevalence and Mann-Kendall trend tests. The results show that developer discussions are dominated by practical concerns regarding the operation of AI-assisted development environments, including agent management, configuration, reliability, authentication, and billing, whereas risks frequently emphasized in survey-based studies, such as hallucination and licensing, rarely surface in this venue. This suggests that discussions of generative AI in the VS Code issue tracker primarily focus on operational aspects of AI-assisted software development. Furthermore, discussions evolved from AI-assisted code completion toward conversational and agent-based development, reflecting the increasing integration of generative AI into software development workflows. These findings suggest that GitHub Issues provide a practical, workflow-oriented perspective on generative AI that complements survey-based studies of developer perceptions.
abstract_cn: GitHub Copilot、ChatGPT 和 coding agents 等生成式 AI 工具已经迅速成为日常软件开发的一部分，但人们对主流开源社区在实践中如何讨论它们却知之甚少。本文对 Visual Studio Code（VS Code）GitHub 仓库中与生成式 AI 相关的讨论进行了纵向分析，使用了 2021 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月之间创建的 43,806 个候选 issue。为提升语料质量，我们把关键词检索与语义相关性过滤结合起来，得到一个包含 25,227 个 AI 相关 issue 的过滤语料。我们对检索到的语料应用 BERTopic 来识别讨论主题，并使用过滤后的语料进行主题验证和一次稳健性重聚类，然后用每月流行度和 Mann-Kendall 趋势检验分析它们随时间的演化。结果显示，开发者的讨论被关于 AI 辅助开发环境运行的实际问题所主导，包括 agent 管理、配置、可靠性、鉴权和计费，而在基于问卷的研究中经常被强调的风险（例如幻觉和许可证问题）则很少在这一场域中出现。这表明 VS Code issue 跟踪器中关于生成式 AI 的讨论主要聚焦于 AI 辅助软件开发的运维层面。此外，讨论从 AI 辅助代码补全演化到对话式和基于 agent 的开发，反映出生成式 AI 正日益融入软件开发工作流。这些发现表明，GitHub Issues 提供了一个面向实际工作流的生成式 AI 视角，可以补充基于问卷的开发者感知研究。
summary_cn: 对 VS Code 仓库 2021.01–2026.06 的 43,806 个候选 issue（过滤后 25,227 个）做 BERTopic 主题建模：讨论被 agent 管理、配置、可靠性、鉴权、计费等运维问题主导，而问卷研究常强调的幻觉与许可风险几乎不出现——issue 视角与问卷视角存在系统性错位。
