Under low calibration budgets, PTA-IRT consistently outperforms prior IRT baselines on score and ranking recovery across four SWE benchmarks. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/PTA-IRT.
abstract_cn: 在真实的基准上评估软件工程 agent 成本高昂，因为每个任务都可能需要多步的代码探索、修改和测试执行。现有的高效评估方法选择具有代表性的子集来估计全基准的表现，但这些方法大多只关注结果本身：它们拟合历史的通过/失败响应矩阵或静态的任务语义，而丢弃了 agent 是如何解决问题的信息。我们提出了 PTA-IRT，一种融合了过程信号与结果信号的、具有特权轨迹感知能力的项目反应理论（Item Response Theory）框架。历史执行轨迹提供了超越通过/失败的过程级证据，例如探索过的上下文、尝试过的编辑以及求解路径，PTA-IRT 将这些信息作为特权信息，用于校准子集的选择和能力估计。在低校准预算下，PTA-IRT 在四个 SWE 基准上的得分恢复和排名恢复方面持续优于此前的 IRT 基线方法。代码和数据已在 https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/PTA-IRT 公开。
summary_cn: 提出 PTA-IRT 框架，将历史执行轨迹（探索的上下文、尝试的编辑、求解路径等过程信号）作为特权信息融入项目反应理论（IRT），用于校准子集选择与能力估计；在低校准预算下于 4 个 SWE 基准上持续超过已有 IRT 基线的得分和排名恢复效果。
comment: Under review
objective_summary: 提出 PTA-IRT 特权轨迹感知项目反应理论框架，将历史执行轨迹（探索上下文、编辑尝试、解题路径）作为特权信息用于校准子集选择与能力估计。在 4 个 SWE 基准上，低校准预算下相对既有 IRT 基线在得分与排名恢复上均更优。
evidence_note: 4 个 SWE 基准对比多个 IRT 基线，评估得分与排名恢复
novelty_note: 首次将执行轨迹作为特权信息融入 IRT 校准，超越纯 pass/fail 矩阵
scope: 4 个 SWE 代理基准的低校准预算高效评估
limitations: 依赖历史执行轨迹数据，仅在 SWE 代理场景验证

title: Adaptive Critical Token-Aware Retrieval for Repository-Level Code Generation
title_cn: ACToR：面向仓库级代码生成的自适应关键 token 感知检索
abstract: The repository-level code generation task requires synthesizing code that satisfies task requirements while remaining consistent with the target repository context. Since real-world repositories often exceed the input length limits of LLMs, existing approaches commonly adopt retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to provide repository-specific context. Despite improving repository-context retrieval, existing methods typically provide context as task-level support, without explicitly identifying the critical tokens that require fine-grained repository context during generation. During the autoregressive generation process of LLMs, errors often concentrate at a small number of decisive positions: once such tokens are generated incorrectly, subsequent code may follow an incorrect semantic path and eventually lead to functional failure. We refer to these positions as "critical tokens". In this paper, we propose ACToR, an adaptive critical token-aware retrieval framework for repository-level code generation. ACToR identifies critical tokens during generation and triggers targeted retrieval on demand to provide repository context at these decisive positions. In addition, we design a position-aware weighting method for dense retrievers to prioritize context that is more informative for generation. We evaluate ACToR on two representative repository-level benchmarks, RepoExec and CoderEval. Experimental results show that ACToR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving relative improvements of 8.4% on RepoExec and 15.4% on CoderEval. Beyond performance gains, we systematically quantify the impact of critical tokens, revealing their central role in major generation failures and highlighting the necessity of targeted retrieval strategies. We provide the code and data at https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/ACToR.
abstract_cn: 仓库级代码生成任务要求在满足任务需求的同时，合成的代码还要与目标仓库上下文保持一致。由于真实世界的仓库常常超出 LLM 的输入长度限制，现有方法通常采用检索增强生成（RAG）来提供仓库特定的上下文。尽管这些方法改善了仓库上下文检索，但它们通常只将上下文作为任务级别的支持提供，而没有明确识别出在生成过程中需要细粒度仓库上下文的关键 token。在 LLM 的自回归生成过程中，错误往往集中在少数几个决定性的位置：一旦这些 token 被错误生成，后续代码就可能沿着错误的语义路径展开，最终导致功能性失败。我们将这些位置称为「关键 token」。在本文中，我们提出了 ACToR，一种面向仓库级代码生成的自适应关键 token 感知检索框架。ACToR 在生成过程中识别关键 token，并在这些决定性位置按需触发有针对性的检索，从而提供仓库上下文。此外，我们为稠密检索器设计了一种位置感知的加权方法，以优先考虑对生成更具信息量的上下文。我们在两个具有代表性的仓库级基准 RepoExec 和 CoderEval 上评估了 ACToR。实验结果表明，ACToR 持续优于最先进的方法，在 RepoExec 和 CoderEval 上分别取得了 8.4% 和 15.4% 的相对提升。除了性能提升之外，我们还系统地量化了关键 token 的影响，揭示了它们在主要生成失败中所起的核心作用，并强调了有针对性检索策略的必要性。我们在 https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/ACToR 提供了代码和数据。
summary_cn: 针对现有 RAG 方法只做任务级检索、未能识别生成过程中需要细粒度仓库上下文的「关键 token」这一问题，提出 ACToR 框架，在生成中动态识别关键 token 并触发针对性检索，配合位置感知的稠密检索加权；在 RepoExec 和 CoderEval 上分别取得 8.4% 和 15.4% 的相对提升。
comment: Under review
objective_summary: 提出 ACToR 自适应关键 token 感知检索框架，在生成过程中识别「关键 token」并按需触发定向检索，配合位置感知加权的稠密检索。在 RepoExec 与 CoderEval 两个 repo 级基准上相对 SOTA 分别提升 8.4% 与 15.4%。
evidence_note: 2 个 repo 级基准对比 SOTA，量化关键 token 对失败的贡献
novelty_note: 提出「关键 token」概念+位置感知加权检索，区别于任务级 RAG 支持
scope: RepoExec 与 CoderEval 两个 repo 级代码生成基准
limitations: 仅两 repo 级基准，未涉及跨语言或非 Python 大型场景验证

title: The Data Problem in Software Vulnerability Analysis: Artifacts, Quality, and Consumption
title_cn: 软件漏洞分析中的数据问题：制品、质量与消费
abstract: Learning- and LLM-based software vulnerability analysis is only as trustworthy as the data it is trained and evaluated on, yet that data is rarely examined as a first-class object. We investigate the data behind vulnerability analysis through a dataset-centric taxonomy that separates what an artifact is (code, metadata, patches, tests/PoCs, reasoning, traces), how good it is (realism, label evidence, scale, diversity, leakage, availability), and what it is used for. From a systematically assembled corpus of 1522 papers covering 2016-2026 plus foundational earlier work we deep-code a tiered set of 111 anchor papers, backing every affirmative rubric-graded value with a verbatim span, and we report, per attribute, both how much it has been studied and how well datasets achieve it. The results trace an evidence ladder: executable artifacts are the only major type where 15 of the 24 datasets are both graded real-world and carry labels that received an independent check, while code-sample datasets-the largest category in both the auto-tagged corpus and the anchor set-are the least realistic: 20 of the 41 draw their vulnerabilities from authentic projects or CVEs, but only 3 keep the sample at the unit the code is deployed in, and only 2 do both-though these are coarse component tests, and just one code-sample dataset meets the codebook's stricter full-context real-world grade. Among these, leakage goes unaddressed by 49 of the 90 datasets where it applies, more than a quarter say nothing about availability, reasoning data has arrived only recently and is mostly model-generated, and primary trace corpora remain limited to three datasets, the total after a corpus-wide screen and a full-text check of every candidate it surfaced, with further datasets releasing traces secondarily behind benchmarks and harnesses.
abstract_cn: 基于学习和 LLM 的软件漏洞分析，其可信度仅取决于用于训练和评估的数据，然而这些数据却很少被当作一等研究对象来审视。我们通过一个以数据集为中心的分类体系，来考察漏洞分析背后的数据，该体系区分了一个制品是什么（代码、元数据、补丁、测试/PoC、推理过程、执行轨迹）、它有多好（真实性、标签证据、规模、多样性、泄漏情况、可获取性），以及它被用于什么用途。基于一个系统汇集的、覆盖 2016-2026 年并包含基础性早期工作的、共 1522 篇论文的语料库，我们深度编码了一组分层的、共 111 篇的锚点论文，为每一个肯定性的、按评分标准评级的取值都提供了逐字引用作为支撑证据，并针对每个属性，既报告其被研究的程度，也报告数据集在该属性上的达成情况。结果勾勒出一条「证据阶梯」：可执行制品是唯一的一个主要类型，其中 24 个数据集里有 15 个既被评为真实世界、又带有经过独立核验的标签；而代码样本数据集——在自动标注语料库和锚点集合中都是最大的类别——则是真实性最差的：41 个里有 20 个的漏洞来自真实项目或 CVE，但只有 3 个保留了代码在其部署环境中的原始单元，且只有 2 个同时满足这两点——即便如此，这些也只是粗粒度的组件测试，只有一个代码样本数据集满足编码手册中更严格的「完整上下文、真实世界」评级。在这些数据集中，泄漏问题在 90 个适用的数据集中有 49 个未被处理，超过四分之一的数据集对可获取性只字未提，推理数据直到最近才出现且大多为模型生成，原始执行轨迹语料库仍仅限于三个数据集——这是在对整个语料库进行筛查、并对其发现的每一个候选进行全文核查之后得出的总数，此外还有一些数据集把执行轨迹作为基准和 harness 的附带产物间接发布。
summary_cn: 对 1522 篇（2016-2026）论文进行系统梳理并深度编码 111 篇锚点论文，构建区分「制品是什么/质量如何/如何被使用」的数据集分类体系，发现可执行制品数据集中 24 个里有 15 个既真实又经过独立标签核验，而代码样本数据集（最大类别）中 41 个里只有 3 个保留了部署时的原始单元、仅 2 个同时满足真实性与标签核验，泄漏问题在 90 个适用数据集中有 49 个未被处理。
objective_summary: 以数据集为一等对象，用三维分类法调研 2016-2026 年 1522 篇软件漏洞分析论文并深度编码 111 篇锚定论文，每条评级配 verbatim span。结果显示 41 个代码样本数据集中仅 3 个保持部署单位、20 个源于真实项目，90 个适用泄漏检查的数据集中 49 个未处理泄漏。
evidence_note: 1522 篇语料+111 篇锚定深度编码，每条断言配 verbatim span 证据
novelty_note: 以数据集为一等对象的三维分类法，系统评级现实性、泄漏、可获得性等属性
scope: 2016-2026 学习/LLM 类软件漏洞分析领域的数据集与论文
limitations: rubric 评级依赖人工深度编码，锚定 111 篇存在抽样与主观性

title: HarnessDev: Can LLMs Create and Evolve Their Own Agent Harness?
title_cn: HarnessDev：LLM 能创造并演化自己的 agent harness 吗？
abstract: As agents move from research prototypes to deployed tools, their capability increasingly depends on model-external execution infrastructure, commonly termed the agent harness. Changing this harness while holding model weights fixed can substantially alter task performance. Current agent evaluations typically report downstream performance under a chosen harness, leaving a model's ability to develop the harness itself comparatively underexplored. We introduce HarnessDev, a benchmark that shifts the unit of evaluation from task outputs to runnable infrastructure. HarnessDev covers two stages. In Creation, the agent starts from a minimal seed and a small number of cases, then builds a complete execution system. In Evolution, it starts from its own created harness and iteratively revises it using downstream execution feedback, with the goal of improving benchmark performance. We then evaluate each constructed harness on capability (task success on held-out benchmarks) and efficiency (execution-token cost). The reported Creation results cover six creator LLMs, four domains, and five downstream benchmarks totaling 2,207 unique downstream instances, with hidden evaluation tasks withheld from development. We find that generated harnesses remain substantially behind mature human-engineered references on code and on search and research, while matching or exceeding the selected references on writing and machine-learning experimentation, with large variation in execution cost. Evolution produces some performance gains, but they are unstable and transfer only partially to held-out tasks. Experiments with a fixed runtime model further show that the gains depend strongly on the model executing the harness, indicating limited transfer across models.
abstract_cn: 随着 agent 从研究原型走向部署工具，其能力越来越依赖于模型之外的执行基础设施，通常被称为 agent harness。在保持模型权重不变的情况下改变这一 harness，可以显著改变任务表现。当前的 agent 评测通常报告在某个选定 harness 之下的下游表现，而对模型自身开发该 harness 的能力，相对而言探索得还很不充分。我们引入了 HarnessDev，这是一个将评测单位从任务输出转移到可运行基础设施本身的基准。HarnessDev 涵盖两个阶段。在「创建」阶段，agent 从一个最小种子和少量样例出发，构建出一套完整的执行系统。在「演化」阶段，它从自己创建的 harness 出发，利用下游执行反馈进行迭代修订，目标是提升基准表现。随后，我们从能力（在留出基准上的任务成功率）和效率（执行的 token 成本）两个维度评估每个构建出的 harness。所报告的「创建」结果覆盖了六个创建者 LLM、四个领域和五个下游基准，共计 2207 个独特的下游实例，其中隐藏的评测任务在开发过程中被隐去不用。我们发现，在代码以及搜索与研究领域，生成的 harness 仍明显落后于成熟的人工工程参考实现，而在写作和机器学习实验领域，其表现可以持平甚至超过所选定的参考实现，执行成本方面则存在很大差异。「演化」带来了一些性能提升，但这些提升并不稳定，并且只能部分迁移到留出任务上。使用固定运行时模型进行的实验进一步表明，这些收益强烈依赖于执行该 harness 的具体模型，说明其跨模型迁移能力有限。
summary_cn: 提出基准 HarnessDev，将评测单位从任务输出转移到「可运行的执行基础设施」本身，涵盖「创建」（从最小种子构建完整执行系统）和「演化」（基于执行反馈迭代改进自建 harness）两阶段；在覆盖 6 个创建者 LLM、4 个领域、5 个下游基准共 2207 个实例的评测中，发现生成的 harness 在代码及搜索/研究任务上明显落后于成熟的人工工程参考实现，而在写作和机器学习实验任务上可持平或超越，演化带来的收益不稳定且迁移有限。
comment: Project page: https://self-developing-agents.github.io/
objective_summary: 提出 HarnessDev 基准，将评估单元从任务输出转向可运行的 agent harness；覆盖 6 个 creator LLM、4 个领域、5 个下游基准共 2207 个实例。结果显示生成 harness 在代码与检索任务上落后于人工工程参考、在写作与 ML 实验上接近或超过；Evolution 阶段有增益但不稳定且跨模型迁移有限。
evidence_note: 覆盖 6 LLM、4 领域、5 基准共 2207 实例，含 held-out 评估与人工参考对比
novelty_note: 将评估单位从任务输出改为可运行 harness，含 Creation 与 Evolution 两阶段
scope: 6 个 creator LLM、4 领域 5 基准 2207 实例的 held-out 评估场景
limitations: Evolution 增益不稳定，跨模型迁移弱，harness 表现强依赖执行模型

title: What Does an Agentic Software Engineering Benchmark Measure? Profiling Task Demands and Agent Behaviour Beyond What Category Labels Reveal
title_cn: Agentic 软件工程基准到底衡量了什么？超越类别标签刻画任务需求与 agent 行为
abstract: Agentic software engineering benchmarks are typically summarized by nominal category labels such as "bug fix" or "feature implementation," yet benchmarks carrying the same label are built through very different curation pipelines. A label thus reveals little about the engineering work a benchmark demands. We introduce the Spread--Novelty--Centrality (SNC) profile, a three-axis characterization of the demands of repository-level coding tasks, grounded in empirical software engineering research. We apply the profile to five widely used benchmarks and 14,922 trajectories of two model families at three scales, and report three findings. (1) A label is an unreliable proxy for task demands, as every pair of benchmarks is statistically separated on at least two SNC axes, and the separations trace back to specific curation decisions. (2) Agent behaviour reveals demands that the human-written gold solution cannot. Agents produce larger solutions than the gold where problem statements withhold hints and smaller ones where curation inflates the gold. How a task is phrased shapes what an agent produces. (3) Task demands correlate with success uniformly, with resolved runs concentrating in the low-SNC region for every family and scale, whereas the behavioural signatures of success are family-specific. Claude succeeds by matching the scope of the gold solution, and its parity share on files rises from $0.17$ at the smallest scale to $0.54$ at the largest. Qwen succeeds by exceeding the gold scope at every scale, and editing too little marks failure for both families.
abstract_cn: Agentic 软件工程基准通常用「bug fix」或「feature implementation」这类名义类别标签来概括，然而带有相同标签的基准往往是通过截然不同的构建流程打造出来的。因此，一个标签几乎无法反映该基准所要求的工程工作。我们引入了 Spread-Novelty-Centrality（SNC）画像，这是一种三轴的刻画方式，用于表征仓库级编码任务的需求，并以经验软件工程研究为基础。我们将该画像应用于五个被广泛使用的基准，以及两个模型家族在三种规模下产生的 14,922 条轨迹，并报告了三项发现。（1）标签是任务需求的不可靠代理：每一对基准都在至少两个 SNC 轴上呈现统计上的显著区分，而这些区分可以追溯到具体的构建决策。（2）agent 的行为揭示了人工撰写的 gold 方案所无法呈现的需求。当问题描述省略提示时，agent 会产生比 gold 方案更大的解；而当构建过程使 gold 方案本身被「灌水」变大时，agent 产生的解则更小。任务的表述方式塑造了 agent 产生的结果。（3）任务需求与成功率的关系在各模型家族和规模下呈现一致的相关性：成功的运行普遍集中在低 SNC 区域，而成功背后的行为特征却因模型家族而异。Claude 通过匹配 gold 方案的改动范围来取得成功，其在文件层面的范围匹配占比从最小规模下的 0.17 上升到最大规模下的 0.54；Qwen 则在每种规模下都通过超出 gold 方案的范围来取得成功，而对两个模型家族而言，编辑范围过小都是失败的标志。
summary_cn: 提出 Spread-Novelty-Centrality（SNC）三轴画像来刻画仓库级编码任务的真实需求，在 5 个常用基准、两个模型家族三种规模共 14,922 条轨迹上发现：类别标签（如「bug fix」）无法可靠代表任务需求，每对基准至少在两个 SNC 轴上存在统计显著差异；Claude 的成功依赖于匹配 gold 方案的改动范围（其规模匹配占比从最小规模的 0.17 升至最大规模的 0.54），而 Qwen 则依赖于超出 gold 范围来取得成功。
objective_summary: 提出 Spread-Novelty-Centrality（SNC）三轴刻画仓库级编码任务需求，并在 5 个基准与两模型家族三种规模共 14,922 条轨迹上应用。发现同标签基准在至少两轴上统计可分，成功集中在低 SNC 区，Claude 通过匹配 gold 规模成功而 Qwen 通过超出 gold 规模成功。
evidence_note: 覆盖 5 基准、两家族三规模共 14,922 轨迹，含成对统计分离与规模趋势，但缺显著性阈值细节。
novelty_note: 提出超越标签的三轴需求刻画并以此揭示 gold 与 agent 行为差异，视角较新。
scope: 结论限于 5 个 agentic SE 基准与两模型家族（Claude、Qwen）三种规模。
limitations: 仅覆盖两模型家族与 5 基准，SNC 轴依赖既有 ESE 经验定义，跨家族行为特征不通用。

title: Continuous Autonomous Refactoring: A Research Roadmap for AI-Driven Code Quality Maintenance
title_cn: 持续自主重构：AI 驱动代码质量维护的研究路线图
abstract: Large language models have shown promising capabilities in code refactoring, but existing approaches remain limited to method-level tasks. In this paper, we envision LLM-based refactoring as a continuous component of software maintenance rather than a tool invoked only for occasional manual refactoring. Under this vision, AI agents continuously monitor, evaluate, and improve codebases against explicit and evolving notions of software quality. We present a roadmap organized around five dimensions: the multi-objective optimization problem, quality definition and evaluation, multi-timescale integration of heterogeneous signals, architecture and design pattern, and trust in autonomous refactoring. We further identify integration into continuous delivery pipelines and cost considerations as cross-cutting concerns. For each dimension, we analyze the underlying challenges and pose open research questions. These dimensions define a research agenda for advancing autonomous refactoring from isolated code improvements to system-level quality maintenance.
abstract_cn: 大语言模型在代码重构方面已展现出可观的能力，但现有方法仍局限于方法级任务。在本文中，我们设想将基于 LLM 的重构视为软件维护中的一个持续性组件，而非仅在偶尔的人工重构中才被调用的工具。在这一愿景下，AI agent 会持续监控、评估并改进代码库，使其符合明确且不断演进的软件质量观念。我们提出了一份围绕五个维度组织的路线图：多目标优化问题、质量的定义与评估、异构信号的多时间尺度整合、架构与设计模式，以及对自主重构的信任。我们进一步指出，与持续交付流水线的集成以及成本考量是跨领域的共性议题。针对每个维度，我们分析了其背后的挑战，并提出了开放性的研究问题。这些维度共同界定了一个研究议程，旨在将自主重构从孤立的代码改进推进到系统级的质量维护。
summary_cn: 针对现有 LLM 重构方法局限于方法级任务的问题，提出将 LLM 重构设想为软件维护中的持续性组件而非偶发人工调用的工具，围绕多目标优化、质量定义与评估、多时间尺度信号整合、架构与设计模式、自主重构中的信任五个维度给出研究路线图，并指出与 CI/CD 集成、成本考量是跨维度议题。
comment: The paper was accepted in ICSME 2026 in the Visions and Emerging Results Track
objective_summary: 提出以 LLM 智能体作为软件维护中持续组件的重构愿景，围绕多目标优化、质量定义与评价、多时间尺度信号整合、架构与设计模式、可信性五个维度组织路线图。并将 CI/CD 集成与成本作为横向关切，提出各维度开放研究问题。
evidence_note: ICSME 2026 Visions 轨愿景论文，无实证实验或数据，仅提出研究议程与开放问题。
novelty_note: 将 LLM 重构由方法级工具重新定位为持续自主维护，属方向上的框架性重构而非全新问题。
scope: 仅为路线图，不限定具体语言/系统，五个维度均为开放研究问题。
limitations: 无实证证据，可行性、成本与信任等挑战均留待未来验证。

title: Athena: Vulnerability-Affected Library Identification via Knowledge Graph Completion
title_cn: Athena：基于知识图谱补全的漏洞受影响库识别
abstract: A single vulnerability in a widely used library can cascade through millions of dependent applications, yet more than half of vulnerability database entries contain missing or incorrect affected-library information. Existing automated approaches neglect the relational structure of vulnerability databases, treating identification as an isolated text retrieval problem. In this paper, we propose Athena, the first graph-based approach for vulnerability affected library identification. Athena models vulnerability databases as a knowledge graph and reformulates the identification problem as knowledge graph completion (KGC). It comprises three key modules: a Modeling module that constructs a security knowledge graph integrating CVEs, libraries, CWE weakness types, CPE products, and software ecosystems; a Completion module that applies a modular KGC backbone to predict missing affected libraries for a given CVE via link prediction; and a Re-ranking module that retrieves KGC candidates and rescores them using a fine-tuned LLM augmented with knowledge graph embeddings, jointly leveraging structural and textual information. Our experiments on VulLib demonstrate that Athena significantly outperforms four state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a 32% improvement in Avg. F1 over the best baseline (i.e., VulLibGen). Notably, our KGC backbone with only 110M parameters already surpasses VulLibGen's best configuration at 7B parameters, demonstrating the effectiveness of graph-based modeling; the re-ranking module then provides substantial further gains, consistently outperforming the best baseline across all evaluated LLM backbones.
abstract_cn: 一个被广泛使用的库中的单个漏洞可能级联影响数以百万计的下游依赖应用，然而超过一半的漏洞数据库条目缺失或包含错误的受影响库信息。现有的自动化方法忽视了漏洞数据库的关系结构，将该识别问题当作孤立的文本检索问题来处理。在本文中，我们提出了 Athena，这是首个基于图的漏洞受影响库识别方法。Athena 将漏洞数据库建模为一个知识图谱，并将识别问题重新表述为知识图谱补全（KGC）问题。它包含三个关键模块：一个建模模块，用于构建整合了 CVE、库、CWE 弱点类型、CPE 产品以及软件生态系统的安全知识图谱；一个补全模块，应用模块化的 KGC 主干通过链接预测为给定 CVE 预测缺失的受影响库；以及一个重排模块，该模块检索 KGC 候选结果，并使用一个结合了知识图谱嵌入的微调 LLM 对其重新打分，联合利用结构信息和文本信息。我们在 VulLib 上的实验表明，Athena 显著优于四个最先进的基线方法，相较最佳基线（即 VulLibGen）在 Avg. F1 上提升了 32%。值得注意的是，我们仅有 1.1 亿参数的 KGC 主干就已经超过了 VulLibGen 70 亿参数的最佳配置，证明了基于图建模的有效性；而重排模块进一步带来了显著的额外提升，在所有评估的 LLM 主干上都持续优于最佳基线。
summary_cn: 将漏洞数据库建模为知识图谱，把「受影响库识别」重构为知识图谱补全（KGC）问题，提出 Athena 框架（建模、补全、重排三模块），在 VulLib 上比最优基线 VulLibGen 的 Avg. F1 提升 32%，且仅 1.1 亿参数的 KGC 主干就已超过 VulLibGen 70 亿参数的最佳配置。
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference)
objective_summary: 提出 Athena，将漏洞库建模为知识图谱并把受影响库识别形式化为 KGC，再用融合图嵌入的微调 LLM 重排候选。在 VulLib 上比最佳基线 VulLibGen 的 Avg. F1 提升 32%，且 110M 参数 KGC 骨干已超过 7B 的 VulLibGen 最佳配置。
evidence_note: 在 VulLib 上对比四个 SOTA 基线，报 Avg. F1 提升 32% 并做多 LLM 骨干消融，未见统计检验。
novelty_note: 首个将受影响库识别形式化为知识图谱补全并结合图嵌入重排的方法，视角较新。
scope: 结论限于 VulLib 数据集与所选 KGC 骨干及若干 LLM 重排器。
limitations: 仅在单一数据集上评估，跨生态与新漏洞时效泛化未验证。

title: Smart Contracts Claimed Vulnerable by the CVE Database, with Labels and Source Locations
title_cn: CVE数据库中声称存在漏洞的智能合约:标签与源码位置
abstract: The Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) database catalogs vulnerability claims in hard- and software, among them those pertaining to blockchain programs a.k.a. smart contracts. We present CVE-Smart-Contracts, a curated dataset of CVE records up to July 2026 referring to Ethereum smart contracts. The dataset contains the vulnerable artifacts (source code and runtime bytecode), labels according to three taxonomies, and function-level locations. The retrieval of CVE records, collection of additional evidence, validation of the correspondence between records and artifacts, label assignment, and vulnerability localization are automated, leaving 15% to manual analysis. The dataset does not validate the original vulnerability claims, but marks a few records obviously wrong as `refuted'. For the sake of reproducibility, all external inputs are retained, so that rerunning the pipelines results in the same outputs. The dataset comprises 491 records linked to deployed contracts, 26 referring to projects (mostly libraries), 45 without validated artifacts, and six records with refuted claims. The dataset supports empirical security research, in particular the evaluation of code analysis and repair techniques.
abstract_cn: CVE(Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures,通用漏洞披露)数据库收录了硬件和软件中的漏洞声称,其中也包括与区块链程序(即智能合约)相关的记录。我们提出了CVE-Smart-Contracts,一个经过整理的数据集,收录截至2026年7月、涉及以太坊智能合约的CVE记录。该数据集包含存在漏洞的工件(源代码和运行时字节码)、依据三套分类体系给出的标签,以及函数级别的位置信息。CVE记录的检索、附加证据的收集、记录与工件对应关系的验证、标签分配以及漏洞定位均已实现自动化,仅有15%需要人工分析。该数据集本身并不验证原始的漏洞声称,但会将少数明显错误的记录标记为”refuted”(已证伪)。为保证可复现性,所有外部输入均予以保留,使得重新运行整个流水线可以得到相同的输出。该数据集共包含491条与已部署合约相关的记录、26条涉及项目(主要是库)的记录、45条未经验证工件的记录,以及6条被证伪的记录。该数据集可支持实证安全研究,尤其是代码分析与修复技术的评估。
summary_cn: 作者构建了CVE-Smart-Contracts数据集,收录截至2026年7月、涉及以太坊智能合约的CVE记录,附带漏洞源码/字节码、三套分类体系下的标签及函数级定位,整个流水线85%自动化完成,最终包含491条已部署合约记录、26条项目级记录、45条无验证工件记录及6条被证伪的记录。
objective_summary: 发布 CVE-Smart-Contracts 数据集，收录截至 2026 年 7 月与以太坊智能合约相关的 CVE 记录、源码/字节码、三种分类标签与函数级定位。共 491 条链接部署合约、26 条项目、45 条无验证 artifact、6 条被反驳，管线 15% 需人工。
evidence_note: 给出数量明细（491/26/45/6）与三分类标签、函数级定位，管线可复现，但不做方法性能实验。
novelty_note: 在已有 CVE 与智能合约漏洞数据集上补充自动化管线、三类标签与函数级定位，是已有方向上的实质扩展。
scope: 限于以太坊智能合约、截至 2026 年 7 月的 CVE 记录，标签依三种既有分类学。
limitations: 作者声明不验证原始漏洞声明真伪，15% 需人工，可能残留错误。

title: Hints Help But Do They Teach? Evaluating Skills Transfer in Code Generation
title_cn: 提示有帮助，但它们真的在教吗？评估代码生成中的技能迁移
abstract: When a hint turns a failing generated program into a passing one, does it provide missing information or merely steer the model toward a solution it could already produce? We test these hypotheses on HumanEval+ and MBPP+ using executable evaluation. For Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, adaptive relevant hints rescue 36 of 79 selected failures; an unrelated hint rescues 19, while eight unhinted samples solve 46 and recover 31 of the 36 relevant-hint rescues. Phi-3.5-mini shows the same pattern: relevant hints rescue 42 of 101 failures, an unrelated hint rescues 17, and unhinted sampling solves 57, including 36 of the 42 relevant-hint rescues. Because the hint conditions use different attempt budgets, these comparisons do not isolate a purely semantic effect. Mechanistic tests on Qwen identify a stable activation direction shared by relevant and unrelated hints. Persistently adding this direction yields 14 rescues and 18 regressions, with no detectable net accuracy gain; learned low-rank interventions have a positive but imprecise estimated effect. Full textual specifications solve 22 of 24 context-defined problems, versus 5-11 for tested virtual-KV prefixes. Post-generation hidden-state probes transfer across benchmarks, with pooled AUROC 0.806 and 0.780, but their top-one selection advantage over token confidence is statistically unresolved. Overall, relevant hints can rescue failures, but most rescued solutions are already reachable through ordinary sampling, and the internal interventions tested here do not establish task-general capability transfer.
abstract_cn: 当一个提示把一个生成失败的程序变成通过的程序时，它究竟是提供了缺失的信息，还是仅仅把模型引向了一个它本来就能产生的解？我们在 HumanEval+ 和 MBPP+ 上使用可执行评估检验了这两种假设。对于 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，自适应的相关提示在 79 个选定失败案例中挽救了 36 个；一个不相关的提示挽救了 19 个，而 8 次无提示采样就解决了 46 个，其中包含了 36 个相关提示挽救案例中的 31 个。由于提示条件下的尝试预算不同，这些比较无法单独隔离出纯语义效应。对 Qwen 的机制层面测试识别出一个被相关提示和无关提示共享的稳定激活方向。持续添加该方向带来了 14 次挽救和 18 次退化，净准确率没有可检测的提升；学习到的低秩干预有正向但不精确的估计效应。完整的文本规约解决了 24 个语境定义问题中的 22 个，相比之下测试性的虚拟 KV 前缀只解决了 5-11 个。生成后的隐藏状态探测在多个基准间可迁移，汇总 AUROC 分别为 0.806 和 0.780，但其相对 token 置信度的 top-1 选择优势在统计上尚未确立。总体而言，相关提示确实能够挽救失败案例，但大多数被挽救的解已经可以通过普通采样触及，而本文测试的内部干预并未确立任务通用的能力迁移。
summary_cn: 在 HumanEval+ 和 MBPP+ 上用可执行评估检验提示（hint）是否真正提供了缺失信息：对 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，相关提示挽救 79 个选定失败中的 36 个，但无提示采样已能解决其中 46 个（涵盖 36 个被挽救案例中的 31 个）；机制分析发现相关与无关提示共享同一激活方向，持续添加该方向带来 14 次挽救和 18 次退化，净准确率无明显提升，表明大多数被挽救的解在普通采样下本就可达。
objective_summary: 在 HumanEval+ 与 MBPP+ 上比较相关 hint、无关 hint 与无 hint 采样对代码生成的救援效果，并做机制性分析。Qwen2.5-3B 相关 hint 救援 36/79 例，但 8 次无 hint 采样解出 46 例并重叠 31 例；持续加激活方向 14 救 18 退，未见净收益。
evidence_note: 两模型、两基准、多条件比较并附机制探针（激活方向、低秩干预、AUROC 0.806/0.780），但预算不匹配。
novelty_note: 用可执行评测把 hint 的语义贡献与采样预算解耦，指出救援多来自可采样解，属反直觉发现。
scope: 结论限于 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct、Phi-3.5-mini 两模型与 HumanEval+/MBPP+ 基准。
limitations: 作者自陈 hint 条件与无 hint 条件预算不匹配，无法完全隔离语义效应，机制干预估计不精。

title: Reliable LLM-Generated Programs for High-Energy Physics Experiments through Graph-Grounded Software Knowledge
title_cn: 通过图结构化软件知识为高能物理实验生成可靠的 LLM 程序
abstract: Extracting physics information from modern particle-physics experiments requires multistage analyses implemented on top of large and highly interconnected software ecosystems. General-purpose large language models (LLMs) often produce unreliable programs for such tasks because a user request alone rarely specifies the required APIs, dependencies, and usage conventions. We organize these software relations before generation and retrieve task-relevant knowledge at inference time. Using the open-source ROOT framework as a representative and reproducible testbed, we evaluate a complete grounding system that combines hybrid retrieval over a heterogeneous software knowledge graph, skill-selected workflow examples, and execution-guided repair. On a benchmark of 275 ROOT tasks, grounding improves first-attempt execution from 58.5% to 76.0% under Claude Code orchestration and from 51.3% to 64.0% under standalone orchestration. Final success increases from 90.5% to 96.0% and from 78.9% to 90.9%, respectively, while the average generation cost per successful task increases by only 1.3% and 3.2%. The gains persist under a strong coding agent, indicating that explicit software knowledge remains valuable even when agentic scaffolding is already in place. Because the method captures software relations common to large codebases rather than facts specific to ROOT or a particular model, it should transfer to other experiment frameworks and proprietary software, especially where documentation is sparse or internal dependencies are complex.
abstract_cn: 从现代粒子物理实验中提取物理信息，需要在庞大且高度互联的软件生态系统之上实现多阶段分析。通用大语言模型（LLM）在此类任务中常常生成不可靠的程序，因为仅凭用户请求很少能明确所需的 API、依赖关系和使用惯例。我们在生成之前先对这些软件关系进行组织，并在推理时检索与任务相关的知识。我们以开源的 ROOT 框架作为具有代表性且可复现的测试平台，评估了一套完整的接地系统，该系统结合了对异构软件知识图的混合检索、经技能筛选的工作流示例，以及执行引导的修复。在一个包含 275 个 ROOT 任务的基准上，在 Claude Code 编排下，接地使首次尝试执行成功率从 58.5% 提升到 76.0%，在独立编排下从 51.3% 提升到 64.0%。最终成功率分别从 90.5% 提升到 96.0%，以及从 78.9% 提升到 90.9%，而每个成功任务的平均生成成本仅分别增加 1.3% 和 3.2%。这些收益在强大的编码 agent 之上依然存在，说明即便已经具备 agentic 脚手架，显式的软件知识仍然有价值。由于该方法捕捉的是大型代码库共有的软件关系，而非特定于 ROOT 或某个模型的事实，它应当能够迁移到其他实验框架和专有软件，尤其是在文档稀少或内部依赖关系复杂的场景中。
summary_cn: 针对通用 LLM 在高能物理软件生态（如 ROOT 框架）中因缺乏 API/依赖/用法约定信息而生成不可靠程序的问题，提出结合异构软件知识图混合检索、技能选择的工作流示例和执行引导修复的接地系统；在 275 个 ROOT 任务上，Claude Code 编排下首次尝试执行成功率从 58.5% 提升到 76.0%，最终成功率从 90.5% 提升到 96.0%，而单个成功任务的平均生成成本仅增加 1.3%。
comment: 24 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables
objective_summary: 面向高能物理 ROOT 框架构建异构软件知识图谱并结合混合检索、技能选择与执行反馈修复。在 275 个 ROOT 任务上，Claude Code 编排下首次执行成功率从 58.5% 升至 76.0%，最终成功率从 90.5% 升至 96.0%，成本仅增 1.3%-3.2%。
evidence_note: 275 个 ROOT 任务、两种编排设置、首/末次成功率与成本对比，有 grounded vs 非 grounded 对照。
novelty_note: 将软件知识图谱 grounding 与执行反馈修复应用于科学计算框架代码生成，方向新颖。
scope: 结论限于 ROOT 框架 275 任务及 Claude Code 与独立编排两种设置，跨框架效果为推测。
limitations: 仅在 ROOT 单一框架上评估，跨框架/私有代码的迁移性未验证。

title: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models to Classify Pull Request-Issue Alignments: Going Beyond Prompting
title_cn: 微调大语言模型以分类 Pull Request 与 Issue 的对齐关系：超越提示工程
abstract: Context: Accurate alignment between pull requests (PRs) and corresponding issues is crucial for efficient software development and maintaining code quality, as misalignments can reduce traceability, hinder defect localization, and decrease maintainability. Objective: This study aims to improve automated PR-issue alignment classification by leveraging fine-tuned large language models (LLMs) across multiple alignment categories, and conducts interpretability analysis to investigate the effects of PR-issue fields on the predictions of fine-tuned LLMs. Method: Our methodology consists of dataset preparation, LLM fine-tuning, and interpretability analysis. We first extended an existing dataset and applied data augmentation to address class imbalance. GPT-4o was then fine-tuned via instruction tuning, and open-source LLMs including CodeLlama-7B, CodeQwen1.5-7B, StableCode-3B, CodeGemma-7B, and Deepseek-Coder-6.7B were fine-tuned using classification-specific heads. Interpretability analysis using Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) was conducted to examine the influence of PR-issue fields on predictions for the best-performing open-source LLM. Results: Fine-tuned LLMs outperformed baseline models, achieving average improvements of 6.15% in accuracy and F1-micro, 14.69% in F1-macro, and 6.15% in recall. CodeLlama-7B emerged as the best-performing fine-tuned LLM overall, while interpretability analysis revealed that code diffs together with issue body and PR body contents exert the greatest influence on predictions. Conclusions: Fine-tuning substantially enhances PR-issue alignment classification, improving both accuracy and efficiency. Interpretability analysis provides actionable insights into the dataset features driving alignment decisions, deepening understanding of how LLMs reason over software artifacts.
abstract_cn: 背景：pull request（PR）与对应 issue 之间的准确对齐对高效的软件开发以及维持代码质量至关重要，因为对齐失误会降低可追溯性、阻碍缺陷定位并降低可维护性。目标：本研究旨在通过在多个对齐类别上利用微调后的大语言模型（LLM）来改进自动化的 PR-issue 对齐分类，并进行可解释性分析，以考察 PR-issue 各字段对微调 LLM 预测结果的影响。方法：我们的方法包括数据集准备、LLM 微调和可解释性分析三部分。我们首先扩展了一个已有数据集，并应用数据增强来解决类别不平衡问题。随后通过指令微调对 GPT-4o 进行了微调，并使用带有分类专用头的方式对开源 LLM（包括 CodeLlama-7B、CodeQwen1.5-7B、StableCode-3B、CodeGemma-7B 和 Deepseek-Coder-6.7B）进行了微调。我们对表现最好的开源 LLM 使用 Shapley 加性解释（SHAP）进行了可解释性分析，以考察 PR-issue 各字段对预测的影响。结果：微调后的 LLM 优于基线模型，在准确率和 F1-micro 上平均提升 6.15%，在 F1-macro 上提升 14.69%，在召回率上提升 6.15%。CodeLlama-7B 是综合表现最好的微调 LLM，而可解释性分析显示，代码 diff 连同 issue 正文和 PR 正文内容对预测的影响最大。结论：微调显著提升了 PR-issue 对齐分类的效果，同时提高了准确率和效率。可解释性分析为驱动对齐决策的数据集特征提供了可操作的见解，加深了人们对 LLM 如何在软件制品上进行推理的理解。
summary_cn: 为提升 PR 与 issue 对齐关系的自动分类，对 GPT-4o 及多个开源 LLM（CodeLlama-7B 等）进行微调，并用 SHAP 做可解释性分析；微调模型在准确率与 F1-micro 上平均提升 6.15%，F1-macro 提升 14.69%，其中 CodeLlama-7B 综合表现最佳，代码 diff、issue 正文与 PR 正文对预测影响最大。
comment: 31 pages, 12 figures. Submitted to Springer Empirical Software Engineering (EMSE), Special Issue on Software Analysis, Evolution, and Reengineering (SANER 2025)
objective_summary: 扩展并数据增强 PR-Issue 对齐数据集，用指令微调 GPT-4o 与分类头微调 CodeLlama-7B 等五个开源 LLM，并用 SHAP 做可解释性分析。相对基线平均 accuracy 与 F1-micro 提升 6.15%、F1-macro 提升 14.69%，CodeLlama-7B 表现最佳。
evidence_note: 覆盖 GPT-4o 与 5 个开源 LLM、多分类指标并附 SHAP 分析，规模较全，但未提统计检验。
novelty_note: 在已有 PR-Issue 对齐任务上做微调对比与可解释性分析，属已有方向上的实质扩展。
scope: 结论限于扩展后的 PR-Issue 对齐分类数据集及所选 6 个 LLM（3B-7B 与 GPT-4o）。
limitations: 结论依赖单一数据集与所选 LLM 家族，SHAP 解释只在最佳开源 LLM 上进行。

title: Does Fault Localization Beat a Fresh Attempt? A Placebo-Controlled Study of Test-Guided Code Repair
title_cn: 故障定位真的比重新尝试更好吗？测试引导代码修复的安慰剂对照研究
abstract: Fault localization can focus a code model's repair on the statements a failing test implicates, but a targeted edit may succeed merely because it is small, and a second model call may succeed without using the failure at all. We separate these explanations with three arms applied to the same failed candidate: blind whole-solution resampling, spectrum-based localization followed by suspect-span infilling, and same-length infilling at a disjoint random code span. Across three frozen 26-32B models, three benchmarks and 488 failing candidates, plus a separately declared 24B fourth model from a third family, three results follow. First, localization is rarely available: only 9.0% of failing candidates expose a failing public test with a usable spectrum. Second, among the 177 candidates localizable from a strong suite, localized infilling loses decisively to blind resampling at a matched attempt count (3:40, p = 3.0 x 10^-9), opposite to our hypothesis; the loss replicates in a third family at -11.3 points (95% CI [-16.6, -6.8]), and widening the edit does not rescue it. Third, against the random-span placebo localized infilling leads pooled (11:1, Holm-adjusted p = .019), but that lead resolves in no individual model under the analysis our shipped plan designates primary (best Holm p = .087), so we report the location effect as suggestive rather than established. Re-pricing attempts as tokens narrows but does not overturn this: a span attempt spends 21.7 generated tokens against 371.1, yet 16 localized attempts reach 6.8% while one blind attempt already reaches 10.1%. Infilling reproduces the removed span verbatim in 48.9% of attempts, which is why more budget does not help. We restrict every localization conclusion to the 24-32B models tested.
abstract_cn: 故障定位可以将代码模型的修复聚焦到失败测试所指涉的语句上，但一次有针对性的编辑可能仅仅因为改动小而成功，而第二次模型调用也可能在完全不利用失败信息的情况下成功。我们通过对同一个失败候选施加三种处理臂来区分这些解释：盲目的整段方案重采样、基于谱信息定位后进行可疑片段填充，以及在一个不相交的随机代码片段上进行等长填充。在三个冻结的 26-32B 模型、三个基准和 488 个失败候选上，外加一个单独声明的、来自第三个模型家族的 24B 第四模型，我们得到三个结果。第一，故障定位很少可用：只有 9.0% 的失败候选暴露出一个具有可用谱信息的失败公共测试。第二，在可从强测试套件中定位的 177 个候选中，在匹配相同尝试次数的情况下，定位式填充明显输给盲目重采样（3:40，p = 3.0 x 10^-9），这与我们的假设相反；这一劣势在第三个模型家族中也重现，差距为 -11.3 个百分点（95% 置信区间 [-16.6, -6.8]），且扩大编辑范围也无法挽救这一结果。第三，相对于随机片段安慰剂对照组，定位式填充在合并结果上占优（11:1，Holm 校正后 p = .019），但在我们预先登记的分析方案所指定的主要分析下，这一优势在任何单个模型中都未能成立（最好的 Holm p = .087），因此我们将定位效应报告为「提示性而非确立性」。将尝试次数按 token 重新计价可以缩小但无法推翻这一结论：一次片段级尝试消耗 21.7 个生成 token，相对 371.1 个而言很少，但 16 次定位式尝试只达到 6.8% 的成功率，而仅仅一次盲目尝试就已经达到 10.1%。填充在 48.9% 的尝试中会逐字复现被移除的片段，这正是增加预算无济于事的原因。我们将所有关于定位的结论限定在所测试的 24-32B 模型范围内。
summary_cn: 通过盲重采样、基于故障定位的可疑片段填充、以及等长随机片段填充（安慰剂对照）三臂实验，在 3 个 26-32B 模型、3 个基准和 488 个失败候选上发现：只有 9.0% 的失败候选可用故障定位，且在可定位的 177 个候选中，定位式填充在相同尝试次数下反而显著输给盲重采样（3:40，p=3.0×10^-9），仅相对随机片段安慰剂组呈现「提示性但未确立」的优势。
objective_summary: 用三臂对照（盲重采样、SBFL 引导 infilling、同长随机跨度 infilling）比较测试引导修复的效果，覆盖 3 个 26-32B 模型、3 个基准和 488 个失败候选并另设 24B 第四模型。发现仅 9.0% 失败候选可用 SBFL，177 例中定位式 infilling 以 3:40 负于盲重采样（p=3.0×10^-9）。
evidence_note: 四个 24-32B 模型、三基准、488 个失败候选，有对照臂、置信区间与 Holm 校正 p 值，规模与统计规范完整。
novelty_note: 以安慰剂对照重新审视故障定位对 LLM 修复的作用，得出定位不敌盲重采样的反预期结论，视角新。
scope: 结论限于 24-32B 代码模型、三个基准与 SBFL + 同长 infilling 设置，仅 9% 候选有可用 spectrum。
limitations: 仅覆盖 24-32B 模型规模，Infilling 有 48.9% 逐字复现原跨度问题，位置效应仅为 suggestive。

title: Probabilistic Model Checking of Autoregressive Neural Sequence Models
title_cn: 自回归神经序列模型的概率模型检验
abstract: Test-set accuracy is silent on two issues that matter when deploying autoregressive neural sequence models: how much probability mass the system under test (SUT) places on constraint-violating alternatives that are reachable under sampling and what fraction of the input population satisfies a domain requirement. We answer both with probabilistic model checking. The pipeline extracts a discrete-time Markov chain (DTMC) from the SUT's token-by-token generation, verifies formal PCTL specifications with the PRISM model checker, and aggregates the per-input verdicts into a coverage curve over the input space. A soundness theorem establishes the DTMC as an under-approximation, so every verdict yields a certified interval on the SUT's true reachability probability. The coverage built from those verdicts is, therefore, conservative by construction. A counterexample-guided abstraction refinement (CEGAR) loop adaptively tightens the interval, and a maximum-likelihood algorithm extracts the most probable falsifying trace. Two case studies exercise the pipeline. On a GPT-2 computer-aided process-planning (CAPP) model with 100% test accuracy, the pipeline quantifies the probability mass greedy decoding hides, but that is reachable with sampling; and identifies the smallest training fraction at which an ordering requirement holds population-wide, neither of which test accuracy can report. We then verify the SMILES molecular generator with a 50x larger vocabulary. The only change is an external chemical-validity oracle, and the pipeline identifies the gap between structural completeness and chemical validity.
abstract_cn: 测试集准确率无法回答两个在部署自回归神经序列模型时至关重要的问题：被测系统（SUT）在采样下可达的、违反约束的备选结果上到底放置了多少概率质量，以及输入总体中有多大比例满足某项领域要求。我们用概率模型检验来回答这两个问题。该流水线从 SUT 逐 token 的生成过程中抽取一个离散时间马尔可夫链（DTMC），用 PRISM 模型检验器验证形式化的 PCTL 规约，并将逐输入的验证结果聚合成输入空间上的覆盖率曲线。一个可靠性定理确立了该 DTMC 是一种欠近似，因此每个验证结果都会给出关于 SUT 真实可达概率的一个经过认证的区间。因此，由这些验证结果构建出的覆盖率在构造上是保守的。一个反例引导的抽象精化（CEGAR）循环会自适应地收紧该区间，并配合一个最大似然算法提取最可能的证伪轨迹。两个案例研究检验了该流水线。在一个测试准确率达到 100% 的 GPT-2 计算机辅助工艺规划（CAPP）模型上，该流水线量化了贪心解码所掩盖、但在采样下可达的概率质量；并识别出使某个排序要求在整体输入群体上成立所需的最小训练数据比例——这些都是测试准确率无法报告的。随后我们验证了词表规模大 50 倍的 SMILES 分子生成器，唯一的变化是引入了一个外部的化学有效性 oracle，该流水线由此识别出结构完整性与化学有效性之间的差距。
summary_cn: 提出将自回归 LLM 的逐 token 生成过程抽取为离散时间马尔可夫链（DTMC）并用 PRISM 进行 PCTL 规约验证的流水线，给出可靠的欠近似区间及 CEGAR 精化循环；在 GPT-2 的 CAPP 模型（测试准确率 100%）和一个词表大 50 倍的 SMILES 分子生成器上，揭示了测试准确率无法反映的采样风险与化学有效性缺口。
comment: 38th International Conference on Testing Software and Systems (IFIP ICTSS 2026)
objective_summary: 从自回归序列模型逐 token 生成中抽取 DTMC，用 PRISM 验证 PCTL 规范并以 CEGAR 收紧区间，聚合每输入判定为覆盖曲线。在 GPT-2 CAPP 模型与词表大 50 倍的 SMILES 分子生成器上做了两个案例研究。
evidence_note: 两个案例（CAPP GPT-2、SMILES 生成器），有 soundness 定理与 CEGAR，但仅两案例、缺 baseline 对比与统计检验。
novelty_note: 将概率模型检验与 CEGAR 引入自回归序列模型的可达性验证并给出保守覆盖曲线，方向上较新。
scope: 结论限于可抽取为 DTMC 的自回归 token 生成模型（GPT-2 CAPP、SMILES），需外部有效性 oracle。
limitations: DTMC 仅为下近似，验证成本随词表与深度增长，仅两个案例难以泛化。

title: Replacing Training with Memory: Listwise Selection for Text-to-SQL
title_cn: 以记忆替代训练：Text-to-SQL 的 Listwise 选择方法
abstract: Modern Text-to-SQL systems often follow generate-execute-select pipelines, generating multiple candidate queries then selecting the best one. Listwise selection, by jointly comparing multiple candidates, has been widely adopted, but fine-tuning listwise selectors is costly. We thus propose a fine-tuning-free listwise selector. We replace two major fine-tuning objectives with inference-time strategies: (1) learning selection criteria as ordering and (2) mitigating positional bias. First, we build reusable structured memories instead of learning selection behavior as model parameters. Given a question, MaP-SQL retrieves memories distilled from training data that encode how natural language maps to schema elements, SQL operations, and expected outputs. These memories serve as explicit decision criteria for evaluating candidates in a listwise manner. Second, to mitigate ordering bias of listwise selectors, we aggregate rankings across multiple input permutations, with inference cost optimized by execution results and pointwise scoring. Our approach improves selection accuracy while maintaining efficiency and compatibility with existing large language models. Across Text-to-SQL benchmarks, it produces more stable selection without fine-tuning and fewer unnecessary comparisons than existing methods. On BIRD-dev, it outperforms the previous state-of-the-art selector-based method R^3-SQL by 2.02 execution accuracy points on average using the same candidate sets, with 2.92x fewer tokens.
abstract_cn: 现代 Text-to-SQL 系统通常遵循「生成—执行—选择」的流水线，先生成多个候选查询，再从中选出最佳结果。通过对多个候选进行联合比较的 listwise 选择方法已被广泛采用，但对 listwise 选择器进行微调的成本很高。因此，我们提出了一种无需微调的 listwise 选择器。我们用推理时的策略替代了两个主要的微调目标：(1) 将选择准则作为排序来学习；(2) 缓解位置偏差。首先，我们不再将选择行为作为模型参数来学习，而是构建可复用的结构化记忆。给定一个问题，MaP-SQL 检索从训练数据中提炼出的记忆，这些记忆编码了自然语言如何映射到 schema 元素、SQL 操作和预期输出。这些记忆作为显式的决策准则，用于以 listwise 方式评估候选结果。其次，为缓解 listwise 选择器的排序偏差，我们在多种输入排列上聚合排名，并通过执行结果和 pointwise 打分来优化推理成本。我们的方法在保持效率并兼容现有大语言模型的同时，提升了选择准确率。在多个 Text-to-SQL 基准上，该方法相比现有方法产生了更稳定的选择结果，且不必要的比较更少。在 BIRD-dev 上，使用相同的候选集，该方法比此前最先进的基于选择器的方法 R^3-SQL 的执行准确率平均高出 2.02 个百分点，同时 token 消耗减少了 2.92 倍。
summary_cn: 提出无需微调的 listwise 候选 SQL 选择器 MaP-SQL，用可复用的结构化记忆替代训练目标，并通过多重排列聚合缓解位置偏差；在 BIRD-dev 上以相同候选集超过此前最优的 R^3-SQL，执行准确率平均高 2.02 个点，且 token 消耗减少 2.92 倍。
comment: Accepted by Findings of EMNLP 2026
objective_summary: 提出免微调的列表式选择器 MaP-SQL，用结构化记忆替代微调目标并通过多排列聚合缓解位置偏差。在 BIRD-dev 上以相同候选集比 R^3-SQL 平均高 2.02 执行准确率点，token 消耗少 2.92 倍。
evidence_note: 在 Text-to-SQL 基准上与 R^3-SQL 等对比，报告执行准确率与 token 数，未提及统计检验或多模型消融规模。
novelty_note: 以检索式结构化记忆替代微调、并用排列聚合处理列表式选择的位置偏差，是列表式选择方向上的实质改进。
scope: 结论限于 Text-to-SQL 场景（BIRD-dev 等），针对已有候选集的选择器，依赖检索到的映射记忆。
limitations: 依赖训练数据蒸馏出的记忆质量；多排列聚合带来推理开销，摘要未给出显著性检验。

title: Towards a Reliable and Practical Eval Pipeline
title_cn: 迈向可靠且实用的Eval流水线
abstract: LLM-based software systems increasingly require effective "evals" as quality gates in the development lifecycle. However, existing work typically addresses individual aspects of eval reliability rather than the full set of practical requirements. We present an end-to-end eval pipeline that combines eval checklist creation, with learned aggregation for checklist responses, to improve agreement across LLM judges and accuracy against human judgments. The framework additionally pro- vides self-consistency, explanations, and prediction uncertainty, and we empirically demonstrate its effectiveness.
abstract_cn: 基于LLM的软件系统正日益需要有效的”eval”作为开发生命周期中的质量关卡。然而,现有工作通常只针对eval可靠性的某个单独方面,而未能覆盖全部实际需求。我们提出了一套端到端的eval流水线,将eval检查清单(checklist)的创建与针对检查清单响应的学习式聚合方法结合起来,以提升多个LLM评判者之间的一致性,并提高相对于人工判断的准确率。该框架还提供了自一致性、可解释性以及预测不确定性等功能,我们通过实验证明了其有效性。
summary_cn: 作者提出一套端到端eval流水线,将eval检查清单(checklist)构建与检查清单响应的学习式聚合相结合,以提升多个LLM评判者之间的一致性以及与人工判断的准确率,并附加自一致性、可解释性与预测不确定性等能力。
objective_summary: 提出端到端的 LLM eval 流水线，将评测清单生成与对清单响应的学习式聚合结合，以提升 LLM 裁判间一致性及与人类判断的准确性，并提供自一致性、解释与预测不确定性。摘要称已实证展示其有效性。
evidence_note: 摘要仅笼统称实证展示有效性，未给出数据规模、基线或统计检验等具体证据。
novelty_note: 在既有 LLM-as-judge 与清单式评测方向上组合学习式聚合与不确定性，属实质改进。
scope: 限于 LLM 系统开发中的质量门 eval 场景，具体任务与数据在摘要未明示。
limitations: 摘要缺乏定量结果、基线与评测协议细节，难以判断改进幅度与适用范围。

title: Automating Static Code Analysis Through CI/CD Pipeline Integration
title_cn: 通过 CI/CD 流水线集成实现静态代码分析的自动化
abstract: In the contemporary landscape of software devel-opment, securing sensitive data is paramount to safeguarding organizational reputation, preventing financial losses, and pro-tecting individuals from identity theft. This paper addresses the pervasive challenge of identifying and rectifying security vulnerabilities early in the development process, emphasizing the role of Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools. While SAST tools play a crucial role in detecting vulnerabilities, widespread adoption has been hindered by usability issues, including high false positive rates and a lack of native pipeline support. This paper proposes a novel, generalized, and automated process for aggregating SAST tool outputs and integrating them into developers' familiar issue-tracking software. The process streamlines the identification and communication of security vulnerabilities during the development lifecycle, facilitating more efficient remediation efforts. We demonstrate the successful implementation of the proposed process with the SonarQube SAST tool in a GitLab-based development environment. Developers were positive about the structured implementation, real-time feedback, and proactive vulnerability management. However, despite some challenges such as a potential learning curve and tradeoffs between secure coding and workflow disruption, the overall positive impact on security awareness and responsiveness suggests that the proposed process holds promise in enhancing the security posture of software development practices
abstract_cn: 在当代软件开发的格局中，保护敏感数据对于维护组织声誉、防止财务损失以及保护个人免受身份盗用而言至关重要。本文针对在开发过程早期识别并修复安全漏洞这一普遍存在的挑战，强调了静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具的作用。虽然 SAST 工具在检测漏洞方面起着关键作用，但其广泛采用一直受到可用性问题的阻碍，包括高误报率以及缺乏原生的流水线支持。本文提出了一个新颖、通用且自动化的流程，用于聚合 SAST 工具的输出，并把它们整合进开发者熟悉的问题跟踪软件之中。该流程简化了开发生命周期中安全漏洞的识别与沟通，有助于开展更高效的修复工作。我们在一个基于 GitLab 的开发环境中，用 SonarQube 这一 SAST 工具演示了所提出流程的成功实现。开发者对结构化的实现方式、实时反馈以及主动的漏洞管理持积极态度。然而，尽管存在一些挑战，例如潜在的学习曲线以及安全编码与工作流打断之间的权衡，其对安全意识与响应能力的总体积极影响表明，所提出的流程有望提升软件开发实践的安全态势。
summary_cn: 提出一套通用流程把 SAST 工具输出聚合后自动写进开发者熟悉的 issue 跟踪系统，在 GitLab + SonarQube 环境中落地；开发者对结构化实现与实时反馈评价正面，但存在学习曲线与打断工作流的权衡。
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, published in 2024 IEEE International Conference on Software Analysis, Evolution and Reengineering - Companion (SANER-C), 12 March 2024
objective_summary: 提出将 SAST 工具输出聚合并集成入开发者常用问题跟踪系统的通用自动化流程，并在 GitLab 环境下以 SonarQube 实施。报告开发者对结构化实施、实时反馈与主动漏洞管理反应积极，但也指出学习曲线与工作流干扰等权衡。
evidence_note: 仅单一 SonarQube+GitLab 案例的定性开发者反馈，无量化对比或规模评估。
novelty_note: SAST 与 CI/CD、Issue 系统集成属常见工程实践，方案组合创新有限。
scope: 限于 SonarQube 工具与 GitLab 流水线的一次实施，反馈来自参与开发者。
limitations: 无控制实验、样本与量化指标缺失，泛化到其他 SAST 工具/平台缺乏证据。

title: Predicting Program Exit Code with LLMs and Programming Language Semantics
title_cn: 用LLM与编程语言语义预测程序退出码
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown proficiency in various software engineering tasks, such as code generation and translation. However, a key limitation in their performance may be their (lack of) understanding of programming-language semantics. Even when explicit semantics are given, it remains unclear whether LLMs apply those rules or lean on priors learned during pre-training instead. We study if LLMs lean on priors or given semantics with a novel task--Program Executability Prediction (PrEx)--that asks models to predict whether a program is semantically valid or invalid (and, if invalid, which formal rule it violates) given the program's syntax and operational semantics. Because PrEx requires both valid and invalid programs, we build a dataset with systematically generated invalid transformations derived from valid programs. We evaluate open-source coding LLMs under two semantic formalisms and two semantic shifts across Human-Written, LLM-Translated, and Fuzzer-Generated program splits. Our findings show that LLMs lean on pre-training priors rather than systematically applying the given rules, performing especially poorly on modified semantics and degrading further as program complexity increases. PrEx is available at https://github.com/EngineeringSoftware/prex.
abstract_cn: 大语言模型(LLM)已在代码生成、代码翻译等多种软件工程任务上展现出能力。然而,其表现的一个关键局限可能在于它们(缺乏)对编程语言语义的理解。即使给出了显式的语义规则,目前仍不清楚LLM是应用了这些规则,还是转而依赖预训练中学到的先验知识。我们通过一个新任务——Program Executability Prediction(PrEx,程序可执行性预测)——研究LLM究竟依赖先验知识还是给定语义:该任务要求模型在给定程序语法和操作语义的情况下,预测该程序在语义上是有效还是无效(若无效,则要指出违反了哪条形式规则)。由于PrEx既需要有效程序也需要无效程序,我们构建了一个数据集,其中的无效变换是从有效程序系统性生成而来的。我们在两种语义形式体系和两种语义变化下,针对Human-Written(人工编写)、LLM-Translated(LLM翻译)和Fuzzer-Generated(模糊测试生成)三种程序划分,评估了开源代码LLM。我们的发现表明,LLM依赖的是预训练先验,而不是系统性地应用给定的规则,在语义被修改的情况下表现尤其差,并且随着程序复杂度的增加而进一步恶化。PrEx已在https://github.com/EngineeringSoftware/prex公开。
summary_cn: 作者提出Program Executability Prediction(PrEx)任务,要求LLM在给定程序语法和操作语义的情况下判断程序是否语义有效(若无效则指出违反了哪条形式规则),发现开源代码LLM主要依赖预训练先验而非系统性地应用给定规则,在语义被修改后表现尤其差,且随程序复杂度上升进一步恶化。
comment: Accepted at LMPL 2026
objective_summary: 提出程序可执行性预测任务 PrEx：给定语法与操作语义，判定程序是否语义合法及违反的形式规则，并系统合成非法变换构建数据集。评估在两种语义形式化、两种语义偏移及人写/LLM 翻译/模糊器生成三类程序上进行，发现开源代码 LLM 主要依赖预训练先验，随程序复杂度上升表现进一步下降。
evidence_note: 双语义形式化、双语义偏移、三类程序来源的系统评测多个开源 LLM，无显式统计检验。
novelty_note: 以形式语义给定为条件的可执行性判定任务此前罕见，构造性合成非法样本设定较新。
scope: 限于开源编码 LLM 在受控操作语义下的可执行性预测，含语义偏移设置。
limitations: 仅评估开源模型，未覆盖闭源前沿模型；语义形式化仅两种。

title: WiseSpec: Requirements-Driven Agents for Code Generation
title_cn: WiseSpec：面向代码生成的需求驱动型 agent
abstract: Code generation aims to automatically generate source code from task requirements and has attracted significant attention with the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs). Despite remarkable progress, LLMs often struggle to generate correct code for complex software engineering tasks because task descriptions are frequently incomplete, ambiguous, or lack critical contextual information. Existing approaches primarily improve the capabilities of coding agents through more sophisticated tools, skills, and workflows, while largely overlooking the quality of the task requirements themselves. To address this limitation, we draw inspiration from software requirements engineering and propose WiseSpec, a novel requirements-driven agent framework for repository-level code generation. WiseSpec automatically constructs structured and information-rich requirements, assesses their quality through execution-based evaluation, and iteratively refines them to better guide code generation. Experimental results show that WiseSpec consistently outperforms all baselines, achieving an average improvement of 13.17% in %Resolved.
abstract_cn: 代码生成旨在根据任务需求自动生成源代码，随着大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展而受到广泛关注。尽管取得了显著进展，LLM 在处理复杂软件工程任务时仍常常难以生成正确的代码，原因在于任务描述往往不完整、含糊或缺乏关键上下文信息。现有方法主要通过更复杂的工具、技能和工作流来提升编码 agent 的能力，却在很大程度上忽视了任务需求本身的质量。为解决这一局限，我们从软件需求工程中获得启发，提出了 WiseSpec，一种面向仓库级代码生成的新型需求驱动型 agent 框架。WiseSpec 自动构建结构化且信息丰富的需求，通过基于执行的评估来衡量其质量，并进行迭代精化以更好地指导代码生成。实验结果表明，WiseSpec 持续优于所有基线方法，在 %Resolved 指标上平均提升 13.17%。
summary_cn: 针对任务描述常常不完整、含糊导致 LLM 代码生成出错的问题，提出需求驱动的 agent 框架 WiseSpec，自动构建结构化需求、通过执行反馈评估需求质量并迭代精化，在仓库级代码生成任务上 %Resolved 平均提升 13.17%。
comment: Accepted by ASE 2026 (SRC)
objective_summary: 提出 WiseSpec，一个面向仓库级代码生成的需求驱动智能体框架：自动构造结构化需求、以执行式评估其质量并迭代精化。实验称在 %Resolved 指标上较所有基线平均提升 13.17%。
evidence_note: 报告了对多基线的平均 13.17% 提升，但为 SRC 短文，数据集/规模/检验细节未在摘要给出。
novelty_note: 将需求工程视角引入代码生成智能体，属既有代理框架方向上的实质改进。
scope: 限于仓库级代码生成任务、%Resolved 指标，模型与基准细节未在摘要披露。
limitations: 作为 ASE 2026 SRC 短文，评估广度与消融深度可能有限，未提及统计检验。

title: Runtime-Independent Persistent Agents: Preserving Identity, Memory, and Code Across Models, Harnesses, and Servers
title_cn: 运行时无关的持久化 Agent：跨模型、Harness 与服务器保持身份、记忆与代码的连续性
abstract: Agent systems are commonly described by the model and harness that currently produce their behavior. That boundary is useful for one execution but underspecifies a long-lived agent that may change models, orchestration harnesses, interaction sessions, and host servers while retaining one identity, memory, and executable code lineage. We present a runtime-independent architecture for persistent agents. A continuity-bearing substrate $P_t=(I_t,M_t,B_t)$ contains an architectural identity representation, private durable memory, and a versioned software body. A replaceable deployment binding comprises an execution substrate $E_t=(R_t,H_t,D_t)$, which supplies a reasoner, harness, and host, and a set of interaction surfaces $S_t$, such as chat, API, or user interface bindings. A deployed execution is $A_t=P_t\triangleright(E_t,S_t)$; changing either replaceable layer is migration, not agent creation, when an authorized protocol preserves attributable lineage and transfers continuation authority within a governed deployment boundary. We define six continuity invariants and a quiesce--checkpoint--validate--bind--rehydrate--resume protocol. Enoch realizes the design as a reusable body plus private installed identity, memory, workflow state, and continuation authority, with infrastructure dependencies behind versioned provider contracts. A clean-room run of the frozen public commit passes 833 core tests and 92 provider and library tests executed separately from the core suite; deployments have exercised reasoner-version, interaction-surface, and host-machine substitutions while retaining continuity-bearing state. This evidence supports mechanical substitutability and authorized system continuity, not behavioral invariance or exhaustive pairwise evaluation. The downstream measurement question is whether an authorized continuation still recalls, composes, and enacts its identity.
abstract_cn: agent 系统通常是由当前产生其行为的模型和 harness 来描述的。这一边界对单次执行而言是有用的，但对于一个可能在保持同一身份、记忆和可执行代码谱系的同时，更换模型、编排 harness、交互会话和宿主服务器的长期存在的 agent 而言，这种描述是不充分的。我们提出一种运行时无关的持久化 agent 架构。一个承载连续性的基底 $P_t=(I_t,M_t,B_t)$ 包含一个架构性的身份表征、私有持久记忆和一个带版本管理的软件体。一个可替换的部署绑定包含一个执行基底 $E_t=(R_t,H_t,D_t)$（提供推理器、harness 和宿主）以及一组交互界面 $S_t$，例如聊天、API 或用户界面绑定。一次部署执行为 $A_t=P_t\triangleright(E_t,S_t)$；当一个经授权的协议保留了可归属的谱系、并在受治理的部署边界内转移了延续权限时，替换任一可替换层就是一次迁移，而非创建新的 agent。我们定义了六条连续性不变量，以及一套 quiesce（静默）-checkpoint（检查点）-validate（验证）-bind（绑定）-rehydrate（重建）-resume（恢复）协议。Enoch 将该设计实现为一个可复用的软件体，加上私有的已安装身份、记忆、工作流状态和延续权限，其基础设施依赖被置于带版本管理的供应商契约之后。对该冻结公开提交的一次干净环境运行通过了 833 项核心测试，以及与核心测试套件分开执行的 92 项供应商与库测试；已有的部署实践了推理器版本、交互界面和宿主机器的替换，同时保留了承载连续性的状态。这些证据支持机械可替换性和经授权的系统连续性，但不支持行为不变性或穷尽式的两两评估。下游的测量问题在于：一次经授权的延续是否仍然能够回忆、组合并践行其身份。
summary_cn: 提出运行时无关的持久化 agent 架构，将 agent 拆分为连续性载体 P_t=(身份、记忆、软件体) 与可替换的部署绑定 E_t=(推理器、harness、宿主)，定义六条连续性不变量和一套 quiesce-checkpoint-validate-bind-rehydrate-resume 协议；参考实现 Enoch 在冻结公开提交上通过 833 项核心测试与 92 项独立执行的供应商/库测试，并已在更换推理器版本、交互界面和宿主机器时保持了连续性状态。
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Reference implementation and artifacts: https://github.com/our-ark/enoch
objective_summary: 提出运行时无关的持久智能体架构，将连续性载体 P_t=(I_t,M_t,B_t) 与可替换部署绑定 E_t=(R_t,H_t,D_t) 分离，定义 6 条连续性不变式与 quiesce-checkpoint-validate-bind-rehydrate-resume 协议。参考实现 Enoch 在冻结公共提交上通过 833 个核心测试与另行运行的 92 个 provider/库测试，并演示了 reasoner、交互面、宿主机替换。
evidence_note: 仅内部测试通过与部署演示，无对比基线、无用户或规模化评估。
novelty_note: 为长期存活智能体明确形式化身份/记忆/代码谱系与迁移协议，视角较新。
scope: 限于作者实现 Enoch 的单智能体迁移场景，涉及 reasoner 版本、交互面、宿主机替换。
limitations: 作者自陈证据仅支持机械可替换性与授权连续性，未评估行为不变性或穷尽配对。

title: What Survives the Next Model? Benchmarking LLM-Based Techniques Against Single-Prompts
title_cn: 什么能在下一代模型面前存活？——将基于 LLM 的技术与单一 prompt 做基准对比
abstract: The software engineering research community has enthusiastically embraced the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into complex techniques to solve a wide variety of tasks. However, the extent to which this investment is strategic remains unclear, as the native capabilities of successive frontier model generations can rapidly render existing techniques obsolete. To assess this research investment, we analyze 35 LLM-based technique papers from ICSE 2026. We evaluate whether their complex tools can be outperformed by the simplest possible alternative: a single, automatically generated prompt executed on a newer generation model, without any iterative refinement. We find that for between 37% and 63% papers, a newer model with a single prompt natively outperforms the heavily engineered tooling proposed just a year prior. We identify that constructive techniques like code generation or repair are more amenable to substitution by a single-prompt. We also identify a surviving set of papers relying on strategies that provide additional insights to the model where newer LLMs will amplify the proposed technique. Our findings raise questions about the cost-benefit proposition of techniques designed as workarounds to temporary model deficits and the need to focus on enduring challenges that scale synergistically with future model generations. Our source codes and results are made publicly available at https://github.com/less-lab-uva/What-Survives-the-Next-Model.
abstract_cn: 软件工程研究界已热情地拥抱将大语言模型（LLM）整合进复杂技术以解决各种各样的任务。然而，这项投资在多大程度上是具有战略意义的，仍不清楚，因为连续几代前沿模型的原生能力可能会迅速让现有技术变得过时。为评估这一研究投资，我们分析了 ICSE 2026 上的 35 篇基于 LLM 的技术论文。我们评估这些论文中复杂的工具是否会被最简单的可能替代方案所超越：在更新一代模型上执行一个自动生成的单一 prompt，且不进行任何迭代精炼。我们发现，对于 37% 到 63% 的论文而言，使用单一 prompt 的更新模型原生地超越了仅在一年前提出的、经过大量工程投入的工具。我们发现，像代码生成或代码修复这类"构造型"技术更容易被单一 prompt 所取代。我们还发现存在一部分能够存活下来的论文，它们依赖于向模型提供额外洞见的策略，而更新的 LLM 会放大这些所提出技术的效果。我们的发现对那些被设计用来临时规避模型缺陷的技术的成本效益提出了质疑，并凸显了应当聚焦于那些能够随未来模型的发展而协同扩展的持久性挑战的必要性。我们的源代码与结果已在 https://github.com/less-lab-uva/What-Survives-the-Next-Model 公开。
summary_cn: 分析 ICSE 2026 的 35 篇基于 LLM 的技术论文，发现用更新一代模型执行一个自动生成的单一 prompt（无需迭代精炼），就能在 37%-63% 的论文中超越一年前提出的重度工程化工具，代码生成/修复等"构造型"任务尤其容易被单一 prompt 取代，而能给模型提供额外洞见的策略更能随新模型协同放大、得以存活。
objective_summary: 分析 ICSE 2026 上 35 篇 LLM 相关技术论文，评估其复杂工具能否被新一代模型上的单次自动生成 prompt 直接超过。结果显示 37%–63% 的论文被单 prompt 新模型原生超越，代码生成/修复类更易被替代，另有一类作为对模型的额外信息注入能被新模型放大。
evidence_note: 覆盖 35 篇论文的重评估，有明确对照（新模型单 prompt vs 原工具），但样本会议单一。
novelty_note: 首次系统追问 LLM4SE 技术在下一代模型下的存活率，问题设定较新。
scope: 限于 ICSE 2026 的 35 篇 LLM 技术论文，主要覆盖代码生成/修复等构造性任务。
limitations: 会议与年份单一，未展开对「附加洞见类」论文的定量刻画。

title: Audit-First Rollback Semantics for Safety-Critical Deployment Pipelines
title_cn: 面向安全关键部署流水线的审计优先回滚语义
abstract: Distributed deployment runtimes carry a coherence obligation that classical fault-tolerance frameworks do not name directly: the live state a component is configured to run and the audit chain that records how it got there must agree at every terminal configuration. Prior works mainly focus on individual aspects of the deploy-time fault surface (canary controllers, configuration rollback, signed attestations), leaving the cross-cutting question of audit/live coherence under fail-stop crash only loosely specified. Yet a key systems question remains unresolved: how can a deployment runtime guarantee that the audit chain answers truthfully about live state even when a transition crashes mid-flight? We present audit-first rollback semantics, a fault-tolerance mechanism that guarantees audit/live coherence at every committed terminal under fail-stop crashes during transition phases. The mechanism pairs with provisional state machines, pipelines whose "active but not yet promoted" states carry an explicit rollback contract and a bounded deadline. We instantiate both in a runtime deployment system and run a dependability evaluation against a fail-open variant of the same pipeline across twelve fault-injection points spanning three structural failure classes. Across 1,200 injected-failure trials, audit-first rollback achieves 100% audit/live-state coherence (600/600, Wilson 95% CI [0.994,1.000]) with per-cell p95 recovery latency below 500 ms (SLO PASS in 12/12 cells); the fail-open variant preserves coherence on only 33% of trials (200/600, Wilson 95% CI [0.297,0.372]). We further lift the construction to a cross-bridge coordination protocol with a safety argument for fleets of fail-stop bridges, leaving fleet-scale empirical evaluation to follow-on work.
abstract_cn: 分布式部署运行时承载着一种经典容错框架未曾直接命名的一致性义务：某个组件被配置运行的实时状态，与记录其如何走到该状态的审计链，必须在每一个终态配置处保持一致。已有工作大多只关注部署时故障面的某一个方面（金丝雀控制器、配置回滚、签名证明），使得在 fail-stop 崩溃下审计-实时一致性这一跨切关切问题只得到了松散的规定。然而一个关键的系统问题依然悬而未决：当一次转换在中途崩溃时，部署运行时如何保证审计链对实时状态给出真实的回答？我们提出审计优先回滚语义，一种在转换阶段发生 fail-stop 崩溃时、能在每一个已提交终态处保证审计-实时一致性的容错机制。该机制与临时状态机配对，即那些"处于活动但尚未晋升"状态携带显式回滚契约和有界截止时限的流水线。我们在一个运行时部署系统中同时实例化了这两者，并针对同一流水线的 fail-open 变体，在覆盖三类结构性故障类别、共十二个故障注入点上进行了可靠性评估。在 1200 次注入失败试验中，审计优先回滚实现了 100% 的审计-实时状态一致性（600/600，Wilson 95% 置信区间 [0.994,1.000]），每个单元的 p95 恢复延迟低于 500 毫秒（12/12 个单元满足 SLO 要求）；而 fail-open 变体仅在 33% 的试验中保持了一致性（200/600，Wilson 95% 置信区间 [0.297,0.372]）。我们进一步将该构造提升为一种跨桥协调协议，并为 fail-stop 桥梁组成的机群给出了安全性论证，将机群规模的实证评估留待后续工作。
summary_cn: 提出"审计优先回滚语义"机制，配合具有显式回滚契约与有界截止时限的临时状态机，在 fail-stop 崩溃场景下保证部署运行时的实时状态与审计链在每个已提交终态处保持一致；在跨越三类结构性故障、共十二个故障注入点的 1200 次注入失败试验中，该机制实现 100% 的审计-实时一致性（600/600，Wilson 95% CI [0.994,1.000]），p95 恢复延迟低于 500ms（12/12 单元满足 SLO），而 fail-open 对照方案仅在 33% 的试验中保持一致（200/600，Wilson 95% CI [0.297,0.372]）。
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures. Reference implementation and reproduction harness: https://github.com/s20sc/audit-first-rollback
objective_summary: 提出审计优先回滚语义，保证 fail-stop 崩溃下部署管道每个终止态审计链与实际态一致，并以临时状态机形式化临时活跃态。跨 12 个故障注入点 1200 次试验中审计/实态一致率 100%（600/600，Wilson 95% CI[0.994,1.000]），失败开放变体仅 33%，P95 恢复延迟均低于 500ms。
evidence_note: 1200 次故障注入、12 单元、fail-open 变体对照并给出 Wilson 置信区间与 SLO 判定。
novelty_note: 命名并系统化了跨切审计-实态一致性问题，给出临时状态机与协议式解法。
scope: 限于 fail-stop 崩溃模型下的单桥部署管道，跨桥协调仅给出安全性论证未做实测。
limitations: 作者明确将车队规模实证留待后续；未覆盖拜占庭故障或非 fail-stop 场景。

title: Federated Trust for Embodied Robot Capability Marketplaces
title_cn: 面向具身机器人能力市场的联邦信任机制
abstract: Robot capability marketplaces, the "app store for robot skills," are emerging as the deployment vector for LLM-driven robot fleets. The default cloud-native answer to "is this package safe to install?" is centralised PKI: one certificate authority, one transparency log, one root of trust. We argue this is the wrong model for embodied robot fleets, where operators face heterogeneous regulatory regimes, air-gapped deployments, tiny operator headcounts, and physical-world consequences for trusting the wrong publisher. We present federated trust: each deployed bridge maintains its own local trust directory of acceptable signers; signers identify themselves with a public key embedded in a detached Ed25519 signature envelope; install-time verification is a local set-membership check rather than a network round trip to a certificate authority. The cryptographic primitives are deliberately standard (Ed25519 detached signatures and SSH-style trust files); the contribution is the architectural commitment that this composition fits embodied robot fleets specifically. We implement the model in a runtime governance layer with a five-subcommand CLI, a registry server, a per-bridge install gate, and 80 tests. A multi-deployment evaluation shows the same registry stream producing divergent install verdicts on bridges with different trust directories, the load-bearing design property. Across 5000 adversarial trials, the strict-mode gate rejects 100% of rogue-publisher, tampered, forged, and revoked-signer attacks, and 96.6% of downgrade attempts under a minimum-version pin extension. A same-hardware comparison against Sigstore-Cosign and python-TUF locates federated trust's per-verify cost between the two and its per-publisher storage footprint below both.
abstract_cn: 机器人能力市场——即”机器人技能的应用商店”——正在成为LLM驱动的机器人机群的部署载体。对于”这个软件包安装是否安全?“这一问题,云原生领域默认的答案是中心化PKI:单一证书颁发机构、单一透明日志、单一信任根。我们认为,对于具身机器人机群而言,这是一个错误的模型,因为运营方面临着各不相同的监管制度、气隙式(air-gapped)部署环境、极小的运营团队规模,以及信任错误发布者所带来的物理世界后果。我们提出了联邦信任(federated trust):每个已部署的桥接节点维护自己本地的可接受签名者信任目录;签名者用嵌入在分离式Ed25519签名信封中的公钥来标识自己;安装时的验证只是一次本地的集合成员关系检查,而不是向证书颁发机构发起网络往返请求。所用的密码学原语是刻意选用的标准方案(Ed25519分离签名和SSH风格的信任文件);本文的贡献在于这样一种架构性论断:这套组合特别适合具身机器人机群。我们在一个运行时治理层中实现了该模型,包含一个五子命令的CLI、一个注册服务器、一个按桥接节点划分的安装网关,以及80个测试。一项多部署评估表明,同一份注册流在具有不同信任目录的桥接节点上会产生不同的安装裁决结果,这正是本方案具有支撑作用的设计特性。在5000次对抗性试验中,严格模式的安装网关对伪造发布者、篡改、伪造和已撤销签名者的攻击拦截率达到100%,对最低版本锁定扩展下的降级攻击拦截率达到96.6%。在相同硬件条件下与Sigstore-Cosign和python-TUF进行的比较表明,联邦信任的单次校验开销介于两者之间,而其每发布者存储开销低于这两者。
summary_cn: 针对机器人技能应用商店场景,作者提出用本地信任目录+Ed25519分离签名+本地成员关系校验取代中心化PKI的”联邦信任”架构,实现了含CLI、注册服务器和安装网关的运行时治理层(80个测试),在5000次对抗性试验中对伪造发布者、篡改、伪造和已撤销签名者的攻击拦截率达100%,对降级攻击的拦截率达96.6%,单次校验开销介于Sigstore-Cosign和python-TUF之间,而每发布者存储开销低于两者。
comment: 32 pages, 2 figures. Reference implementation and reproduction data: https://github.com/s20sc/embodied-federated-trust
objective_summary: 为具身机器人技能市场提出联邦信任架构：各桥维护本地信任目录，用 Ed25519 分离签名做本地集合成员校验替代中心化 PKI。实现含 5 子命令 CLI 与 80 个测试，5000 次对抗试验中严格模式对伪造/篡改/吊销 100% 拒绝、降级 96.6%，与 Sigstore-Cosign、python-TUF 对比其单次验证成本居中。
evidence_note: 5000 次对抗试验、2 个已有工具对照、多部署差异化裁决实验，无统计显著性检验。
novelty_note: 密码原语为标准 Ed25519 与 SSH 风格信任文件，创新在于面向具身机器人的架构性组合。
scope: 面向异构监管、气隙部署的具身机器人桥队列，验证在单硬件多部署配置下进行。
limitations: 作者自述创新为架构选择而非新原语，未在真实机器人车队大规模长期部署中评估。

title: Operation-Type-Aware Client Routing for Leader-Based Consensus Datastores
title_cn: 面向基于领导者共识数据存储的操作类型感知客户端路由
abstract: Leader-based consensus datastores (etcd, ZooKeeper) face two competing routing goals: spread load evenly across members, and route operations to the member whose protocol role matches the operation. Writes must commit through the leader, so sending them elsewhere adds a forwarding hop. Linearizable reads need only a lightweight leader confirmation before any member can serve them locally. The upstream etcd client uses gRPC's round_robin balancer, distributing reads and writes uniformly across cluster members. An operation-aware client resolves this by pinning writes to the leader and distributing reads across the healthy read pool. In steady state on a 3-node etcd cluster (80/20 read/write mix, 5 trials), this lowers write P50 by 29% and raises throughput by 9%. When a follower degrades silently, the operation-aware client detects the latency shift and removes it from the read pool, cutting read P99 by 64%, write P99 by 74%, and raising throughput by 89%. The same routing rule applied to ZooKeeper (ZAB protocol, different implementation) points in the same direction, showing that the result follows from leader-based consensus structure rather than one system's implementation. The key obstacle to discovering this policy adaptively is that the leader confirmation round-trip occurs between cluster members, so the client sees only a blended latency signal rather than the decisive coordination cost directly.
abstract_cn: 基于leader的共识数据存储(etcd、ZooKeeper)面临两个相互竞争的路由目标:在成员间均匀分摊负载,以及将操作路由到协议角色与该操作相匹配的成员。写操作必须通过leader提交,因此发送到其他节点会增加一次转发跳数。可线性化读操作只需要一次轻量级的leader确认,之后任何成员都可以在本地提供服务。上游的etcd客户端使用gRPC的round_robin负载均衡器,将读和写均匀分布到集群各成员上。一个操作感知的客户端通过将写操作固定到leader、将读操作分散到健康的读节点池来解决这一问题。在一个3节点etcd集群的稳态下(80/20的读写比例,5次试验),这一做法将写P50延迟降低29%,吞吐提升9%。当某个follower发生静默降级时,操作感知客户端能检测到延迟变化并将其从读节点池中移除,从而将读P99降低64%,写P99降低74%,吞吐提升89%。将同样的路由规则应用于ZooKeeper(ZAB协议,实现方式不同)也得到相同方向的结果,说明该结论源于基于leader的共识结构本身,而非某一个具体系统的实现。自适应地发现这一策略的关键障碍在于,leader确认的往返过程发生在集群成员之间,因此客户端只能看到一个混合的延迟信号,而无法直接观测到起决定作用的协调开销。
summary_cn: 作者提出将写操作固定路由到leader、读操作分散到健康节点池的路由策略,在3节点etcd集群稳态下将写P50延迟降低29%、吞吐提升9%,follower静默降级时读P99降低64%、写P99降低74%、吞吐提升89%,并在ZooKeeper上验证了同样的结论,证明该结果源于基于leader的共识结构本身而非具体实现。
comment: Added new contribution to upstream
objective_summary: 为基于 Leader 共识的 etcd/ZooKeeper 提出按操作类型路由的客户端：写钉在 Leader、读均衡到健康副本。3 节点 etcd 80/20 读写、5 次试验下写 P50 降 29%、吞吐升 9%；跟随节点静默降级时读 P99 降 64%、写 P99 降 74%、吞吐升 89%。
evidence_note: 仅 3 节点小集群、5 次试验，虽跨 etcd/ZooKeeper 两系统但无统计检验。
novelty_note: 在 gRPC round_robin 之上做操作感知路由，属已知思路的实证化，非全新机制。
scope: 结论限于 3 节点 Leader-based 共识集群、80/20 读写混合工作负载。
limitations: 样本量小、缺乏大规模或长尾故障场景，自适应发现该策略仍受限于混合延迟信号。

title: Bounded, Indeterminate, or a Bug: A Condition-Aware Oracle for Differential Testing of SQL Aggregates
title_cn: 有界、不确定,还是Bug:面向SQL聚合函数差分测试的条件感知Oracle
abstract: Differential database testing compares results across engines and calls a discrepancy a bug. For floating-point aggregates this is unsound: engines legitimately disagree because floating-point arithmetic is not associative. Practice patches this with an epsilon; the leading oracles avoid floating point entirely. We give the oracle this practice lacks, and show its decisive quantity is not the query but the engine's algorithm. Ground truth is the exact rational value of the stored doubles -- arithmetic, not another engine -- and each discrepancy is classified exact, bounded, or indeterminate. The relative error of an aggregate f under an algorithm A obeys rel_err <= C_A(n,u) * kappa_f^p, so the testability boundary, beyond which no oracle can separate a bug from rounding, is kappa*_{f,A} = (1/C_A)^{1/p}. SUM and AVG are the linear case p=1; variance is p=2 for the one-pass algorithm and p=1 for Welford. Across eight engines in four classes the measured exponent recovers each algorithm, and ClickHouse is the lone one-pass engine (p=2.05); engine-wide, it returns zero standard deviation, NaN correlation and wrong-sign regression, while every other engine stays exact and the vendor ships the Welford fix. Its variance is untestable at a condition number 10^6 below SUM's, which ordinary storage conventions (epoch-nanosecond timestamps, tight sensors) cross -- there ClickHouse errs by 2100%. A randomised hunt of 360 tests finds zero anomalies, evidence the oracle is sound. Code and data are public.
abstract_cn: 差分数据库测试通过比较不同引擎间的结果,并将出现的差异称为bug。对于浮点数聚合函数而言,这种做法是不可靠的,因为浮点运算不满足结合律,引擎之间存在合理的分歧。业界的做法是用一个epsilon容差来打补丁;而领先的oracle则干脆完全回避浮点数。本文给出了业界目前缺乏的这种oracle,并说明其中起决定作用的量不是查询本身,而是引擎所用的算法。真值是所存储的双精度数的精确有理数值——由算术运算给出,而非由另一个引擎给出——每个差异被分类为exact(精确)、bounded(有界)或indeterminate(不确定)。算法A下聚合函数f的相对误差满足rel_err <= C_A(n,u) * kappa_f^p,由此得到的可测试性边界——超出此边界后任何oracle都无法区分bug与舍入误差——为kappa*_{f,A} = (1/C_A)^{1/p}。SUM和AVG是线性情形p=1;方差在单遍算法下p=2,在Welford算法下p=1。在四类共八个引擎上,测得的指数值都能还原出各自所用的算法,ClickHouse是唯一采用单遍算法的引擎(p=2.05);在引擎层面,它会返回标准差为零、相关系数为NaN、回归系数符号错误的结果,而其他所有引擎都保持精确,并且供应商已发布了Welford修复方案。它的方差在比SUM低6个数量级的条件数下就已不可测试——而普通的存储惯例(纳秒级时间戳、精密传感器数据)就会跨过这一边界——在这种情况下ClickHouse的误差高达2100%。360次随机测试未发现任何异常,这证明了本文提出的oracle是可靠的。代码与数据已公开。
summary_cn: 作者提出以存储双精度数的精确有理数值为真值,将差分数据库测试中的每个差异分类为exact/bounded/indeterminate三类,推导出算法相关的可测试性边界;在8个引擎上验证后发现ClickHouse是唯一的单遍(one-pass)方差算法引擎,在条件数比SUM低6个数量级时即不可测,实际场景中误差可达2100%,而360次随机测试未能发现该问题,证明传统oracle不可靠。
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures. Code + one-command reproduction: https://github.com/samyama-ai/numeric-semantics-oracle
objective_summary: 针对浮点聚合的差分数据库测试提出以精确有理数为基准的条件感知谕示，将差异分类为精确/有界/不定，并给出可测性边界 kappa*_{f,A}=(1/C_A)^{1/p}。跨 4 类 8 引擎验证算法指数，发现 ClickHouse 一遍算法 p=2.05，在 epoch 纳秒时间戳等常见场景下方差误差达 2100%，360 次随机测试 0 误报。
evidence_note: 覆盖 8 引擎 4 类，含 360 次随机测试与厂商修复对照，未做显著性检验但有理论误差界。
novelty_note: 首次以精确有理数值+条件数-算法系数区分舍入与真 bug，并给出可测性边界公式。
scope: 适用于 double 存储下 SUM/AVG/方差/相关/回归等聚合，在 8 个主流关系型引擎上验证。
limitations: 评估未涵盖非浮点或复合聚合，谕示成本随数据规模上升未做大数据量压测。

title: Deterministic LLM Inference Across GPU Kernels: Power-of-Two INT8 Quantization Scales and the Limits of Tolerance-Based Conformance
title_cn: 跨GPU内核的确定性LLM推理:二次幂INT8量化尺度与基于容差一致性检验的局限
abstract: Conformance suites for quantized GEMM kernels ask whether two implementations agree within a tolerance. We measure what such a suite can detect. Injecting nine faults into a reference INT8 pipeline over 8,232 layer--fault--regime cells of Qwen3-1.7B, we find that every one of five epilogue faults -- scale precision, double rounding, multiplication order, output truncation, fused ordering -- moves the output by at most a single bfloat16 spacing, and by exactly one whenever it moves it at all, across 5,880 cells. A tolerance of one spacing is therefore blind to the entire class by construction: four of the five faults are detected by no check in the suite, and the fifth only under power-of-two scales. Faults that violate the accumulator's exactness preconditions, or that break operand sharing, are detected without exception, and a null fault never fires. What a tolerance-based suite of this shape establishes is therefore narrower than interchangeability: that the preconditions hold, that operands are shared, and that differences stay within one spacing. The power-of-two constraint that exposes the one detected fault is also deployable. Requantizing every weight scale to its nearest power of two makes CUTLASS and Triton agree bitwise at every linear layer (196/196 and 252/252, against 8/196 and 10/252 under the checkpoints' own scales) and yields byte-identical generated token sequences at 1.7B, 8B and 14B (8/8 prompts, against 0/8 at all three). Observed perplexity point estimates are +0.32%, -0.28% and +0.48%; the 90% intervals cover zero at the two smaller sizes but not at 14B, reaching +0.71% and +0.76%. A previously reported +157% perplexity for this intervention was an artifact of a probe that rewrote scales without requantizing the weights; separating the effects attributes 99.8% of it to the resulting weight--scale mismatch rather than to the power-of-two constraint itself.
abstract_cn: 量化GEMM内核的一致性测试套件检验的是两种实现是否在某个容差内一致。本文测量这类套件究竟能检测到什么。我们在Qwen3-1.7B的参考INT8流水线中,针对8,232个层-故障-场景单元注入9种故障,发现五种尾段(epilogue)故障——尺度精度、二次舍入、乘法顺序、输出截断、融合排序——中的每一种都使输出最多移动一个bfloat16间距,并且只要发生移动就恰好移动一个间距,在5,880个单元中皆是如此。因此,一个间距的容差在设计上就对整类故障视而不见:五种故障中有四种在该套件的任何检查下都无法被检测到,第五种也只有在二次幂尺度下才能被检测到。违反累加器精确性前提条件的故障,或破坏操作数共享的故障,则无一例外都能被检测到,而空故障(null fault)从不误报。因此,这种形状的基于容差的套件所能确立的结论,要弱于“可互换性”(interchangeability):它只能确立前提条件成立、操作数被共享、且差异保持在一个间距以内。使唯一可检测故障暴露出来的二次幂约束同样也是可部署的。将每个权重尺度重新量化为最接近的二次幂后,CUTLASS与Triton在每个线性层上实现逐位一致(196/196和252/252,相比各自原始尺度下的8/196和10/252),并在1.7B、8B、14B三种规模下生成逐字节相同的token序列(8/8个提示词,相比三种规模原本均为0/8)。观察到的困惑度点估计分别为+0.32%、-0.28%和+0.48%;90%置信区间在两个较小规模下覆盖零,但在14B规模下不覆盖零,达到+0.71%到+0.76%。此前报告的该干预措施导致+157%困惑度的结果,是一个探针在未重新量化权重的情况下改写尺度所产生的伪影;将两种效应分离后,99.8%可归因于由此产生的权重-尺度不匹配,而非二次幂约束本身。
summary_cn: 作者在Qwen3-1.7B上对8,232个层-故障-场景单元注入9种故障,发现基于容差(一个bfloat16间距)的一致性检验对5种尾段(epilogue)故障中的4种完全检测不到;而将所有权重尺度取整为二次幂后,CUTLASS与Triton在196/196和252/252个线性层上实现逐位一致(相比原尺度下仅8/196和10/252),在1.7B/8B/14B三种规模下生成的token序列全部逐字节相同(8/8,相比原来0/8),且此前报告的+157%困惑度异常被证明是探针未重新量化权重导致的伪影,99.8%可归因于权重-尺度不匹配。
comment: 9 pages (IEEEtran two-column), 3 figures, 5 tables. Fault injection against a two-stage-pinned prediction matrix (8,232 scored cells; 63-cell pre-data core, corrected and re-pinned after a disclosed smoke run); power-of-two requantization measured at 1.7B/8B/14B. Companion to arXiv:2608.13756, whose open questions on check sensitivity and deployability this paper answers
objective_summary: 在 Qwen3-1.7B 上对 INT8 GEMM 内核注入 9 类故障共 8232 层-故障-制度单元，发现 5 类 epilogue 故障最多只造成一个 bfloat16 间距偏差，容差型检查对其中 4 类完全不敏感。将权重 scale 量化到最近 2 的幂后 CUTLASS 与 Triton 在 196/196 与 252/252 层比特一致，1.7B/8B/14B 生成 token 序列 8/8 提示字节相同，困惑度点估计 +0.32%、-0.28%、+0.48%。
evidence_note: 8232 单元故障注入 + 三种模型规模比特级对比，量化差异并给 90% 置信区间，规模与对照充分。
novelty_note: 量化证明容差型合规套件的可检测边界，并证明 2 的幂 scale 量化可跨内核实现比特一致，属新发现。
scope: 限于 INT8 量化 GEMM 内核、CUTLASS 与 Triton 实现，模型规模在 1.7B/8B/14B 且核心测量在 Qwen3-1.7B。
limitations: 14B 困惑度 90% 区间不覆盖零（+0.71%、+0.76%），故障类别仅 9 种，实现仅两个内核。

title: Revisiting Feedback-Driven LLM Code Repair: A Replication and Exploratory Java Extension
title_cn: 重访反馈驱动的 LLM 代码修复：一项复现研究与 Java 探索性扩展
abstract: Since the advent of Large Language Models (LLMs), practitioners have increasingly leveraged them to support their software engineering tasks, including automated code repair, showing promising results. Yet, concerns regarding reproducibility and generalizability remain largely unexplored. To further evaluate these concerns and associated impacts, we partially reproduce and conduct an exploratory Java extension of the FeedbackEval benchmark [1], which evaluates how LLMs leverage different feedback types for Python code repair. First, we partially replicate the original study on 394 repair tasks using GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet, reproducing and observing the main qualitative trends reported in the original work. Second, we conduct an exploratory Java extension by constructing 100 erroneous repair instances from 50 Java tasks and evaluating feedback effectiveness. Our results show that previous conclusions from Python may be sensitive to benchmark construction, feedback representation, and tooling ecosystem, motivating more controlled multilingual benchmarks. Specifically, while test feedback remains the strongest feedback type in our Python replication, the same ranking is not observed in our Java extension, as simple and JUnit-based test feedback do not differ significantly. We hypothesize that differences in feedback informativeness and tooling ecosystems, such as the verbosity of test frameworks, may partly explain such a difference. Finally, lighter prompts reduce cost without significant differences in repair effectiveness. Overall, our findings confirm key trends under a partially controlled replication and highlight the need for more rigorous multilingual evaluation and careful feedback design in LLMbased repair systems.
abstract_cn: 自大语言模型（LLM）出现以来，从业者已越来越多地利用它们来支持自己的软件工程任务，包括自动化代码修复，并展现出了颇具希望的结果。然而，关于可复现性和可泛化性的顾虑在很大程度上仍未被探索。为进一步评估这些顾虑及其相关影响，我们对 FeedbackEval 基准 [1]（该基准评估 LLM 如何利用不同类型的反馈进行 Python 代码修复）进行了部分复现，并开展了一项探索性的 Java 扩展研究。首先，我们使用 GPT-4o 和 Claude 3.5 Sonnet，在 394 个修复任务上部分复现了原始研究，复现并观察到了原始工作中报告的主要定性趋势。其次，我们通过从 50 个 Java 任务构造出 100 个错误修复实例，开展了一项探索性的 Java 扩展研究，并评估了反馈的有效性。我们的结果表明，先前基于 Python 得出的结论可能对基准构造、反馈表示方式和工具生态系统敏感，这促使我们呼吁开展更为受控的多语言基准研究。具体而言，虽然在我们的 Python 复现中测试反馈仍然是最强的反馈类型，但在我们的 Java 扩展中并未观察到相同的排序，简单测试反馈与基于 JUnit 的测试反馈之间没有显著差异。我们推测，反馈信息量以及工具生态系统方面的差异（例如测试框架的冗长程度）可能部分解释了这种差异。最后，更简洁的 prompt 能够在不显著影响修复效果的情况下降低成本。总体而言，我们的发现在部分受控的复现下确认了关键趋势，并凸显了在基于 LLM 的修复系统中开展更严谨的多语言评估和精心设计反馈的必要性。
summary_cn: 部分复现 FeedbackEval 基准（GPT-4o 与 Claude 3.5 Sonnet，394 个修复任务）并新增 Java 探索性扩展（50 个 Java 任务构造出 100 个错误修复实例）：Python 复现验证了测试反馈最有效的原结论，但该排序在 Java 扩展中未再成立（简单测试反馈与 JUnit 测试反馈差异不显著），说明先前结论可能对基准构造、反馈表示和工具链敏感，且更简洁的 prompt 能在不显著影响修复效果的情况下降低成本。
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables
objective_summary: 部分复现 FeedbackEval 基准：用 GPT-4o 与 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 在 394 个修复任务上再现原研究主要定性趋势；再构造 50 个 Java 任务共 100 个错误实例做扩展，发现测试反馈在 Python 中最强的排序在 Java 中不成立，简单反馈与 JUnit 反馈差异不显著。
evidence_note: Python 394 任务复现 + Java 100 实例扩展，涉及 2 个 LLM，规模中等但摘要未详列统计检验。
novelty_note: 通过跨语言复现挑战原结论的普适性，指出反馈类型排序对语言与工具链敏感，属实质性复现贡献。
scope: 限于 GPT-4o 与 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 在 FeedbackEval 的 Python 394 任务与 50 个 Java 任务上的代码修复。
limitations: Java 扩展仅 100 个实例、模型仅两款，反馈类型与工具链差异的因果解释仍为假设。

title: Exploring Quantum Software Testing Across Research and Practice: Emerging Results from a Multivocal Literature Review
title_cn: 跨研究与实践探索量子软件测试：来自一项多声源文献综述的新兴结果
abstract: This paper presents preliminary findings from a multivocal literature review investigating how quantum software testing is characterized across academic and practitioner-oriented sources. Our study integrated peer-reviewed studies with gray literature, including blogs, tutorials, forums, technical reports, documentation pages, and company webpages. Our results indicate a rapidly evolving but fragmented ecosystem involving classical adapted testing approaches, quantum-specific techniques, statistical validation methods, simulators, debugging environments, and verification frameworks. The reviewed material also revealed recurring challenges related to scalability limitations, hardware noise, probabilistic execution, limited observability, and immature tooling ecosystems. These findings provide an initial characterization of how research and practice currently discuss quantum software testing challenges, techniques, and tooling.
abstract_cn: 本文呈现了一项多声源文献综述的初步发现，该综述考察量子软件测试在学术界与实践者导向的资料中是如何被刻画的。我们的研究将经过同行评审的研究与灰色文献（包括博客、教程、论坛、技术报告、文档页面和公司网页）整合在一起。我们的结果表明，这是一个快速演化但碎片化的生态系统，涉及经典方法的适配性测试方法、量子特有的技术、统计验证方法、模拟器、调试环境和验证框架。所审阅的材料还揭示出与可扩展性限制、硬件噪声、概率化执行、有限的可观测性以及不成熟的工具生态系统相关的反复出现的挑战。这些发现为研究与实践当前如何讨论量子软件测试的挑战、技术和工具提供了一个初步的刻画。
summary_cn: 一项多声源文献综述（整合同行评审论文与博客、教程、论坛、技术报告等灰色文献）的初步发现，刻画了量子软件测试领域一个快速演化但碎片化的生态，并总结出可扩展性受限、硬件噪声、概率化执行、可观测性有限和工具链不成熟等反复出现的挑战。
objective_summary: 开展多声道文献综述，整合同行评审论文与博客、教程、论坛、文档、公司网页等灰色文献，初步刻画量子软件测试的方法、工具与挑战，识别出可扩展性、硬件噪声、概率执行、可观测性有限等重复出现的挑战。
evidence_note: 多声道文献综述但为初步结果，摘要未给纳入文献数量、检索协议或编码一致性等关键规模指标。
novelty_note: 对量子软件测试做多声道综述属于既有综述方向的扩展，主要贡献是整合灰色文献视角。
scope: 限于量子软件测试主题下学术与实践者文献的初步特征化。
limitations: 结果被作者定位为「初步」，缺乏文献筛选规模与方法学细节的定量报告。

title: Spec-Driven Development for Agentic Software Engineering: Harnessing Human-Agent Teamwork
title_cn: 面向 Agentic 软件工程的规范驱动开发：驾驭人机协作
abstract: Context: Software engineering is moving from AI-assisted practices like vibe coding, in which assistants accelerate individual developers, towards Agentic Software Engineering (ASE), in which autonomous agents are delegated goal-level tasks. However, industry reports a productivity paradox: as individual productivity increases, team throughput, review capacity, and stability degrade because team-scale software engineering discipline is neglected. Objective: This paper aims to establish the conceptual and methodological foundations of Spec-Driven Development (SDD) as an enabling discipline for ASE at team scale and characterize the harness, i.e., the technical and methodological mechanisms through which teams govern agent behavior. Method: We conducted a conceptual analysis drawing predominantly on gray literature, including ASE vision and roadmap papers, practitioner reports, talks, and tooling, because peer-reviewed evidence and a shared academic-industrial vocabulary are not yet established. Results: Using a comparative characterization of the paradigm progression as conceptual framing, the article presents (i) a socio-technical model of SDD in which specifications act as the contract substrate between humans and agents; (ii) an operational characterization of the harness, distinguishing the technical harness around the agent from the methodological harness around the team, with worked examples; and (iii) a typology of five human--agent interaction patterns through which the human role is redefined. Conclusion: We conclude that SDD reconstitutes, in specification-centric form, the contracts that vibe coding dissolves: accountability, verifiability, and transferability. Given the immaturity of the evidence base, this work is presented as a first step toward academic-industrial consensus rather than a validated theory, and outlines a research agenda for future empirical validation.
abstract_cn: 背景：软件工程正从诸如 vibe coding 这类 AI 辅助实践（助手加速单个开发者的工作）转向 Agentic Software Engineering（ASE），在其中自主 agent 被委派以目标层面的任务。然而，业界报告了一种生产力悖论：随着个人生产力的提升，团队吞吐量、评审能力和稳定性却在下降，因为团队规模的软件工程纪律被忽视了。目标：本文旨在为规范驱动开发（Spec-Driven Development，SDD）建立概念与方法论基础，将其作为在团队规模上支撑 ASE 的一门学科，并刻画 harness，即团队用以治理 agent 行为的技术性与方法论机制。方法：由于经过同行评审的证据以及学术界与工业界共享的词汇尚未确立，我们主要基于灰色文献开展了一项概念分析，包括 ASE 的愿景与路线图论文、从业者报告、演讲及工具文档。结果：以对范式演进的比较刻画作为概念性框架，本文提出：(i) SDD 的社会技术模型，其中规范充当人类与 agent 之间的契约基底；(ii) 对 harness 的操作性刻画，区分了围绕 agent 的技术性 harness 与围绕团队的方法论性 harness，并附有实例说明；(iii) 人-agent 交互模式的五种类型学，通过这些模式人类的角色被重新定义。结论：我们得出结论，SDD 以规范为中心的形式重建了 vibe coding 所瓦解的那些契约：问责、可验证性和可转移性。鉴于证据基础尚不成熟，本文被呈现为迈向学术界与工业界共识的第一步，而非一个已被验证的理论，并为未来的实证验证勾勒出一份研究议程。
